/-! # Pasting on independent local spaces

The two local spaces are realized in a common product space by adjoining fixed
basis vectors. Tensor placement supplies the corresponding
measurements, with projectivity and postprocessing preserved.

## References

Paper `lem:pasting`,
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`, and its use in
`lem:qld-xz-lines`, `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:882-963`.
The common-space realization is a formalization-only auxiliary; see issue
Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-QPBT-bak#495.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum
open DistanceCalculus

/-- The effects obtained by sandwiching one measurement with a projective
measurement form a POVM. This is `lem:pasting-measurement`, the measurement
assertion for `eq:pasting-2a`; blueprint `lem:pasting-measurement`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:514-524`. -/
theorem pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement {Γ₁ Γ₂ ι : Type*}
    [Fintype Γ₁] [Fintype Γ₂] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (G₁ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement Γ₁ ι) (G₂ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement Γ₂ ι)
    (hG₂ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective G₂) :
    (∀ g : Γ₁ × Γ₂,
      0 ≤ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pastedMeasurement G₁.effect G₂.effect g.1 g.2) ∧
      (∑ g : Γ₁ × Γ₂,
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pastedMeasurement G₁.effect G₂.effect g.1 g.2) = 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro g
    unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pastedMeasurement
    apply Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
    have hpos : ((G₂.effect g.2)ᴴ * G₁.effect g.1 * G₂.effect g.2).PosSemidef :=
      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (G₁.pos g.1)).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
        (G₂.effect g.2)
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.measurement_effect_hermitian G₂ g.2] at hpos
    exact hpos
  · classical
    unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pastedMeasurement
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
    calc
      (∑ g₂ : Γ₂, ∑ g₁ : Γ₁,
          G₂.effect g₂ * G₁.effect g₁ * G₂.effect g₂) =
          ∑ g₂ : Γ₂,
            G₂.effect g₂ * (∑ g₁ : Γ₁, G₁.effect g₁) * G₂.effect g₂ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro g₂ _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = ∑ g₂ : Γ₂, G₂.effect g₂ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro g₂ _
        rw [G₁.sum_eq_one, mul_one, (hG₂ g₂).isIdempotentElem.eq]
      _ = 1 := G₂.sum_eq_one

namespace Pasting

variable {ιA ιB : Type*}
  [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]

/-- Adjoin a fixed basis vector to each local register. Alice's original
coordinate is first and Bob's original coordinate is last. This is the
common-carrier realization used for the heterogeneous pasting estimate;
blueprint `def:pasting-product-state`. -/
noncomputable def productPaddedState (a₀ : ιA) (b₀ : ιB)
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ ((ιA × ιB) × (ιA × ιB)) :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 (fun p => if p.1.2 = b₀ then
    if p.2.1 = a₀ then ψ (p.1.1, p.2.2) else 0 else 0)







end Pasting







/-- The fixed heterogeneous pasting error used by the current QPBT proof. -/
noncomputable def heterogeneousPastingError (η δ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  115 * (η ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) + δ ^ (1 / 8 : ℝ))





end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-! # State-dependent Schmidt mirrors

This module constructs the opposite-register mirror used in the one-sided
pasting argument. The auxiliary construction uses the spectral theorem and
orthonormal completion, including zero Schmidt coefficients.

## References

`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`, `lem:pasting`;
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_pasting-product-error.tex`, issue Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-QPBT-bak#201. The
Schmidt-mirror
argument is a formalization auxiliary, not an additional paper hypothesis.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective



/-- A square matrix admits Schmidt coordinates, including its zero singular
values. This specializes the existing positive-Gram orthonormal completion
to equal row and column index types; no invertibility is assumed. -/
theorem exists_schmidt_coordinates {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (coeff : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    ∃ (left right : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (values : ι → ℝ),
      (∀ index, 0 ≤ values index) ∧
      coeff = (left : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) * Matrix.diagonal (fun index => (values index : ℂ)) *
        (right : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)ᴴ := by
  classical
  let gram := coeffᴴ * coeff
  let hermitian := Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self coeff
  obtain ⟨rows, hrows⟩ :=
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.exists_unitaryGroup_with_positive_gram_spectrum_rows
      coeff gram hermitian rfl (Function.Embedding.subtype _)
  have htranspose : (rows : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)ᵀ * ((rows : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)ᵀ)ᴴ = 1 := by
    rw [show ((rows : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)ᵀ)ᴴ = ((rows : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)ᴴ)ᵀ from rfl,
      ← Matrix.transpose_mul,
      show (rows : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)ᴴ * (rows : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) = 1 from Unitary.coe_star_mul_self rows,
      Matrix.transpose_one]
  let left : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ :=
    ⟨(rows : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)ᵀ, Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff.mpr htranspose⟩
  let right := hermitian.eigenvectorUnitary
  let values := fun index => Real.sqrt (hermitian.eigenvalues index)
  have hcolumns : coeff * (right : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) =
      (left : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) * Matrix.diagonal (fun index => (values index : ℂ)) := by
    ext row col
    rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    have himage : (coeff * (right : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)) row col =
        (Matrix.toEuclideanLin coeff (hermitian.eigenvectorBasis col)) row := by
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, right, Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary_apply,
        Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    rw [himage]
    by_cases hpositive : 0 < hermitian.eigenvalues col
    · have hrow := hrows ⟨col, hpositive⟩ row
      have hvalue : (values col : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hpositive).ne'
      change (rows : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) col row =
        ((1 / values col : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (Matrix.toEuclideanLin coeff (hermitian.eigenvectorBasis col)) row at hrow
      change _ = (rows : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) col row * (values col : ℂ)
      rw [hrow]
      push_cast
      field_simp
    · have hzero :=
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.matrix_image_eq_zero_of_nonpositive_gram_eigenvalue
          coeff gram hermitian (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self coeff) rfl col hpositive
      have hvalue : values col = 0 := Real.sqrt_eq_zero_of_nonpos (le_of_not_gt hpositive)
      rw [hzero, hvalue]
      simp
  refine ⟨left, right, values, fun index => Real.sqrt_nonneg _, ?_⟩
  calc
    coeff = coeff * (right : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) * (right : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)ᴴ := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc,
        show (right : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) * (right : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)ᴴ = 1 from Unitary.coe_mul_star_self right,
        Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = _ := by rw [hcolumns]







variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

/-- The coefficient matrix of a bipartite vector in the fixed computational
bases. This is a representation adapter, not a change of state. -/
def schmidtCoefficientMatrix (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × ι)) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι :=
  Matrix.of fun row col => ψ (row, col)

/-- Schmidt coordinates chosen from the proved square-matrix decomposition.
The choice is made once for the state and is independent of all measurements. -/
noncomputable def schmidtCoordinates (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × ι)) :
    Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ × Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ × (ι → ℝ) :=
  let existence := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_schmidt_coordinates (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.schmidtCoefficientMatrix ψ)
  ⟨Classical.choose existence, Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec existence),
    Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec existence))⟩



/-- The unitary identifying the transposed Bob coordinates with the Alice
Schmidt coordinates. Zero Schmidt directions use the orthonormal completion. -/
noncomputable def schmidtMirrorUnitary (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × ι)) :
    Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.schmidtCoordinates ψ).1 * star (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.schmidtCoordinates ψ).2.1

/-- The state-dependent opposite-register mirror, a linear map on Bob
operators. It reverses multiplication because it includes a transpose. -/
noncomputable def schmidtMirror (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × ι)) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι →ₗ[ℂ] _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι where
  toFun bob := (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.schmidtMirrorUnitary ψ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) * bobᵀ * (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.schmidtMirrorUnitary ψ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)ᴴ
  map_add' first second := by simp [Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
  map_smul' scalar bob := by
    simp [Matrix.transpose_smul]



/-- Mirrors preserve the identity and therefore completeness of a measurement. -/
theorem schmidtMirror_one (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × ι)) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.schmidtMirror ψ 1 = 1 := by
  change (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.schmidtMirrorUnitary ψ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) * (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)ᵀ *
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.schmidtMirrorUnitary ψ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)ᴴ = 1
  rw [Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.mul_one]
  exact Unitary.coe_mul_star_self _





/-- The transpose and unitary conjugation preserve positivity of effects. -/
theorem schmidtMirror_posSemidef (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × ι)) (bob : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)
    (hbob : bob.PosSemidef) : (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.schmidtMirror ψ bob).PosSemidef := by
  have hpositive := hbob.transpose.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.schmidtMirrorUnitary ψ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)ᴴ
  simpa only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.schmidtMirror, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hpositive



/-- Applying the fixed Schmidt mirror to every effect produces an actual
measurement; no normalization or completion of its effects is required. -/
noncomputable def schmidtMirrorMeasurement {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × ι)) (measurement : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ι) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ι :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne (fun answer => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.schmidtMirror ψ (measurement.effect answer))
    (fun answer => Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.schmidtMirror_posSemidef ψ _ (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (measurement.pos answer))))
    (by rw [← map_sum, measurement.sum_eq_one, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.schmidtMirror_one])





end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Compact Palomar statement definitions

This Mathlib-only module is the single elaboration unit for the compact game,
strategy, consistency, and extraction definitions used by the four Palomar
headline aliases.  Keeping the complete statement surface in one module makes
the generated standalone challenge reproduce Lean-generated declaration names.

## References

`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1052-1208`;
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:10-270`;
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-1491`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder Matrix

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar

/-- A finite two-player one-round game with a Mathlib probability mass function. -/
structure Game (X Y A B : Type) [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B] where
  μ : PMF (X × Y)
  decide : X → Y → A → B → Bool

/-- A finite POVM, represented by positive semidefinite effects summing to the identity. -/
structure POVM (A I : Type*) [Fintype A] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] where
  effect : A → Matrix I I ℂ
  pos : ∀ a, (effect a).PosSemidef
  sum_eq_one : ∑ a, effect a = 1

/-- A finite-dimensional pure unit-state tensor-product strategy. -/
structure Strategy (X Y A B : Type) [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    where
  ιA : Type
  ιB : Type
  [ιAFintype : Fintype ιA]
  [ιBFintype : Fintype ιB]
  [ιADecidableEq : DecidableEq ιA]
  [ιBDecidableEq : DecidableEq ιB]
  ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)
  ψ_norm : ‖ψ‖ = 1
  alice : X → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM A ιA
  bob : Y → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM B ιB

attribute [instance] _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy.ιAFintype _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy.ιBFintype
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy.ιADecidableEq _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy.ιBDecidableEq

/-- Reindex a finite Euclidean state along an equivalence of coordinates. -/
noncomputable def reindexState {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] (e : I ≃ J)
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ I) : EuclideanSpace ℂ J :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv J ℂ).symm (fun j => (EuclideanSpace.equiv I ℂ ψ) (e.symm j))

/-- A symmetric finite game. -/
structure SymmetricGame (X A : Type) [Fintype X] [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq A] extends _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game X X A A where
  μ_symm : ∀ x y, μ (x, y) = μ (y, x)
  decide_symm : ∀ x y a b, decide x y a b = decide y x b a

/-- A swap-invariant strategy using one local space and one measurement family. -/
structure SymmetricStrategy (X A : Type) [Fintype X] [Fintype A] where
  ι : Type
  [ιFintype : Fintype ι]
  [ιDecidableEq : DecidableEq ι]
  ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × ι)
  ψ_norm : ‖ψ‖ = 1
  ψ_swap : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.reindexState (Equiv.prodComm ι ι) ψ = ψ
  meas : X → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM A ι

attribute [instance] _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricStrategy.ιFintype _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricStrategy.ιDecidableEq

/-- Regard a symmetric strategy as a general tensor-product strategy. -/
def SymmetricStrategy.toStrategy {X A : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype A]
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricStrategy X A) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy X X A A where
  ιA := S.ι
  ιB := S.ι
  ψ := S.ψ
  ψ_norm := S.ψ_norm
  alice := S.meas
  bob := S.meas

/-- The Born weight of a fixed question and answer tuple. -/
noncomputable def Strategy.outcomeWeight {X Y A B : Type}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
  (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy X Y A B) (x : X) (y : Y) (a : A) (b : B) : ℝ :=
  (inner ℂ S.ψ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin
    (Matrix.kronecker ((S.alice x).effect a) ((S.bob y).effect b)) S.ψ)).re

/-- The tensor-product Born value of a strategy in a finite game. -/
noncomputable def Strategy.value {X Y A B : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B] (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy X Y A B) (G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game X Y A B) : ℝ :=
  ∑ xy, (G.μ xy).toReal * ∑ a, ∑ b,
    if G.decide xy.1 xy.2 a b then S.outcomeWeight xy.1 xy.2 a b else 0

/-- Every effect of a projective POVM is a self-adjoint idempotent. -/
def POVM.IsProjective {A I : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (M : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM A I) : Prop :=
  ∀ a, IsStarProjection (M.effect a)

/-- Projectivity of both measurement families of a strategy. -/
def Strategy.IsProjective {X Y A B : Type}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy X Y A B) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, (S.alice x).IsProjective) ∧ ∀ y, (S.bob y).IsProjective

/-- State-dependent consistency of one POVM with itself across the two tensor factors. -/
def POVM.IsConsistentOn {A I : Type*} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (M : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM A I) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × I)) : Prop :=
  ∀ a, (Matrix.kronecker (M.effect a) 1).mulVec ψ =
    (Matrix.kronecker 1 (M.effect a)).mulVec ψ

/-- Consistency of every measurement in a symmetric strategy. -/
def SymmetricStrategy.IsConsistent {X A : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricStrategy X A) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, (S.meas x).IsConsistentOn S.ψ

/-- Commutation on question pairs of strictly positive probability. -/
def IsCommutingOn {X Y A B I : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (μ : PMF (X × Y)) (alice : X → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM A I) (bob : Y → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM B I) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y, 0 < μ (x, y) → ∀ a b, Commute ((alice x).effect a) ((bob y).effect b)

/-- Symmetric, projective, consistent, and support-wise commuting strategy. -/
def SymmetricStrategy.IsSPCC {X A : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq A] (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricStrategy X A)
    (G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricGame X A) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, (S.meas x).IsProjective) ∧ S.IsConsistent ∧ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.IsCommutingOn G.μ S.meas S.meas


/-- The numerical domain of the classical low individual degree game. -/
structure LowDegreeParams where
  q : ℕ
  m : ℕ
  d : ℕ
  k : ℕ
  hm : 1 ≤ m
  hd : 1 ≤ d
  hk : 1 ≤ k
  hq : ∃ r : ℕ, Odd r ∧ q = 2 ^ r
  hdvd : m ∣ q

/-- The positive dimension supplies the nonzero modulus used by `chiIndex`. -/
instance LowDegreeParams.instNeZeroM (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams) : NeZero P.m :=
  ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one P.hm)⟩

/-- The three question types of the classical low individual degree game. -/
inductive LowDegreeType where
  | point
  | aline
  | dline
  deriving DecidableEq, Inhabited

instance instFintypeLowDegreeType : Fintype _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeType :=
  ⟨{.point, .aline, .dline}, by intro x; cases x <;> simp⟩

/-- The full point, seed, and direction space sampled by the verifier. -/
abbrev LowDegreeSpace (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams) (K : Type) :=
  ((Fin P.m → K) × K) × (Fin P.m → K)

/-- A typed low-degree question, retaining every ambient coordinate. -/
abbrev LowDegreeQuestion (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams) (K : Type) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeSpace P K

/-- The full three-summand answer alphabet, including malformed answers. -/
abbrev LowDegreeAnswer (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams) (K : Type) :=
  (Fin P.k → K) ⊕
    ((Fin P.k → Fin (P.d + 1) → K) ⊕
      (Fin P.k → Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → K))

/-- Simultaneous bounded polynomial representatives used by low-degree soundness. -/
noncomputable abbrev LowDegreePolynomialTuple (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams) (K : Type)
    [CommSemiring K] :=
  Fin P.k → ↥(MvPolynomial.restrictDegree (Fin P.m) K P.d)

/-- Restricted-degree polynomials over a finite semiring form a finite type. -/
noncomputable instance restrictedDegreeFintype (m d : ℕ) (K : Type)
    [CommSemiring K] [Fintype K] :
    Fintype ↥(MvPolynomial.restrictDegree (Fin m) K d) := by
  letI : Finite ↥(MvPolynomial.restrictDegree (Fin m) K d) :=
    Module.finite_of_finite K
  exact Fintype.ofFinite _

/-- The least coordinate at which a nonzero direction is nonzero. -/
noncomputable def lowDegreePivot {K : Type} [Zero K] [DecidableEq K] {m : ℕ}
    (v : Fin m → K) (hv : v ≠ 0) : Fin m := by
  let support := Finset.univ.filter fun j => v j ≠ 0
  have hsupport : support.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    apply hv
    funext j
    by_contra hj
    apply h
    refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
    simp only [support, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    simpa using hj
  exact support.min' hsupport

/-- The elementary least-pivot representative, with identity at zero direction. -/
noncomputable def lowDegreeLineRep {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K] {m : ℕ}
    (u v : Fin m → K) : Fin m → K :=
  if hv : v = 0 then u
  else
    let j := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreePivot v hv
    u - (u j / v j) • v

/-- The paper's balanced seed-to-coordinate map. -/
noncomputable def lowDegreeChiIndex {K : Type} (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams)
    (encoding : K ≃ Fin P.q) (s : K) : Fin P.m :=
  Fin.ofNat P.m ((encoding s).val / (P.q / P.m))

/-- Zero the direction coordinates preceding `i`. -/
def lowDegreePrefix {K : Type} [Zero K] {m : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (v : Fin m → K) :
    Fin m → K :=
  fun j => if j.val < i.val then 0 else v j

/-- The concrete question map for each of the three question types. -/
noncomputable def lowDegreeMap {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]
    (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams) (encoding : K ≃ Fin P.q) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeType → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeSpace P K → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeSpace P K
  | .point, z => ((z.1.1, 0), 0)
  | .aline, z =>
      let direction := Pi.single (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeChiIndex P encoding z.1.2) 1
      ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeLineRep z.1.1 direction, z.1.2), 0)
  | .dline, z =>
      let direction := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreePrefix (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeChiIndex P encoding z.1.2) z.2
      ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeLineRep z.1.1 direction, z.1.2), direction)

/-- The uniform law on all nine ordered type pairs and the entire ambient space. -/
noncomputable def lowDegreeQuestionPMF {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    [DecidableEq K] (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams) (encoding : K ≃ Fin P.q) :
    PMF (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeQuestion P K × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeQuestion P K) :=
  (PMF.uniformOfFintype ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeType) × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeSpace P K)).map
    fun z => ((z.1.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeMap P encoding z.1.1 z.2),
      (z.1.2, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeMap P encoding z.1.2 z.2))

/-- Evaluate a bounded coefficient list at a field element. -/
def lowDegreeEval {K : Type} [Semiring K] {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → K) (t : K) : K :=
  ∑ i : Fin n, c i * t ^ i.val

/-- Whether an answer lies in the summand prescribed by its question type. -/
def validLowDegreeAnswer {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams} {K : Type} :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeType → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeAnswer P K → Bool
  | .point, .inl _ => true
  | .aline, .inr (.inl _) => true
  | .dline, .inr (.inr _) => true
  | _, _ => false

/-- The complete low-degree verifier, including universal zero-direction tests. -/
noncomputable def lowDegreeWin {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams) (encoding : K ≃ Fin P.q) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeQuestion P K → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeQuestion P K →
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeAnswer P K → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeAnswer P K → Bool :=
  open Classical in
  fun (tA, xA) (tB, xB) a b =>
    if _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.validLowDegreeAnswer tA a && _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.validLowDegreeAnswer tB b then
      match tA, tB, a, b with
      | .point, .point, .inl u, .inl v => decide (u = v)
      | .aline, .point, .inr (.inl f), .inl u => decide (∀ t,
          xB.1.1 = xA.1.1 + t • Pi.single (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeChiIndex P encoding xA.1.2) 1 →
            ∀ j, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeEval (f j) t = u j)
      | .point, .aline, .inl u, .inr (.inl f) => decide (∀ t,
          xA.1.1 = xB.1.1 + t • Pi.single (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeChiIndex P encoding xB.1.2) 1 →
            ∀ j, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeEval (f j) t = u j)
      | .dline, .point, .inr (.inr f), .inl u => decide (∀ t,
          xB.1.1 = xA.1.1 + t • xA.2 → ∀ j, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeEval (f j) t = u j)
      | .point, .dline, .inl u, .inr (.inr f) => decide (∀ t,
          xA.1.1 = xB.1.1 + t • xB.2 → ∀ j, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeEval (f j) t = u j)
      | .aline, .aline, .inr (.inl f), .inr (.inl g) => decide (f = g)
      | .dline, .dline, .inr (.inr f), .inr (.inr g) => decide (f = g)
      | _, _, _, _ => true
    else false

/-- The compact classical low individual degree game. -/
noncomputable def lowDegreeGame {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams) (encoding : K ≃ Fin P.q) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeQuestion P K) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeQuestion P K)
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeAnswer P K) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeAnswer P K) where
  μ := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeQuestionPMF P encoding
  decide := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeWin P encoding


/-- Auxiliary finite spaces, local extraction isometries, and a unit auxiliary state. -/
structure ExtractionWitness {X Y A B R : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy X Y A B) where
  ιA' : Type
  ιB' : Type
  [ιAFintype : Fintype ιA']
  [ιBFintype : Fintype ιB']
  [ιADecidableEq : DecidableEq ιA']
  [ιBDecidableEq : DecidableEq ιB']
  φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ S.ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA' × R)
  φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ S.ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιB' × R)
  aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA' × ιB')
  aux_norm : ‖aux‖ = 1

attribute [instance] _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.ExtractionWitness.ιAFintype _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.ExtractionWitness.ιBFintype
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.ExtractionWitness.ιADecidableEq _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.ExtractionWitness.ιBDecidableEq

/-- The normalized maximally entangled vector on a nonempty finite register. -/
noncomputable def normalizedEPRState (R : Type) [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    [Nonempty R] : EuclideanSpace ℂ (R × R) :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (R × R) ℂ).symm fun p =>
    if p.1 = p.2 then (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card R : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0

/-- Apply two local linear isometries to a bipartite Euclidean state. -/
noncomputable def localIsometryTensor {ιA ιB κA κB : Type}
    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB) :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (κA × κB) ℂ).symm fun p =>
    ∑ i : ιA, ∑ j : ιB,
      (φA ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ιA ℂ).symm (Pi.single i 1))) p.1 *
        (φB ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ιB ℂ).symm (Pi.single j 1))) p.2 * ψ (i, j)

/-- The auxiliary state tensored with the EPR vector, shuffled into player-local order. -/
noncomputable def idealExtractionState {X Y A B R : Type}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R] [Nonempty R] {S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy X Y A B}
    (w : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.ExtractionWitness (R := R) S) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ ((w.ιA' × R) × (w.ιB' × R)) :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv ((w.ιA' × R) × (w.ιB' × R)) ℂ).symm fun p =>
    w.aux (p.1.1, p.2.1) * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.normalizedEPRState R (p.1.2, p.2.2)

/-- The unsquared norm error between the extracted state and the ideal state. -/
noncomputable def stateError {X Y A B R : Type}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R] [Nonempty R] {S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy X Y A B}
    (w : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.ExtractionWitness (R := R) S) : ℝ :=
  ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.localIsometryTensor w.φA w.φB S.ψ - _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.idealExtractionState w‖

/-- Alice's unaveraged sum of squared operator errors on the ideal state. -/
noncomputable def aliceOperatorError {X Y A B R O : Type}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype O]
    [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R] [Nonempty R] {S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy X Y A B}
    (w : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.ExtractionWitness (R := R) S)
    (actual ideal : O → Matrix ((w.ιA' × R) × (w.ιB' × R))
      ((w.ιA' × R) × (w.ιB' × R)) ℂ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ o : O, ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin (actual o - ideal o) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.idealExtractionState w)‖ ^ 2

/-- Bob's unaveraged sum of squared operator errors on the ideal state. -/
noncomputable def bobOperatorError {X Y A B R O : Type}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype O]
    [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R] [Nonempty R] {S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy X Y A B}
    (w : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.ExtractionWitness (R := R) S)
    (actual ideal : O → Matrix ((w.ιA' × R) × (w.ιB' × R))
      ((w.ιA' × R) × (w.ιB' × R)) ℂ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ o : O, ‖Matrix.toEuclideanLin (actual o - ideal o) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.idealExtractionState w)‖ ^ 2


noncomputable section

/-- A compact strategy for the low-degree question and answer carriers. -/
abbrev LowDegreeStrategy (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams) (K : Type) [Fintype K] :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeQuestion P K) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeQuestion P K)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeAnswer P K) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeAnswer P K)

/-- A compact POVM indexed by simultaneous bounded polynomial representatives. -/
abbrev LowDegreePolynomialPOVM (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams) (K I : Type)
    [CommSemiring K] [Fintype K] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreePolynomialTuple P K) I

/-- The effect obtained by deterministic postprocessing along `f`. -/
def postprocessEffect {A B I : Type*} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    [DecidableEq B] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (M : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM A I) (f : A → B) (b : B) : Matrix I I ℂ :=
  ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b), M.effect a

/-- Evaluate every polynomial in a simultaneous tuple at the same point. -/
def evalLowDegreePolynomialTuple {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams} {K : Type}
    [CommSemiring K] (u : Fin P.m → K) (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreePolynomialTuple P K) :
    Fin P.k → K :=
  fun j => MvPolynomial.eval u (g j).1

/-- The compact point question associated with a field point. -/
def lowDegreePointQuestion {K : Type} [Zero K] (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams)
    (u : Fin P.m → K) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeQuestion P K :=
  (.point, ((u, 0), 0))

/-- Read point values and send both malformed answer forms to the zero tuple. -/
def lowDegreePointValuesOrZero {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams} {K : Type} [Zero K] :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeAnswer P K → Fin P.k → K
  | .inl values => values
  | .inr (.inl _) => 0
  | .inr (.inr _) => 0

/-- The exact PMF-averaged off-diagonal Born weight of two local effect families. -/
def consistencyDefect {X O I J : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype O]
    [DecidableEq O] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    (μ : PMF X) (A : X → O → Matrix I I ℂ) (B : X → O → Matrix J J ℂ)
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J)) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x, (μ x).toReal * ∑ a, ∑ b, if a = b then 0 else
    (inner ℂ ψ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (I × J) ℂ).symm
      ((Matrix.kronecker (A x a) (1 : Matrix J J ℂ) *
        Matrix.kronecker (1 : Matrix I I ℂ) (B x b)).mulVec ψ))).re

/-- Alice's point answers compared with evaluations of Bob's polynomial POVM. -/
def ldPointPolynomialDefect {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeStrategy P K)
    (GB : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreePolynomialPOVM P K S.ιB) : ℝ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.consistencyDefect (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin P.m → K))
    (fun (u : Fin P.m → K) (a : Fin P.k → K) =>
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.postprocessEffect (S.alice (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreePointQuestion P u))
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreePointValuesOrZero (P := P) (K := K)) a)
    (fun (u : Fin P.m → K) (a : Fin P.k → K) =>
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.postprocessEffect GB (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.evalLowDegreePolynomialTuple u) a) S.ψ

/-- Evaluations of Alice's polynomial POVM compared with Bob's point answers. -/
def ldPolynomialPointDefect {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeStrategy P K)
    (GA : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreePolynomialPOVM P K S.ιA) : ℝ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.consistencyDefect (PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin P.m → K))
    (fun (u : Fin P.m → K) (a : Fin P.k → K) =>
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.postprocessEffect GA (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.evalLowDegreePolynomialTuple u) a)
    (fun (u : Fin P.m → K) (a : Fin P.k → K) =>
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.postprocessEffect (S.bob (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreePointQuestion P u))
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreePointValuesOrZero (P := P) (K := K)) a) S.ψ

/-- Alice's and Bob's complete polynomial tuples compared with no question law. -/
def ldPolynomialPolynomialDefect {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeStrategy P K)
    (GA : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreePolynomialPOVM P K S.ιA)
    (GB : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreePolynomialPOVM P K S.ιB) : ℝ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.consistencyDefect (PMF.uniformOfFintype Unit)
    (fun (_ : Unit) (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreePolynomialTuple P K) => GA.effect g)
    (fun (_ : Unit) (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreePolynomialTuple P K) => GB.effect g) S.ψ

/-- The error function of low-degree soundness, in argument order `(a,b,ε,q,m,d,k)`. -/
def deltaLd (a b ε : ℝ) (q m d k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  a * Real.rpow (((d * m * k : ℕ) : ℝ)) a *
    (Real.rpow ε b + Real.rpow (q : ℝ) (-b) +
      Real.rpow 2 (-(b * ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ))))

end


/-- The numerical domain of the Pauli basis game. -/
structure PauliParams where
  q : ℕ
  m : ℕ
  d : ℕ
  hm : 1 ≤ m
  hd : 1 ≤ d
  hq : ∃ r : ℕ, Odd r ∧ q = 2 ^ r
  hdvd : m ∣ q

/-- The positive dimension supplies the modulus used by `pauliChiIndex`. -/
instance PauliParams.instNeZeroM (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams) : NeZero P.m :=
  ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one P.hm)⟩

/-- The classical low-degree parameters used by each Pauli basis. -/
def PauliParams.toLowDegreeParams (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams where
  q := P.q
  m := P.m
  d := P.d
  k := 1
  hm := P.hm
  hd := P.hd
  hk := by decide
  hq := P.hq
  hdvd := P.hdvd

/-- The two generalized Pauli bases. -/
inductive PauliKind where
  | X
  | Z
  deriving DecidableEq, Inhabited

instance instFintypePauliKind : Fintype _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind :=
  ⟨{.X, .Z}, by intro x; cases x <;> simp⟩

/-- The complete 26-element Pauli question-type carrier. -/
inductive PauliType where
  | point (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind)
  | aline (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind)
  | dline (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind)
  | pauli (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind)
  | pairW (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind)
  | pair
  | constraint (i : Fin 6)
  | variable (j : Fin 9)
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype, Inhabited

/-- The full coordinates `(uX,uZ,s,v,rX,rZ)` of a Pauli question seed. -/
abbrev PauliSpace (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams) (K : Type) :=
  (Fin P.m → K) × (Fin P.m → K) × K × (Fin P.m → K) × K × K

/-- Select the point block belonging to one Pauli basis. -/
def pauliPointBlock {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams} {K : Type}
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind) (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliSpace P K) : Fin P.m → K :=
  match W with
  | .X => z.1
  | .Z => z.2.1

/-- Read the low-degree point, seed, and direction coordinates. -/
def pauliLowDegreeSpace {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams} {K : Type}
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind) (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliSpace P K) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeSpace P.toLowDegreeParams K :=
  ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliPointBlock W z, z.2.2.1), z.2.2.2.1)

/-- The balanced seed-to-coordinate map in the Pauli parameter presentation. -/
noncomputable def pauliChiIndex {K : Type} (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams)
    (encoding : K ≃ Fin P.q) (s : K) : Fin P.m :=
  Fin.ofNat P.m ((encoding s).val / (P.q / P.m))

/-- Embed low-degree coordinates into one basis block and clear all others. -/
def pauliEmbedLowDegree {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams} {K : Type} [Zero K]
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind) (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeSpace P.toLowDegreeParams K) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliSpace P K :=
  match W with
  | .X => (z.1.1, 0, z.1.2, z.2, 0, 0)
  | .Z => (0, z.1.1, z.1.2, z.2, 0, 0)

/-- The concrete question map for every Pauli question type. -/
noncomputable def pauliMap {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]
    (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams) (encoding : K ≃ Fin P.q) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliType → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliSpace P K → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliSpace P K
  | .point W, z => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEmbedLowDegree W
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeMap P.toLowDegreeParams encoding .point (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliLowDegreeSpace W z))
  | .aline W, z => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEmbedLowDegree W
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeMap P.toLowDegreeParams encoding .aline (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliLowDegreeSpace W z))
  | .dline W, z => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEmbedLowDegree W
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeMap P.toLowDegreeParams encoding .dline (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliLowDegreeSpace W z))
  | .pauli _, _ => 0
  | .pairW _, z | .pair, z | .constraint _, z | .variable _, z =>
      (z.1, z.2.1, 0, 0, z.2.2.2.2.1, z.2.2.2.2.2)

/-- The Magic Square variable at one position of a constraint. -/
def magicVariable (i : Fin 6) (j : Fin 3) : Fin 9 :=
  ⟨if i.val < 3 then i.val * 3 + j.val else i.val - 3 + j.val * 3, by
    split
    · rename_i h
      exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.add_le_add
        (Nat.mul_le_mul_right 3 (Nat.le_of_lt_succ h)) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ j.isLt))
    · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.add_le_add
        (Nat.sub_le_sub_right (Nat.le_of_lt_succ i.isLt) 3)
        (Nat.mul_le_mul_right 3 (Nat.le_of_lt_succ j.isLt)))⟩

/-- The exceptional parity of the final Magic Square constraint. -/
def magicParity (i : Fin 6) : ZMod 2 := if i.val = 5 then 1 else 0

/-- The undirected Pauli type graph, including every self-loop. -/
def pauliEdges : Finset (Sym2 _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliType) :=
  let loops := Finset.univ.image fun t : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliType => Sym2.mk t t
  let lines := (Finset.univ : Finset _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind).image (fun W =>
      Sym2.mk (.point W) (.aline W)) ∪
    (Finset.univ : Finset _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind).image (fun W =>
      Sym2.mk (.point W) (.dline W)) ∪
    (Finset.univ : Finset _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind).image (fun W =>
      Sym2.mk (.point W) (.pauli W))
  let basis := (Finset.univ : Finset _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind).image (fun W =>
      Sym2.mk (.point W) (.pairW W)) ∪
    ({Sym2.mk (.point .X) (.variable 0),
      Sym2.mk (.point .Z) (.variable 4)} : Finset (Sym2 _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliType))
  let pairs := (Finset.univ : Finset _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind).image fun W =>
    Sym2.mk (.pairW W) .pair
  let magic := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 6 × Fin 3)).image fun ij =>
    Sym2.mk (.constraint ij.1) (.variable (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.magicVariable ij.1 ij.2))
  loops ∪ lines ∪ basis ∪ pairs ∪ magic

/-- The ordered carrier of the Pauli type graph. -/
abbrev PauliEdge :=
  {e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliType // Sym2.mk e.1 e.2 ∈ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges}

/-- A loop supplies the nonempty ordered-edge carrier. -/
instance instNonemptyPauliEdge : Nonempty _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliEdge :=
  ⟨⟨(.point .X, .point .X), by simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges]⟩⟩

/-- A typed Pauli question, retaining every ambient coordinate. -/
abbrev PauliQuestion (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams) (K : Type) := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliSpace P K

/-- Full finite question coordinates have decidable equality. -/
noncomputable instance instDecidableEqPauliQuestion {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams} {K : Type} [DecidableEq K] :
    DecidableEq (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion P K) := Classical.decEq _

/-- The question law is uniform on all ordered edges and the full seed space. -/
noncomputable def pauliQuestionPMF {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    [DecidableEq K] (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams) (encoding : K ≃ Fin P.q) :
    PMF (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion P K × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion P K) :=
  (PMF.uniformOfFintype (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliEdge × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliSpace P K)).map fun s =>
    ((s.1.1.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliMap P encoding s.1.1.1 s.2),
      (s.1.1.2, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliMap P encoding s.1.1.2 s.2))

/-- The seven answer forms, including malformed answers at every question. -/
inductive PauliAnswer (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams) (K : Type) where
  | value (a : K)
  | alinePoly (a : Fin (P.d + 1) → K)
  | dlinePoly (a : Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → K)
  | pairBits (a : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2)
  | bit (a : ZMod 2)
  | msTriple (a : Fin 3 → ZMod 2)
  | pauliOutcome (a : (Fin P.m → Bool) → K)
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- Whether an answer constructor is prescribed by its question type. -/
def validPauliAnswer {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams} {K : Type} :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliType → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliAnswer P K → Bool
  | .point _, .value _ | .aline _, .alinePoly _ | .dline _, .dlinePoly _ => true
  | .pauli _, .pauliOutcome _ | .pairW _, .bit _ | .pair, .pairBits _ => true
  | .constraint _, .msTriple _ | .variable _, .bit _ => true
  | _, _ => false

/-- One entry of the Boolean-cube indicator vector. -/
def pauliIndicator {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams} {K : Type} [CommRing K]
    (x : Fin P.m → K) (y : Fin P.m → Bool) : K :=
  ∏ i : Fin P.m, if y i then x i else 1 - x i

/-- Evaluate the multilinear low-degree encoding of a Pauli outcome. -/
def pauliEncoded {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams} {K : Type} [CommRing K]
    (h : (Fin P.m → Bool) → K) (x : Fin P.m → K) : K :=
  dotProduct h (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliIndicator x)

/-- The phase bit computed from the shared tuple coordinates. -/
def pauliGamma {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams} {K : Type} [CommRing K]
    (trace : K → ZMod 2) (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliSpace P K) : ZMod 2 :=
  trace (dotProduct (z.2.2.2.2.1 • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliIndicator z.1)
    (z.2.2.2.2.2 • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliIndicator z.2.1))

/-- The complete Pauli verifier, including gamma gates and off-edge defaults. -/
noncomputable def pauliWin {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams) (encoding : K ≃ Fin P.q) (trace : K → ZMod 2) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion P K → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion P K → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliAnswer P K → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliAnswer P K → Bool :=
  open Classical in
  fun (tA, xA) (tB, xB) a b =>
    if _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.validPauliAnswer tA a && _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.validPauliAnswer tB b then
      if tA = tB then decide (a = b) else
      match tA, tB, a, b with
      | .aline W, .point W', .alinePoly f, .value u => if W = W' then decide (∀ t,
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliPointBlock W xB = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliPointBlock W xA +
            t • Pi.single (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliChiIndex P encoding xA.2.2.1) 1 →
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeEval f t = u) else true
      | .point W, .aline W', .value u, .alinePoly f => if W = W' then decide (∀ t,
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliPointBlock W xA = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliPointBlock W xB +
            t • Pi.single (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliChiIndex P encoding xB.2.2.1) 1 →
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeEval f t = u) else true
      | .dline W, .point W', .dlinePoly f, .value u => if W = W' then decide (∀ t,
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliPointBlock W xB = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliPointBlock W xA + t • xA.2.2.2.1 →
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeEval f t = u) else true
      | .point W, .dline W', .value u, .dlinePoly f => if W = W' then decide (∀ t,
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliPointBlock W xA = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliPointBlock W xB + t • xB.2.2.2.1 →
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeEval f t = u) else true
      | .point W, .pauli W', .value u, .pauliOutcome h =>
          if W = W' then decide (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEncoded h (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliPointBlock W xA) = u) else true
      | .pauli W, .point W', .pauliOutcome h, .value u =>
          if W = W' then decide (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEncoded h (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliPointBlock W xB) = u) else true
      | .pairW W, .pair, .bit β, .pairBits bits => decide (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliGamma trace xA ≠ 0 ∨
          match W with | .X => bits.1 = β | .Z => bits.2 = β)
      | .pair, .pairW W, .pairBits bits, .bit β => decide (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliGamma trace xB ≠ 0 ∨
          match W with | .X => bits.1 = β | .Z => bits.2 = β)
      | .point W, .pairW W', .value u, .bit β => if W = W' then decide
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliGamma trace xB ≠ 0 ∨ trace (u * if W = .X then xB.2.2.2.2.1
            else xB.2.2.2.2.2) = β) else true
      | .pairW W, .point W', .bit β, .value u => if W = W' then decide
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliGamma trace xA ≠ 0 ∨ trace (u * if W = .X then xA.2.2.2.2.1
            else xA.2.2.2.2.2) = β) else true
      | .constraint i, .variable j, .msTriple bits, .bit β =>
          if ∃ k, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.magicVariable i k = j then decide (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliGamma trace xA = 0 ∨
            (∑ k, bits k) = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.magicParity i ∧ ∃ k, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.magicVariable i k = j ∧ bits k = β)
          else true
      | .variable j, .constraint i, .bit β, .msTriple bits =>
          if ∃ k, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.magicVariable i k = j then decide (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliGamma trace xB = 0 ∨
            (∑ k, bits k) = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.magicParity i ∧ ∃ k, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.magicVariable i k = j ∧ bits k = β)
          else true
      | .point W, .variable j, .value u, .bit β => decide (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliGamma trace xB = 0 ∨
          (j = 0 ∧ W = .X ∧ trace (u * xB.2.2.2.2.1) = β) ∨
          (j = 4 ∧ W = .Z ∧ trace (u * xB.2.2.2.2.2) = β))
      | .variable j, .point W, .bit β, .value u => decide (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliGamma trace xA = 0 ∨
          (j = 0 ∧ W = .X ∧ trace (u * xA.2.2.2.2.1) = β) ∨
          (j = 4 ∧ W = .Z ∧ trace (u * xA.2.2.2.2.2) = β))
      | _, _, _, _ => true
    else false

/-- The compact Pauli basis game. -/
noncomputable def pauliGame {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams) (encoding : K ≃ Fin P.q) (trace : K → ZMod 2) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion P K) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion P K) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliAnswer P K) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliAnswer P K) := by
  classical
  exact { μ := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionPMF P encoding, decide := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliWin P encoding trace }


/-- A compact strategy on the full Pauli question and answer carriers. -/
abbrev PauliStrategy (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams) (K : Type) [Fintype K] :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion P K) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion P K)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliAnswer P K) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliAnswer P K)

/-- A compact symmetric strategy on the full Pauli carriers. -/
abbrev SymmetricPauliStrategy (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams) (K : Type) [Fintype K] :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricStrategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion P K) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliAnswer P K)

/-- The field-valued Boolean-cube register in the Pauli soundness conclusion. -/
abbrev PauliRegister (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams) (K : Type) :=
  (Fin P.m → Bool) → K

/-- The binary register obtained by expanding each field coordinate in a fixed basis. -/
abbrev QubitRegister (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams) (r : ℕ) :=
  (Fin P.m → Bool) × Fin r → ZMod 2

/-- The prescribed Pauli-basis question with zero ambient seed. -/
def pauliMeasurementQuestion {K : Type} [Zero K]
    (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion P K :=
  (.pauli W, 0)

/-- The concrete projective, consistent, support-wise commuting predicate for
the compact Pauli question law. -/
def SymmetricStrategy.IsPauliSPCC {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    [DecidableEq K] (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams) (encoding : K ≃ Fin P.q)
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricPauliStrategy P K) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, (S.meas x).IsProjective) ∧ S.IsConsistent ∧
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.IsCommutingOn (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionPMF P encoding) S.meas S.meas

/-- The error scale in the Pauli soundness and qubit-soundness conclusions. -/
noncomputable def deltaQld (a b epsilon : ℝ) (m d q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  a * Real.rpow ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) a *
    (Real.rpow epsilon b + Real.rpow (q : ℝ) (-b) +
      Real.rpow 2 (-(b * ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ))))

noncomputable def pauliPhaseSign (t : ZMod 2) : ℂ :=
  if t = 0 then 1 else -1

/-- One coordinate of a generalized Pauli eigenvector. -/
noncomputable def singlePauliVec {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (trace : K → ZMod 2) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind) (e x : K) : ℂ :=
  match W with
  | .Z => if x = e then 1 else 0

      (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card K : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliPhaseSign (trace (e * x))

/-- The tensor-product generalized Pauli eigenvector. -/

    [Fintype I] (trace : K → ZMod 2) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind)
    (e x : I → K) : ℂ :=
  ∏ i : I, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.singlePauliVec trace W (e i) (x i)

/-- The rank-one generalized Pauli projector. -/
noncomputable def pauliProj {K I : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Fintype I] (trace : K → ZMod 2) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind)

  Matrix.vecMulVec (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliVec trace W e) (fun x => star (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliVec trace W e x))

/-- The binary Pauli projector, using the trace of `ZMod 2` over itself. -/
noncomputable abbrev qubitPauliProj {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind) (e : I → ZMod 2) : Matrix (I → ZMod 2) (I → ZMod 2) ℂ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliProj (Algebra.trace (ZMod 2) (ZMod 2)) W e

/-- Conjugate an operator by a local linear isometry. -/
noncomputable def conjIsometry {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    (phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ I →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ J)
    (M : Matrix I I ℂ) : Matrix J J ℂ :=
  let U : Matrix J I ℂ := Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm phi.toLinearMap

/-- Lift Alice's conjugated qudit effect to the full extracted target space. -/
noncomputable def liftedPauliAliceEffect
    {I I' J' R : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [Fintype I'] [DecidableEq I'] [Fintype J'] [DecidableEq J']
    [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    (phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ I →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (I' × R))
    (M : Matrix I I ℂ) :
    Matrix ((I' × R) × (J' × R)) ((I' × R) × (J' × R)) ℂ :=
  fun p q => if p.2 = q.2 then _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.conjIsometry phi M p.1 q.1 else 0

/-- Lift Bob's conjugated qudit effect to the full extracted target space. -/
noncomputable def liftedPauliBobEffect
    {I I' J' R : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [Fintype I'] [DecidableEq I'] [Fintype J'] [DecidableEq J']
    [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    (phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ I →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (J' × R))
    (M : Matrix I I ℂ) :
    Matrix ((I' × R) × (J' × R)) ((I' × R) × (J' × R)) ℂ :=
  fun p q => if p.1 = q.1 then _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.conjIsometry phi M p.2 q.2 else 0

/-- Lift Alice's conjugated qubit effect by tensoring with Bob's identity. -/
noncomputable def liftedQubitAliceEffect
    {I I' J' R : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [Fintype I'] [DecidableEq I'] [Fintype J'] [DecidableEq J']
    [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    (phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ I →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (I' × R))
    (M : Matrix I I ℂ) :
    Matrix ((I' × R) × (J' × R)) ((I' × R) × (J' × R)) ℂ :=
  Matrix.kronecker (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.conjIsometry phi M) 1

/-- Lift Bob's conjugated qubit effect by tensoring with Alice's identity. -/
noncomputable def liftedQubitBobEffect
    {I I' J' R : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    [Fintype I'] [DecidableEq I'] [Fintype J'] [DecidableEq J']
    [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    (phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ I →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (J' × R))
    (M : Matrix I I ℂ) :
    Matrix ((I' × R) × (J' × R)) ((I' × R) × (J' × R)) ℂ :=
  Matrix.kronecker 1 (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.conjIsometry phi M)

  fun p q => if p.1.1 = q.1.1 ∧ p.2 = q.2 then M p.1.2 q.1.2 else 0

/-- Place a register projector on Bob's target register. -/

    [DecidableEq I'] [DecidableEq J'] [DecidableEq R]
    (M : Matrix R R ℂ) :

    (trace : K → ZMod 2) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind) : ℝ :=

/-!
# Finite controlled unitaries

A complete projective measurement controls a family of operators on a second
finite-dimensional space. Orthogonality of the measurement effects makes
multiplication of the resulting operator sums componentwise. In particular,
unitary components give a unitary controlled operator.

These are formalization-only algebraic lemmas, not the extraction theorem:
they do not construct the global measurement or establish the Pauli relations.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1700`,
  the unitarity calculation in the proof of `lem:qld-unitary`.
- Blueprint `def:v-swap-unitary` and `lem:v-swap-conjugation`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix

namespace LIDT
namespace MIPStarRE.Quantum

open MIPStarRE.QPBT

variable {Outcome Control Target : Type*}
variable [Fintype Outcome] [Fintype Control] [DecidableEq Control]
variable [Fintype Target]

/-- Multiplication of operator sums controlled by the same projective measurement
is componentwise. This isolates the orthogonality calculation in the proof of
`lem:qld-unitary`, before any unitarity of the controlled components is used. -/
theorem sum_heteroKron_mul_sum_heteroKron
    (measurement : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement Outcome Control)
    (hprojective : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective measurement)
    (leftOperators rightOperators : Outcome → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op Target) :
    (∑ outcome, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (leftOperators outcome)) *
        (∑ outcome, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (rightOperators outcome)) =
      ∑ outcome, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome)
        (leftOperators outcome * rightOperators outcome) := by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro outcome _
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single outcome]
  · rw [(hprojective outcome).isIdempotentElem.eq]
  · intro other _ hother
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero
      measurement hprojective hother.symm]
    exact Matrix.zero_kronecker _
  · simp

variable [DecidableEq Target]

/-- A controlled operator times its adjoint is the identity when each component
times its adjoint is the identity. This is the finite controlled-unitary
calculation at paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1700`,
with arbitrary unitary components in place of the products of Pauli observables. -/
theorem sum_heteroKron_mul_conjTranspose
    (measurement : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement Outcome Control)
    (hprojective : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective measurement)
    (operators : Outcome → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op Target)
    (hunitary : ∀ outcome, operators outcome * (operators outcome)ᴴ = 1) :
    (∑ outcome, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome)) *
        (∑ outcome, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome))ᴴ = 1 := by
  have hself (outcome : Outcome) :
      (measurement.effect outcome)ᴴ = measurement.effect outcome :=
    (hprojective outcome).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
  calc
    _ = (∑ outcome, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome)) *
        (∑ outcome, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) ((operators outcome)ᴴ)) := by
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
        Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, hself]
    _ = ∑ outcome, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome)
        (operators outcome * (operators outcome)ᴴ) :=
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.sum_heteroKron_mul_sum_heteroKron measurement hprojective _ _
    _ = ∑ outcome, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op Target) := by
      simp_rw [hunitary]
    _ = 1 := by
      rw [← _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_left, measurement.sum_eq_one,
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron_one_one]





end MIPStarRE.Quantum
end LIDT

/-!
# Finite-dimensional state transformations

This file defines the tensor and reindexing operations used for strategy
distance, Magic Square rigidity, and the qudit-to-qubit isomorphism. See
blueprint chapters 11--13 and the declaration-level references below.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped Matrix

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

/-- Conjugation by the local isometries in `thm:ms-rigidity` and
`lem:pauli-binary`; blueprint `thm:ms-rigidity` and
`lem:pauli-binary`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652` and
`04_preliminaries.tex:1163-1208`. -/
noncomputable def conjIsometry {ι ι' : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι')
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι' :=
  let U : Matrix ι' ι ℂ := Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm φ.toLinearMap
  U * M * Uᴴ

/-- Coordinate transport used by blueprint
`def:strategy-distance`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:273-285`. -/
noncomputable def reindexState {ι ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι'] (e : ι ≃ ι')
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι' :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι' ℂ).symm
    (fun j => (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ ψ) (e.symm j))

/-- Apply the two independent local isometries of blueprint
`thm:ms-rigidity`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652`. -/
noncomputable def isometryTensor
    {ιA ιB κA κB : Type*}
    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA] [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB]
    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιA →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ ιB →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB) :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (κA × κB) ℂ).symm
    (fun p =>
      ∑ i : ιA, ∑ j : ιB,
        ((EuclideanSpace.equiv κA ℂ)
            (φA ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ιA ℂ).symm (Pi.single i 1))) p.1) *
          ((EuclideanSpace.equiv κB ℂ)
            (φB ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ιB ℂ).symm (Pi.single j 1))) p.2) *
          ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (ιA × ιB) ℂ) ψ (i, j)))

/-- Coordinate tensor used in the ideal state of blueprint
`thm:ms-rigidity`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652`. -/
noncomputable def vecTensor {ι κ : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ κ) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × κ) :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (ι × κ) ℂ).symm
    (fun p => (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ u) p.1 * (EuclideanSpace.equiv κ ℂ v) p.2)

/-- Operator transport used by blueprint
`def:strategy-distance`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:273-285`. -/
def reindexOp {ι ι' : Type*} (e : ι ≃ ι') (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι') : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι :=
  (Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm) M

/-- Four-factor tensor shuffle used by blueprint
`thm:ms-rigidity`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:620-652`. -/
def prodShuffle {α β γ δ : Type*} :
    (α × β) × (γ × δ) ≃ (α × γ) × (β × δ) where
  toFun p := ((p.1.1, p.2.1), (p.1.2, p.2.2))
  invFun p := ((p.1.1, p.2.1), (p.1.2, p.2.2))
  left_inv p := by cases p; rfl
  right_inv p := by cases p; rfl

/-! ## Norm identities for the coordinate operations -/

/-- Reindexing Euclidean coordinates along an equivalence preserves norm.
This is a formalization-only auxiliary identity (no source counterpart). -/
theorem reindexState_norm_eq
    {iota kappa : Type*}
    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    [Fintype kappa] [DecidableEq kappa]
    (e : iota ≃ kappa) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) :
    ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexState e psi‖ = ‖psi‖ := by
  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  change (∑ j : kappa, ‖psi (e.symm j)‖ ^ 2) = ∑ i : iota, ‖psi i‖ ^ 2
  exact e.symm.sum_comp (fun i => ‖psi i‖ ^ 2)

/-- The coordinate tensor of two Euclidean vectors has the product norm.
This is a formalization-only auxiliary identity (no source counterpart). -/
theorem vecTensor_norm_eq
    {iota kappa : Type*}
    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    [Fintype kappa] [DecidableEq kappa]
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ kappa) :
    ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.vecTensor u v‖ = ‖u‖ * ‖v‖ := by
  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))]
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, mul_pow, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq,
    EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  change (∑ p : iota × kappa, ‖u p.1 * v p.2‖ ^ 2) =
    (∑ i : iota, ‖u i‖ ^ 2) * ∑ j : kappa, ‖v j‖ ^ 2
  simp only [norm_mul, mul_pow]
  rw [← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-! # State-dependent consistency and strategy closeness

The definitions are the finite-dimensional forms of blueprint
`def:consistency` and `def:strategy-distance`,
from `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:219-288`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

/-- The off-diagonal defect in blueprint
`def:consistency`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:232-248`. -/
noncomputable def consistencyDefect {X α ι : Type*}
    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution X) (A B : X → α → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : ℝ :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver μ (fun x =>
    ∑ a : α, ∑ b : α,
      if a = b then 0 else
        (inner ℂ ψ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ).symm
          ((A x a * B x b).mulVec ψ))).re)











/-- Unit-alphabet specialization of blueprint
`def:povm-distance`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:258-271`. -/
noncomputable def opDistSq {X ι : Type*}
    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (μ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution X) (M N : X → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) : ℝ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x (_ : Unit) => M x) (fun x (_ : Unit) => N x) ψ



/-- The strategy-distance relation `def:strategy-distance`. The two strategies'
local Hilbert spaces are identified, and both measurement distances are
evaluated on the first strategy's state. Blueprint
`def:strategy-distance`, paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:273-285`. -/
structure AreCloseStrategies (G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game) (S S' : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G) (δ : ℝ) : Prop where
  /-- Identification of Alice's local Hilbert spaces. -/
  hA : S.ιA = S'.ιA
  /-- Identification of Bob's local Hilbert spaces. -/
  hB : S.ιB = S'.ιB
  state : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.stateDistSq S.ψ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexState
      (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.cast hA).symm (Equiv.cast hB).symm) S'.ψ) ≤ δ
  alice : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.opFamilyDistSq (G.μ.map Prod.fst)
      (fun x a => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) 1)
      (fun x a => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp (Equiv.cast hA) ((S'.A x).effect a)) 1)
      S.ψ ≤ δ
  bob : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.opFamilyDistSq (G.μ.map Prod.snd)
      (fun y b => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron 1 ((S.B y).effect b))
      (fun y b => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron 1 (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp (Equiv.cast hB) ((S'.B y).effect b)))
      S.ψ ≤ δ

end MIPStarRE.QPBT
