/-! # Pauli product, commutation, and cancellation identities

The principal results are blueprint `lem:twisted-commutation` and
`lem:cancellation`, from
`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1056-1095,1124-1151`. The
general-prime statements use the canonical character `ffChar`; binary
declarations below are separately named QPBT specializations.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

/-- The shift observable in blueprint
`lem:twisted-commutation`, paper `04_preliminaries.tex:1056-1089`. -/
noncomputable def primeTauShift {p : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    [DecidableEq K] [Fact p.Prime] [Algebra (ZMod p) K]
    (a : K) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op K := fun i j => if i = j + a then 1 else 0

/-- The phase observable in blueprint
`lem:twisted-commutation`, paper `04_preliminaries.tex:1056-1089`. -/
noncomputable def primeTauPhase {p : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    [DecidableEq K] [Fact p.Prime] [Algebra (ZMod p) K]
    (b : K) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op K := fun i j =>
  if i = j then _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.ffChar (p := p) (F := K) (b * j) else 0

/-- The multi-qudit observable in `lem:twisted-commutation`, with `false`
denoting phase; blueprint `lem:twisted-commutation`, paper
`04_preliminaries.tex:1073-1095,1141-1151`. -/
noncomputable def primeTauObservable {p : ℕ} {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    [DecidableEq K] [Fact p.Prime] [Algebra (ZMod p) K]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (W : Bool) (a : ι → K) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ι → K) :=
  fun x y => ∏ i : ι, if W then _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift (p := p) (a i) (x i) (y i)
    else _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase (p := p) (a i) (x i) (y i)

/-- The coordinatewise tensor-entry presentation used by the Pauli observables. -/
private def productMatrix {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (A : ι → Matrix κ κ ℂ) : Matrix (ι → κ) (ι → κ) ℂ :=
  fun x y => ∏ i, A i (x i) (y i)

/-- Matrix multiplication distributes over `productMatrix`. -/
private theorem productMatrix_mul {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    [Fintype κ]
    (A B : ι → Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    (productMatrix A * productMatrix B : Matrix (ι → κ) (ι → κ) ℂ) =
      productMatrix (fun i => A i * B i) := by
  classical
  ext x y
  simpa only [productMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.prod_mul_distrib] using
    (Fintype.prod_sum (fun i z => A i (x i) z * B i z (y i))).symm

/-- Two single-coordinate shifts compose by adding their displacements. -/
private theorem primeTauShift_mul {p : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    [DecidableEq K] [Fact p.Prime] [Algebra (ZMod p) K] (a a' : K) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift (p := p) a * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift (p := p) a' =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift (p := p) (a + a') := by
  ext x y
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift, add_comm, add_left_comm]

/-- Two single-coordinate phases compose by adding their labels. -/
private theorem primeTauPhase_mul {p : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    [DecidableEq K] [Fact p.Prime] [Algebra (ZMod p) K] (b b' : K) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase (p := p) b * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase (p := p) b' =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase (p := p) (b + b') := by
  ext x y
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase, add_mul, AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]

/-- The generalized Pauli observable with zero label is the identity. -/
private theorem primeTauObservable_zero {p : ℕ} {K ι : Type*} [Field K]
    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Fact p.Prime] [Algebra (ZMod p) K]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (W : Bool) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) W (0 : ι → K) = 1 := by
  classical
  ext x y
  cases W <;>
    simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable, if_true, Pi.zero_apply, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase, zero_mul, AddChar.map_zero_eq_one, Matrix.one_apply]
  all_goals
    by_cases hxy : ∀ i, x i = y i
    · have h : x = y := funext hxy
      simp [h]
    · simp only [not_forall] at hxy
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hxy
      rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (by simp [hi])]
      have h : x ≠ y := fun hxy => hi (congr_fun hxy i)
      simp [h]

/-- The product identity blueprint
`eq:pauli-product-power`, paper `04_preliminaries.tex:1082-1089`. -/
theorem primeTauObservable_mul {p : ℕ} {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    [DecidableEq K] [Fact p.Prime] [Algebra (ZMod p) K] [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι] (W : Bool) (a a' : ι → K) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) W a * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) W a' =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) W (a + a') := by
  cases W with
  | false =>
      change productMatrix (fun i => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase (p := p) (a i)) *
          productMatrix (fun i => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase (p := p) (a' i)) =
        productMatrix (fun i => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase (p := p) ((a + a') i))
      simpa [primeTauPhase_mul] using
        (productMatrix_mul
          (A := fun i => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase (p := p) (a i))
          (B := fun i => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase (p := p) (a' i)))
  | true =>
      change productMatrix (fun i => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift (p := p) (a i)) *
          productMatrix (fun i => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift (p := p) (a' i)) =
        productMatrix (fun i => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift (p := p) ((a + a') i))
      simpa [primeTauShift_mul] using
        (productMatrix_mul
          (A := fun i => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift (p := p) (a i))
          (B := fun i => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift (p := p) (a' i)))

/-- Natural powers of a generalized Pauli observable multiply its label by
repeated addition. -/
private theorem primeTauObservable_pow_nat {p : ℕ} {K ι : Type*} [Field K]
    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Fact p.Prime] [Algebra (ZMod p) K]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (W : Bool) (a : ι → K) (n : ℕ) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) W a) ^ n =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) W (fun i => n • a i) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [pow_zero]
      have hzero : (fun i => (0 : ℕ) • a i) = (0 : ι → K) := by
        funext i
        simp
      rw [hzero]
      exact (primeTauObservable_zero (p := p) (K := K) (ι := ι) W).symm
  | succ n ih =>
      calc
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) W a) ^ (n + 1) =
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) W a) ^ n *
              _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) W a := pow_succ _ _
        _ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) W (fun i => n • a i) *
              _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) W a := by rw [ih]
        _ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) W ((fun i => n • a i) + a) :=
              _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable_mul W _ _
        _ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) W (fun i => (n + 1) • a i) := by
              have hlabels : ((fun i => n • a i) + a) =
                  (fun i => (n + 1) • a i) := by
                funext i
                rw [Pi.add_apply, add_nsmul, one_nsmul]
              exact congrArg
                (fun c => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) W c) hlabels



/-- The characteristic-`p` consequence of `primeTauObservable_pow`, blueprint
`eq:pauli-product-power`, paper `04_preliminaries.tex:1088-1089`. -/
theorem primeTauObservable_pow_char {p : ℕ} {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    [DecidableEq K] [Fact p.Prime] [Algebra (ZMod p) K] [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι] (W : Bool) (a : ι → K) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) W a) ^ p = 1 := by
  haveI : CharP K p := (Algebra.charP_iff (ZMod p) K p).mp (ZMod.charP p)
  rw [primeTauObservable_pow_nat]
  have hlabel : (fun i => p • a i) = (0 : ι → K) := by
    funext i
    simp [nsmul_eq_mul, CharP.cast_eq_zero]
  rw [hlabel, primeTauObservable_zero]













/-- A single-coordinate shift and phase satisfy the generalized Pauli twisted
commutation relation. -/
private theorem primeTauShift_mul_primeTauPhase {p : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K]
    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Fact p.Prime] [Algebra (ZMod p) K]
    (a b : K) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift (p := p) a * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase (p := p) b =
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.ffChar (p := p) (F := K) (-a * b)) •
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase (p := p) b * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift (p := p) a) := by
  ext x y
  by_cases hxy : x = y + a
  · subst x
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase, Matrix.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    simp only [add_left_inj, mul_ite, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, mul_zero,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, mul_one]
    rw [← AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    ring_nf
  · simp [Matrix.mul_apply, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase, Matrix.smul_apply, hxy]

/-- The source multi-qudit twisted relation blueprint
`eq:twisted-fq`, paper `04_preliminaries.tex:1090-1095,1141-1151`. -/
theorem primeTauObservable_X_mul_Z {p : ℕ} {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    [DecidableEq K] [Fact p.Prime] [Algebra (ZMod p) K] [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι] (a b : ι → K) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) true a * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) false b =
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.ffChar (p := p) (F := K) (-dotProduct a b)) •
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) false b * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := p) true a) := by
  let ψ := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.ffChar (p := p) (F := K)
  have hchar : ψ (-dotProduct a b) = ∏ i, ψ (-(a i) * b i) := by
    calc
      ψ (-dotProduct a b) = ψ (∑ i, -(a i) * b i) := by
        congr 1
        simp [dotProduct]
      _ = ∏ i, ψ (-(a i) * b i) := by
        simpa only [AddChar.toMonoidHom_apply, toAdd_prod, toAdd_ofAdd] using
          (map_prod ψ.toMonoidHom (fun i => Multiplicative.ofAdd (-(a i) * b i))
            Finset.univ)
  change productMatrix (fun i => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift (p := p) (a i)) *
      productMatrix (fun i => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase (p := p) (b i)) =
    ψ (-dotProduct a b) •
      (productMatrix (fun i => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase (p := p) (b i)) *
        productMatrix (fun i => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauShift (p := p) (a i)))
  rw [productMatrix_mul, productMatrix_mul]
  ext x y
  simp only [productMatrix, primeTauShift_mul_primeTauPhase, Matrix.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  rw [← hchar]

/-- The canonical finite-field character at `p = 2` is `phaseSign` composed
with the binary trace. -/
private theorem ffChar_two_eq_phaseSign {K : Type*} [Field K]
    [Algebra (ZMod 2) K] (x : K) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.ffChar (p := 2) (F := K) x = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binTrace K x) := by
  rw [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.ffChar_apply]
  exact (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign_eq_ffChar (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binTrace K x)).symm

/-- The binary Pauli observable is the characteristic-two specialization of
the prime-characteristic observable. -/
private theorem tauObservable_eq_primeTauObservable {K ι : Type*} [Field K]
    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι] (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (a : ι → K) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W a = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable (p := 2)
      (match W with | .X => true | .Z => false) a := by
  cases W with
  | X =>
      ext x y
      rfl
  | Z =>
      ext x y
      simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false,
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauPhase, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauPhase]
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      by_cases hxy : x i = y i
      · rw [if_pos hxy, if_pos hxy, _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.ffChar_apply]
        exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign_eq_ffChar _
      · rw [if_neg hxy, if_neg hxy]

/-- With no coordinates, every binary Pauli observable is the identity. -/
private theorem tauObservable_eq_one_of_isEmpty {K ι : Type*} [Field K]
    [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [Fintype ι]
    [DecidableEq ι] [IsEmpty ι] (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (a : ι → K) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W a = 1 := by
  classical
  ext x y
  have hxy : x = y := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst y
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable]

/-- Binary specialization of blueprint
`eq:pauli-product-power`, paper `04_preliminaries.tex:1082-1089`.

**Scope restriction:** This characteristic-two specialization is separated
from the general-prime identity as documented in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_characteristic-two-pauli-scope.tex`. -/
theorem tauObservable_mul {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (a a' : ι → K) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W a * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W a' = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W (a + a') := by
  cases W with
  | X =>
      simpa only [tauObservable_eq_primeTauObservable] using
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable_mul (p := 2) true a a')
  | Z =>
      simpa only [tauObservable_eq_primeTauObservable] using
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable_mul (p := 2) false a a')

/-- Binary characteristic-two specialization of blueprint
`eq:pauli-product-power`, paper `04_preliminaries.tex:1088-1089`.

**Scope restriction:** This characteristic-two specialization is separated
from the general-prime identity as documented in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_characteristic-two-pauli-scope.tex`. -/
theorem tauObservable_sq {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (a : ι → K) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W a * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W a = 1 := by
  cases W with
  | X =>
      simpa only [tauObservable_eq_primeTauObservable, pow_two] using
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable_pow_char (p := 2) true a)
  | Z =>
      simpa only [tauObservable_eq_primeTauObservable, pow_two] using
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable_pow_char (p := 2) false a)

/-- Binary specialization of blueprint
`eq:twisted-fq`, paper `04_preliminaries.tex:1090-1095`.

**Scope restriction:** This characteristic-two specialization is separated
from the general-prime identity as documented in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_characteristic-two-pauli-scope.tex`. -/
theorem tauObservable_X_mul_Z {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (a b : ι → K) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable .X a * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable .Z b =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binTrace K (dotProduct a b))) •
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable .Z b * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable .X a) := by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with
  | inl hι =>
      letI : IsEmpty ι := hι
      rw [tauObservable_eq_one_of_isEmpty]
      simp [dotProduct, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign]
  | inr hι =>
      letI : Nonempty ι := hι
      have hphase : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.ffChar (p := 2) (F := K) (-dotProduct a b) =
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binTrace K (dotProduct a b)) := by
        rw [ffChar_two_eq_phaseSign]
        congr 1
        rw [map_neg]
        exact ZMod.neg_eq_self_mod_two _
      simpa only [tauObservable_eq_primeTauObservable, hphase] using
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.primeTauObservable_X_mul_Z (p := 2) a b)













/-- Expand every register label in the fixed self-dual binary basis. This
arbitrary-index construction is the computational-basis identification in the
proof of `lem:pauli-binary`, shared by the algebra and soundness modules. -/
noncomputable def quditQubitLabelEquiv {q : ℕ} {ι : Type*}
    (F : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.FixedFieldModel q) :
    (ι → F.K) ≃ (ι × Fin F.basisDim → ZMod 2) :=
  (Equiv.piCongrRight (fun _ : ι => F.binaryCoordinates.toEquiv)).trans
    (Equiv.curry ι (Fin F.basisDim) (ZMod 2)).symm















/-- The tensor product of binary Pauli projectors, obtained by specializing
`pauliProj` to `ZMod 2`. This is the binary target in blueprint
`lem:pauli-binary`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1163-1208`. -/
noncomputable abbrev qubitPauliProj {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (b : ι → ZMod 2) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (ι → ZMod 2) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W b



end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# The EPR projection in Pauli extraction

The product of the averaged, paired X and Z observables is the rank-one
projection onto the EPR vector. This is an algebraic prerequisite for constructing
the auxiliary state in `exists_extractionWitness_ofGlobalPairWitness`.

## References

Blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`; paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1725-1742`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries

noncomputable section

variable {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

/-- The operator `H_W` of the EPR projection argument, averaged over all
generalized Pauli labels. Paper lines 1725-1733 define this average after
reindexing by a nonzero element of the binary basis. -/
def pauliCorrelation (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ((ι → K) × (ι → K)) :=
  (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ •
    ∑ u : ι → K, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W u) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W u)













end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction

/-! # Operations on finite distributions

Finite distributions support products, convex mixtures, dependent binds,
normalized restrictions, and push-forwards.  Uniform laws are preserved by
bijections and balanced maps, their product projections are uniform, and
dependent uniform sampling agrees with push-forward from a product.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT

/-- The product of two finite distributions, a formalization-only auxiliary
used by the sandwich construction; blueprint `lem:ld-sandwich`,
paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-501`. -/
noncomputable def Distribution.prod {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (μ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution α) (ν : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution β) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (α × β) where
  support := μ.support.product ν.support
  weight p := μ.weight p.1 * ν.weight p.2
  nonnegative p := mul_nonneg (μ.nonnegative p.1) (ν.nonnegative p.2)
  outsideSupport p hp := by
    by_cases hμ : p.1 ∈ μ.support
    · have hν : p.2 ∉ ν.support := by
        intro h
        exact hp (Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hμ, h⟩)
      simp [ν.outsideSupport p.2 hν]
    · simp [μ.outsideSupport p.1 hμ]



/-- The convex mixture with a coefficient in `[0,1]`, as used for
the equal mixture in blueprint
`def:line-point-dist`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`. -/
noncomputable def Distribution.mix {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1)
    (μ ν : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution α) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution α where
  support := μ.support ∪ ν.support
  weight a := t * μ.weight a + (1 - t) * ν.weight a
  nonnegative a := by
    exact add_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg ht0 (μ.nonnegative a))
      (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1) (ν.nonnegative a))
  outsideSupport a ha := by
    have hμ : a ∉ μ.support := fun h => ha (Finset.mem_union_left _ h)
    have hν : a ∉ ν.support := fun h => ha (Finset.mem_union_right _ h)
    simp [μ.outsideSupport a hμ, ν.outsideSupport a hν]

/-- A convex mixture of probability distributions is a probability distribution;
blueprint `def:line-point-dist`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`. -/
theorem Distribution.mix_isProbability {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (t : ℝ) (μ ν : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution α) (hμ : μ.IsProbability)
    (hν : ν.IsProbability) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.mix t ht0 ht1 μ ν).IsProbability := by
  have hμ_union :
      ∑ a ∈ μ.support ∪ ν.support, μ.weight a = 1 := by
    apply hμ.weight_sum_eq_one_of_subset
    intro a ha
    exact Finset.mem_union_left ν.support ha
  have hν_union :
      ∑ a ∈ μ.support ∪ ν.support, ν.weight a = 1 := by
    apply hν.weight_sum_eq_one_of_subset
    intro a ha
    exact Finset.mem_union_right μ.support ha
  simp only [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.IsProbability, _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.totalWeight,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.mix]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    hμ_union, hν_union]
  ring

/-- The dependent bind of finite distributions used for typed question
distributions, blueprint `def:typed-cl-distributions`, paper
`07_types.tex:84-94`. -/
noncomputable def Distribution.bind {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq β]
    (μ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution α) (ν : α → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution β) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution β where
  support := μ.support.biUnion (fun a => (ν a).support)
  weight b := ∑ a ∈ μ.support, μ.weight a * (ν a).weight b

as in blueprint

noncomputable def Distribution.restrict {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]

The results of this section are not named in the paper.  They record the

/-- Formalization-only lemma: two finite distributions coincide as soon as
their supports and weight functions coincide.  This is the support statement
`lem:distribution-ext-support` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
theorem Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight {α : Type*} {μ ν : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution α}
    (hsupport : μ.support = ν.support) (hweight : μ.weight = ν.weight) :
    μ = ν := by
  cases μ with
  | mk s w hn ho =>
    cases ν with
    | mk s' w' hn' ho' =>
      have hs : s = s' := hsupport
      have hw : w = w' := hweight
      subst hs
      subst hw
      rfl

/-- Formalization-only lemma: successive push-forwards of a finite distribution
compose.  This is `lem:distribution-map-comp` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
theorem Distribution.map_map {α β γ : Type*}
    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (μ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution α) (e : α → β) (f : β → γ) :
    (μ.map e).map f = μ.map fun a => f (e a) := by
  refine _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
  · change (μ.support.image e).image f = μ.support.image fun a => f (e a)
    rw [Finset.image_image]
    rfl
  · funext c
    have hmaps : ∀ a ∈ μ.support.filter fun a => f (e a) = c,
        e a ∈ (μ.support.image e).filter fun b => f b = c := by
      intro a ha
      obtain ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ ha1, ha2⟩
    have hkey := Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmaps μ.weight
    change (∑ b ∈ (μ.support.image e).filter fun b => f b = c,
        ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter fun a => e a = b, μ.weight a) =
      ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter fun a => f (e a) = c, μ.weight a
    rw [← hkey]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb => ?_
    obtain ⟨-, hb2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hb
    congr 1
    ext a
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨ha1, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨ha1, hb2⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨ha1, -⟩, hae⟩
      exact ⟨ha1, hae⟩

theorem uniformDistribution_weight_apply (α : Type*)

  simp [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution]

theorem uniformDistribution_map_weight {α γ : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] [DecidableEq γ]
    (e : α → γ) (c : γ) :
    ((_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution α).map e).weight c =
      (((Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun x => e x = c).card : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) *
        (1 / (Fintype.card α : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)) := by
  change (∑ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).filter (fun x => e x = c),
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution α).weight x) = _
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.uniformDistribution_weight_apply α x,
    Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]

/-- Formalization-only lemma: a map whose fibers all have the same cardinality

`lem:uniform-map-equal-fibers` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
theorem uniformDistribution_map_of_card_fiber {α β : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β]
    (e : α → β) (c : ℕ)
    (hc : ∀ b : β, ((Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun a => e a = b).card = c) :
    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution α).map e = _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution β := by
  have hcpos : 0 < c := by
    obtain ⟨a₀⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty α)
    have hmem : a₀ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun a => e a = e a₀ :=
      Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    have hpos := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨a₀, hmem⟩
    rwa [hc] at hpos

    have h := Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
      (f := e) (s := (Finset.univ : Finset α)) (t := (Finset.univ : Finset β))
      (fun a _ => Finset.mem_univ _)

  refine _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
  · change (Finset.univ : Finset α).image e = (Finset.univ : Finset β)

    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hne

    have hbeta : (Fintype.card β : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) ≠ 0 := by

    have hc' : (c : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hcpos.ne'

theorem uniformDistribution_map_fst {α β : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] :
    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (α × β)).map Prod.fst = _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution α := by

theorem bind_uniformOnFinset_map {α β γ σ : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [Nonempty σ]
    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] [DecidableEq γ]
    (s : Finset α) (f : σ → α) (hinj : Function.Injective f)

      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (σ × β)).map fun q => g (f q.1) q.2 := by

    intro a

  have hcard : s.card = Fintype.card σ := by
    rw [← himage, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj, Finset.card_univ]
  have hsum : ∀ h : α → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error, ∑ a ∈ s, h a = ∑ x : σ, h (f x) := by

        ((_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution β).map (g a)).weight c =
        (((Finset.univ : Finset β).filter fun b => g a b = c).card : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) *

        (1 / ((Fintype.card σ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) * (Fintype.card β : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error))),
      ← Finset.sum_mul,
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.uniformDistribution_weight_apply (σ × β) q,
      Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hcount, Fintype.card_prod]

`lem:restricted-line-mixture-bounds`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1052-1058`. -/
theorem avgOver_mix {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t)
    (ht1 : t ≤ 1) (μ ν : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution α) (f : α → ℝ) :

    refine (Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_left ?_).symm
    intro a _ ha
    rw [μ.outsideSupport a ha, zero_mul]

      ∑ a ∈ ν.support, ν.weight a * f a := by
    refine (Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_right ?_).symm
    intro a _ ha
    rw [ν.outsideSupport a ha, zero_mul]

    (t * μ.weight a + (1 - t) * ν.weight a) * f a) = _
  rw [hsplit, hμ, hν]

equivalences.  These forms are used by the directly indexed low-degree
line-point laws and by the correspondence between the seed-indexed and directly

`lem:uniform-first-marginal-after-equivalence` in blueprint chapter 13. -/

    {alpha beta gamma : Type*}

    [Fintype beta] [DecidableEq beta] [Nonempty beta]
    [Finite gamma] [Nonempty gamma]

  classical
  letI : Fintype gamma := Fintype.ofFinite gamma
  calc
    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution alpha).map f =
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution alpha).map (fun a => (e a).1) := by
      congr 1
      funext a
      exact hf a
    _ = ((_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution alpha).map e).map Prod.fst :=
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.map_map _ _ _).symm
    _ = (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (beta × gamma)).map Prod.fst := by
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.uniformDistribution_map_equiv]
    _ = _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution beta := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.uniformDistribution_map_fst

/-! # Quantitative support for sandwiched measurements

This module develops the consistency and operator-distance estimates used
in the quantitative sandwich argument.

## References

Blueprint `lem:ld-sandwich` and `lem:ld-sandwich-measurement`; paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-501`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum
open DistanceCalculus

namespace SandwichProduct

/-- Averaging over the product of two finite distributions is iterated
averaging. This is the formalization-only identity
`lem:sandwich-product-average` used in the proof of `lem:ld-sandwich`; detailed
source argument `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:952-994`. -/
theorem avgOver_distribution_prod {X Y : Type*}
    [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] (μ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution X) (ν : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution Y)
    (f : X × Y → ℝ) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.prod μ ν) f =
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver μ (fun x => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver ν (fun y => f (x, y))) := by
  unfold _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver
  change (∑ p ∈ μ.support.product ν.support,
    (μ.weight p.1 * ν.weight p.2) * f p) = _
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ μ.support.product ν.support,
        (μ.weight p.1 * ν.weight p.2) * f p) =
        ∑ x ∈ μ.support, ∑ y ∈ ν.support,
          (μ.weight x * ν.weight y) * f (x, y) := by
      exact Finset.sum_product' μ.support ν.support
        (fun x y => (μ.weight x * ν.weight y) * f (x, y))
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      ring















/-- Coarsening the outcomes of a projective measurement preserves
projectivity. This is the formalization-only fact
`lem:sandwich-postprocess-projective` used in the palindromic construction of
`lem:ld-sandwich`; detailed source argument
`references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:930-946`. -/
theorem postprocess_isProjective {α β ι : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ι) (hM : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
    (f : α → β) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M.postprocess f) := by
  classical
  intro b
  refine { isIdempotentElem := ?_, isSelfAdjoint := ?_ }
  · change (M.postprocess f).effect b * (M.postprocess f).effect b =
      (M.postprocess f).effect b
    simp only [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    calc
      (∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b),
          ∑ a' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a' => f a' = b),
            M.effect a * M.effect a') =
          ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b),
            ∑ a' ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a' => f a' = b),
              if a' = a then M.effect a else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a' _
        by_cases haa' : a' = a
        · subst a'
          simp [(hM a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
        · rw [if_neg haa']
          exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero
            M hM (Ne.symm haa')
      _ = ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b), M.effect a := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a ha
        simp [ha]
  · change ((M.postprocess f).effect b)ᴴ = (M.postprocess f).effect b
    exact
      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp ((M.postprocess f).pos b)).isHermitian.eq



/-- An injective relabeling does not merge the effect at a relabeled
outcome. This is the formalization-only identity
`lem:sandwich-injective-postprocess` used to identify product outcomes in
`lem:ld-sandwich`; detailed source argument
`references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:930-946`. -/
theorem postprocess_effect_of_injective {α β ι : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ι) (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) (a : α) :
    (M.postprocess f).effect (f a) = M.effect a := by
  simp only [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single a]
  · simp
  · intro z hza
    rw [if_neg]
    exact fun h => hza (hf h)











end SandwichProduct

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-! # Typed conditionally linear distributions

Typed question distributions first sample an ordered edge of the type graph and
then sample the corresponding pair of conditionally linear images of one common
uniform seed.

## References

These are blueprint `def:typed-cl-functions` and `def:typed-cl-distributions`,
with paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/07_types.tex:57-94`.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT



/-- The typed CL distribution: sample a type pair from the graph distribution,
then bind it to the CL distribution selected by those two types. This is
blueprint `def:typed-cl-distributions`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/07_types.tex:84-94`. -/
noncomputable def typedCLDistribution {K T ι : Type*}
    [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Fintype T] [DecidableEq T] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (E : Finset (Sym2 T)) (hE : E.Nonempty)
    (L R : T → (ι → K) → (ι → K)) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution ((T × (ι → K)) × (T × (ι → K))) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.bind (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.graphDistribution E hE) fun uv =>
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.clDistribution (L uv.1) (R uv.2)).map fun xy =>
      ((uv.1, xy.1), (uv.2, xy.2))

/-- A typed conditionally linear distribution built from a single family is
symmetric under exchanging the two players: the edge law of
`def:graph-distribution` is symmetric, and exchanging the two types exchanges
the two images of the common seed.  This is not a named statement of the source
article; it is `lem:typed-cl-distribution-symm` in
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex`. -/
theorem typedCLDistribution_symm {K T ι : Type*}
    [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Fintype T] [DecidableEq T] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (E : Finset (Sym2 T)) (hE : E.Nonempty)
    (L : T → (ι → K) → (ι → K))
    (c : (T × (ι → K)) × (T × (ι → K))) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.typedCLDistribution E hE L L).weight c =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.typedCLDistribution E hE L L).weight c.swap := by
  classical
  have hinner : ∀ (u v : T) (w : (T × (ι → K)) × (T × (ι → K))),
      ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.clDistribution (L u) (L v)).map fun xy => ((u, xy.1), (v, xy.2))).weight w =
        (((Finset.univ : Finset (ι → K)).filter
            fun z => ((u, L u z), (v, L v z)) = w).card : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) *
          (1 / (Fintype.card (ι → K) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)) := by
    intro u v w
    have hmap : ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.clDistribution (L u) (L v)).map fun xy => ((u, xy.1), (v, xy.2))) =
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (ι → K)).map fun z => ((u, L u z), (v, L v z)) := by
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.clDistribution]
      exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.map_map _ _ _
    rw [hmap, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.uniformDistribution_map_weight]
  have hfib : ∀ (u v : T) (w : (T × (ι → K)) × (T × (ι → K))),
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (ι → K)).filter
          fun z => ((u, L u z), (v, L v z)) = w) =
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (ι → K)).filter
          fun z => ((v, L v z), (u, L u z)) = w.swap) := by
    rintro u v ⟨w₁, w₂⟩
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro z _
    exact Prod.swap_inj.symm
  have hbind : ∀ w : (T × (ι → K)) × (T × (ι → K)),
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.typedCLDistribution E hE L L).weight w =
        ∑ uv : T × T, (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.graphDistribution E hE).weight uv *
          ((((Finset.univ : Finset (ι → K)).filter
              fun z => ((uv.1, L uv.1 z), (uv.2, L uv.2 z)) = w).card : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) *
            (1 / (Fintype.card (ι → K) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error))) := by
    intro w
    have hsupport : (∑ uv ∈ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.graphDistribution E hE).support,
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.graphDistribution E hE).weight uv *
          ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.clDistribution (L uv.1) (L uv.2)).map
            fun xy => ((uv.1, xy.1), (uv.2, xy.2))).weight w) =
        ∑ uv : T × T, (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.graphDistribution E hE).weight uv *
          ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.clDistribution (L uv.1) (L uv.2)).map
            fun xy => ((uv.1, xy.1), (uv.2, xy.2))).weight w := by
      refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) fun uv _ huv => ?_
      rw [(_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.graphDistribution E hE).outsideSupport uv huv, zero_mul]
    change (∑ uv ∈ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.graphDistribution E hE).support,
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.graphDistribution E hE).weight uv *
        ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.clDistribution (L uv.1) (L uv.2)).map
          fun xy => ((uv.1, xy.1), (uv.2, xy.2))).weight w) = _
    rw [hsupport]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun uv _ => by rw [hinner uv.1 uv.2 w]
  rw [hbind c, hbind c.swap]
  refine Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.prodComm T T) _ _ ?_
  rintro ⟨u, v⟩
  change (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.graphDistribution E hE).weight (u, v) *
      ((((Finset.univ : Finset (ι → K)).filter
          fun z => ((u, L u z), (v, L v z)) = c).card : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) *
        (1 / (Fintype.card (ι → K) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error))) =
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.graphDistribution E hE).weight (v, u) *
      ((((Finset.univ : Finset (ι → K)).filter
          fun z => ((v, L v z), (u, L u z)) = c.swap).card : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) *
        (1 / (Fintype.card (ι → K) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error)))
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.graphDistribution_symm E hE u v, hfib u v c]

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Lines, bounded line polynomials, and line-point distributions

This file provides the seed-bearing line descriptions and coefficient-list
polynomials shared by the observable and combining chapters. It also realizes
the line-point distribution directly from the conditionally linear sampler.
Over a finite coefficient field, bounded individual-degree multivariate
polynomials form a finite outcome set for the associated measurements.

## References

The line and bounded-polynomial definitions are blueprint
`def:ideg-deg-polynomials`, with source origin
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:51-58`. The
line-point sampler is `def:line-point-dist` in blueprint chapter 13, from
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries

noncomputable section

/-- A formalization-only identity used to construct canonical line
descriptions: applying the canonical line-representative projection twice has
the same effect as applying it once. -/
theorem lineRepMap_apply_self {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
    (v u : Fin m → K) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap v (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap v u) = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap v u := by
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.canonicalProjOfKernel, LinearMap.comp_apply]

/-- The two presentations of lines used by the low-degree question sampler. -/
inductive LineKind where
  | axis
  | diagonal
  deriving DecidableEq

instance LineKind.instFintype : Fintype _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineKind :=
  ⟨{.axis, .diagonal}, by intro x; cases x <;> simp⟩

/-- A seed-bearing line description for blueprint
`def:line-point-dist`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:143-174,243-287`.

An axis description stores its canonical base and seed. A diagonal description
stores only the projected direction, together with its prefix-zero invariant.
Both cases carry the assertion that their base is fixed by the
appropriate `lineRepMap`. Coordinates are numbered from zero; coordinate `j`
corresponds to the paper's coordinate `j + 1`. -/
inductive LineDesc (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) where
  | axis (base : Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) (seed : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)
      (baseFixed : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex L seed)) base = base)
  | diagonal (base : Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) (seed : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)
      (direction : Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)
      (baseFixed : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap direction base = base)
      (prefixZero : ∀ j : Fin L.m, j.val < (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex L seed).val → direction j = 0)
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- The tag of a canonical line description. -/
def LineDesc.kind {L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams} : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineKind
  | .axis _ _ _ => .axis
  | .diagonal _ _ _ _ _ => .diagonal

/-- The seed retained by a canonical line description. -/
def LineDesc.seed {L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams} : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L
  | .axis _ seed _ => seed
  | .diagonal _ seed _ _ _ => seed

/-- The canonical base stored by a line description. -/
def LineDesc.base {L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams} : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L → Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L
  | .axis base _ _ => base
  | .diagonal base _ _ _ _ => base

/-- The geometric direction represented by a canonical line description.
Diagonal descriptions already store the projected data, so this map does
not apply a second projection. -/
def LineDesc.direction {L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams} (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L) :
    Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L :=
  match line with
  | .axis _ seed _ => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex L seed)
  | .diagonal _ _ direction _ _ => direction





/-- The point set represented by a seed-bearing line description. -/
noncomputable def LineDesc.pointSet {L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams} (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L) :
    Set (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePoints line.base line.direction



/-- Coefficient-list representation of a univariate polynomial of degree at
most `c` over the scalar field of `L`. -/
abbrev DegPoly (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (c : ℕ) := Fin (c + 1) → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L

/-- Extend a coefficient list by zero from degree bound `c` to `c'`. -/
def DegPoly.padTo {L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams} {c c' : ℕ} (_h : c ≤ c')
    (f : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly L c) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly L c' :=
  fun i =>
    if hi : i.val < c + 1 then f ⟨i.val, hi⟩ else 0

/-- A line polynomial evaluates to `a` at `u` when `u` has a line parameter
and every such parameter gives the same value.  The universal clause handles
the zero-direction presentation without choosing a sentinel parameter. -/
def EvaluatesTo {L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams} {c : ℕ} (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L)
    (f : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly L c) (u : Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) : Prop :=
  (∃ t : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L, u = line.base + t • line.direction) ∧
    ∀ t : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L, u = line.base + t • line.direction → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalCoefficient f t = a

/-- Partially evaluate a line polynomial at a point. The value is undefined
when the point does not determine an evaluation. This formalization-only
completion is used in blueprint chapter 14; the displayed family at paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:197-206` has no bottom outcome. -/
noncomputable def evalOpt {L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams} {c : ℕ} (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L)
    (u : Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) (f : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly L c) : Option (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) := by
  classical
  exact if h : ∃ a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.EvaluatesTo line f u a then
    some (Classical.choose h)
  else none

/-- Convert an axis-line CL output to its seed-bearing presentation; paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-257,276-287`. -/
def aLineDescOf (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace L) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L :=
  let direction := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex L line.seed)
  let base := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap direction line.point
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc.axis base line.seed (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap_apply_self direction line.point)

/-- Convert a diagonal-line CL output to its seed-bearing presentation; paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:261-287`. -/
def dLineDescOf (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace L) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L :=
  let direction := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.prefixProjection (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex L line.seed) line.direction
  let base := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap direction line.point
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc.diagonal base line.seed direction
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap_apply_self direction line.point) (by
      intro j hj
      change _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.prefixProjection (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex L line.seed) line.direction j = 0
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.prefixProjection, if_pos hj])

/-- The axis-line/point component of the low-degree line-point sampler; paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-257,274-287`. -/
noncomputable def aLinePointDist (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.clDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldALineCL L) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldPointCL L)).map fun sample =>
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aLineDescOf L sample.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace.point sample.2)

/-- The diagonal-line/point component of the low-degree line-point sampler; paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:261-287`. -/
noncomputable def dLinePointDist (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.clDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldDLineCL L) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldPointCL L)).map fun sample =>
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.dLineDescOf L sample.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace.point sample.2)

/-- The equal mixture of axis and diagonal line-point samples from
`def:line-point-dist`; paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`. -/
noncomputable def linePointDist (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.mix (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aLinePointDist L) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.dLinePointDist L)

/-- The affine line-point component has total probability one. -/
theorem aLinePointDist_isProbability (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aLinePointDist L).IsProbability :=
  ((_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution_isProbability _).map _).map _

/-- The diagonal line-point component has total probability one. -/
theorem dLinePointDist_isProbability (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.dLinePointDist L).IsProbability :=
  ((_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution_isProbability _).map _).map _

/-- The line-point mixture has total probability one. -/
theorem linePointDist_isProbability (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L).IsProbability := by
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.mix_isProbability _ _ _
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aLinePointDist_isProbability L) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.dLinePointDist_isProbability L)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Zero-direction mass for axis lines

This module records that the axis-line component of the line-point sampler has
no mass at zero direction.

## References

The sampler is `def:line-point-dist`, from
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT

noncomputable section

/-- Axis-line sampling gives zero mass to zero directions, since a coordinate
direction is nonzero. This is a formalization-only consequence of
`def:line-point-dist`, paper `08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`. -/
theorem aLinePointDist_zero_direction_mass (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aLinePointDist L) (fun sample =>
      if sample.1.direction = 0 then 1 else 0) = 0 := by
  classical
  unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aLinePointDist
  rw [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.avgOver_map]
  have hdir (raw : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace L) : (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aLineDescOf L raw).direction ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hcoord := congrFun hzero (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex L raw.seed)
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aLineDescOf, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc.direction, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection] at hcoord
  simp [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver, hdir]

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Retained mass for nondegenerate-line pasting

This module defines the mass retained when the first line in the product
line-point law is restricted to nonzero direction and proves uniform lower and
upper bounds for that mass.

## References

The restriction is the proof-only conditioning used in `lem:qld-xz-lines`,
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:950-963`.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT

noncomputable section

/-- Probability retained by the proof-only first-line nondegeneracy
restriction in the pasting argument for `lem:qld-xz-lines`. -/
def nondegenerateLinePastingMass (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) : ℝ :=
  ∑ samples ∈
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.prod (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L)).support.filter
        (fun samples => samples.1.1.direction ≠ 0),
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.prod (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L)).weight samples

/-- The retained product-law mass lies between one half and one. -/
theorem nondegenerateLinePastingMass_bounds (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    1 / 2 ≤ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.nondegenerateLinePastingMass L ∧
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.nondegenerateLinePastingMass L ≤ 1 := by
  classical
  let indicator := fun sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) =>
    if sample.1.direction ≠ 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0
  have hmass : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.nondegenerateLinePastingMass L =
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L) indicator := by
    unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.nondegenerateLinePastingMass
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.sum_filter_weight_eq_avgOver, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SandwichProduct.avgOver_distribution_prod]
    change _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L) (fun sample =>
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L) (fun _ => indicator sample)) = _
    simp_rw [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_const_of_isProbability _ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist_isProbability L)]
  have haxis : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aLinePointDist L) indicator = 1 := by
    have hindicator : indicator = fun sample =>
        1 - if sample.1.direction = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
      funext sample
      by_cases hzero : sample.1.direction = 0 <;> simp [indicator, hzero]
    rw [hindicator, _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_sub,
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_const_of_isProbability _ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aLinePointDist_isProbability L),
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aLinePointDist_zero_direction_mass]
    norm_num
  have hdiag : 0 ≤ _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.dLinePointDist L) indicator :=
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_nonneg _ _ fun sample => by
      by_cases hzero : sample.1.direction = 0 <;> simp [indicator, hzero]
  have hlower : 1 / 2 ≤ _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L) indicator := by
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.avgOver_mix, haxis]
    norm_num
    linarith
  rw [hmass]
  refine ⟨hlower, ?_⟩
  calc
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L) indicator ≤
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L) (fun _ => 1) :=
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun sample => by
        by_cases hzero : sample.1.direction = 0 <;> simp [indicator, hzero]
    _ = 1 := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver_const_of_isProbability _ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist_isProbability L) 1

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Nondegenerate-line pasting distribution

This module constructs the proof-only normalized product line-point law whose
first sampled line has nonzero direction.

## References

The conditioning supports the pasting argument in `lem:qld-xz-lines`,
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:950-963`, using
the normalized question laws from
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT

noncomputable section

/-- The first-line nondegeneracy event has positive mass under the product
line-point law. -/
theorem prod_linePointDist_nondegenerate_mass_pos (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    0 < ∑ samples ∈
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.prod (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L)).support.filter
          (fun samples => samples.1.1.direction ≠ 0),
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.prod (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L)).weight samples := by
  change 0 < _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.nondegenerateLinePastingMass L
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.nondegenerateLinePastingMass_bounds L).1

/-- Proof-only question law obtained by conditioning the product line-point law
on nonzero first-line direction and relabeling the two samples for pasting. -/
def nondegenerateLinePastingDist (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L) ×
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L))) ×
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L))) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.restrict (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.prod (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist L))
    (fun samples => samples.1.1.direction ≠ 0)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.prod_linePointDist_nondegenerate_mass_pos L)).map
      (fun samples => (((samples.1.1, samples.2.1), samples.2), samples.1))



end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Restriction of low-degree encodings to canonical lines

This module substitutes a canonical line into a multivariate polynomial and
records the resulting univariate polynomial as a coefficient list. The
multilinear low-degree encoding has degree at most `m ≤ m*d` on any line and
degree at most `1 ≤ d` on an axis-parallel line. Its coefficient list evaluates
to the original encoding at every point on the line, including a line with
zero direction.

## References

The encoding is equation `eq:ld-encoding` in
`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:869-896`. Restriction supplies the
line answers in `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1244-1273`, and the ancillary
line projector in the proof of `lem:qld-comm-line-cons`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-556`. The restriction bounds and
evaluation identities are recorded in blueprint
`lem:low-degree-encoding-line-restriction`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT

noncomputable section

/-- Substitute the affine parameterization of a canonical line into a
multivariate polynomial. This is the polynomial `g_h(u₀ + tv)` used in
`def:expanded-line-measurement`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:535-557`, blueprint
`def:expanded-line-measurement`. -/
noncomputable def polynomialOnLine (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L)
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin L.m) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)) : Polynomial (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) :=
  MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom _root_.Polynomial.C
    (fun i : Fin L.m =>
      (_root_.Polynomial.C (line.base i) +
        _root_.Polynomial.X * _root_.Polynomial.C (line.direction i) :
        Polynomial (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L))) g

/-- The degree-`m*d` coefficient list obtained by restricting `g` to `line`.
This is the concrete restriction operation in `def:expanded-line-measurement`,
paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:535-557`, blueprint
`def:expanded-line-measurement`. -/
noncomputable def restrictToLine (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L)
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin L.m) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly L (L.m * L.d) :=
  fun i => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.polynomialOnLine L line g).coeff i.val











/-- A degree-`m*d` coefficient list actually lies in the embedded degree-`d`
subspace when all coefficients above `d` vanish. This is the coefficient
interpretation of `deg_d(line) ⊆ deg_md(line)` in
`def:expanded-line-measurement`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:548-557`. -/
def DegPoly.FitsDegree {L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams} {c : ℕ} (d : ℕ)
    (f : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly L c) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin (c + 1), d < i.val → f i = 0



/-! ## Evaluation of the restriction along the line -/











end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Exact bridges for the compact Palomar game foundation

This module converts the compact Mathlib-only game and strategy data to and
from the library structures.  The conversions preserve every effect, state,
Born value, and the projective, consistency, commutation, and SPCC predicates.

This bridge uses the repository's legacy import form because Lean `module`
files cannot import the current non-`module` game API.  The compact foundation
itself uses the public module surface required by the Palomar extraction.

## References

`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:10-57,68-180`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

/-- The canonical project distribution associated to a finite Mathlib PMF. -/
noncomputable def pmfDistribution {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p : PMF α) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution α where
  support := Finset.univ
  weight := fun a => (p a).toReal
  nonnegative := fun _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  outsideSupport := by simp

/-- The canonical distribution associated to a PMF has total mass one. -/
theorem pmfDistribution_isProbability {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p : PMF α) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pmfDistribution p).IsProbability := by
  simpa [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.IsProbability, _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.totalWeight, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pmfDistribution] using
    _root_.LIDT.PMF.sum_toReal_eq_one p

/-- Converting a finite PMF to a project distribution and back is exact. -/
@[simp] theorem pmfDistribution_toPMF {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p : PMF α) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pmfDistribution p).toPMF (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pmfDistribution_isProbability p) = p := by
  ext a
  rw [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.toPMF_apply]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (p.apply_ne_top a)

namespace Game

/-- Convert a library game to the compact PMF representation. -/
noncomputable def ofGame (G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game G.QuestionA G.QuestionB G.AnswerA G.AnswerB where
  μ := G.μ.toPMF G.μ_prob
  decide := G.decide

/-- Convert a compact game to the library representation with canonical full support. -/
noncomputable def toGame {X Y A B : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B] (G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game X Y A B) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game where
  QuestionA := X
  QuestionB := Y
  AnswerA := A
  AnswerB := B
  μ := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pmfDistribution G.μ
  μ_prob := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pmfDistribution_isProbability G.μ
  decide := G.decide

/-- The canonical library conversion has exactly the original question PMF. -/
@[simp] theorem toGame_questionPMF {X Y A B : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B] (G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game X Y A B) :
    (G.toGame.μ.toPMF G.toGame.μ_prob) = G.μ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pmfDistribution_toPMF G.μ

/-- Compact-to-library-to-compact game conversion is exact. -/
@[simp] theorem ofGame_toGame {X Y A B : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y]
    [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B] (G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game X Y A B) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.ofGame G.toGame = G := by
  cases G
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.ofGame, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.toGame]
  rfl

/-- Library-to-compact-to-library conversion preserves the question PMF exactly. -/
@[simp] theorem ofGame_toGame_questionPMF (G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.ofGame G).toGame.μ.toPMF (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.ofGame G).toGame.μ_prob) = G.μ.toPMF G.μ_prob := by
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.toGame_questionPMF]
  rfl

end Game

namespace SymmetricGame

/-- Convert a library symmetric game to the compact PMF representation. -/
noncomputable def ofSymmetricGame (G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SymmetricGame) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricGame G.Question G.Answer where
  toGame :=
    { μ := G.μ.toPMF G.μ_prob
      decide := G.decide }
  μ_symm := by
    intro x y
    change ENNReal.ofReal (G.μ.weight (x, y)) = ENNReal.ofReal (G.μ.weight (y, x))
    rw [G.μ_symm]
  decide_symm := G.decide_symm

/-- Convert a compact symmetric game to the library representation. -/
noncomputable def toSymmetricGame {X A : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq A]
    (G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricGame X A) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SymmetricGame where
  Question := X
  Answer := A
  μ := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pmfDistribution G.μ
  μ_prob := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pmfDistribution_isProbability G.μ
  μ_symm := fun x y => congrArg ENNReal.toReal (G.μ_symm x y)
  decide := G.decide
  decide_symm := G.decide_symm

/-- Compact-to-library-to-compact symmetric-game conversion is exact. -/
@[simp] theorem ofSymmetricGame_toSymmetricGame
    {X A : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq A]
    (G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricGame X A) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricGame.ofSymmetricGame G.toSymmetricGame = G := by
  cases G
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricGame.ofSymmetricGame, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricGame.toSymmetricGame]
  rfl

end SymmetricGame

/-- Convert a library measurement to a compact POVM. -/
def ofMeasurement {A I : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement A I) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM A I where
  effect := M.effect
  pos := fun a => Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (M.pos a)
  sum_eq_one := M.sum_eq_one

/-- Convert a compact POVM to a library measurement. -/
def toMeasurement {A I : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (M : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM A I) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement A I :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne M.effect
    (fun a => Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr (M.pos a)) M.sum_eq_one

@[simp] theorem ofMeasurement_effect {A I : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype I]
    [DecidableEq I] (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement A I) (a : A) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM.ofMeasurement M).effect a = M.effect a := rfl

@[simp] theorem toMeasurement_effect {A I : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype I]
    [DecidableEq I] (M : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM A I) (a : A) :
    M.toMeasurement.effect a = M.effect a := rfl

/-- Compact-to-library-to-compact POVM conversion is exact. -/
@[simp] theorem ofMeasurement_toMeasurement {A I : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype I]
    [DecidableEq I] (M : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM A I) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM.ofMeasurement M.toMeasurement = M := by
  cases M
  rfl

/-- Library-to-compact-to-library measurement conversion is exact. -/
@[simp] theorem toMeasurement_ofMeasurement {A I : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype I]
    [DecidableEq I] (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement A I) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM.ofMeasurement M).toMeasurement = M := by
  apply _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ext
  intro a
  rfl





end POVM

namespace Strategy

/-- Convert a library strategy to compact carrier-parametric data. -/
def ofStrategy {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game} (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy G.QuestionA G.QuestionB G.AnswerA G.AnswerB where
  ιA := S.ιA
  ιB := S.ιB
  ψ := S.ψ
  ψ_norm := S.ψ_norm
  alice := fun x => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM.ofMeasurement (S.A x)
  bob := fun y => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM.ofMeasurement (S.B y)

/-- Convert compact strategy data to a strategy for a library game on the same carriers. -/
def toStrategy {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy G.QuestionA G.QuestionB G.AnswerA G.AnswerB) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G where
  ιA := S.ιA
  ιB := S.ιB
  ψ := S.ψ
  ψ_norm := S.ψ_norm
  A := fun x => (S.alice x).toMeasurement
  B := fun y => (S.bob y).toMeasurement

/-- Strategy conversion preserves Alice's effects pointwise. -/
@[simp] theorem toStrategy_alice_effect {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy G.QuestionA G.QuestionB G.AnswerA G.AnswerB)
    (x : G.QuestionA) (a : G.AnswerA) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy.toStrategy S).A x).effect a = (S.alice x).effect a := rfl

/-- Strategy conversion preserves Bob's effects pointwise. -/
@[simp] theorem toStrategy_bob_effect {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy G.QuestionA G.QuestionB G.AnswerA G.AnswerB)
    (y : G.QuestionB) (b : G.AnswerB) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy.toStrategy S).B y).effect b = (S.bob y).effect b := rfl

/-- Library-to-compact-to-library strategy conversion is exact. -/
@[simp] theorem toStrategy_ofStrategy {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy.toStrategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy.ofStrategy S) = S := by
  cases S
  rfl

/-- Compact-to-library-to-compact strategy conversion is exact. -/
@[simp] theorem ofStrategy_toStrategy {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy G.QuestionA G.QuestionB G.AnswerA G.AnswerB) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy.ofStrategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy.toStrategy S) = S := by
  cases S
  rfl









end Strategy









namespace SymmetricStrategy

/-- Convert a library symmetric strategy to compact data. -/
def ofSymmetricStrategy {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SymmetricGame}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SymmetricStrategy G) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricStrategy G.Question G.Answer where

  ψ_norm := S.ψ_norm
  ψ_swap := S.ψ_swap

@[simp] theorem toSymmetricStrategy_ofSymmetricStrategy
    {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SymmetricGame} (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SymmetricStrategy G) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricStrategy.toSymmetricStrategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricStrategy.ofSymmetricStrategy S) = S := by

  rfl

/-!
# Low-degree sampling and polynomial measurements

The low-degree question laws have uniform point and coordinate-index marginals,
and every sampled line is incident to its paired point.  Polynomial outcomes
are bounded multivariate polynomials. The soundness theorem using these
definitions is proved in `LowDegreeGameTheorems`.

## References

The principal definition and theorem are blueprint `def:ld-meas` and
`lem:ld-soundness`. Their paper origin is
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-287,392-480`.
The dimension-divisibility hypothesis is documented in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-!
### Formalization-only auxiliary facts about the ambient low-degree space
-/

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary equivalence splitting an ambient low-degree
vector into its point, seed, and direction blocks. -/
def ldSpaceSplit (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace L ≃ ((Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) where
  toFun z := ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace.point z, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace.seed z), _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace.direction z)
  invFun p := fun i =>
    match i with
    | .inl (.inl j) => p.1.1 j
    | .inl (.inr _) => p.1.2
    | .inr j => p.2 j
  left_inv z := by
    funext i
    rcases i with (j | u) | j
    · rfl
    · cases u
      rfl
    · rfl
  right_inv p := by
    obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, c⟩ := p
    rfl





/-- The coordinate index of a uniformly random scalar is uniform.  This is the
balance assertion in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
`lem:chi-index-uniform`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:215-221`.
-/
theorem uniformDistribution_map_chiIndex (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)).map (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex L) =
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (Fin L.m) := by
  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedFiberEquiv L) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex L) fun s => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedFiberEquiv_fst L s).symm

















/-- Bounded multivariate polynomials form a finite set over a finite coefficient
semiring. This is the finite outcome set required by blueprint
`def:ld-meas`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:394-408`. -/
noncomputable instance polyFuncFintype (m : ℕ) (K : Type*)
    [CommSemiring K] [Fintype K] (d : ℕ) : Fintype ↥(_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc m K d) := by
  letI : Finite ↥(_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc m K d) := Module.finite_of_finite K
  exact Fintype.ofFinite _

/-- A bounded multivariate polynomial outcome over an arbitrary finite
coefficient semiring. -/
noncomputable abbrev PolyIndex (m : ℕ) (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K]
    [Fintype K] (d : ℕ) := ↥(_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc m K d)

/-- A POVM indexed by one bounded multivariate polynomial. -/
noncomputable abbrev PolyMeas (m : ℕ) (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K]
    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] (d : ℕ) (ι : Type*)
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyIndex m K d) ι

/-- The dependent family in `def:ld-meas`: component `i` may
have its own coefficient field, number of variables, and degree bound.
Blueprint `def:ld-meas`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:394-408`. -/
noncomputable abbrev PolyMeasFamily (k : ℕ) (K : Fin k → Type*)
    [∀ i, CommSemiring (K i)] [∀ i, Fintype (K i)]
    [∀ i, DecidableEq (K i)] (m d : Fin k → ℕ) (ι : Type*)
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement ((i : Fin k) → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyIndex (m i) (K i) (d i)) ι

/-- A simultaneous tuple of `L.k` bounded polynomial representatives. -/
noncomputable abbrev PolyTuple (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :=
  Fin L.k → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyIndex L.m (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) L.d

/-- The constant-family specialization used by `lem:ld-soundness`. -/
noncomputable abbrev PolyMeasTuple (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (ι : Type*)
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyMeasFamily L.k (fun _ => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) (fun _ => L.m) (fun _ => L.d) ι

/-- Evaluate every component of a polynomial tuple at a point. -/
def evalPolyTupleAt {L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams} (u : Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)
    (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyTuple L) : Fin L.k → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L :=
  fun j => MvPolynomial.eval u (g j).1

/-- Embed a geometric point into the ambient coefficient space used by a
point question. -/
def pointSpaceOf (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (u : Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace L :=
  fun i => match i with
  | .inl (.inl j) => u j
  | .inl (.inr _) => 0
  | .inr _ => 0

/-- The typed low-degree point question associated with `u`. -/
def ldPointQuestionOf (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (u : Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdQuestion L :=
  (.point, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pointSpaceOf L u)

/-- Read the point component of a low-degree answer, sending answers of the
wrong form to the fixed zero tuple. This total relabeling turns the strategy's
answer measurement into the point POVM used by `lem:ld-soundness`. -/
def ldPointValuesOrZero (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdAnswer L → Fin L.k → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L
  | .pointVals values => values
  | .alinePolys _ => 0
  | .dlinePolys _ => 0

/-- The quantitative error function in `lem:ld-soundness`.  Its argument order
is `(a, b, ε, q, m, d, k)`. -/
noncomputable def deltaLd (a b ε : ℝ) (q m d k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  a * Real.rpow (((d * m * k : ℕ) : ℝ)) a *
    (Real.rpow ε b + Real.rpow (q : ℝ) (-b) +
      Real.rpow 2 (-(b * ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ))))

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT
