/-!
# Independent blocks of the restricted line-point laws

This module isolates the independent generating blocks of the restricted
line-point laws used by the sampling procedure of the sub-line lemma.  A
uniformly sampled low-degree vector splits into a point block and a
seed-direction block; the coordinate-index event constrains only the second
block, so conditioning on it leaves the point block uniform and independent.
The conditioned seed-direction block is the fresh diagonal direction pair of
the sub-line construction, and the uniform mixture of those pairs over the
coordinate index is the unconditioned law.

## References

The generating descriptions support `lem:qld-sublines` in
blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
The restricted laws themselves are `def:ith-restricted-line`, blueprint lines
1209--1228, paper lines 1038--1048.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT

noncomputable section

/-! ## The block decomposition of an ambient low-degree vector -/

/-- Split an ambient low-degree vector into its point block and its
seed-direction block.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`. -/
def ldSpaceBlockEquiv (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace L ≃
      (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) × (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)) where
  toFun z := (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace.point z, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace.seed z, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace.direction z)
  invFun w := fun i =>
    match i with
    | .inl (.inl j) => w.1 j
    | .inl (.inr _) => w.2.1
    | .inr j => w.2.2 j
  left_inv z := by
    funext i
    rcases i with (j | u) | j <;> rfl
  right_inv w := rfl

/-- The coordinate-index event of `def:ith-restricted-line` read on the
seed-direction block of an ambient low-degree vector.  Blueprint
`def:ith-restricted-line`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1048`. -/
def ldSeedDirEvent (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (i : Fin L.m)
    (sw : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)) : Prop :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex L sw.1 = i

/-- Decidability of the coordinate-index event on the seed-direction block. -/
instance ldSeedDirEvent_decidablePred (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
    DecidablePred (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSeedDirEvent L i) := by
  intro sw
  unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSeedDirEvent
  infer_instance

/-- Each coordinate-index event of the seed-direction block carries mass
`1 / m` under the uniform law, because the retained seed is uniform and its
`m` coordinate-index fibers are equal.  Blueprint
`lem:restricted-line-mixture-bounds`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1049-1051`. -/
theorem ldSeedDirEvent_mass (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
    ∑ sw ∈ (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L))).support.filter
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSeedDirEvent L i),
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L))).weight sw =
      1 / (L.m : ℝ) := by
  classical
  have hmap : (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L))).map
        (fun sw => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex L sw.1) = _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (Fin L.m) := by
    rw [← _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.map_map _ Prod.fst (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex L),
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.uniformDistribution_map_fst, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.uniformDistribution_map_chiIndex]
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.sum_filter_weight_eq_avgOver,
    show (fun sw : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) =>
        if _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSeedDirEvent L i sw then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      fun sw => (fun j : Fin L.m => if j = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex L sw.1) from rfl,
    ← _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.avgOver_map
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)))
      (fun sw => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex L sw.1)
      (fun j : Fin L.m => if j = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0), hmap]
  unfold _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.uniformDistribution_weight_apply, mul_ite]

/-- Every coordinate-index event of the seed-direction block has positive
mass.  Blueprint `def:ith-restricted-line`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1048`. -/
theorem ldSeedDirEvent_positive (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
    0 < ∑ sw ∈ (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L))).support.filter
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSeedDirEvent L i),
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L))).weight sw := by
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSeedDirEvent_mass]
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < (L.m : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one L.hm
  positivity

/-! ## Fresh diagonal direction pairs -/

/-- The fresh diagonal direction pair at coordinate index `i`: a scalar seed
uniform in the fiber of `i` together with a direction block uniform on the
whole space.  This is the auxiliary randomness of the sampling procedure of
blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
noncomputable def freshDiagonalPairDist (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.restrict
    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSeedDirEvent L i) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSeedDirEvent_positive L i)





/-! ## Independence of the point block under the coordinate-index event -/



/-! ## Generating form of the restricted line-point laws -/

/-- The axis-line decoder read on the block decomposition. -/
def aLineDescOfBlock (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams)
    (w : (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) × (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L))) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aLineDescOf L ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm w)

/-- The diagonal-line decoder read on the block decomposition. -/
def dLineDescOfBlock (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams)
    (w : (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) × (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)))  :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.dLineDescOf L ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSpaceBlockEquiv L).symm w)





end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Exact bridge for the compact low individual degree game

This module identifies the compact product-space game with the existing
low-degree game.  The bridge is by explicit equivalences of question
coordinates and answer summands.  It preserves the question PMF, every branch
of the Boolean verifier, and the value of every compact strategy exactly.

## References

`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-440`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT

/-- Copy the original numerical parameter record into the compact domain. -/
@[reducible] def LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams
    (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams where
  q := P.q
  m := P.m
  d := P.d
  k := P.k
  hm := P.hm
  hd := P.hd
  hk := P.hk
  hq := P.hq
  hdvd := P.hdvd

/-- The compact and original three-element question-type carriers are equivalent. -/
def lowDegreeTypeEquiv : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeType ≃ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType where
  toFun
    | .point => .point
    | .aline => .aline
    | .dline => .dline
  invFun
    | .point => .point
    | .aline => .aline
    | .dline => .dline
  left_inv t := by cases t <;> rfl
  right_inv t := by cases t <;> rfl

/-- Split-function coordinates identify the complete compact and original spaces. -/
def lowDegreeSpaceEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeSpace (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P) ≃
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace P :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSpaceSplit P).symm

/-- Typed questions are equivalent by the explicit type and coordinate maps. -/
def lowDegreeQuestionEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeQuestion (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P) ≃
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdQuestion P :=
  Equiv.prodCongr _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeTypeEquiv (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeSpaceEquiv P)

/-- The three answer summands are exactly the original answer constructors. -/
@[reducible] noncomputable def lowDegreeAnswerEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeAnswer (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P) ≃
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdAnswer P :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldAnswerEquiv P).symm

/-- The complete common-source spaces are equivalent coordinate by coordinate. -/
def lowDegreeSourceEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeType) ×
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeSpace (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P)) ≃
      ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType) ×
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace P) :=
  Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.prodCongr _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeTypeEquiv _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeTypeEquiv)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeSpaceEquiv P)

/-- Equivalence of the two ordered question-pair carriers. -/
def lowDegreeQuestionPairEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeQuestion (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P) ×
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeQuestion (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P)) ≃
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdQuestion P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdQuestion P) :=
  Equiv.prodCongr (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeQuestionEquiv P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeQuestionEquiv P)

/-- The compact seed-index map is the original `chiIndex`. -/
@[simp] theorem lowDegreeChiIndex_eq (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams)
    (s : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreeChiIndex (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model) s =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex P s := by
  rfl

/-- The compact prefix projection is the original prefix projection. -/
@[simp] theorem lowDegreePrefix_eq (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams)
    (i : Fin P.m) (v : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreePrefix i v = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.prefixProjection i v :=
  rfl

/-- The compact least nonzero coordinate is the one used by the published formula. -/
theorem lowDegreePivot_eq_linePivotIndex {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]
    {m : ℕ} (v : Fin m → K) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreePivot v hv = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePivotIndex v hv := by
  have hpivot_ne : v (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreePivot v hv) ≠ 0 := by
    unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreePivot
    change v ((Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin m => v j ≠ 0).min' _) ≠ 0
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.min'_mem
      (Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin m => v j ≠ 0) _)).2
  have hpivot_le (i : Fin m) (hi : v i ≠ 0) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.lowDegreePivot v hv ≤ i := by

/-!
# Strategy bridge for the compact low individual degree game

This module transports compact strategies across the exact question and answer
equivalences of `LowDegreeGameBridge`.  The transported game is the existing
low-degree game, and every compact strategy has exactly the same Born value
after conversion through the Palomar foundation bridge.

## References

`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-440`.

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar

namespace POVM

/-- Relabel the outcomes of a compact POVM along an equivalence. -/
def relabel {A B I : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] [Fintype I]
    [DecidableEq I] (e : A ≃ B) (M : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM A I) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM B I where
  effect := fun b => M.effect (e.symm b)
  pos := fun b => M.pos (e.symm b)
  sum_eq_one := by
    calc
      ∑ b : B, M.effect (e.symm b) = ∑ a : A, M.effect a :=
        Equiv.sum_comp e.symm M.effect
      _ = 1 := M.sum_eq_one

/-- Outcome relabeling preserves every POVM effect. -/
@[simp] theorem relabel_effect {A B I : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (e : A ≃ B) (M : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM A I) (b : B) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM.relabel e M).effect b = M.effect (e.symm b) :=
  rfl



end POVM

namespace Game

/-- Two compact games on fixed carriers are equal when their data fields agree. -/
theorem ext {X Y A B : Type}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B]
    {G H : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game X Y A B} (hμ : G.μ = H.μ) (hdecide : G.decide = H.decide) :
    G = H := by
  cases G
  cases H
  simp_all

/-- Relabel all question and answer carriers of a compact game. -/
def relabel {X Y A B X' Y' A' B' : Type}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [Fintype X'] [Fintype Y'] [Fintype A'] [Fintype B']
    [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B]
    [DecidableEq X'] [DecidableEq Y'] [DecidableEq A'] [DecidableEq B']
    (G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game X Y A B) (eX : X ≃ X') (eY : Y ≃ Y')
    (eA : A ≃ A') (eB : B ≃ B') : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game X' Y' A' B' where
  μ := G.μ.map (Equiv.prodCongr eX eY)
  decide := fun x y a b =>
    G.decide (eX.symm x) (eY.symm y) (eA.symm a) (eB.symm b)

end Game

namespace Strategy

/-- Relabel the questions and outcomes of a compact strategy. -/
def relabel {X Y A B X' Y' A' B' : Type}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [Fintype X'] [Fintype Y'] [Fintype A'] [Fintype B']
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy X Y A B) (eX : X ≃ X') (eY : Y ≃ Y')
    (eA : A ≃ A') (eB : B ≃ B') : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy X' Y' A' B' where
  ιA := S.ιA
  ιB := S.ιB
  ψ := S.ψ
  ψ_norm := S.ψ_norm
  alice := fun x => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM.relabel eA (S.alice (eX.symm x))
  bob := fun y => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM.relabel eB (S.bob (eY.symm y))

/-- Relabeling preserves each Born weight after pulling back all four labels. -/
@[simp] theorem outcomeWeight_relabel {X Y A B X' Y' A' B' : Type}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [Fintype X'] [Fintype Y'] [Fintype A'] [Fintype B']
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy X Y A B) (eX : X ≃ X') (eY : Y ≃ Y')
    (eA : A ≃ A') (eB : B ≃ B') (x : X') (y : Y') (a : A') (b : B') :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy.relabel S eX eY eA eB).outcomeWeight x y a b =
      S.outcomeWeight (eX.symm x) (eY.symm y) (eA.symm a) (eB.symm b) :=
  rfl







end Strategy

def lowDegreeStrategyToLibrary (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams)

/-!
# Observables of the perfect Magic Square strategy

This module builds the operator table of `thm:ms-from-ac`.  It records the EPR
state carried by the perfect strategy, the binary reflection effects attached
to a Hermitian involution, the real Pauli matrices on the auxiliary qubit, and
the nine cell observables together with their Hermiticity, involutivity,
commutation, and constraint-product identities.

## References

The source statement is blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`, from
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:654-722`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for
`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`): the EPR state on `V` is invariant under
exchanging its two tensor factors. -/
theorem reindexState_prodComm_eprState
    (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V] :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexState (Equiv.prodComm V V) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState V) = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState V := by
  apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (V × V) ℂ).injective
  funext p
  rcases p with ⟨i, j⟩
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexState, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState, ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    Equiv.prodComm, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp
  · have hji : j ≠ i := fun h => hij h.symm
    simp [hij, hji]





private theorem binary_effects_sum
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) V) :
    M.effect 0 + M.effect 1 = 1 := by
  rw [← _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sum_zmod_two M.effect]
  exact M.sum_eq_one

 theorem binary_effects_orthogonal
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) V)
    (hM : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) :
    M.effect 0 * M.effect 1 = 0 ∧ M.effect 1 * M.effect 0 = 0 := by
  have hsum := binary_effects_sum M
  have hcomp : M.effect 1 = 1 - M.effect 0 := by
    rw [← hsum]
    abel
  constructor
  · rw [hcomp]
    exact (hM 0).mul_one_sub_self
  · rw [hcomp]
    exact (hM 0).one_sub_mul_self

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for
`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`): the ±1-valued observable attached to a binary
projective measurement is Hermitian. -/
theorem obsOf_conjTranspose
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) V)
    (hM : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf M)ᴴ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf M := by
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf, Matrix.conjTranspose_sub,
    (hM 0).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq,
    (hM 1).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq]

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for
`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`): the ±1-valued observable attached to a binary
projective measurement is an involution, that is, it squares to the identity. -/
theorem obsOf_sq
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) V)
    (hM : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf M * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf M = 1 := by
  rcases binary_effects_orthogonal M hM with ⟨h01, h10⟩
  calc
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf M * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf M =
        M.effect 0 * M.effect 0 - M.effect 0 * M.effect 1 -
          M.effect 1 * M.effect 0 + M.effect 1 * M.effect 1 := by
      simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf]
      noncomm_ring
    _ = M.effect 0 + M.effect 1 := by
      rw [(hM 0).isIdempotentElem.eq, (hM 1).isIdempotentElem.eq, h01, h10]
      abel
    _ = 1 := binary_effects_sum M

/-- The effect with eigenvalue `(-1)^b` for a Hermitian involution. -/
noncomputable def reflectionEffect {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq V] (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (b : ZMod 2) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V :=
  if b = 0 then (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (1 + O) else (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (1 - O)

private theorem reflectionEffect_isProj
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (hO : Oᴴ = O) (hO_sq : O * O = 1) (b : ZMod 2) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.IsProj (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect O b) := by
  have hplus : (1 + O) * (1 + O) = (2 : ℂ) • (1 + O) := by
    calc
      (1 + O) * (1 + O) = 1 + O + O + O * O := by noncomm_ring
      _ = (2 : ℂ) • (1 + O) := by rw [hO_sq]; module
  have hminus : (1 - O) * (1 - O) = (2 : ℂ) • (1 - O) := by
    calc
      (1 - O) * (1 - O) = 1 - O - O + O * O := by noncomm_ring
      _ = (2 : ℂ) • (1 - O) := by rw [hO_sq]; module
  refine isStarProjection_iff'.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one b with rfl | rfl
    · simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect, if_pos]
      rw [smul_mul_smul, hplus, smul_smul]
      norm_num
    · simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect, if_neg one_ne_zero]
      rw [smul_mul_smul, hminus, smul_smul]
      norm_num
  · rcases _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one b with rfl | rfl
    · simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, hO]
    · simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, hO]

/-- The binary projective measurement associated with a Hermitian involution. -/
noncomputable def reflectionMeasurement
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (hO : Oᴴ = O) (hO_sq : O * O = 1) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) V :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect O)
    (fun b => by
      exact (reflectionEffect_isProj O hO hO_sq b).nonneg)
    (by
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sum_zmod_two]
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect]
      module)

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for
`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`): the binary measurement built from a Hermitian
involution is projective. -/
theorem reflectionMeasurement_projective
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (hO : Oᴴ = O) (hO_sq : O * O = 1) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionMeasurement O hO hO_sq) :=
  reflectionEffect_isProj O hO hO_sq



/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for
`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`): passing from a binary projective measurement to
its ±1-valued observable and back recovers the original effects. -/
theorem reflectionEffect_obsOf_measurement
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) V) (b : ZMod 2) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf M) b = M.effect b := by
  have hsum := binary_effects_sum M
  rcases _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one b with rfl | rfl
  · simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect, if_pos, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf]
    rw [show (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) = M.effect 0 + M.effect 1 from hsum.symm]
    module
  · simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect, if_neg one_ne_zero, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf]
    rw [show (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) = M.effect 0 + M.effect 1 from hsum.symm]
    module

local notation "qubitX" => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauShift (K := ZMod 2) 1)
local notation "qubitZ" => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauPhase (K := ZMod 2) 1)

private theorem heteroKron_conjTranspose
    {V W : Type*} (A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op W) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron A B)ᴴ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron Aᴴ Bᴴ := by
  exact Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker A B

private theorem heteroKron_transpose
    {V W : Type*} (A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op W) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron A B)ᵀ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron Aᵀ Bᵀ := by
  ext i j
  rfl

private theorem heteroKron_neg_neg
    {V W : Type*} (A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op W) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (-A) (-B) = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron A B := by
  ext i j
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron]

 theorem anti_mul_sq
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (A B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (hA : A * A = 1) (hB : B * B = 1)
    (hAB : A * B = -(B * A)) :
    (A * B) * (A * B) = -1 := by
  have hBA : B * A = -(A * B) := by
    rw [hAB]
    simp
  calc
    (A * B) * (A * B) = A * (B * A) * B := by noncomm_ring
    _ = -(A * A) * (B * B) := by rw [hBA]; noncomm_ring
    _ = -1 := by rw [hA, hB]; simp

private theorem anti_mul_conjTranspose
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    (A B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (hA : Aᴴ = A) (hB : Bᴴ = B)
    (hAB : A * B = -(B * A)) :
    (A * B)ᴴ = -(A * B) := by
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hA, hB]
  rw [hAB]
  simp

private theorem anti_mul_transpose
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    (A B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (hA : Aᵀ = A) (hB : Bᵀ = B)
    (hAB : A * B = -(B * A)) :
    (A * B)ᵀ = -(A * B) := by
  rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, hA, hB]
  rw [hAB]
  simp

/-- The nine observables in the operator table of `thm:ms-from-ac`. -/
def msCellObservable
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (OA OB : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) : Fin 9 → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (V × ZMod 2) :=
  ![_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron OA 1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron 1 qubitX, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron OA qubitX,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron 1 qubitZ, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron OB 1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron OB qubitZ,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron OA qubitZ, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron OB qubitX,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (OA * OB) (qubitZ * qubitX)]

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for
`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`): each of the nine cell observables of the operator
table is Hermitian whenever `OA` and `OB` are Hermitian and anticommute. -/
theorem msCellObservable_conjTranspose
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (OA OB : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (hOA : OAᴴ = OA) (hOB : OBᴴ = OB)
    (hac : OA * OB = -(OB * OA)) (j : Fin 9) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable OA OB j)ᴴ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable OA OB j := by
  have hAB := anti_mul_conjTranspose OA OB hOA hOB hac
  have hZX := anti_mul_conjTranspose qubitZ qubitX _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauPhase_conjTranspose
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauShift_conjTranspose (by
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauShift_mul_tauPhase]
      simp)
  fin_cases j <;>
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable, heteroKron_conjTranspose, hOA, hOB,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauShift_conjTranspose, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauPhase_conjTranspose, hAB, hZX,
      heteroKron_neg_neg]

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for
`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`): each of the nine cell observables of the operator
table is an involution whenever `OA` and `OB` are anticommuting involutions. -/
theorem msCellObservable_sq
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (OA OB : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (hOA : OA * OA = 1) (hOB : OB * OB = 1)
    (hac : OA * OB = -(OB * OA)) (j : Fin 9) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable OA OB j * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable OA OB j = 1 := by
  have hAB := anti_mul_sq OA OB hOA hOB hac
  have hZX := anti_mul_sq qubitZ qubitX _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauPhase_sq _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauShift_sq (by
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauShift_mul_tauPhase]
    simp)
  fin_cases j <;>
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron_mul, hOA, hOB, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauShift_sq,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauPhase_sq, hAB, hZX, heteroKron_neg_neg, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron_one_one]

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for
`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`): each of the nine cell observables of the operator
table is symmetric whenever `OA` and `OB` are symmetric and anticommute. -/
theorem msCellObservable_transpose
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (OA OB : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (hOA : OAᵀ = OA) (hOB : OBᵀ = OB)
    (hac : OA * OB = -(OB * OA)) (j : Fin 9) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable OA OB j)ᵀ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable OA OB j := by
  have hAB := anti_mul_transpose OA OB hOA hOB hac
  have hZX := anti_mul_transpose qubitZ qubitX _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauPhase_transpose
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauShift_transpose (by
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauShift_mul_tauPhase]
      simp)
  fin_cases j <;>
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable, heteroKron_transpose, hOA, hOB,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauShift_transpose, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauPhase_transpose, hAB, hZX,
      heteroKron_neg_neg]

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for
`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`): the observables attached to any two cells of the
same Magic Square constraint commute. -/
theorem msConstraintObservable_commute
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (OA OB : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (hOA : OA * OA = 1) (hOB : OB * OB = 1)
    (hac : OA * OB = -(OB * OA)) (i : Fin 6) (k l : Fin 3) :
    Commute (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable OA OB (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i k))
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable OA OB (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i l)) := by
  have hA_BA : OA * (OB * OA) = -OB := by
    calc
      OA * (OB * OA) = (OA * OB) * OA := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (-(OB * OA)) * OA := by rw [hac]
      _ = -OB := by rw [neg_mul, mul_assoc, hOA, mul_one]
  have hBA_A : OB * OA * OA = OB := by rw [mul_assoc, hOA, mul_one]
  have hB_BA : OB * (OB * OA) = OA := by rw [← mul_assoc, hOB, one_mul]
  have hBA_B : OB * OA * OB = -OA := by
    calc
      OB * OA * OB = OB * (OA * OB) := mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = OB * (-(OB * OA)) := by rw [hac]
      _ = -OA := by rw [mul_neg, ← mul_assoc, hOB, one_mul]
  have hZ_ZX : qubitZ * (qubitZ * qubitX) = qubitX := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauPhase_sq, one_mul]
  have hZX_Z : qubitZ * qubitX * qubitZ = -qubitX := by
    calc
      qubitZ * qubitX * qubitZ = -(qubitX * qubitZ) * qubitZ := by
        rw [show qubitZ * qubitX = -(qubitX * qubitZ) by
          rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauShift_mul_tauPhase]
          simp]
      _ = -qubitX := by rw [neg_mul, mul_assoc, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauPhase_sq, mul_one]
  have hX_ZX : qubitX * (qubitZ * qubitX) = -qubitZ := by
    calc
      qubitX * (qubitZ * qubitX) = (qubitX * qubitZ) * qubitX :=
        (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (-(qubitZ * qubitX)) * qubitX := by rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauShift_mul_tauPhase]
      _ = -qubitZ := by rw [neg_mul, mul_assoc, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauShift_sq, mul_one]
  have hZX_X : qubitZ * qubitX * qubitX = qubitZ := by
    rw [mul_assoc, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauShift_sq, mul_one]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l <;>
    simp [commute_iff_eq, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron_mul, hOA, hOB, hac, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauShift_sq, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauPhase_sq,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryTauShift_mul_tauPhase, hA_BA, hBA_A, hB_BA, hBA_B, hZ_ZX,
      hZX_Z, hX_ZX, hZX_X, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron_neg_left,

`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`): the reflection effects of two commuting Hermitian
involutions commute. -/
theorem reflectionEffect_commute
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {O P : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V} (hOP : Commute O P) (a b : ZMod 2) :
    Commute (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect O a) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect P b) := by
  rw [commute_iff_eq]
  rcases _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one a with rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one b with rfl | rfl <;>
      simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect, if_pos, if_neg one_ne_zero]
  all_goals rw [smul_mul_smul, smul_mul_smul]
  all_goals congr 1

/-!
# Measurements of the perfect Magic Square strategy

This module turns the operator table of `thm:ms-from-ac` into a measurement
family.  It forms the joint measurement of two commuting binary projective
measurements, records the post-processing identities for injective
relabellings, encodes a constraint answer as the parity triple determined by
two freely chosen bits, and assembles the nine cell measurements into the
Magic Square measurement family, closing with the multiplication rule relating
a constraint outcome to the outcomes of its incident variables.

## References

The source statement is blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`, from
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:654-722`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-- The joint measurement of two commuting binary projective measurements. -/
noncomputable def binaryJointMeasurement
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (M N : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) V)
    (hM : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
    (hN : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective N)
    (hcomm : ∀ a b, Commute (M.effect a) (N.effect b)) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) V :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    (fun ab => M.effect ab.1 * N.effect ab.2)
    (fun ab => (hM ab.1).mul (hN ab.2) (hcomm ab.1 ab.2) |>.nonneg)
    (by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [N.sum_eq_one]
      simp [M.sum_eq_one])

private theorem binaryJointMeasurement_projective
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (M N : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) V)
    (hM : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
    (hN : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective N)
    (hcomm : ∀ a b, Commute (M.effect a) (N.effect b)) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryJointMeasurement M N hM hN hcomm) :=
  fun ab => (hM ab.1).mul (hN ab.2) (hcomm ab.1 ab.2)





 theorem postprocess_effect_of_injective
    {α β V : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α V) (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) (a : α) :
    (M.postprocess f).effect (f a) = M.effect a := by
  simp only [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single a]
  · simp
  · intro b hba
    have hfb : f b ≠ f a := fun h => hba (hf h)
    simp [hfb]

/-- Relabeling a measurement gives zero effect to outcomes outside the image. -/
theorem postprocess_effect_eq_zero_of_notMem
    {α β V : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α V) (f : α → β) {b : β}
    (hb : b ∉ Set.range f) :
    (M.postprocess f).effect b = 0 := by
  rw [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro a ha
  exact (hb ⟨a, (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2⟩).elim

private theorem postprocess_projective_of_injective
    {α β V : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α V) (hM : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
    (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M.postprocess f) := by
  intro b
  by_cases hb : b ∈ Set.range f
  · rcases hb with ⟨a, rfl⟩
    rw [postprocess_effect_of_injective M f hf a]
    exact hM a
  · rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.postprocess_effect_eq_zero_of_notMem M f hb]
    exact IsStarProjection.zero _

/-- Encode two freely chosen bits as the unique triple of the prescribed parity. -/
def parityTriple (i : Fin 6) (ab : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) : Fin 3 → ZMod 2 :=
  ![ab.1, ab.2, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msParity i - ab.1 - ab.2]

private theorem parityTriple_injective (i : Fin 6) :
    Function.Injective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.parityTriple i) := by
  intro ab cd h
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact congrFun h 0
  · exact congrFun h 1



 theorem bit_embedding_injective :
    Function.Injective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsAnswer.bit : ZMod 2 → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsAnswer) := by
  intro a b h
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsAnswer.bit.inj h

 theorem triple_embedding_injective (i : Fin 6) :
    Function.Injective (fun ab => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsAnswer.triple (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.parityTriple i ab)) := by
  intro ab cd h
  apply parityTriple_injective i
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsAnswer.triple.inj h

/-- The binary measurement associated with a cell of the operator table. -/
noncomputable def msCellMeasurement
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (OA OB : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (hOA : OAᴴ = OA) (hOB : OBᴴ = OB)
    (hOA_sq : OA * OA = 1) (hOB_sq : OB * OB = 1)
    (hac : OA * OB = -(OB * OA)) (j : Fin 9) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) (V × ZMod 2) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionMeasurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable OA OB j)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable_conjTranspose OA OB hOA hOB hac j)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable_sq OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac j)

@[simp]
private theorem msCellMeasurement_effect
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (OA OB : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (hOA : OAᴴ = OA) (hOB : OBᴴ = OB)
    (hOA_sq : OA * OA = 1) (hOB_sq : OB * OB = 1)
    (hac : OA * OB = -(OB * OA)) (j : Fin 9) (b : ZMod 2) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellMeasurement OA OB hOA hOB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac j).effect b =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable OA OB j) b :=
  rfl

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for
`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`): each of the nine cell measurements of the Magic
Square strategy is projective. -/
theorem msCellMeasurement_projective
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (OA OB : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (hOA : OAᴴ = OA) (hOB : OBᴴ = OB)
    (hOA_sq : OA * OA = 1) (hOB_sq : OB * OB = 1)
    (hac : OA * OB = -(OB * OA)) (j : Fin 9) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellMeasurement OA OB hOA hOB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac j) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionMeasurement_projective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable OA OB j)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable_conjTranspose OA OB hOA hOB hac j)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable_sq OA OB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac j)

private theorem reflectionEffect_transpose
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (hO : Oᵀ = O) (b : ZMod 2) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect O b)ᵀ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect O b := by
  rcases _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one b with rfl | rfl <;>
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect, Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_sub, hO]

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for
`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`): every effect of a cell measurement is symmetric
whenever `OA` and `OB` are symmetric. -/
theorem msCellMeasurement_transpose
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (OA OB : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op V) (hOA : OAᴴ = OA) (hOB : OBᴴ = OB)
    (hOA_sq : OA * OA = 1) (hOB_sq : OB * OB = 1)
    (hOA_t : OAᵀ = OA) (hOB_t : OBᵀ = OB)
    (hac : OA * OB = -(OB * OA)) (j : Fin 9) (b : ZMod 2) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellMeasurement OA OB hOA hOB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac j).effect b)ᵀ =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellMeasurement OA OB hOA hOB hOA_sq hOB_sq hac j).effect b := by
  rw [msCellMeasurement_effect]
  exact reflectionEffect_transpose _
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellObservable_transpose OA OB hOA_t hOB_t hac j) b

/-- The joint measurement of the first two cells in a Magic Square constraint. -/
noncomputable def msConstraintJoint
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (P : Fin 9 → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) V)
    (hP : ∀ j, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (P j))
    (hcomm : ∀ i k l a b,
      Commute ((P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i k)).effect a)
        ((P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i l)).effect b))
    (i : Fin 6) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) V :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryJointMeasurement (P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i 0))
    (P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i 1)) (hP _) (hP _) (hcomm i 0 1)

/-- The global Magic Square measurement family induced by the nine cell measurements. -/
noncomputable def msStrategyMeasurement
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (P : Fin 9 → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) V)
    (hP : ∀ j, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (P j))
    (hcomm : ∀ i k l a b,
      Commute ((P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i k)).effect a)
        ((P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i l)).effect b)) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsAnswer V
  | .var j => (P j).postprocess _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsAnswer.bit
  | .constraint i =>
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintJoint P hP hcomm i).postprocess
        (fun ab => .triple (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.parityTriple i ab))









/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for
`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`): the global Magic Square measurement family is
projective at every question. -/
theorem msStrategyMeasurement_projective
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (P : Fin 9 → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) V)
    (hP : ∀ j, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (P j))
    (hcomm : ∀ i k l a b,
      Commute ((P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i k)).effect a)
        ((P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i l)).effect b))
    (x : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msStrategyMeasurement P hP hcomm x) := by
  cases x with
  | var j =>
      exact postprocess_projective_of_injective (P j) (hP j)
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsAnswer.bit bit_embedding_injective
  | constraint i =>
      apply postprocess_projective_of_injective
      · exact binaryJointMeasurement_projective _ _ (hP _) (hP _)
          (hcomm i 0 1)
      · exact triple_embedding_injective i

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for
`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`): post-processing a measurement along a relabelling
of outcomes preserves symmetry of its effects. -/
theorem postprocess_effect_transpose
    {α β V : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α V) (f : α → β)
    (hM : ∀ a, (M.effect a)ᵀ = M.effect a) (b : β) :
    ((M.postprocess f).effect b)ᵀ = (M.postprocess f).effect b := by
  rw [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
  ext r c
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply]
  rw [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  exact congrFun (congrFun (hM a) r) c

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma for
`exists_ms_perfect_strategy_of_anticommuting` (blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`): the effects of the joint measurement of the first
two cells of a constraint are symmetric whenever the underlying cell effects
are. -/
theorem msConstraintJoint_effect_transpose
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (P : Fin 9 → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) V)
    (hP : ∀ j, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (P j))
    (hcomm : ∀ i k l a b,
      Commute ((P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i k)).effect a)
        ((P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i l)).effect b))
    (hPt : ∀ j b, ((P j).effect b)ᵀ = (P j).effect b)
    (i : Fin 6) (ab : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintJoint P hP hcomm i).effect ab)ᵀ =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintJoint P hP hcomm i).effect ab := by
  change (((P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i 0)).effect ab.1 *
    (P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i 1)).effect ab.2)ᵀ) = _
  rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, hPt, hPt]
  exact (hcomm i 0 1 ab.1 ab.2).symm.eq





end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Perfect strategies for the Magic Square game

This file completes the construction of `thm:ms-from-ac`.  It identifies the
question pairs in the support of the Magic Square distribution, shows that the
measurement family commutes there and annihilates rejected answer pairs on the
EPR state, evaluates the Born weights of the accepted answers, and assembles a
symmetric SPCC strategy of value one from an anticommuting consistent pair of
binary measurements.

## References

The source statement is blueprint
`thm:ms-from-ac`, from
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:654-722`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section



















/-- Formalization-only auxiliary for the perfect Magic Square strategy and the
proof of `lem:pauli-completeness`: the constructed Magic Square family has
symmetric effects when its underlying projective cell measurements have
symmetric effects. -/
theorem msStrategyMeasurement_effect_transpose
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (P : Fin 9 → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) V)
    (hP : ∀ j, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (P j))
    (hcomm : ∀ i k l a b,
      Commute ((P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i k)).effect a)
        ((P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i l)).effect b))
    (hPt : ∀ j b, ((P j).effect b)ᵀ = (P j).effect b)
    (x : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType) (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsAnswer) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msStrategyMeasurement P hP hcomm x).effect a)ᵀ =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msStrategyMeasurement P hP hcomm x).effect a := by
  cases x with
  | var j =>
      exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.postprocess_effect_transpose (P j) _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsAnswer.bit (hPt j) a
  | constraint i =>
      exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.postprocess_effect_transpose (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintJoint P hP hcomm i)
        (fun ab => .triple (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.parityTriple i ab))
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintJoint_effect_transpose P hP hcomm hPt i) a

















end

/-!
# The ideal target of the Magic Square rigidity theorem

The conclusion of `thm:ms-rigidity` compares the two players' bit measurements
with the Pauli basis projectors on a two-qubit register and their shared state
with two EPR pairs tensored with an auxiliary bipartite state.  This file
records the two elementary properties of that target which the estimates of the
rigidity assembly use: the Pauli basis projectors of one kind form a complete
projective measurement, so that any marginal of them is a positive contraction,
and the ideal state is a unit vector whenever the auxiliary state is.

The completeness of the Pauli basis follows from the Fourier expansion
`tauObservable_eq_sum_pauliProj` evaluated at the zero label, where the
generalized Pauli observable is the identity.  Positivity is the rank-one
factorization `pauliProj W e = v vᴴ` for the normalized Pauli eigenvector `v`.

## References

`def:generalized-pauli` and blueprint
`lem:pauli-observable-expansion`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:908-1161`; the target of the
rigidity theorem is blueprint
`thm:ms-rigidity`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod 2) K]
/-! ## Marginals of the Pauli basis -/

/-- A marginal of the Pauli basis projectors, over any set of labels, is
positive semidefinite. -/
theorem posSemidef_sum_ite_pauliProj {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (p : (ι → K) → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    (∑ e : ι → K, if p e then _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e else 0).PosSemidef := by
  classical
  refine Finset.sum_induction _ Matrix.PosSemidef (fun _ _ h₁ h₂ => h₁.add h₂)
    (Matrix.PosSemidef.zero) ?_
  intro e _
  by_cases hp : p e
  · rw [if_pos hp]
    exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.posSemidef_pauliProj W e
  · rw [if_neg hp]
    exact Matrix.PosSemidef.zero

/-- A marginal of the Pauli basis projectors is a positive operator in the
Loewner order. -/
theorem sum_ite_pauliProj_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (p : (ι → K) → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    0 ≤ ∑ e : ι → K, if p e then _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e else 0 := by
  refine Matrix.le_iff.mpr ?_
  simpa using _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.posSemidef_sum_ite_pauliProj W p

/-- The two marginals of the Pauli basis attached to a binary function of the
labels sum to the identity. -/
theorem sum_binary_marginal_pauliProj {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (f : (ι → K) → ZMod 2) :
    (∑ b : ZMod 2, ∑ e : ι → K, if f e = b then _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e else 0) = 1 := by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  rw [← _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sum_pauliProj_eq_one (K := K) (ι := ι) W]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 2)) (f e) (fun _ => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e)]
  simp

/-- The binary measurement on the Pauli basis attached to a binary function of
the labels: its effects are the two marginals of the Pauli basis projectors.
This is the ideal target family of blueprint
`thm:ms-rigidity`. -/
noncomputable def pauliMarginalMeasurement {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (f : (ι → K) → ZMod 2) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) (ι → K) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    (fun b => ∑ e : ι → K, if f e = b then _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e else 0)
    (fun b => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sum_ite_pauliProj_nonneg W (fun e => f e = b))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sum_binary_marginal_pauliProj W f)

/-- The effects of the Pauli marginal measurement are the marginals
themselves. -/
@[simp]
theorem pauliMarginalMeasurement_effect {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (f : (ι → K) → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMarginalMeasurement W f).effect b =
      ∑ e : ι → K, if f e = b then _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e else 0 := rfl



/-! ## The ideal state is normalized -/



end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Swap-isometry extraction for Magic Square rigidity

This module constructs the local swap isometries used in the finite-dimensional
proof of Magic Square rigidity.  A binary observable `Z` splits a local vector
into its two eigenspaces, while a second binary observable `X` identifies the
negative eigenspace with the residual copy of the original Hilbert space.
Crucially, the resulting map is an exact isometry even when `X` and `Z`
anticommute only on the strategy state.

The final section specializes this construction to the distinguished local
binary observables of both players in the projectively dilated Magic Square
strategy.  A joint two-EPR specialization is not stated here: the current
symmetric game does not relate the two players' variable representations.  The
resulting two-copy obstruction is recorded in
`audits/2026-09-04_magic-square-rigidity-orientation-obstruction.md`.

## References

The target statement is blueprint `thm:ms-rigidity`, from
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`.
The concrete binary Pauli projectors and EPR vector are those of
`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1097-1262`.  The cited robust
self-test is Coladangelo--Stark, arXiv:1709.09267v2, Theorem 6.9.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-! ## The one-qubit swap isometry -/

/-- Formalization-only linear controlled-swap map supporting
`thm:ms-rigidity`.  For a binary output `b`, its residual component is
`X^b P_b(Z) psi`, where `P_b(Z)` is the spectral effect of the binary observable
`Z`. -/
def binarySwapMap {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (X Z : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (ZMod 2 × ι) where
  toFun ψ := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (ZMod 2 × ι) ℂ).symm
    (fun bi => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (X ^ bi.1.val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z bi.1) ψ bi.2)
  map_add' ψ ξ := by
    apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (ZMod 2 × ι) ℂ).injective
    funext bi
    simp only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState
    rw [map_add]
    rfl
  map_smul' c ψ := by
    apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (ZMod 2 × ι) ℂ).injective
    funext bi
    simp only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
    unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState
    rw [map_smul]
    rfl

/-- Formalization-only support for `thm:ms-rigidity`: the controlled-swap map
preserves norms whenever both controlling operators are binary observables.  No
anticommutation assumption is needed. -/
theorem binarySwapMap_norm {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (X Z : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) (hX : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable X) (hZ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable Z)
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.binarySwapMap X Z ψ‖ = ‖ψ‖ := by
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  change
    (∑ bi : ZMod 2 × ι,
      ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (X ^ bi.1.val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z bi.1) ψ bi.2‖ ^ 2) =
      ∑ i : ι, ‖ψ i‖ ^ 2
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sum_zmod_two]
  simp only [ZMod.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, ZMod.val_one, pow_one]
  rw [show
      ∑ i : ι, ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z 0) ψ i‖ ^ 2 =
        ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z 0) ψ‖ ^ 2 by
          exact (EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq _).symm,
    show
      ∑ i : ι, ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (X * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z 1) ψ i‖ ^ 2 =
        ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (X * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z 1) ψ‖ ^ 2 by
          exact (EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq _).symm,
    show ∑ i : ι, ‖ψ i‖ ^ 2 = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 by
      exact (EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq _).symm,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_isometry_mul hX.isometry]
  have hplus : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z 0) ψ =
      (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (ψ + _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState Z ψ) := by
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.applyOperatorToState_smul,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.applyOperatorToState_add_op, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.applyOperatorToState_one]
  have hminus : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z 1) ψ =
      (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ • (ψ - _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState Z ψ) := by
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState]
  rw [hplus, hminus, norm_smul, norm_smul]
  rw [show ‖(2 : ℂ)⁻¹‖ = (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ by norm_num]
  have hZnorm := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_of_isometry hZ.isometry ψ
  have hpara := parallelogram_law_with_norm_mul ℂ ψ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState Z ψ)
  rw [hZnorm] at hpara
  nlinarith [hpara]

/-- Formalization-only local controlled-swap map for `thm:ms-rigidity`, bundled
as a linear isometric embedding. -/
noncomputable def binarySwapIsometry {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (X Z : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) (hX : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable X) (hZ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable Z) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (ZMod 2 × ι) where
  toLinearMap := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.binarySwapMap X Z
  norm_map' := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.binarySwapMap_norm X Z hX hZ

/-- Formalization-only coordinate formula for the binary swap isometry used in
`thm:ms-rigidity`. -/
@[simp]
theorem binarySwapIsometry_apply {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (X Z : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) (hX : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable X) (hZ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable Z)
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (b : ZMod 2) (i : ι) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.binarySwapIsometry X Z hX hZ ψ (b, i) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (X ^ b.val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z b) ψ i := rfl

/-!
# The two-qubit controlled-swap isometry

The conclusion of `thm:ms-rigidity` places each player's extracted register on
two qubits, indexed by `Fin 2 → ZMod 2`: the first carries the logical pair at
the cells `0` and `4`, the second the logical pair at the cells `1` and `3`.
`Rigidity/Swap.lean` builds the controlled-swap embedding attached to a single
anticommuting pair.  This file composes two of them.

For two pairs of binary observables `(X₁, Z₁)` and `(X₂, Z₂)` on one local
space, the map defined here sends a vector `ψ` to the family

    (e, i) ↦ (X₂^{e(1)} P^{Z₂}_{e(1)} X₁^{e(0)} P^{Z₁}_{e(0)} ψ) (i),

where `P^{Z}_b` is the spectral effect `reflectionEffect Z b`.  It is the
composition of the controlled swap of the first pair with the controlled swap
of the second pair applied to the residual copy of the local space, so it is an
*exact* isometry with no commutation assumption on the two pairs; approximate
commutation of the two pairs enters only when the second pair's observables are
transported through the first swap, which is not part of this file.

The first pair is applied innermost and is indexed by the register coordinate
`0`, matching `idealMagicBitProj`, whose marginal is taken over the coordinate
`0` of the label.

## References

blueprint `thm:ms-rigidity`,
paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`;
the cited robust self-test is Coladangelo--Stark, arXiv:1709.09267v2,
Theorem 6.9, `references/cs-paper/self-testing.tex:660-730`.  The one-qubit
construction is `binarySwapIsometry` in `Rigidity/Swap.lean`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-! ## Sums over a two-qubit label -/

/-- Formalization-only: a sum over two-qubit labels is a double sum over the two
coordinates. -/
theorem sum_pi_fin_two {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ZMod 2 → ZMod 2 → M) :
    (∑ e : Fin 2 → ZMod 2, f (e 0) (e 1)) = ∑ b : ZMod 2, ∑ c : ZMod 2, f b c :=
  calc (∑ e : Fin 2 → ZMod 2, f (e 0) (e 1))
      = ∑ p : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2, f p.1 p.2 :=
        Fintype.sum_equiv (piFinTwoEquiv fun _ => ZMod 2) _ _ fun _ => rfl
    _ = ∑ b : ZMod 2, ∑ c : ZMod 2, f b c := Fintype.sum_prod_type _

/-- Formalization-only: the squared norm of the one-qubit controlled-swap image
is the sum of the squared norms of its two residual components. -/
theorem sum_norm_sq_binarySwapComponent {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (X Z : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    (∑ b : ZMod 2,
        ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (X ^ b.val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z b) v‖ ^ 2) =
      ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.binarySwapMap X Z v‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq _

/-- The two residual components of a controlled swap carry the whole squared
norm of the input.  This is `binarySwapMap_norm` in the form in which the
two-qubit construction iterates it. -/
theorem sum_norm_sq_binarySwapComponent_eq {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (X Z : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) (hX : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable X) (hZ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable Z)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    (∑ b : ZMod 2,
        ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (X ^ b.val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z b) v‖ ^ 2) = ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.sum_norm_sq_binarySwapComponent, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.binarySwapMap_norm X Z hX hZ]

/-! ## The two-qubit controlled-swap map -/

/-- Formalization-only linear controlled-swap map on a two-qubit register
supporting `thm:ms-rigidity`.  The component at the label `e` is obtained by
applying the residual component of the first pair at `e 0` and then that of the
second pair at `e 1`. -/
def twoBinarySwapMap {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (X₁ Z₁ X₂ Z₂ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ((Fin 2 → ZMod 2) × ι) where
  toFun ψ := (EuclideanSpace.equiv ((Fin 2 → ZMod 2) × ι) ℂ).symm
    (fun p => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState
      (X₂ ^ (p.1 1).val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z₂ (p.1 1) *
        (X₁ ^ (p.1 0).val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z₁ (p.1 0))) ψ p.2)
  map_add' ψ ξ := by
    apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv ((Fin 2 → ZMod 2) × ι) ℂ).injective
    funext p
    simp only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState
    rw [map_add]
    rfl
  map_smul' c ψ := by
    apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv ((Fin 2 → ZMod 2) × ι) ℂ).injective
    funext p
    simp only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
    unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState
    rw [map_smul]
    rfl

/-- Formalization-only coordinate formula for the two-qubit controlled-swap
map. -/
@[simp]
theorem twoBinarySwapMap_apply {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (X₁ Z₁ X₂ Z₂ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (e : Fin 2 → ZMod 2) (i : ι) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.twoBinarySwapMap X₁ Z₁ X₂ Z₂ ψ (e, i) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState
        (X₂ ^ (e 1).val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z₂ (e 1) *
          (X₁ ^ (e 0).val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z₁ (e 0))) ψ i := rfl

/-- The two-qubit controlled-swap map preserves norms whenever the four
controlling operators are binary observables.  No commutation assumption between
the two pairs is needed: the map is the composition of the controlled swap of
the first pair with the controlled swap of the second pair applied to the
residual space. -/
theorem twoBinarySwapMap_norm {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (X₁ Z₁ X₂ Z₂ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)
    (hX₁ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable X₁) (hZ₁ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable Z₁)
    (hX₂ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable X₂) (hZ₂ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable Z₂)
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.twoBinarySwapMap X₁ Z₁ X₂ Z₂ ψ‖ = ‖ψ‖ := by
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  have hcomp : ∀ (e : Fin 2 → ZMod 2),
      (∑ i : ι, ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.twoBinarySwapMap X₁ Z₁ X₂ Z₂ ψ (e, i)‖ ^ 2) =
        ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (X₂ ^ (e 1).val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z₂ (e 1))
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState
            (X₁ ^ (e 0).val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z₁ (e 0)) ψ)‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro e
    rw [← _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.applyOperatorToState_mul]
    exact (EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState
      (X₂ ^ (e 1).val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z₂ (e 1) *
        (X₁ ^ (e 0).val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z₁ (e 0))) ψ)).symm
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl
    fun e (_ : e ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2 → ZMod 2))) => hcomp e]
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.sum_pi_fin_two (fun b c =>
    ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (X₂ ^ c.val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z₂ c)
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (X₁ ^ b.val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z₁ b) ψ)‖ ^ 2)]
  have hinner : ∀ b : ZMod 2,
      (∑ c : ZMod 2, ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (X₂ ^ c.val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z₂ c)
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (X₁ ^ b.val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z₁ b) ψ)‖ ^ 2) =
        ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (X₁ ^ b.val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z₁ b) ψ‖ ^ 2 :=
    fun b => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.sum_norm_sq_binarySwapComponent_eq X₂ Z₂ hX₂ hZ₂ _
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl
    fun b (_ : b ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 2))) => hinner b]
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.sum_norm_sq_binarySwapComponent_eq X₁ Z₁ hX₁ hZ₁ ψ

/-- Formalization-only local two-qubit controlled-swap embedding for
`thm:ms-rigidity`, bundled as a linear isometric embedding.  Its codomain is the
two-qubit register of the conclusion, `(Fin 2 → ZMod 2) × ι`. -/
noncomputable def twoBinarySwapIsometry {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (X₁ Z₁ X₂ Z₂ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)
    (hX₁ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable X₁) (hZ₁ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable Z₁)
    (hX₂ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable X₂) (hZ₂ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable Z₂) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ((Fin 2 → ZMod 2) × ι) where
  toLinearMap := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.twoBinarySwapMap X₁ Z₁ X₂ Z₂
  norm_map' := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.twoBinarySwapMap_norm X₁ Z₁ X₂ Z₂ hX₁ hZ₁ hX₂ hZ₂

/-- Formalization-only coordinate formula for the two-qubit controlled-swap
isometry. -/
@[simp]
theorem twoBinarySwapIsometry_apply {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (X₁ Z₁ X₂ Z₂ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι)
    (hX₁ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable X₁) (hZ₁ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable Z₁)
    (hX₂ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable X₂) (hZ₂ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsBinaryObservable Z₂)
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (e : Fin 2 → ZMod 2) (i : ι) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity.twoBinarySwapIsometry X₁ Z₁ X₂ Z₂ hX₁ hZ₁ hX₂ hZ₂ ψ (e, i) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState
        (X₂ ^ (e 1).val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z₂ (e 1) *
          (X₁ ^ (e 0).val * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect Z₁ (e 0))) ψ i := rfl

/-! ## Magic Square specialization -/















end
