/-!
# Rejection probabilities for the directly indexed low-degree game

This module compares the rejection probability of the directly indexed game
with the branch weights used by the low individual degree test.
All declarations below are formalization-only support derived from the game
value; none is a paper-labelled result.

## References

The uniform distribution on the three ordered question types is specified in
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:178-186`,
and its verifier is specified in the same file at lines 320-392.  The three
equal outer weights of the low individual degree test and its uniform role
choices are specified in `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:10-67`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section



/-- Rejection probability conditioned on an ordered pair of low-degree
question types, averaged over the common direct sample. -/
noncomputable def directLdBranchRejectionProbability
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D))
    (types : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType) : ℝ :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace D)) fun sample =>
    ∑ a : (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D).AnswerA, ∑ b : (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D).AnswerB,
      if _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdWinPredicate D
          (types.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap D types.1 sample)
          (types.2, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap D types.2 sample) a b then
        0
      else _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.outcomeWeight S
        (types.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap D types.1 sample)
        (types.2, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap D types.2 sample) a b

/-- Total rejection probability of the directly indexed low-degree game,
averaged uniformly over its nine ordered type branches. -/
noncomputable def directLdRejectionProbability
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D)) : ℝ :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S)

/-- The branch failure probability with the weights used by the low
individual degree test. -/
noncomputable def directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D)) : ℝ :=
  let B := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S
  ((B (.aline, .point) + B (.point, .aline)) / 2 +
      B (.point, .point) +
      (B (.dline, .point) + B (.point, .dline)) / 2) / 3













end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Branch comparison for the coordinate strategies of the direct low-degree game

Every branch of the low individual degree failure probability of a coordinate
strategy `directCoordinateProjStrat` is compared with the ordered type-pair
branch of the direct game asking the same questions.  An accepted direct
answer pair reads out to equal LDT answers: the line answer, rebased to the
LDT line and evaluated at the LDT base point, is the point answer, and the
zero-direction convention reads the constant value at the base point.  Hence
the LDT inconsistency mass at a question pair is at most the rejected direct
Born mass there.  The point-agreement and axis-line branches then compare
exactly after the coordinate reindexing of `directPointEquiv`; the diagonal
branches are treated in `Transport.DiagonalRecursion`.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:214-458`
- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:130-151`
- Blueprint `def:ld-question-distribution`, `lem:ld-aline-level`,
  `lem:ld-dline-level`, `lem:ld-question-typed-cl`, `lem:alnf`, `lem:dlnf`,
  `def:ld-win-predicate`, `rem:ld-win-zero-direction`, and `def:ld-meas`
- `MIPStarRE/LDT/Test/StrategyFailures.lean:18-130`
- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section



/-! ## Rejected Born mass at a fixed question pair -/

/-- The Born mass of the rejected answer pairs at a fixed pair of direct
questions.  Its uniform average over the common direct sample of an ordered
type pair is `directLdBranchRejectionProbability`. -/
def directRejectedMass (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D))
    (x y : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D) : ℝ :=
  ∑ a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D, ∑ b : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D,
    if _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdWinPredicate D x y a b then 0 else _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.outcomeWeight S x y a b







/-! ## Accepted answer pairs read out consistently

An accepted answer pair of the direct game consists of well-formed answers
satisfying the line-versus-point clause or the consistency clause of
`def:ld-win-predicate`.  The readouts of `Transport.Questions` evaluate the
rebased line polynomial at the LDT base point, which is the direct point
at the canonical rebase parameter; the accepted clause forces this value to
be the point answer.  Zero directions use the constant readout at the base
point, where the universal clause of `rem:ld-win-zero-direction` gives the
value at parameter zero. -/















/-! ## Direct samples as products -/

/-- A direct sample as its point-index pair together with its direction.
Formalization-only reindexing of the direct sample space. -/
def directLdSpaceSplitEquiv (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace D ≃
      ((Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) × Fin D.m) × (Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) where
  toFun s := ((s.point, s.index), s.direction)
  invFun x := ⟨x.1.1, x.1.2, x.2⟩
  left_inv s := by cases s; rfl
  right_inv x := rfl

/-! ## The point-agreement and axis-line branches -/



end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Index-conditioned rejection probabilities of the directly indexed game

`lem:ld-combined-value` transports the value of a strategy along
`def:ld-combined-strategy` by splitting each branch of the combined game
according to the event of `lem:ld-combined-question-law`, that is according to
whether the stored coordinate index of the common sample is a point coordinate
or a combining coordinate.  This module provides the corresponding refinement
of the branch rejection probability: the uniform average over the common sample
is the uniform average over the stored coordinate index of the average over the
sampled point and the sampled direction alone.

The point-versus-point branch is recorded separately, because it is the branch
that the combining coordinates of the combined game reduce to: both of its
questions are the point question at the sampled point, so its rejected mass
depends on neither the stored coordinate index nor the sampled direction.

All declarations below are formalization-only support derived from the game
value; none is a paper-labelled result.

## References

* `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1409-1503`
* `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`
* `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:517-568`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries

noncomputable section

/-! ## The index-conditioned branch rejection probability -/

/-- The rejection probability of an ordered pair of low-degree question types
conditioned on the stored coordinate index of the common sample, averaged over
the sampled point and the sampled direction alone. -/
def directLdIndexedBranchRejectionProbability
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D))
    (types : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType) (i : Fin D.m) : ℝ :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution
      ((Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D)))
    fun pd => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directRejectedMass D S
      (types.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap D types.1 ⟨pd.1, i, pd.2⟩)
      (types.2, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap D types.2 ⟨pd.1, i, pd.2⟩)

/-!
# The combined parameters of the simultaneity reduction

The extension of the quantum soundness of the low individual degree test from
simultaneity parameter `1` to a general simultaneity parameter `k` applies the
case `k = 1` once, to a directly indexed low-degree game whose dimension is
`m + k` and whose simultaneity parameter is `1`.  This module records that
parameter map, the polynomial-tuple outcomes it carries, and the two maps
relating outcomes of the two games: the combining map, which sends a tuple of
`k` polynomials in `m` variables to the one-component tuple consisting of the
combined polynomial in `m + k` variables, and its total left inverse, which
returns the components of a combined polynomial and an arbitrary tuple
otherwise.

The field, the degree, and the admissibility of the field size are inherited
unchanged; only the dimension and the simultaneity parameter change.  The
degree is inherited because the combining map is linear in the fresh
coordinates, so it raises no individual degree above `d` when `1 ≤ d`; this is
where the individual-degree formulation differs from the total-degree
formulation of the source, which passes from degree `d` to degree `d + 1`.

## References

* `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1409-1503`
* `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`
* `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:240-250`
* `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-simultaneous-sandwich.tex`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries

noncomputable section

/-! ## The combined parameter tuple -/

/-- The parameters of the game to which the reduction applies the case of
simultaneity parameter `1`: the dimension grows from `m` to `m + k` and the
simultaneity parameter becomes `1`, while the field size, the degree, and the
admissibility hypothesis are unchanged. -/
@[reducible] def DirectLdParams.combined (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams where
  q := D.q
  m := D.m + D.k
  d := D.d
  k := 1
  hm := le_trans D.hm (Nat.le_add_right D.m D.k)
  hd := D.hd
  hk := le_refl 1
  hq := D.hq

@[simp] theorem DirectLdParams.combined_q (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    D.combined.q = D.q := rfl

@[simp] theorem DirectLdParams.combined_m (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    D.combined.m = D.m + D.k := rfl

@[simp] theorem DirectLdParams.combined_d (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    D.combined.d = D.d := rfl

@[simp] theorem DirectLdParams.combined_k (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    D.combined.k = 1 := rfl





/-- The one-element index set of the combined simultaneity parameter. -/
instance instUniqueFinKCombined (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) : Unique (Fin D.combined.k) :=
  show Unique (Fin 1) from inferInstance

/-! ## The combining map on game outcomes -/

/-- The combined polynomial of a tuple of direct polynomial representatives:
`(u, α) ↦ ∑_{r < k} α_r g_r(u)`, of individual degree at most `d` in the
`m + k` variables of the combined parameters.

Source `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1425-1435`. -/
def directCombinedPolynomial (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple D) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyIndex D.combined.m (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) D.d :=
  ⟨_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePolyTuple (fun r => (g r).1),
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePolyTuple_mem_polyFunc D.hd _ fun r => (g r).2⟩

@[simp] theorem directCombinedPolynomial_val (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple D) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPolynomial D g).1 = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePolyTuple (fun r => (g r).1) :=
  rfl



/-- The combining map is injective on polynomial tuples. -/
theorem directCombinedPolynomial_injective (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    Function.Injective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPolynomial D) := by
  intro g g' h
  have hval : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePolyTuple (fun r => (g r).1) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePolyTuple (fun r => (g' r).1) := congrArg Subtype.val h
  have hcomp := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePolyTuple_injective hval
  funext r
  exact Subtype.ext (congrFun hcomp r)

/-- The one-component polynomial tuple of the combined game carrying the
combined polynomial of a tuple. -/
def directCombinedTuple (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple D) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple D.combined :=
  fun _ => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPolynomial D g

@[simp] theorem directCombinedTuple_apply (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple D)
    (r : Fin D.combined.k) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedTuple D g r = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPolynomial D g := rfl

/-! ## Recovering the polynomial tuple -/

/-- A polynomial in the variables of the combined parameters is combined when it
is the combined polynomial of a tuple.  This is the source's exact linearity in
the combining variables, together with the individual-degree bound on the
components.  Source
`references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1462-1477`. -/
def IsDirectCombined (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyIndex D.combined.m (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) D.d) : Prop :=
  ∃ g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple D, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPolynomial D g = p

theorem isDirectCombined_directCombinedPolynomial (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple D) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsDirectCombined D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPolynomial D g) :=
  ⟨g, rfl⟩

/-- The polynomial tuple represented by a polynomial in the variables of the
combined parameters: its components when it is combined, and the zero tuple
otherwise.  The source leaves the value on non-combined outcomes arbitrary; the
zero tuple is one admissible choice, and the estimates use only the value on
combined outcomes.  Source
`references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1477-1483`. -/
def directTupleOfCombined (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyIndex D.combined.m (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) D.d) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple D := by
  classical
  exact if h : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsDirectCombined D p then h.choose else fun _ => 0

/-- The components of a combined polynomial are the tuple it combines. -/
@[simp] theorem directTupleOfCombined_directCombinedPolynomial (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple D) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directTupleOfCombined D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPolynomial D g) = g := by
  classical
  have hex : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsDirectCombined D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPolynomial D g) :=
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.isDirectCombined_directCombinedPolynomial D g
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directTupleOfCombined, dif_pos hex]
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPolynomial_injective D hex.choose_spec

/-- The polynomial tuple represented by an outcome of the combined game. -/
def directTupleOfCombinedTuple (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple D.combined) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple D :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directTupleOfCombined D (p default)

@[simp] theorem directTupleOfCombinedTuple_directCombinedTuple (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple D) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directTupleOfCombinedTuple D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedTuple D g) = g := by
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directTupleOfCombinedTuple, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedTuple_apply,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directTupleOfCombined_directCombinedPolynomial]

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# The joint recovery estimate in the point and combining variables

`lem:ld-combining-recovery` compares the tuple of values at a point of the
components recovered from an outcome of the combined game with the tuple of
answers of the point measurement of the original game.  The comparison rests on
a joint estimate over the sampled point `u` and the sampled combining vector
`α`: for every outcome `p` of the combined game and every tuple `b` of scalars,
the event that the recovered tuple of values at `u` differs from `b` while the
value of `p` at the combined point agrees with the combination `∑_r α_r b_r`
has probability at most `(m + k) d / q`.

Two cases occur.  If `p` is the combined polynomial of a tuple `g`, its value at
the combined point is the combination `∑_r α_r g_r(u)`, and two combinations
with distinct coefficient tuples agree at a uniformly sampled `α` with
probability at most `1 / q`.  If `p` is not combined, then by
`lem:ld-combining-exact-linearity` its restriction `p(u, ·)` fails to be a
linear form except with probability `m d / q` over `u`, and off that event the
restriction and the linear form of `b` are distinct polynomials of total degree
at most `k d`, so they agree at a uniformly sampled `α` with probability at
most `k d / q`.

The estimate is recorded in two stages, because the consistency calculus
averages it against Born weights which depend on the sampled point but not on
the sampled combining vector: a bound at a fixed point which does not depend on
the tuple `b`, and the average of that bound over the point.

## Main statements

* `directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound` — the bound at a fixed point.
* `directCombinedRecoveryEvent_avg_le` — the estimate at a fixed point.
* `directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound_avg_le` — the average of the bound at a
  fixed point over a uniformly sampled point.
* `directCombinedRecoveryBadEvent_avg_le` — the joint estimate of
  `lem:ld-combining-recovery`.

## References

* `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1440-1503`
* `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`
* `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:617-680`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries

noncomputable section

/-! ## Elementary facts about the parameters -/







/-! ## The collision estimates in the combining variables -/





/-! ## The estimate at a fixed point -/

open scoped Classical in
/-- The bound at a fixed point of the recovery step: the collision probability
`1 / q` of two combinations when the outcome is combined, and otherwise the
indicator that the restriction of the outcome at the point is a linear form
together with the collision probability `k d / q` of two polynomials of total
degree at most `k d` in the combining variables. -/
def directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyIndex D.combined.m (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) D.d)
    (u : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error :=
  if _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsDirectCombined D p then (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) / D.q
  else
    (if ∃ c : Fin D.k → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D,
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedRestrict p.1 u = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combiningLinearForm c then (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) else 0) +
      ((D.k * D.d : ℕ) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Error) / D.q





/-! ## The averaged estimate -/





end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Question correspondence for the directly indexed low-degree game

The finite-field coordinates, polynomial answers, and question law of the
directly indexed game are equivalent to their seed-indexed and low individual
degree counterparts.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-458`
- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:98-151`
- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-! ## Parameters and finite-field coordinates -/

/-- Regard direct-game parameters as low individual degree test parameters.
The field size, dimension, and degree are unchanged. -/
@[reducible] def DirectLdParams.toLDTParameters (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters where
  m := D.m
  q := D.q
  d := D.d
  hm := lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one D.hm
  hq := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hq⟩ := D.hq
    rw [hq]
    exact Nat.pow_pos (by decide)
  hqPrimePower := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hq⟩ := D.hq
    exact ⟨2, n, Nat.prime_two, hn.pos, hq⟩

/-- The fixed QPBT field model, viewed as the field model of the low
individual degree test. -/
@[reducible] noncomputable def DirectLdParams.toLDTFieldModel (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel D.toLDTParameters.q :=
  D.model.toFieldModel

/-- Coordinate coding from the direct scalar field to the LDT carrier. -/
noncomputable def directScalarEquiv (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D ≃ _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation D.model

/-- Coordinate coding identifies direct points with LDT points, with the
coordinate order reversed: direct coordinate `j` is LDT coordinate
`Fin.rev j`.  The direct game zeroes a *prefix* of a sampled diagonal
direction (`directPrefixProjection`, paper equation `eq:cl-dlnf`), whereas
the low individual degree test zeroes a *suffix*
(`extendRestrictedDirection`, `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:49-65`).
Reversing the coordinate order aligns the two restriction conventions, as
required by the game
correspondence in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`. -/
noncomputable def directPointEquiv (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    (Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) ≃ _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point D.toLDTParameters where
  toFun u i := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D (u (Fin.rev i))
  invFun u j := (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D).symm (u (Fin.rev j))
  left_inv u := by
    funext j
    simp
  right_inv u := by
    funext i
    simp

@[simp] theorem directPointEquiv_apply (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (u : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) (i : Fin D.m) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointEquiv D u i = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D (u (Fin.rev i)) :=
  rfl

@[simp] theorem directPointEquiv_symm_apply (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (u : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point D.toLDTParameters) (j : Fin D.m) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointEquiv D).symm u j =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D).symm (u (Fin.rev j)) :=
  rfl

/-! ## Bounded coefficient vectors -/

/-- Turn a coefficient vector into its polynomial of degree at most `n`. -/
noncomputable def coefficientPolynomial
    {K : Type*} [Field K] (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → K) : Polynomial K :=
  ((Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv K (n + 1)).symm c).1

 theorem coefficientPolynomial_degree_le
    {K : Type*} [Field K] (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → K) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coefficientPolynomial n c).natDegree ≤ n := by
  let p := (Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv K (n + 1)).symm c
  have hp : p.1 ∈ Polynomial.degreeLE K n := by
    rw [← Polynomial.degreeLT_succ_eq_degreeLE]
    exact p.2
  have hdegree : p.1.degree ≤ n := Polynomial.mem_degreeLE.mp hp
  by_cases hzero : p.1 = 0
  · simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coefficientPolynomial, p, hzero]
  · exact Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_degree_le.mpr hdegree

@[simp]  theorem coefficientPolynomial_coeff
    {K : Type*} [Field K] (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → K)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coefficientPolynomial n c).coeff i = c i := by
  exact congrFun ((Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv K (n + 1)).apply_symm_apply c) i



/-- Direct axis-line coefficients are equivalent to LDT bounded axis-line
polynomials over the fixed field model. -/
noncomputable def directAxisAnswerEquiv (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly D D.d ≃ _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  refine
    { toFun := fun c =>
        { poly := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coefficientPolynomial D.d c
          degreeBounded := by
            exact coefficientPolynomial_degree_le D.d c }
      invFun := fun f i => f.poly.coeff i
      left_inv := by
        intro c
        funext i
        exact coefficientPolynomial_coeff D.d c i
      right_inv := by
        intro f
        apply _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisLinePolynomial.ext
        apply _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.linePolynomial_coeff_fin_injective D.toLDTParameters
          (coefficientPolynomial_degree_le D.d fun i => f.poly.coeff i)
          f.degreeBounded
        intro i
        exact coefficientPolynomial_coeff D.d (fun j => f.poly.coeff j) i }

/-- Direct diagonal-line coefficients are equivalent to LDT bounded
diagonal-line polynomials over the fixed field model. -/
noncomputable def directDiagonalAnswerEquiv (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly D (D.m * D.d) ≃ _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  refine
    { toFun := fun c =>
        { poly := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coefficientPolynomial (D.m * D.d) c
          degreeBounded := by
            exact coefficientPolynomial_degree_le (D.m * D.d) c }
      invFun := fun f i => f.poly.coeff i
      left_inv := by
        intro c
        funext i
        exact coefficientPolynomial_coeff (D.m * D.d) c i
      right_inv := by
        intro f
        apply _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLinePolynomial.ext
        apply _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.linePolynomial_coeff_fin_injective D.toLDTParameters
          (coefficientPolynomial_degree_le (D.m * D.d) fun i => f.poly.coeff i)
          f.degreeBounded
        intro i
        exact coefficientPolynomial_coeff (D.m * D.d) (fun j => f.poly.coeff j) i }





/-! ## Parameters and answers of the two QPBT game presentations -/

/-- Forget the divisibility field and expose the directly indexed parameters. -/
@[reducible] def LdParams.toDirectLdParams (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams where
  q := L.q
  m := L.m
  d := L.d
  k := L.k
  hm := L.hm
  hd := L.hd
  hk := L.hk
  hq := L.hq

@[simp] theorem LdParams.toDirectLdParams_model (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    L.toDirectLdParams.model = L.model := by
  unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams.model _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams.model _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams.toDirectLdParams
  congr

/-- The canonical answer equivalence between the seed-indexed and directly
indexed QPBT games: point answers correspond to point answers, axis-line
answers to axis-line answers, and diagonal-line answers to diagonal-line
answers. -/
noncomputable def ldDirectAnswerEquiv (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdAnswer L ≃ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams where
  toFun
    | .pointVals a => .pointVals a
    | .alinePolys a => .alinePolys a
    | .dlinePolys a => .dlinePolys a
  invFun
    | .pointVals a => .pointVals a
    | .alinePolys a => .alinePolys a
    | .dlinePolys a => .dlinePolys a
  left_inv a := by cases a <;> rfl
  right_inv a := by cases a <;> rfl

/-! ## Parsing seed-indexed questions -/

/-- Parse a seed-indexed question into the directly indexed question carrying
the coordinate selected by `chiIndex`. -/
noncomputable def parseLdQuestion (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdQuestion L → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams
  | (.point, z) =>
      (.point, ⟨z.point, L.toDirectLdParams.firstIndex, 0⟩)
  | (.aline, z) =>
      (.aline, ⟨z.point, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex L z.seed, 0⟩)
  | (.dline, z) =>
      (.dline, ⟨z.point, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.chiIndex L z.seed, z.direction⟩)

/-- Embed a direct sample into the seed-indexed ambient space using the
specified residue in the selected seed fiber. -/
noncomputable def ldSpaceOfDirectResidue (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams)
    (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams)
    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace L
  | .inl (.inl i) => sample.point i
  | .inl (.inr _) => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedOfIndexResidue L sample.index residue
  | .inr i => sample.direction i

@[simp] theorem ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_point (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams)
    (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams)
    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue).point = sample.point :=
  rfl

@[simp] theorem ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_seed (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams)
    (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams)
    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue).seed =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedOfIndexResidue L sample.index residue :=
  rfl

@[simp] theorem ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_direction (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams)
    (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams)
    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue).direction = sample.direction :=
  rfl

/-- The ambient seed-indexed sample space is a direct sample together with a
uniform residue in the selected seed fiber. -/
noncomputable def ldSpaceSeedFiberEquiv (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace L ≃ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams × Fin (L.q / L.m) where
  toFun z :=
    (⟨z.point, (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedFiberEquiv L z.seed).1, z.direction⟩,
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedFiberEquiv L z.seed).2)
  invFun x := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L x.1 x.2
  left_inv z := by
    funext i
    rcases i with (i | i)
    · rcases i with (i | i)
      · rfl
      · rcases i with ⟨⟩
        change (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedFiberEquiv L).symm (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedFiberEquiv L z.seed) = z.seed
        exact (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedFiberEquiv L).symm_apply_apply z.seed
    · rfl
  right_inv x := by
    rcases x with ⟨sample, residue⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · cases sample with
      | mk point index direction =>
          simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_point,
            _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_seed, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_direction]
          rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedFiberEquiv_seedOfIndexResidue]
    · simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedOfIndexResidue]





/-! ## Exact question-law transport -/

/-- The common source sample is a direct common sample together with its
uniform seed-fiber residue. -/
noncomputable def ldQuestionSeedFiberEquiv (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType) × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace L) ≃
      (((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType) × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams) ×
        Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
  (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.refl (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSpaceSeedFiberEquiv L)).trans
      (Equiv.prodAssoc (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams) (Fin (L.q / L.m))).symm









end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# The scalar error of the low-degree soundness transport

This module supplies the scalar half of the soundness transport for the
directly indexed low-degree game.  Its content is purely arithmetic: the
auxiliary sampling parameter with which the low individual degree theorem is
applied to a coordinate strategy, the resulting bounds on the three terms of
the LDT error `mainFormalError`, and the absorption of the
simultaneous-measurement estimate into the error function `deltaLd` of
`lem:ld-soundness`.

## Main definitions

* `directLdAuxParameter D = 2560000 m³ d` is the sampling parameter handed to
  `MIPStarRE.LDT.Test.mainFormal`.  It is the multiple of the exponential scale
  `2560000 m²` of `mainFormalError` with quotient `m d`, so that the
  exponential term of the LDT error is exactly `exp (-m d)`.

## Main results

* `directLdAuxParameter_pos` and `four_hundred_mul_le_directLdAuxParameter` are
  the two hypotheses `0 < k` and `400 m d ≤ k` of `mainFormal`, proved from the
  positivity of the dimension and of the degree alone.
* `directLd_test_term_le`, `directLd_field_term_le` and
  `directLd_exponential_term_le` bound the three terms of
  `mainFormalError D.toLDTParameters (directLdAuxParameter D) (3 ε)`: the test
  term by `3 ε^(1/40000)`, the field term by `d q^(-1/40000)`, and the
  exponential term by `2^(-b m d)` for every `0 ≤ b ≤ 1`.
* `exists_directLdTransportConstants` exhibits, for a sandwich constant
  `C₀ ≥ 1`, the explicit universal constants `a = 2500000000 C₀` and
  `b = 1/80000` for which `C₀ k √(mainFormalError + m d / q + ε)` is at most
  `deltaLd a b ε q m d k` in the regime `0 < ε ≤ 1`.
* `one_le_deltaLd_of_one_le_error` and
  `one_le_deltaLd_of_fieldSize_le_degree` bound `deltaLd` below by one in the
  two degenerate regimes `1 ≤ ε` and `q ≤ d`, and
  `consistencyDefect_heteroKron_le_one` bounds every bipartite consistency
  defect on a unit state above by one.  Together they close both degenerate
  regimes, where the conclusion of `lem:ld-soundness` carries no information.

The exponent `b = 1/80000` is half the exponent `1/40000` carried by
`mainFormalError`; the halving is exactly what the square root of the
simultaneous-measurement estimate costs.

## References

* `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`
* `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:139-167`
* `MIPStarRE/LDT/Test/MainTheorem/MainFormal.lean:288-327`
* `MIPStarRE/LDT/Test/MainTheorem/ScalarBounds/Definitions.lean:28-36`
* `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:180-202`
* `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

/-! ## The auxiliary sampling parameter -/

/-- The auxiliary sampling parameter of the low-degree soundness transport.

The low individual degree theorem is applied to each coordinate strategy of
a directly indexed strategy with `k = 2560000 m³ d` samples.  This
is the multiple of the exponential scale `2560000 m²` of `mainFormalError`
whose quotient is `m d`, and it dominates the corrected large-sampling
hypothesis `400 m d ≤ k` of `MIPStarRE.LDT.Test.mainFormal` uniformly in the
parameters.  Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:139-167`; paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`. -/
def directLdAuxParameter (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) : ℕ := 2560000 * D.m ^ 3 * D.d





/-! ## Elementary positivity of the parameters

The four lemmas below are formalization-only conveniences: they record the
positivity fields of `DirectLdParams` in the real numbers, where all the
scalar estimates of this module take place. -/









/-! ## The three terms of the LDT error -/









/-! ## The transport envelope

The three scalar quantities `ε^b`, `q^(-b)` and `2^(-b m d)` at the transport
exponent `b = 1/80000` are the inner factor of `deltaLd`; the abbreviation
below names their sum. -/

/-- The inner factor of `deltaLd` at the transport exponent `b = 1/80000`.
This is a formalization-only abbreviation, shared with the absorption of the
error of `prop:ld-simultaneous-general-k`. -/
noncomputable def transportEnvelope (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (ε : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.rpow ε (1 / 80000) + Real.rpow (D.q : ℝ) (-(1 / 80000)) +
    Real.rpow 2 (-((1 / 80000) * ((D.m * D.d : ℕ) : ℝ)))







/-! ## The LDT error at the auxiliary sampling parameter -/













/-! ## Absorption into the error function of `lem:ld-soundness` -/





/-! ## The degenerate regimes

In the two regimes `1 ≤ ε` and `q ≤ d` the error function `deltaLd` is at
least one, so the consistency conclusions of `lem:ld-soundness` hold for any
witnesses; the low-degree test carries no information there. -/





/-! ## A coarse universal bound on the consistency defect

The consistency defect compared with `deltaLd` in `lem:ld-soundness` is the
off-diagonal Born mass of a pair of measurement families acting on the two
tensor factors of a unit bipartite state.  Since the joint Born weights are
nonnegative and sum to one, that mass is at most one; combined with the two
lower bounds on `deltaLd` above this closes the regimes `1 ≤ ε` and `q ≤ d`.

The theorem below is formalization-only.  It is a generic statement about
`consistencyDefect` rather than about the low-degree game, and would naturally
live in `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/DistanceTheorems.lean`. -/

/-!
# Affine resampling of directly indexed lines

This module identifies the joint directly indexed line-point laws with the
equivalent sampling procedure that first draws their line marginal and then a
uniform affine parameter.  The argument retains zero diagonal directions: it
uses only translations of finite affine spaces and never cancels a direction.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-287`
- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1020-1116`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT

noncomputable section

/-- Translate the point coordinate of a direct sample along a direction that
depends only on its stored index and direction coordinates. -/
 def directLdSpacePointTranslateEquiv (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (directionOf : Fin D.m → (Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) →
      (Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D))
    (t : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace D ≃ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace D where
  toFun sample :=
    ⟨sample.point + t • directionOf sample.index sample.direction,
      sample.index, sample.direction⟩
  invFun sample :=
    ⟨sample.point + (-t) • directionOf sample.index sample.direction,
      sample.index, sample.direction⟩
  left_inv sample := by
    cases sample with
    | mk point index direction =>
        simp [add_assoc]
  right_inv sample := by
    cases sample with
    | mk point index direction =>
        simp [add_assoc]

@[simp]  theorem directLdSpacePointTranslateEquiv_apply
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (directionOf : Fin D.m → (Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) →
      (Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D))
    (t : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace D) :
    directLdSpacePointTranslateEquiv D directionOf t sample =
      ⟨sample.point + t • directionOf sample.index sample.direction,
        sample.index, sample.direction⟩ := rfl

@[simp]  theorem directLdSpacePointTranslateEquiv_symm_apply
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (directionOf : Fin D.m → (Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) →
      (Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D))
    (t : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace D) :
    (directLdSpacePointTranslateEquiv D directionOf t).symm sample =
      ⟨sample.point + (-t) • directionOf sample.index sample.direction,
        sample.index, sample.direction⟩ := rfl







end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Question and answer transport for the directly indexed low-degree game

This module reads low individual degree test questions as canonical direct
questions and rebases direct answers to the LDT line parametrization.

Points and lines are decoded with the coordinate order reversed
(`directPointEquiv`), so that the suffix-zero direction restriction of the
LDT diagonal test becomes the prefix-zero restriction of the direct game.
An LDT diagonal line reveals no coordinate index, whereas a direct diagonal
question carries one.  The transported question uses the *leading index* of
the decoded direction, the least coordinate at which the direction is
nonzero.  Under the direct sampler, this is the index attached to the sampled
direction exactly when the direction is nonzero at the sampled index
(`directDiagonalIndexOf_prefixProjection`), an event of conditional
probability `1 - 1/q`; on the LDT side, the leading index of a decoded
`j`-restricted direction is `Fin.rev j` exactly when its pivot coordinate is
nonzero (`directDiagonalIndexOf_extendRestrictedDirection`).  Diagonal answers
on zero-direction lines are read as the constant polynomial carrying their
value at the base point, following `rem:ld-win-zero-direction`.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:230-272`
- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:49-65`
- `rem:ld-win-zero-direction`
- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-! ## Canonical line rebasing of LDT lines -/

/-- A chosen affine parameter expressing a point relative to its canonical
line representative. -/
noncomputable def directLineRepParameter
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ} (v u : Fin m → K) : K :=
  Classical.choose (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.mem_linePoints_lineRepMap v u)

/-- The chosen canonical rebase parameter reconstructs the original point. -/
theorem directLineRepParameter_spec
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ} (v u : Fin m → K) :
    u = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap v u + _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLineRepParameter v u • v :=
  Classical.choose_spec (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.mem_linePoints_lineRepMap v u)

/-- Canonical line representatives are unchanged by translation along their
direction. -/
theorem lineRepMap_add_smul
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
    (v u : Fin m → K) (t : K) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap v (u + t • v) = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap v u := by
  let W : Submodule K (Fin m → K) := Submodule.span K ({v} : Set (Fin m → K))
  have hv : v ∈ W := Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton v)
  have hzero : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap v v = 0 := by
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.canonicalProjOfKernel, W, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_of_mem_right
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.isCompl_registerSubmodule_canonicalComplement W).symm hv]
  simp [map_add, map_smul, hzero]

/-- For a nonzero direction, the canonical rebase parameter is unique. -/
theorem directLineRepParameter_eq_of_nonzero
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
    {v u : Fin m → K} (hv : v ≠ 0) {t : K}
    (ht : u = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap v u + t • v) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLineRepParameter v u = t := by
  have hfun : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLineRepParameter v u • v = t • v := by
    apply add_left_cancel (a := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap v u)
    exact (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLineRepParameter_spec v u).symm.trans ht
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, v i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    apply hv
    funext i
    simpa using not_exists.mp h i
  have hcoord := congrFun hfun i
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hcoord
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ hi hcoord

/-- Translating a point on a nonzero line adds the translation to its
canonical rebase parameter. -/
theorem directLineRepParameter_add_smul
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
    {v u : Fin m → K} (hv : v ≠ 0) (t : K) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLineRepParameter v (u + t • v) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLineRepParameter v u + t := by
  apply _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLineRepParameter_eq_of_nonzero hv
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap_add_smul]
  calc
    u + t • v =
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap v u + _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLineRepParameter v u • v) + t • v := by
      rw [← _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLineRepParameter_spec v u]
    _ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap v u + (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLineRepParameter v u + t) • v := by
      module

/-! ## The leading index of a direction -/

/-- The coordinates at which a direct direction vector is nonzero. -/
def directionSupport (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (v : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) :
    Finset (Fin D.m) :=
  open Classical in
  Finset.univ.filter fun j => v j ≠ 0



/-- The leading index of a direction: the least coordinate at which it is
nonzero, or the last coordinate for the zero direction.  Every coordinate
before the leading index vanishes, so a direction is the prefix projection of
itself at its leading index, and the pair (leading index, direction) is a
canonical direct diagonal sample.  It is the direct index of the sample
whenever the sampled direction is nonzero at the sampled index. -/
noncomputable def directDiagonalIndexOf (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (v : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) : Fin D.m :=
  open Classical in
  if h : (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directionSupport D v).Nonempty then (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directionSupport D v).min' h
  else Fin.rev D.firstIndex









/-! ## Decoding LDT points and lines -/

/-- Decode an LDT point into the fixed direct scalar field, reversing the
coordinate order. -/
abbrev ldtPointToDirect (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point D.toLDTParameters → Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointEquiv D).symm

/-- The direct canonical axis question represented by an LDT axis line.
The LDT coordinate index is reversed together with the point
coordinates. -/
noncomputable def directAxisQuestionOf (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (line : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D :=
  let u := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D line.base
  let i : Fin D.m := Fin.rev line.direction
  let v : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection i
  (.aline, ⟨_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap v u, i, 0⟩)

/-- The direct canonical diagonal question represented by an LDT diagonal
line.  The decoded direction is kept and the direct index is its leading
index, so the question is the canonical direct question of the direct sample
formed by the decoded base, the leading index, and the decoded direction
(`directDiagonalQuestionOf_eq_directLdMap`). -/
noncomputable def directDiagonalQuestionOf (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (line : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D :=
  let u := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D line.base
  let v := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D line.direction
  (.dline, ⟨_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap v u, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalIndexOf D v, v⟩)

/-- The direct point question represented by an LDT point. -/
noncomputable def directPointQuestionOf (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (u : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point D.toLDTParameters) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdPointQuestionOf D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D u)



/-- The LDT diagonal line represented by a direct sample: the encoded
point and the encoded direction. -/
def ldtDiagonalLineOf (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace D) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters :=
  { base := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointEquiv D sample.point
    direction := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointEquiv D sample.direction }







/-! ## Rebasing lines -/

/-- Decoding an axis-line rebase is translation by the decoded scalar along
the reversed direct coordinate direction. -/
theorem ldtPointToDirect_axis_rebase (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (line : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
    (t : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).base =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D line.base +
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D).symm t •
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection (Fin.rev line.direction) := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  funext i
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointEquiv_symm_apply,
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisParallelLine.rebaseAt, _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisParallelLine.pointAt, Pi.add_apply,
    Pi.smul_apply]
  by_cases hi : i = Fin.rev line.direction
  · subst hi
    simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection, Fin.rev_rev, if_pos, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [Pi.single_eq_same, mul_one]
    exact (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel.equiv (q := D.q)).symm_apply_apply _
  · have hrev : Fin.rev i ≠ line.direction := by
      intro h
      apply hi
      rw [← h, Fin.rev_rev]
    simp [hi, hrev, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection]

/-- Decoding a diagonal-line rebase is translation by the decoded scalar
along the decoded direct direction. -/
theorem ldtPointToDirect_diagonal_rebase (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (line : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
    (t : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).base =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D line.base +
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D).symm t • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D line.direction := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  funext i
  change _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.decodeScalar
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.addCoord (line.base (Fin.rev i))
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.mulCoord t (line.direction (Fin.rev i)))) =
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.decodeScalar (line.base (Fin.rev i)) +
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.decodeScalar t * _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.decodeScalar (line.direction (Fin.rev i))
  simp [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.addCoord, _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.mulCoord]

/-- Canonical direct axis questions do not depend on the chosen base point of
the LDT line. -/
theorem directAxisQuestionOf_rebase (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (line : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
    (t : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisQuestionOf D (line.rebaseAt t) = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisQuestionOf D line := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisQuestionOf, AxisParallelLine.rebaseAt_direction]
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect_axis_rebase, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap_add_smul]

/-- Canonical direct diagonal questions do not depend on the chosen base point
of the LDT line; the leading index depends only on the direction. -/
theorem directDiagonalQuestionOf_rebase (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (line : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
    (t : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalQuestionOf D (line.rebaseAt t) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalQuestionOf D line := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalQuestionOf, _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLine.rebaseAt]
  have hrebase := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect_diagonal_rebase D line t
  change _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D (line.pointAt t) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D line.base +
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D).symm t • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D line.direction at hrebase
  rw [hrebase, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap_add_smul]

/-- The fixed scalar coding transports field addition to LDT coordinate
addition. -/
theorem directScalarEquiv_add (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (x y : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D (x + y) =
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.addCoord (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D x) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D y) := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  change _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel.equiv (x + y) =
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel.equiv
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel.equiv.symm (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel.equiv x) +
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel.equiv.symm (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel.equiv y))
  rw [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel.equiv.symm_apply_apply, _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel.equiv.symm_apply_apply]

private theorem coordinateDirection_ne_zero
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ} (i : Fin m) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection i : Fin m → K) ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hi := congrFun h i
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection] at hi

/-- Canonical rebase parameter for an LDT axis-parallel line. -/
noncomputable def directAxisRebaseParameter (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (line : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLineRepParameter (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection (Fin.rev line.direction))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D line.base)

/-- Canonical rebase parameter for an LDT diagonal line. -/
noncomputable def directDiagonalRebaseParameter (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (line : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLineRepParameter (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D line.direction)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D line.base)

/-- Axis-line canonical parameters add under LDT line rebasing. -/
theorem directAxisRebaseParameter_rebase (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (line : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
    (t : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisRebaseParameter D (line.rebaseAt t) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisRebaseParameter D line + (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D).symm t := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisRebaseParameter
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect_axis_rebase]
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLineRepParameter_add_smul
    (coordinateDirection_ne_zero (Fin.rev line.direction)) _

/-- Nonzero diagonal-line canonical parameters add under LDT line rebasing. -/
theorem directDiagonalRebaseParameter_rebase (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (line : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
    (t : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters)
    (hdir : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D line.direction ≠ 0) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalRebaseParameter D (line.rebaseAt t) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalRebaseParameter D line + (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D).symm t := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalRebaseParameter
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect_diagonal_rebase]
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLineRepParameter_add_smul hdir _

/-! ## Reading direct answers as LDT answers -/

/-- The constant diagonal-line answer with the given direct value. -/
noncomputable def constantDiagonalAnswer (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (x : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  exact { poly := Polynomial.C x
          degreeBounded := by simp }

/-- Constant answers are fixed by every reparametrization. -/
theorem constantDiagonalAnswer_reparamAt (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (x : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) (t : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.constantDiagonalAnswer D x) t =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.constantDiagonalAnswer D x := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  apply _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLinePolynomial.ext
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.constantDiagonalAnswer, _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt]



/-- Read one simultaneous coordinate from a direct point answer. -/
noncomputable def directPointAnswerReadout (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  intro answer
  exact match answer with
    | .pointVals a => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D (a r)
    | .alinePolys _ => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D 0
    | .dlinePolys _ => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D 0

/-- Read one simultaneous coordinate from a direct axis-line answer and
rebase its polynomial from the canonical direct line to the LDT line. -/
noncomputable def directAxisAnswerReadout (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
    (line : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  intro answer
  exact match answer with
    | .alinePolys a => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisAnswerEquiv D (a r))
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisRebaseParameter D line))
    | .pointVals _ => default
    | .dlinePolys _ => default

/-- Read one simultaneous coordinate from a direct diagonal-line answer.  For
a nonzero direction the polynomial is rebased from the canonical direct line
to the LDT line.  A zero direction is the singleton line through its base,
where the direct predicate accepts an answer exactly when its polynomial
function is constant with the point's value (`rem:ld-win-zero-direction`);
the answer is read as the constant polynomial carrying its value at the base
point, which is fixed by every reparametrization.  Wrong-form answers are
sent to the default polynomial. -/
noncomputable def directDiagonalAnswerReadout (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
    (line : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  classical
  intro answer
  exact match answer with
    | .dlinePolys a =>
        if _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D line.direction = 0 then
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.constantDiagonalAnswer D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalCoefficient (a r) 0)
        else
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalAnswerEquiv D (a r))
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalRebaseParameter D line))
    | .pointVals _ => default
    | .alinePolys _ => default

/-- Axis answer readout is covariant under LDT line rebasing. -/
theorem directAxisAnswerReadout_rebase (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
    (line : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
    (t : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters) (answer : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisAnswerReadout D r (line.rebaseAt t) answer =
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisAnswerReadout D r line answer) t := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  cases answer with
  | pointVals a => simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisAnswerReadout]
  | dlinePolys a => simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisAnswerReadout]
  | alinePolys a =>
      simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisAnswerReadout]
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisRebaseParameter_rebase, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv_add]
      rw [(_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D).apply_symm_apply]
      exact (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt_reparamAt
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisAnswerEquiv D (a r)) _ _).symm

/-- Diagonal answer readout is covariant under LDT line rebasing, including
the constant zero-direction convention. -/
theorem directDiagonalAnswerReadout_rebase (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
    (line : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
    (t : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters) (answer : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalAnswerReadout D r (line.rebaseAt t) answer =
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalAnswerReadout D r line answer) t := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  cases answer with
  | pointVals a => simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalAnswerReadout]
  | alinePolys a => simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalAnswerReadout]
  | dlinePolys a =>
      by_cases hdir : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D line.direction = 0
      · have hrebase : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).direction = 0 := by
          simpa [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLine.rebaseAt] using hdir
        simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalAnswerReadout, hdir, hrebase,
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.constantDiagonalAnswer_reparamAt]
      · have hrebase : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).direction ≠ 0 := by
          simpa [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLine.rebaseAt] using hdir
        simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalAnswerReadout, hdir, hrebase, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalRebaseParameter_rebase D line t hdir,
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv_add, (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D).apply_symm_apply]
        exact (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt_reparamAt
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalAnswerEquiv D (a r)) _ _).symm

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# The combined strategy of the simultaneity reduction

`def:ld-combined-strategy` turns a projective strategy for the directly indexed
low-degree game at parameters `D` into a projective strategy for the same game
at the combined parameters `D.combined` of `def:ld-combining-parameters`, on
the same state and the same two Hilbert spaces.  Each question of the combined
game is answered by measuring one question of the original strategy and
relabelling its outcome; the question measured and the relabelling are fixed by
the type of the combined question and by whether its stored coordinate index is
a point coordinate or a combining coordinate.

Writing a point of the combined space as `(u, α)` with `u` its point part and
`α` its combining part, the five cases are:

1. a point question at `(u, α)` measures the point question at `u` and answers
   the combined value `∑ r, α r * b r`;
2. an axis-parallel line question whose stored index is the point coordinate
   `j` measures the canonical axis-parallel line question of the original game
   at `u` with index `j`, and answers the combination `∑ r, α r * f r` of the
   measured line answers;
3. an axis-parallel line question whose stored index is a combining coordinate
   measures the point question at `u`: the line lies in the fiber of the
   projection to the point coordinates through `u`, so the combined polynomial
   restricted to it is the affine function of the parameter determined by the
   `k` values at `u`;
4. a diagonal line question whose stored index is the point coordinate `j`
   measures the canonical diagonal line question of the original game at `u`
   with index `j` and the point part of the direction, and answers
   `t ↦ ∑ r, (α r + t * w r) * f r (t + s)`;
5. a diagonal line question whose stored index is a combining coordinate
   measures the point question at `u`, its direction having vanishing point
   part, and answers as in case 3.

The affine shift `s` of cases 2 and 4 is `directCombinedRebaseParameter`, the
change of parameter between the presentation of the image line by the point
part of the combined canonical base and its presentation by its own canonical
base; the two need not agree, since the canonical base of a line of the
combined space need not project to the canonical base of its image.

Each case measures a single measurement of the original strategy and relabels
its outcome, so the combined strategy is again projective; this is
`directCombinedStrategy_isProjective`.

## Main definitions

* `directCombinedMeasuredQuestion` — the question of the original game measured
  on a question of the combined game.
* `directCombinedAnswerMap` — the relabelling of the measured outcome.
* `directCombinedStrategy` — `def:ld-combined-strategy`.

## References

* `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1409-1503`
* `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`
* `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:420-472`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-! ## Coordinates of a combined question -/

/-- The point part of a point of the combined space, at the combined
parameters of `def:ld-combining-parameters`. -/
def directCombinedPointPart (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (z : Fin D.combined.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointPart (m := D.m) (k := D.k) z

/-- The combining part of a point of the combined space. -/
def directCombinedCoefficientPart (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (z : Fin D.combined.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) : Fin D.k → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientPart (m := D.m) (k := D.k) z

@[simp] theorem directCombinedPointPart_combinedPoint (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (u : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) (α : Fin D.k → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPoint u α) = u :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointPart_combinedPoint u α

@[simp] theorem directCombinedCoefficientPart_combinedPoint (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (u : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) (α : Fin D.k → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedCoefficientPart D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPoint u α) = α :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientPart_combinedPoint u α

/-- A coordinate of the combined dimension is either a point coordinate or a
combining coordinate. -/
def directCombinedIndexSplit (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (i : Fin D.combined.m) :
    Fin D.m ⊕ Fin D.k :=
  finSumFinEquiv.symm i

@[simp] theorem directCombinedIndexSplit_combinedPointVar (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (j : Fin D.m) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedIndexSplit D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar D.m D.k j) = Sum.inl j := by
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedIndexSplit, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar]

@[simp] theorem directCombinedIndexSplit_combinedCoefficientVar
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedIndexSplit D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientVar D.m D.k r) = Sum.inr r := by
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedIndexSplit, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientVar]

/-- The geometric direction of the line carried by a question of the combined
game; the zero direction on point questions. -/
def directCombinedQuestionDirection (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (q : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D.combined) : Fin D.combined.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D :=
  match q.1 with
  | .point => 0
  | .aline => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection q.2.index
  | .dline => q.2.direction

/-! ## The measured question -/

/-- The direction of the line of the original game measured on a question of
the combined game.  It is the coordinate direction of the stored point
coordinate for an axis-parallel question, and the prefix projection of the
point part of the combined direction for a diagonal question; on the three
cases measuring a point question it is the zero direction. -/
def directCombinedMeasuredDirection (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (q : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D.combined) : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D :=
  match q.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedIndexSplit D q.2.index with
  | .aline, .inl j => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection j
  | .dline, .inl j =>
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPrefixProjection j (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D q.2.direction)
  | _, _ => 0

/-- The change of parameter between the presentation of the measured line by
the point part of the canonical base of the combined line and its presentation
by its own canonical base.  It is the canonical parameter of that line for the
measured direction; it is needed because the canonical base of a line of the
combined space need not project to the canonical base of its image line. -/
def directCombinedRebaseParameter (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (q : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D.combined) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLineRepParameter (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedMeasuredDirection D q)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D q.2.point)

/-- The question of the original game measured by the combined strategy on a
question of the combined game.  This is the case distinction of
`def:ld-combined-strategy`: cases 1, 3 and 5 measure a point question, case 2
an axis-parallel line question, and case 4 a diagonal line question. -/
def directCombinedMeasuredQuestion (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (q : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D.combined) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D :=
  match q.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedIndexSplit D q.2.index with
  | .aline, .inl j =>
      (.aline, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap D .aline
        ⟨_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D q.2.point, j, 0⟩)
  | .dline, .inl j =>
      (.dline, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap D .dline
        ⟨_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D q.2.point, j,
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D q.2.direction⟩)
  | _, _ => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdPointQuestionOf D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D q.2.point)

/-! ## The relabelling of the measured outcome -/

/-- The relabelling by which the combined strategy answers a question of the
combined game from the outcome of the measured question of the original game.
An outcome whose constructor does not match the measured question type is sent
to the zero answer of the constructor required by the combined question type,
which the combined win predicate treats exactly as the original win predicate
treats the mismatched outcome. -/
def directCombinedAnswerMap (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (q : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D.combined) (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D.combined :=
  let α := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedCoefficientPart D q.2.point
  let w := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedCoefficientPart D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedQuestionDirection D q)
  let s := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedRebaseParameter D q
  match q.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedIndexSplit D q.2.index with
  | .point, _ =>
      .pointVals fun _ =>
        match a with
        | .pointVals b => ∑ r : Fin D.k, α r * b r
        | .alinePolys _ => 0
        | .dlinePolys _ => 0
  | .aline, .inl _ =>
      .alinePolys fun _ =>
        match a with
        | .alinePolys f =>
            _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coefficientsOfPolynomial D.combined.d (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedAxisPolynomial α s f)
        | .pointVals _ => 0
        | .dlinePolys _ => 0
  | .aline, .inr _ =>
      .alinePolys fun _ =>
        match a with
        | .pointVals b =>
            _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coefficientsOfPolynomial D.combined.d (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fiberLinePolynomial α w b)
        | .alinePolys _ => 0
        | .dlinePolys _ => 0
  | .dline, .inl _ =>
      .dlinePolys fun _ =>
        match a with
        | .dlinePolys f =>
            _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coefficientsOfPolynomial (D.combined.m * D.combined.d)
              (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedDiagonalPolynomial α w s f)
        | .pointVals _ => 0
        | .alinePolys _ => 0
  | .dline, .inr _ =>
      .dlinePolys fun _ =>
        match a with
        | .pointVals b =>
            _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coefficientsOfPolynomial (D.combined.m * D.combined.d)
              (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fiberLinePolynomial α w b)
        | .alinePolys _ => 0
        | .dlinePolys _ => 0

/-! ## The combined strategy -/

/-- The combined strategy of `def:ld-combined-strategy`: the same state and the
same two Hilbert spaces, each question of the combined game answered by
measuring `directCombinedMeasuredQuestion` and relabelling its outcome by
`directCombinedAnswerMap`. -/
def directCombinedStrategy (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D)) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D.combined) where
  ιA := S.ιA
  ιB := S.ιB
  ψ := S.ψ
  ψ_norm := S.ψ_norm
  A := fun q =>
    (S.A (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedMeasuredQuestion D q)).postprocess
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedAnswerMap D q)
  B := fun q =>
    (S.B (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedMeasuredQuestion D q)).postprocess
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedAnswerMap D q)

@[simp] theorem directCombinedStrategy_state (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D)) : (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedStrategy D S).ψ = S.ψ := rfl

@[simp] theorem directCombinedStrategy_A (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D)) (q : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D.combined) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedStrategy D S).A q =
      (S.A (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedMeasuredQuestion D q)).postprocess
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedAnswerMap D q) := rfl

@[simp] theorem directCombinedStrategy_B (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D)) (q : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D.combined) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedStrategy D S).B q =
      (S.B (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedMeasuredQuestion D q)).postprocess
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedAnswerMap D q) := rfl



end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT
