/-!
# The questions measured by the combined strategy

`lem:ld-combined-question-law` identifies the pair of questions measured by the
combined strategy of `def:ld-combined-strategy` on a sample of the combined
game.  The coordinate index of the common sample is uniform on the `m + k`
coordinates of the combined dimension, and the identification splits according
to whether that index is a point coordinate or a combining coordinate.

On a point coordinate `j`, all three question types measure the canonical
question of the same type of the original game attached to the *projected*
sample `directCombinedSampleProjection`: the point part of the sampled point,
the index `j`, and the point part of the sampled direction.  This uses the
coordinate order of `def:ld-combining-map`: the point coordinates precede the
combining coordinates, so the coordinate direction of a point coordinate has
point part the corresponding coordinate direction, and the prefix projection at
a point coordinate restricts to the prefix projection at that coordinate of the
point part.

On a combining coordinate, every direction produced by the question
distribution has vanishing point part, so all three question types measure the
point question at the point part of the sampled point.

The projected sample is read from the *canonical* base of the combined line,
which need not project to the canonical base of the image line; the two agree
after rebasing along the image direction, which is
`lineRepMap_directCombinedPointPart_lineRepMap`.

## References

* `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1409-1503`
* `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`
* `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:473-508`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries

noncomputable section

local instance directCombinedIndexNonempty (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    Nonempty (Fin D.combined.m) :=
  ⟨D.combined.firstIndex⟩

/-! ## Coordinates of the combined dimension -/

@[simp] theorem combinedPointVar_val (m k : ℕ) (j : Fin m) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar m k j).val = j.val := by
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar]

@[simp] theorem combinedCoefficientVar_val (m k : ℕ) (r : Fin k) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientVar m k r).val = m + r.val := by
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientVar]

/-- The coordinate direction of a point coordinate of the combined dimension
has point part the corresponding coordinate direction. -/
@[simp] theorem directCombinedPointPart_coordinateDirection_pointVar
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (j : Fin D.m) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar D.m D.k j)) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection j := by
  funext j'
  show (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar D.m D.k j) :
      Fin (D.m + D.k) → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar D.m D.k j') =
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection j j'
  by_cases h : j' = j
  · subst h
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection, Pi.single_eq_same,
      Pi.single_eq_same]
  · rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection,
      Pi.single_eq_of_ne fun hc => h (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar_injective D.m D.k hc),
      Pi.single_eq_of_ne h]

/-- The coordinate direction of a combining coordinate of the combined
dimension has vanishing point part. -/
@[simp] theorem directCombinedPointPart_coordinateDirection_coefficientVar
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientVar D.m D.k r)) = 0 := by
  funext j
  show (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientVar D.m D.k r) :
      Fin (D.m + D.k) → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar D.m D.k j) = 0
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection,
    Pi.single_eq_of_ne (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientVar_ne_combinedPointVar D.m D.k r j).symm]

/-- Prefix projection at a point coordinate restricts to prefix projection at
that coordinate of the point part.  This is the coordinate order of
`def:ld-combining-map`: the point coordinates precede the combining ones. -/
@[simp] theorem directCombinedPointPart_directPrefixProjection_pointVar
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (j : Fin D.m)
    (w : Fin D.combined.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPrefixProjection (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar D.m D.k j) w) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPrefixProjection j (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D w) := by
  funext j'
  show (if (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar D.m D.k j').val < (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar D.m D.k j).val
      then 0 else w (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar D.m D.k j')) =
    if j'.val < j.val then 0 else _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D w j'
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar_val, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar_val]
  rfl

/-- Prefix projection at a combining coordinate annihilates the point part:
every point coordinate precedes every combining coordinate. -/
@[simp] theorem directCombinedPointPart_directPrefixProjection_coefficientVar
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
    (w : Fin D.combined.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPrefixProjection (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientVar D.m D.k r) w) = 0 := by
  funext j'
  show (if (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar D.m D.k j').val <
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientVar D.m D.k r).val
      then 0 else w (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar D.m D.k j')) = 0
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar_val, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientVar_val, if_pos]
  omega

/-! ## Canonical bases -/







/-! ## The measured questions -/

/-- The sample of the original game to which a sample of the combined game
projects at a point coordinate index: the point part of the sampled point, the
index, and the point part of the sampled direction. -/
def directCombinedSampleProjection (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (j : Fin D.m)
    (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace D.combined) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace D :=
  ⟨_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D sample.point, j,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D sample.direction⟩





/-! ## The law of the projected sample -/

/-- A point of the combined space is recovered from its two parts. -/
@[simp] theorem combinedPoint_combinedPointPart_combinedCoefficientPart
    {K : Type*} {m k : ℕ} (z : Fin (m + k) → K) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPoint (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointPart z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientPart z) = z := by
  funext i
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPoint]
  rcases hi : finSumFinEquiv.symm i with j | r
  · show _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointPart z j = z i
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointPart, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar, ← hi, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  · show _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientPart z r = z i
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientPart, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientVar, ← hi,
      Equiv.apply_symm_apply]







/-- The decomposition of a sample of the combined game into its coordinate
index and its two point parts on the one side, and its two combining parts on
the other. -/
 def directCombinedSpaceIndexEquiv (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace D.combined ≃
      ((Fin D.combined.m ×
          ((Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D))) ×
        ((Fin D.k → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.k → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D))) where
  toFun sample :=
    ((sample.index,
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D sample.point,
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D sample.direction)),
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedCoefficientPart D sample.point,
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedCoefficientPart D sample.direction))
  invFun x := ⟨_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPoint x.1.2.1 x.2.1, x.1.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPoint x.1.2.2 x.2.2⟩
  left_inv sample := by
    obtain ⟨point, index, direction⟩ := sample
    dsimp only
    congr 1 <;>
      first
        | rfl
        | exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPoint_combinedPointPart_combinedCoefficientPart _
  right_inv x := by
    obtain ⟨⟨i, u, v⟩, α, w⟩ := x
    dsimp only
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
    exact ⟨⟨trivial, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointPart_combinedPoint u α,
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointPart_combinedPoint v w⟩,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientPart_combinedPoint u α,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientPart_combinedPoint v w⟩



end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# The recovery of the polynomial-tuple measurements

`lem:ld-combining-recovery` turns the three conclusions of `lem:ld-soundness`
for the combined strategy at the combined parameters into the three conclusions
for the original strategy at the original parameters, by post-processing the
measurements of the combined game with the recovery map of
`def:ld-combining-map`.

The two point relations follow from the consistency-defect transport
inequality.  At a point `(u, α)` of the combined space the point measurement of
the combined strategy is the point measurement of the original strategy at `u`
post-processed by the combination with coefficients `α`, and the polynomial
measurement of the combined game read at that point is the same measurement
read through the recovery map and then combined with the same coefficients; the
two families therefore differ only on the recovery discrepancy event, whose
average is `(m + k) d / q`.  The uniform law on the combined space is the
product of the uniform laws on the point part and on the combining part, which
is the reindexing along
`directCombinedPointEquiv`.

The polynomial relation is data processing: the recovered measurements are
post-processings of the measurements of the combined game.

## Main statements

* `directCombinedPointEquiv` — the point of the combined space with given
  point and combining parts, as an identification.
* `directCombinedRecovery_relation_one` — the first conclusion.
* `directCombinedRecovery_relation_two` — the second conclusion.
* `directCombinedRecovery_relation_three` — the third conclusion.

## References

* `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1440-1503`
* `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`
* `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:617-680`
-/

/-! ## The two blocks of a point of the combined space -/

/-- The identification of a point of the combined space with the pair formed by
its point part and its combining part. -/
def directCombinedPointEquiv (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    ((Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.k → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D)) ≃
      (Fin D.combined.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) where
  toFun z := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPoint z.1 z.2
  invFun z := (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D z, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedCoefficientPart D z)
  left_inv z := by
    have h1 : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPoint z.1 z.2) = z.1 :=
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedPointPart_combinedPoint D z.1 z.2
    have h2 : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedCoefficientPart D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPoint z.1 z.2) = z.2 :=
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedCoefficientPart_combinedPoint D z.1 z.2

      (fun r => z (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr r))) (finSumFinEquiv.symm i) = z i

    · simp only [Sum.elim_inr]
      rw [← hi, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

/-!
# The value of the combined strategy

`lem:ld-combined-value` transports the value of a projective strategy along
`def:ld-combined-strategy`.  Both games weight their nine ordered type pairs
uniformly, so it suffices to bound the rejection probability of each branch of
the combined game by a bounded number of branch rejection probabilities of the
original game.  Splitting a branch according to the event of
`lem:ld-combined-question-law`, the branch conditioned on a point coordinate
index is the branch of the original game at the same ordered type pair, and the
branch conditioned on a combining coordinate index is the point-versus-point
branch of the original game; on each of the two events the relabelling of
`def:ld-combined-strategy` carries acceptance to acceptance, which is
`directCombinedWinTransport_all`.  Each branch of the combined game is therefore
rejected with probability at most the sum of two branch rejection probabilities
of the original game, and summing over the nine branches multiplies the
rejection probability by at most ten.

## References

* `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1409-1503`
* `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`
* `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:526-568`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-- The rejected mass of the original strategy at the pair of questions
measured by the combined strategy, as a function of the coordinate index and of
the two point parts of the sample of the combined game.  By
`lem:ld-combined-question-law` those three data determine the measured pair. -/
def directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D)) (types : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType)
    (i : Fin D.combined.m)
    (pd : (Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D)) : ℝ :=
  match _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedIndexSplit D i with
  | .inl j =>
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directRejectedMass D S
        (types.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap D types.1 ⟨pd.1, j, pd.2⟩)
        (types.2, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap D types.2 ⟨pd.1, j, pd.2⟩)
  | .inr _ =>
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directRejectedMass D S (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdPointQuestionOf D pd.1)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdPointQuestionOf D pd.1)













end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Branch-wise acceptance transport for the combined strategy

By `directRejectedMass_directCombinedStrategy_le`, the branch-wise estimates of
`lem:ld-combined-value` reduce to the following statement: the relabelling of
`def:ld-combined-strategy` sends an answer pair accepted by the win predicate
of the original game at the measured questions to an answer pair accepted by
the win predicate of the combined game.  This module proves that statement for
each of the nine ordered type pairs of the combined game.

Three of the nine branches are deterministic.  The two questions of a branch
whose type pair is diagonal are equal, so the acceptance clause of the original
game forces the two measured outcomes to be equal, and the relabelling, being a
function, sends them to equal combined outcomes.  The two branches pairing an
axis-parallel line with a diagonal line impose no condition in either game.

The six remaining branches pair a line with a point, and split according to
whether the stored coordinate index of the common sample is a point coordinate
or a combining coordinate.  On a point coordinate the acceptance clause of the
combined game is obtained from the acceptance clause of the original game by
the affine change of parameter `directCombinedRebaseParameter`: the parameter
presenting the sampled point on the sampled line of the combined space presents
the point part of the sampled point on the image line, after the shift.  On a
combining coordinate the sampled line lies in a fiber of the projection to the
point coordinates, the combining part of the sampled point is the affine
function `α₀ + t w` of the parameter, and the acceptance clause of the combined
game is the identity `∑ r (α₀ + t w)_r b_r = ∑ r α_r b_r`.

All declarations below are formalization-only support for
`lem:ld-combined-value`; none is a paper-labelled result.

## References

* `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1409-1503`
* `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`
* `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:526-568`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries

noncomputable section

/-! ## The two parts of a point along a line -/





/-- The coordinate direction of a point coordinate of the combined dimension
has vanishing combining part. -/
@[simp] theorem directCombinedCoefficientPart_coordinateDirection_pointVar
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (j : Fin D.m) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedCoefficientPart D
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar D.m D.k j)) = 0 := by
  funext r
  show (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPointVar D.m D.k j) :
      Fin (D.m + D.k) → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientVar D.m D.k r) = 0
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection,
    Pi.single_eq_of_ne (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedCoefficientVar_ne_combinedPointVar D.m D.k r j)]

/-! ## Degree bounds at the combined parameters -/





/-! ## Evaluation of the combined answers -/







/-! ## Structural clauses of the win predicate -/

/-! ## The branch-wise acceptance transport -/

/-- The acceptance transport of `lem:ld-combined-value` on one ordered type
pair: the relabelling of `def:ld-combined-strategy` sends an answer pair
accepted by the win predicate of the original game at the measured questions to
an answer pair accepted by the win predicate of the combined game. -/
def DirectCombinedWinTransport (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (t₁ t₂ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdType)
    (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace D.combined) : Prop :=
  ∀ a b : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdWinPredicate D
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedMeasuredQuestion D (t₁, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap D.combined t₁ sample))
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedMeasuredQuestion D (t₂, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap D.combined t₂ sample))
        a b = true →
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdWinPredicate D.combined
        (t₁, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap D.combined t₁ sample) (t₂, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap D.combined t₂ sample)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedAnswerMap D (t₁, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap D.combined t₁ sample) a)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCombinedAnswerMap D (t₂, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap D.combined t₂ sample) b) = true

















end

/-!
# Seed-fiber dilation for the directly indexed low-degree game

This module dilates a seed-indexed low-degree strategy by a maximally
correlated residue register.  Block-diagonal projective measurements retain
arbitrary dependence on the seed within each `chiIndex` fiber.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-458`
- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-! ## Projective block measurements -/

/-- Relabel a matrix measurement along an equivalence of outcome alphabets. -/
noncomputable def matrixMeasurementTransport
    {alpha beta iota : Type*}
    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement beta iota :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    (fun b => M.effect (e.symm b))
    (fun b => M.pos (e.symm b))
    (by
      calc
        ∑ b, M.effect (e.symm b) = ∑ a, M.effect a :=
          Equiv.sum_comp e.symm M.effect
        _ = 1 := M.sum_eq_one)

@[simp] theorem matrixMeasurementTransport_effect
    {alpha beta iota : Type*}
    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    (b : beta) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.matrixMeasurementTransport e M).effect b = M.effect (e.symm b) :=
  rfl



/-- Assemble a family of matrix measurements as diagonal blocks indexed by a
finite classical register. -/
noncomputable def blockDiagonalMeasurement
    {alpha iota block : Type*}
    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
    (M : block → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha (iota × block) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    (fun a => Matrix.blockDiagonal fun r => (M r).effect a)
    (fun a => _root_.LIDT.Matrix.blockDiagonal_nonneg
      (fun r => (M r).effect a) (fun r => (M r).pos a))
    (by
      ext ⟨i, r⟩ ⟨j, s⟩
      simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply]
      by_cases hrs : r = s
      · subst s
        simp only [if_pos]
        calc
          ∑ x, (M r).effect x i j = (1 : Matrix iota iota ℂ) i j :=
            by
              simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using
                congrFun (congrFun (M r).sum_eq_one i) j
          _ = (1 : Matrix (iota × block) (iota × block) ℂ)
              (i, r) (j, r) := by
                change (if i = j then 1 else 0) =
                  (if (i, r) = (j, r) then 1 else 0)
                simp
      · simp [hrs])

@[simp] theorem blockDiagonalMeasurement_effect
    {alpha iota block : Type*}
    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
    (M : block → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    (a : alpha) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.blockDiagonalMeasurement M).effect a =
      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a) :=
  rfl



/-! ## The correlated residue state -/

/-- The normalized maximally correlated state on the common seed-fiber
residue. -/
noncomputable def seedResidueAncilla (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ
      (Fin (L.q / L.m) × Fin (L.q / L.m)) := by
  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState (Fin (L.q / L.m))

/-- The seed-residue ancilla has unit norm. -/
theorem seedResidueAncilla_norm (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedResidueAncilla L‖ = 1 := by
  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState_norm (Fin (L.q / L.m))

/-- Tensor the original strategy state with the maximally correlated residue
state and shuffle the factors back into the two local carriers. -/
noncomputable def seedFiberLiftedState
    {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game} (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G) (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ
      ((S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m)) × (S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m))) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexState _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.prodShuffle (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.vecTensor S.ψ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedResidueAncilla L))

/-- The correlated seed-fiber lift preserves normalization of the strategy
state. -/
theorem seedFiberLiftedState_norm
    {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game} (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G) (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedFiberLiftedState S L‖ = 1 := by
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedFiberLiftedState, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexState_norm_eq, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.vecTensor_norm_eq,
    S.ψ_norm, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedResidueAncilla_norm, one_mul]

/-! ## From the seed-indexed game to the direct game -/

/-- The seed-indexed question selected in one residue block of a direct
question.  Applying `ldCL` ensures that irrelevant ambient coordinates are
canonicalized exactly as in the source game. -/
noncomputable def seededLdQuestion (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams)
    (q : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdQuestion L :=
  (q.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldCL L q.1 (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L q.2 residue))

/-- Dilate a strategy for the seed-indexed low-degree game to the directly
indexed game.  The two local carriers receive correlated copies of the seed
residue, and each measurement is block diagonal in that residue. -/
noncomputable def ldStrategyToDirect (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams)
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldGame L)) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame L.toDirectLdParams) where
  ιA := S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m)
  ιB := S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m)
  ψ := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedFiberLiftedState S L
  ψ_norm := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedFiberLiftedState_norm S L
  A q := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.blockDiagonalMeasurement fun residue =>
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.matrixMeasurementTransport (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldDirectAnswerEquiv L)

      Matrix.blockDiagonal fun residue =>

          ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm answer) :=
  rfl

@[simp] theorem ldStrategyToDirect_B_effect (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams)
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldGame L))
    (q : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
    (answer : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldStrategyToDirect L S).B q).effect answer =
      Matrix.blockDiagonal fun residue =>
        (S.B (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seededLdQuestion L q residue)).effect

/-!
# Correlated-ancilla consistency compression

This module contains the correlated-state identities and the two valid
seed-fiber consistency-defect compression results.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:393-458`
- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:180-202`
- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

/-! ## Seed-fiber identities -/

/-- Reconstructing a seed-indexed point question in any residue block gives
the original point question. -/
@[simp] theorem seededLdQuestion_directLdPointQuestionOf
    (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (u : Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)
    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seededLdQuestion L
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdPointQuestionOf L.toDirectLdParams u) residue =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldPointQuestionOf L u :=
  rfl

/-- The direct point-answer readout agrees with the seed-indexed readout: the
answer equivalence preserves point answers. -/
@[simp] theorem ldPointValuesOrZero_ldDirectAnswerEquiv_symm
    (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldPointValuesOrZero L ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm a) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdPointValuesOrZero L.toDirectLdParams a := by
  cases a <;> rfl























end

/-!
# Low-degree consistency transport

This module identifies the low individual degree polynomial outcomes with the
bounded polynomial representatives used by the directly indexed QPBT game.  It
also transports complete measurements and their evaluation postprocessings
without changing either coordinate order or consistency error.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:393-458`
- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:180-202`
- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-! ## Polynomial outcomes -/

private theorem directPolynomialRename_degreeOf_le
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin D.m) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D))
    (hp : ∀ i, MvPolynomial.degreeOf i p ≤ D.d) (i : Fin D.m) :
    MvPolynomial.degreeOf i (MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev p) ≤ D.d := by
  rw [← Fin.rev_rev i,
    MvPolynomial.degreeOf_rename_of_injective Fin.rev_injective]
  exact hp (Fin.rev i)

private theorem ldtPolynomial_ext
    {params : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Parameters} [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.FieldModel params.q]
    {g h : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params} (hpoly : g.poly = h.poly) : g = h := by
  cases g with
  | mk gp hg =>
      cases h with
      | mk hp hh =>
          simp only at hpoly
          subst hp
          rfl

/-- Bounded QPBT polynomial representatives are equivalent to LDT
polynomial outcomes.  The variable renaming is the same coordinate reversal
as `directPointEquiv`, so evaluation retains the direct coordinate order. -/
noncomputable def directPolyEquivPolynomial (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyIndex D.m (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) D.d ≃
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  refine
    { toFun := fun g =>
        { poly := MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev g.1
          lowIndividualDegree := by
            exact directPolynomialRename_degreeOf_le D g.1
              (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.degreeOf_le_of_mem_polyFunc g.2) }
      invFun := fun g =>
        ⟨MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev g.poly, by
          rw [MvPolynomial.mem_restrictDegree]
          intro s hs i
          exact (MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_iff.mp (by
            exact directPolynomialRename_degreeOf_le D g.poly
              g.lowIndividualDegree i)) s hs⟩
      left_inv := ?_
      right_inv := ?_ }
  · intro g
    apply Subtype.ext
    change MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev
      (MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev g.1) = g.1
    rw [MvPolynomial.rename_rename]
    rw [show Fin.rev ∘ Fin.rev = id by funext i; simp]
    exact MvPolynomial.rename_id_apply g.1
  · intro g
    cases g with
    | mk p hp =>
        have hpoly : MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev
            (MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev p) = p := by
          rw [MvPolynomial.rename_rename]
          rw [show Fin.rev ∘ Fin.rev = id by funext i; simp]
          exact MvPolynomial.rename_id_apply p
        exact (by
          exact ldtPolynomial_ext hpoly)

@[simp] theorem directPolyEquivPolynomial_poly
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyIndex D.m (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) D.d) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPolyEquivPolynomial D g).poly = MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev g.1 := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  rfl

/-- The polynomial equivalence commutes with evaluation after the direct point
and scalar codings. -/
@[simp] theorem directPolyEquivPolynomial_apply
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyIndex D.m (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) D.d)
    (u : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPolyEquivPolynomial D g (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointEquiv D u) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D (MvPolynomial.eval u g.1) := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  unfold _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial.toFun _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.evalPolynomialModel
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPolyEquivPolynomial_poly]
  unfold _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.decodePoint
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval_rename]
  congr 1
  apply congrArg (fun v : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D =>
    MvPolynomial.eval v g.1)
  funext i
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointEquiv_apply, Fin.rev_rev]
  change (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D).symm (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D (u i)) = u i
  exact (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D).symm_apply_apply (u i)

/-! ## Complete measurements -/

/-- Regard a complete LDT measurement as a matrix-valued QPBT
measurement, with exactly the same effects. -/
noncomputable def ldtMeasurementToMatrixMeasurement
    {alpha iota : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement alpha iota) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne M.outcome M.outcome_pos (by
    rw [M.sum_eq_total, M.total_eq_one])

@[simp] theorem ldtMeasurementToMatrixMeasurement_effect
    {alpha iota : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement alpha iota) (a : alpha) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtMeasurementToMatrixMeasurement M).effect a = M.outcome a :=
  rfl

/-- Relabel an LDT polynomial projective measurement by direct QPBT
polynomial representatives. -/
noncomputable def directPolynomialMeasurement
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    {iota : Type*} → [Fintype iota] → [DecidableEq iota] →
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial D.toLDTParameters) iota →
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyMeas D.m (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) D.d iota := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  intro iota _ _ G
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.matrixMeasurementTransport (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPolyEquivPolynomial D).symm
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtMeasurementToMatrixMeasurement G.toMeasurement)

@[simp] theorem directPolynomialMeasurement_effect
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    ∀ {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
      (G : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial D.toLDTParameters) iota)
      (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyIndex D.m (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) D.d),
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPolynomialMeasurement D G).effect g =
        G.outcome (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPolyEquivPolynomial D g) := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  intro iota _ _ G g
  rfl











/-! ## Correlated-ancilla compression -/

/-!
The diagonal-block conditional expectation preserves either mixed defect
exactly because the point measurement on the opposite carrier is constant on
the residue register.  It does not yield a global/global compression theorem:
the lifted state pairs equal residues, whereas separately compressing both
polynomial measurements produces an independent double average over residues.
Neither quantity bounds the other in general.  This open obstruction is
recorded in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`.
-/

/-- The normalized diagonal-block average of an operator on a carrier with a
finite ancillary register.  This is the local conditional expectation used to
discard one half of the correlated seed-residue ancilla. -/
noncomputable def averageDiagonalBlock
    {iota block : Type*} [Fintype iota] [Fintype block]
    (A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (iota × block)) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op iota := by
  classical
  exact (Fintype.card block : ℝ)⁻¹ •
    ∑ r, A.submatrix (fun i => (i, r)) (fun i => (i, r))

/-- Compress a POVM through the normalized diagonal-block average.  The
nonemptiness assumption says precisely that the normalized finite average is
defined over at least one ancillary basis element. -/
noncomputable def correlatedAncillaCompressMeasurement
    {alpha iota block : Type*}
    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block] [Nonempty block]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha (iota × block)) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    (fun a => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.averageDiagonalBlock (M.effect a))
    (fun a => by
      unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.averageDiagonalBlock
      apply smul_nonneg
      · positivity
      · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun r _ =>
          Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
            ((Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (M.pos a)).submatrix
              (fun i => (i, r))))
    (by
      classical
      ext i j
      simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.averageDiagonalBlock, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply,
        Matrix.submatrix_apply]
      calc
        ∑ a, (Fintype.card block : ℝ)⁻¹ •
              ∑ r, M.effect a (i, r) (j, r) =
            (Fintype.card block : ℝ)⁻¹ •
              ∑ a, ∑ r, M.effect a (i, r) (j, r) := by
                rw [Finset.smul_sum]
        _ = (Fintype.card block : ℝ)⁻¹ •
              ∑ r, ∑ a, M.effect a (i, r) (j, r) := by
                rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        _ = (Fintype.card block : ℝ)⁻¹ •
              ∑ r, (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (iota × block)) (i, r) (j, r) := by
                congr 1
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro r _
                simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using
                  congrFun (congrFun M.sum_eq_one (i, r)) (j, r)
        _ = (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op iota) i j := by
              simp [Matrix.one_apply, Fintype.card_ne_zero])

@[simp] theorem correlatedAncillaCompressMeasurement_effect
    {alpha iota block : Type*}
    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block] [Nonempty block]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha (iota × block)) (a : alpha) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.correlatedAncillaCompressMeasurement M).effect a =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.averageDiagonalBlock (M.effect a) :=
  rfl





/-- Specialize ancillary compression to the nonempty residue fiber supplied by
the divisibility data of `LdParams`. -/
noncomputable def seedFiberCompressMeasurement
    (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) {alpha iota : Type*}
    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha
      (iota × Fin (L.q / L.m))) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota := by
  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.correlatedAncillaCompressMeasurement M

@[simp] theorem seedFiberCompressMeasurement_effect
    (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) {alpha iota : Type*}
    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha
      (iota × Fin (L.q / L.m))) (a : alpha) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedFiberCompressMeasurement L M).effect a =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.averageDiagonalBlock (M.effect a) :=
  rfl



/-- Compress a direct polynomial-tuple POVM from the correlated seed-residue
carrier to the corresponding seed-indexed polynomial POVM. -/
noncomputable def seedFiberCompressPolyMeasTuple
    (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    (G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyMeasTuple L.toDirectLdParams
      (iota × Fin (L.q / L.m))) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyMeasTuple L iota := by
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedFiberCompressMeasurement L G

@[simp] theorem seedFiberCompressPolyMeasTuple_effect
    (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    (G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyMeasTuple L.toDirectLdParams
      (iota × Fin (L.q / L.m))) (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyTuple L) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.seedFiberCompressPolyMeasTuple L G).effect g =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.averageDiagonalBlock (G.effect g) :=
  rfl









end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Value of the seed-fiber dilation

The correlated seed-fiber dilation `ldStrategyToDirect` reads a strategy for
the seed-indexed low-degree game as a strategy for the directly indexed game.
This module shows that the dilation preserves the value exactly.

The direct game asks the canonical questions of a common direct sample.  In
each residue block the dilated strategy asks the original strategy the seeded
canonical questions of that sample; since canonicalizing a canonical sample
changes nothing, these are the seed-indexed questions of the common sample
carrying that residue.  The Born weight of the dilation is the uniform average
of the original Born weights over the residue, the predicates agree after
parsing, and the seed-indexed sample is a direct sample together with a
uniform residue, so the two averages coincide branch by branch, including the
point/point, line/line, and wrong-form clauses and the zero-direction
convention.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:214-458`
- Blueprint `def:ld-question-distribution`, `lem:ld-aline-level`,
  `lem:ld-dline-level`, `lem:ld-question-typed-cl`, `lem:alnf`, and `lem:dlnf`
- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section



/-- Accepted Born mass at a fixed pair of seed-indexed questions. -/
 def ldAcceptedMass (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldGame L))
    (x y : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdQuestion L) : ℝ :=
  ∑ a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdAnswer L, ∑ b : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdAnswer L,
    if _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldWinPredicate L x y a b then _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.outcomeWeight S x y a b else 0

/-- Accepted Born mass at a fixed pair of direct questions. -/
 def directAcceptedMass (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D))
    (x y : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D) : ℝ :=
  ∑ a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D, ∑ b : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D,
    if _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdWinPredicate D x y a b then _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.outcomeWeight S x y a b else 0





end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Strategy transport for the directly indexed low-degree game

This module reads one coordinate of a projective directly indexed strategy as
a two-space low individual degree test strategy.  The question and answer
transport of `Transport.Questions` supplies the canonical direct question of
every LDT line, with the reversed coordinate order and the leading index of
the decoded diagonal direction, together with answer readouts that are
covariant under line rebasing; this establishes all four covariance
conditions of `ProjStrat`.  The module also records exact Born-weight
formulas for both directions of strategy transport.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-458`
- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:49-151`
- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-! ## From a direct strategy to an LDT strategy -/

/-- Regard a matrix-valued projective measurement as a projective measurement
of the low individual degree test. -/
noncomputable def matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas
    {alpha iota : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    (hM : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas alpha iota where
  toMeasurement := {
    toSubMeas := {
      outcome := M.effect
      total := 1
      outcome_pos := M.pos
      sum_eq_total := M.sum_eq_one
      total_le_one := le_rfl
    }
    total_eq_one := rfl
  }
  proj a := (hM a).isIdempotentElem.eq

@[simp] theorem matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas_outcome
    {alpha iota : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    (hM : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) (a : alpha) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas M hM).outcome a = M.effect a :=
  rfl

/-- Point measurements obtained by querying the direct strategy and reading
one simultaneous coordinate. -/
noncomputable def directCoordinatePointMeasurement
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
    {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    (M : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D →
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D) iota)
    (hM : ∀ q, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M q)) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point D.toLDTParameters) (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters) iota := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  intro u
  exact _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas.postprocess
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (M (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointQuestionOf D u))
      (hM (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointQuestionOf D u)))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointAnswerReadout D r)

/-- Axis-line measurements obtained by querying the canonical direct line and
rebasing one coordinate polynomial to the LDT line parametrization. -/
noncomputable def directCoordinateAxisMeasurement
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
    {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    (M : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D →
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D) iota)
    (hM : ∀ q, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M q)) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters) iota := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  intro line
  exact _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas.postprocess
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (M (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisQuestionOf D line))
      (hM (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisQuestionOf D line)))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisAnswerReadout D r line)

/-- Diagonal-line measurements obtained by querying the canonical direct line
and rebasing one coordinate polynomial to the LDT line parametrization. -/
noncomputable def directCoordinateDiagonalMeasurement
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
    {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    (M : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D →
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D) iota)
    (hM : ∀ q, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M q)) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters) iota := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  intro line
  exact _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas.postprocess
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (M (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalQuestionOf D line))
      (hM (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalQuestionOf D line)))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalAnswerReadout D r line)

/-- The coordinate axis-line family is independent of the chosen affine
parametrization of an LDT line. -/
theorem directCoordinateAxisMeasurement_reparam
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
    {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    (M : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D →
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D) iota)
    (hM : ∀ q, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M q)) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisParallelMeasurementReparamInvariant D.toLDTParameters
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCoordinateAxisMeasurement D r M hM) := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  classical
  intro line t f
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCoordinateAxisMeasurement, _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas.postprocess,
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SubMeas.postprocess_outcome, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas_outcome]
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisQuestionOf_rebase]
  have hfiber :
      Finset.univ.filter (fun answer =>
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisAnswerReadout D r (line.rebaseAt t) answer =
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt f t) =
        Finset.univ.filter (fun answer =>
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisAnswerReadout D r line answer = f) := by
    ext answer
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directAxisAnswerReadout_rebase]
    exact (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAtEquiv t).injective.eq_iff
  rw [hfiber]

/-- The coordinate diagonal-line family is independent of the chosen affine
parametrization, including the zero-direction convention. -/
theorem directCoordinateDiagonalMeasurement_reparam
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
    {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    (M : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion D →
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D) iota)
    (hM : ∀ q, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M q)) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalMeasurementReparamInvariant D.toLDTParameters
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCoordinateDiagonalMeasurement D r M hM) := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  classical
  intro line t f
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCoordinateDiagonalMeasurement, _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas.postprocess,
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.SubMeas.postprocess_outcome, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas_outcome]
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalQuestionOf_rebase]
  have hfiber :
      Finset.univ.filter (fun answer =>
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalAnswerReadout D r (line.rebaseAt t) answer =
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt f t) =
        Finset.univ.filter (fun answer =>
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalAnswerReadout D r line answer = f) := by
    ext answer
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDiagonalAnswerReadout_rebase]
    exact (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAtEquiv t).injective.eq_iff
  rw [hfiber]

 theorem strategy_carrier_nonempty {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game} (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G) :
    Nonempty (S.ιA × S.ιB) := by
  by_contra h
  rw [not_nonempty_iff] at h
  letI := h
  have hzero : S.ψ = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hnorm := S.ψ_norm
  rw [hzero, norm_zero] at hnorm
  exact zero_ne_one hnorm

/-- The pure LDT state represented by a game's unit strategy vector. -/
noncomputable def strategyPureState {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game} (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G)
    [Nonempty (S.ιA × S.ιB)] : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.PureState (S.ιA × S.ιB) where
  vector := S.ψ
  unit := by
    rw [dotProduct_comm, ← EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct,
      inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, S.ψ_norm]
    norm_num

/-- The density-matrix state represented by a game's unit strategy vector. -/
noncomputable def strategyQuantumState {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game} (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.QuantumState (S.ιA × S.ιB) := by
  letI : Nonempty (S.ιA × S.ιB) := by
    exact strategy_carrier_nonempty S
  exact _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.PureState.toQuantumState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.strategyPureState S)

/-- The density-matrix state associated with a game strategy is normalized. -/
theorem strategyQuantumState_isNormalized {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game} (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.strategyQuantumState S).IsNormalized := by
  letI : Nonempty (S.ιA × S.ιB) := strategy_carrier_nonempty S
  simpa [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.strategyQuantumState] using
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.PureState.toQuantumState_isNormalized (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.strategyPureState S)

/-- The complex Born amplitude of a vector and two local effects. -/
 noncomputable def vectorBornAmplitude
    {iotaA iotaB : Type*}
    [Fintype iotaA] [DecidableEq iotaA]
    [Fintype iotaB] [DecidableEq iotaB]
    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (iotaA × iotaB))
    (A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op iotaA) (B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op iotaB) : ℂ :=
  inner ℂ psi (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron A B) psi)

/-- The real Born quadratic form of a vector and two local effects. -/
 noncomputable def vectorBornWeight
    {iotaA iotaB : Type*}
    [Fintype iotaA] [DecidableEq iotaA]
    [Fintype iotaB] [DecidableEq iotaB]
    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (iotaA × iotaB))
    (A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op iotaA) (B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op iotaB) : ℝ :=
  (vectorBornAmplitude psi A B).re



























/-- Read coordinate `r` of a projective direct-game strategy as a two-space
projective strategy for the low individual degree test. -/
noncomputable def directCoordinateProjStrat
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D))
    (hS : S.IsProjective) (r : Fin D.k) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjStrat D.toLDTParameters S.ιA S.ιB := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  exact {
    state := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.strategyQuantumState S
    isNormalized := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.strategyQuantumState_isNormalized S
    pointMeasurementA := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCoordinatePointMeasurement D r S.A hS.1
    axisParallelMeasurementA := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCoordinateAxisMeasurement D r S.A hS.1
    axisParallelReparamInvariantA :=
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCoordinateAxisMeasurement_reparam D r S.A hS.1
    diagonalMeasurementA := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCoordinateDiagonalMeasurement D r S.A hS.1
    diagonalReparamInvariantA :=
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCoordinateDiagonalMeasurement_reparam D r S.A hS.1
    pointMeasurementB := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCoordinatePointMeasurement D r S.B hS.2
    axisParallelMeasurementB := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCoordinateAxisMeasurement D r S.B hS.2
    axisParallelReparamInvariantB :=
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCoordinateAxisMeasurement_reparam D r S.B hS.2
    diagonalMeasurementB := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCoordinateDiagonalMeasurement D r S.B hS.2
    diagonalReparamInvariantB :=
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCoordinateDiagonalMeasurement_reparam D r S.B hS.2
  }







end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

# State conversion and direct point readout

This module contains the pure-state conversion and direct point-readout
portion of the low-degree consistency transport.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:393-458`
- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:180-202`
- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
-/

/-! ## Equality of the two consistency formulations -/

-- The following identities identify pure-state expectation with the
-- Euclidean quadratic form used in the consistency calculations below.  They
-- send a pure state to its Euclidean coordinate vector and identify the
-- quadratic form of that vector with evaluation in the associated density
-- state; they are stated for an arbitrary finite index type in
-- `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/DistanceTheorems/Support.lean`.




/-! ## Direct-strategy state and point readout -/



/-- The pure state carried by a game strategy, regarded as an LDT pure state. -/
noncomputable def gameStrategyPureState {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game} (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G) :
    letI : Nonempty (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.strategyQuantumState_isNormalized S).nonempty
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.PureState (S.ιA × S.ιB) := by
  letI : Nonempty (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.strategyQuantumState_isNormalized S).nonempty
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.strategyPureState S

@[simp] theorem gameStrategyPureState_vector {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game} (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G) :
    letI : Nonempty (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.strategyQuantumState_isNormalized S).nonempty
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.gameStrategyPureState S).vector = S.ψ := by
  letI : Nonempty (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.strategyQuantumState_isNormalized S).nonempty
  rfl



/-- The Euclidean vector of the strategy's pure-state presentation is the
original game vector. -/
@[simp] theorem gameStrategyPureState_euclideanVector
    {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game} (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G) :
    letI : Nonempty (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.strategyQuantumState_isNormalized S).nonempty
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.pureStateEuclideanVector (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.gameStrategyPureState S) = S.ψ := by
  letI : Nonempty (S.ιA × S.ιB) :=
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.strategyQuantumState_isNormalized S).nonempty
  apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (S.ιA × S.ιB) ℂ).injective
  rfl



@[simp] theorem directPointQuestionOf_directPointEquiv
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (u : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointQuestionOf D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointEquiv D u) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdPointQuestionOf D u := by
  unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointQuestionOf _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPointToDirect
  rw [(_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointEquiv D).symm_apply_apply]



/-- The LDT scalar readout is the direct coordinate readout followed by
the scalar coding equivalence. -/
@[simp] theorem directPointAnswerReadout_eq
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k) (answer : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer D) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointAnswerReadout D r answer =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdPointValuesOrZero D answer r) := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  cases answer <;> rfl





/-- Alice's direct point measurement followed by projection to coordinate
`r`. -/
noncomputable def directPointCoordinateMeasurementA
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D))
    (r : Fin D.k) (u : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) S.ιA :=
  (S.A (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
    (fun answer => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdPointValuesOrZero D answer r)

/-- Bob's direct point measurement followed by projection to coordinate
`r`. -/
noncomputable def directPointCoordinateMeasurementB
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D))
    (r : Fin D.k) (u : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) S.ιB :=
  (S.B (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
    (fun answer => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdPointValuesOrZero D answer r)

/-- Evaluate a transported LDT polynomial measurement at a direct point. -/
noncomputable def directPolynomialEvaluationMeasurement
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    {iota : Type*} → [Fintype iota] → [DecidableEq iota] →
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial D.toLDTParameters) iota →
        (Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) →
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) iota := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  intro iota _ _ G u
  exact (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPolynomialMeasurement D G).postprocess
    (fun g => MvPolynomial.eval u g.1)

/-- Alice's LDT point family obtained from direct coordinate `r`. -/
noncomputable def ldtCoordinatePointMeasurementA
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D))
    (hS : S.IsProjective) (r : Fin D.k) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point D.toLDTParameters) (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters) S.ιA := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  exact (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).pointMeasurementA

/-- Bob's LDT point family obtained from direct coordinate `r`. -/
noncomputable def ldtCoordinatePointMeasurementB
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D))
    (hS : S.IsProjective) (r : Fin D.k) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point D.toLDTParameters) (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters) S.ιB := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  exact (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).pointMeasurementB

/-- The LDT projective evaluation family associated with a global
polynomial projective measurement. -/
noncomputable def ldtPolynomialEvaluationMeasurement
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    {iota : Type*} → [Fintype iota] → [DecidableEq iota] →
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial D.toLDTParameters) iota →
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.IdxProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point D.toLDTParameters) (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters) iota := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  intro iota _ _ G u
  exact _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas.postprocess G (fun g => g u)

/-- Left placement of Alice's LDT point family. -/
noncomputable def ldtPointAPlaced
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D))
    (hS : S.IsProjective) (r : Fin D.k) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point D.toLDTParameters → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ιA × S.ιB) := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  intro u a
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtCoordinatePointMeasurementA D S hS r u).outcome a) 1

/-- Right placement of Bob's LDT point family. -/
noncomputable def ldtPointBPlaced
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D))
    (hS : S.IsProjective) (r : Fin D.k) :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point D.toLDTParameters → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ιA × S.ιB) := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  intro u a
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron 1 ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtCoordinatePointMeasurementB D S hS r u).outcome a)

/-- Left placement of an LDT polynomial evaluation family. -/
noncomputable def ldtPolynomialEvaluationLeft
    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) {iotaA iotaB : Type*}
    [Fintype iotaA] [DecidableEq iotaA]
    [Fintype iotaB] [DecidableEq iotaB] :

      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point D.toLDTParameters → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (iotaA × iotaB) := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  intro G u a
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPolynomialEvaluationMeasurement D G u).outcome a) 1

    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) {iotaA iotaB : Type*}
    [Fintype iotaA] [DecidableEq iotaA]
    [Fintype iotaB] [DecidableEq iotaB] :
    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial D.toLDTParameters) iotaB →
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Point D.toLDTParameters → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (iotaA × iotaB) := by
  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
  intro G u a
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron 1 ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldtPolynomialEvaluationMeasurement D G u).outcome a)

/-- Left placement of an LDT global polynomial measurement. -/

    (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) {iotaA iotaB : Type*}
    [Fintype iotaA] [DecidableEq iotaA]

/-!
# Diagonal branches of the coordinate strategies of the direct low-degree game

The LDT `j`-restricted diagonal sampler decodes to a direct direction with
vanishing prefix below the reversed index `i = Fin.rev j`, and the transported
question of `Transport.Questions` carries the leading index of that direction.
On the generic event that the direction is nonzero at `i`, the leading index
is `i` and the question is the canonical direct question of the direct sample
`(p, i, v)`, where the LDT defect is bounded by the direct rejection.
Otherwise the restricted direction is also the restriction at the next index,
so the LDT quantity recurses to that index with the factor `q⁻¹`, the
probability that the sampled coordinate vanishes; at the last index the zero
direction has the last coordinate as its leading index by convention and no
recursion occurs.  Summing the recursion shows that each LDT diagonal branch
is at most `q / (q - 1) ≤ 2` times the corresponding branch rejection of the
direct game.  The factor is genuine: a strategy that answers the canonical
question of a direction badly and the non-canonical questions of the same
geometric line well has LDT diagonal failure exceeding the direct branch
rejection.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:214-458`
- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:49-65,130-151`
- Blueprint `def:ld-question-distribution`, `lem:ld-aline-level`,
  `lem:ld-dline-level`, `lem:ld-question-typed-cl`, `lem:alnf`, and `lem:dlnf`
- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-! ## Direction coordinates and the one-coordinate recursion

The LDT `j`-restricted diagonal sampler decodes to a direct direction with
vanishing prefix below the reversed index `i = Fin.rev j`, and the transported
question carries the leading index of that direction.  On the generic event
that the direction is nonzero at `i`, the leading index is `i` and the
question is the canonical direct question of the direct sample `(p, i, v)`.
Otherwise the restricted direction is also the restriction at the next index,
so the LDT quantity recurses with the factor `q⁻¹`, the probability that
the sampled coordinate vanishes.  At the last index the zero direction has the
last coordinate as its leading index by convention, and no recursion occurs. -/

section DirectionCoordinates

variable (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)









/-- Split a direct direction into the LDT free coordinates of the
`j`-restricted diagonal test, read in reversed coordinate order, and the
coordinates below the reversed index. -/
 def restrictedDirectionEquiv (j : Fin D.m) :
    (Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) ≃
      (Fin (j.val + 1) → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Fq D.toLDTParameters) ×
        (Fin (Fin.rev j).val → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) where
  toFun v :=
    (fun c => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D (v ⟨D.m - 1 - c.val, by have := D.hm; omega⟩),
      fun c => v ⟨c.val, by
        have h1 := c.isLt
        have h2 := Fin.val_rev j
        omega⟩)
  invFun x := fun c =>
    if h : c.val < (Fin.rev j).val then x.2 ⟨c.val, h⟩
    else (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directScalarEquiv D).symm
      (x.1 ⟨D.m - 1 - c.val, by
        have h1 := c.isLt
        have h2 := j.isLt
        have h3 := Fin.val_rev j
        omega⟩)
  left_inv v := by
    funext c
    by_cases h : c.val < (Fin.rev j).val
    · simp only [dif_pos h, Fin.eta]
    · simp only [dif_neg h, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      refine congrArg v (Fin.ext ?_)
      change D.m - 1 - (D.m - 1 - c.val) = c.val
      have h1 := c.isLt
      have h2 := D.hm
      omega
  right_inv x := by
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · funext c
      have h1 := c.isLt
      have h2 := j.isLt
      have h3 := Fin.val_rev j
      have hc : ¬ (D.m - 1 - c.val < (Fin.rev j).val) := by omega
      simp only [dif_neg hc, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      refine congrArg x.1 (Fin.ext ?_)
      change D.m - 1 - (D.m - 1 - c.val) = c.val
      omega
    · funext c
      simp only [dif_pos c.isLt, Fin.eta]





end DirectionCoordinates





/-! ## The diagonal-line branches -/

section DiagonalBranches

variable (D : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams) (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame D))
  (hS : S.IsProjective) (r : Fin D.k)

/-- The rejected direct mass at the diagonal question of a direct sample with
the line on the left. -/
 def diagonalLinePointRejection (p : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) (i : Fin D.m)
    (v : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directRejectedMass D S (.dline, ⟨_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap v p, i, v⟩) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdPointQuestionOf D p)

/-- The rejected direct mass at the diagonal question of a direct sample with
the point on the left. -/
 def diagonalPointLineRejection (p : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) (i : Fin D.m)
    (v : Fin D.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directRejectedMass D S (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdPointQuestionOf D p) (.dline, ⟨_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineRepMap v p, i, v⟩)

/-- The LDT diagonal defect with the line on the left, as a function of the
decoded base point and decoded direction of the LDT line. -/

/-!
# Parameter evaluation versus completed line evaluation

Completed evaluation of a coefficient vector may return `none`, notably on a
zero-direction line when the represented polynomial is not constant.  A
successful completed readout at the point represented by a parameter agrees
with ordinary coefficient evaluation at that parameter.  Consequently,
parameter-value disagreement is contained in the union of completed-readout
disagreement and the two failure events.

The final theorem lifts this inclusion to the Born weights of two arbitrary
strategy POVMs.  It uses neither projectivity nor a collision estimate.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:230-390`
- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1267-1402`
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT

noncomputable section

namespace ExtendedLineGame





/-- Born mass of disagreement between the two parameter evaluations. -/
def parameterEvalDefect {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game} {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams} {degree : ℕ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G) (questionA : G.QuestionA) (questionB : G.QuestionB)
    (readA : G.AnswerA → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly params degree)
    (readB : G.AnswerB → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly params degree)
    (parameter : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ params) : ℝ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.outcomeEventWeight S questionA questionB fun answerA answerB =>
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalCoefficient (readA answerA) parameter ≠
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalCoefficient (readB answerB) parameter

/-- Born mass of disagreement between the two completed evaluation readouts. -/
def completedEvalDefect {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game} {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams} {degree : ℕ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G) (questionA : G.QuestionA) (questionB : G.QuestionB)
    (readA : G.AnswerA → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly params degree)
    (readB : G.AnswerB → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly params degree)
    (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc params) (parameter : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ params) : ℝ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.outcomeEventWeight S questionA questionB fun answerA answerB =>
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directEvalOpt line (line.base + parameter • line.direction) (readA answerA) ≠
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directEvalOpt line (line.base + parameter • line.direction) (readB answerB)

/-- Alice's marginal Born mass of a failed completed evaluation. -/
def completedEvalNoneMassA {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game} {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams} {degree : ℕ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G) (questionA : G.QuestionA)
    (readA : G.AnswerA → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly params degree)
    (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc params) (parameter : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ params) : ℝ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aliceEventWeight S questionA fun answerA =>
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directEvalOpt line (line.base + parameter • line.direction) (readA answerA) = none

/-- Bob's marginal Born mass of a failed completed evaluation. -/
def completedEvalNoneMassB {G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Game} {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams} {degree : ℕ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy G) (questionB : G.QuestionB)
    (readB : G.AnswerB → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly params degree)
    (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc params) (parameter : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ params) : ℝ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.bobEventWeight S questionB fun answerB =>
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directEvalOpt line (line.base + parameter • line.direction) (readB answerB) = none



end ExtendedLineGame

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT
