/-!
# The branch data of the sub-line sampling procedure

The sampling procedure of the sub-line lemma draws a line kind, a stored
extended coordinate, and an unrestricted extended direction, and forms from
them the direction of the extended line: the elementary direction at the
stored coordinate in the axis branch, and the extended direction with the
coordinates preceding the stored coordinate replaced by zero in the diagonal
branch.  The two source lines are then read off the two coordinate blocks.
This module fixes the coordinate index that each source line must carry: the
stored coordinate itself when it belongs to that block, the first coordinate
otherwise.  With that choice the source block of the extended direction always
lies in the line spanned by the corresponding source direction, which is the
incidence hypothesis of the two projection lemmas.  The module also records
that moving an extended point to its canonical representative does not change
the canonical representative of either of its source blocks.

## References

The statements support `lem:qld-sublines` in
blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
The coordinate blocks are those of `def:combine-map`, blueprint lines
445--480, paper lines 970--989; the prefix truncation is that of
blueprint `def:ld-question-distribution`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT

noncomputable section

/-! ## The three ranges of extended coordinates -/



/-! ## Linearity of the identification of the two scalar fields -/





/-! ## The coordinate index carried by each source line -/

/-- The first coordinate of the source space.  Blueprint
`eq:chi-func`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:958-961`.
-/
def subLineFirstIndex (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) : Fin P.m :=
  ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one P.one_le_m⟩

/-- The coordinate index carried by the source `X` line of a branch: the
stored extended coordinate when it is an `X`-block coordinate, and the first
coordinate otherwise.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
def subLineXIndex (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) : Fin P.m :=
  if h : k.val < P.m then ⟨k.val, h⟩ else _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineFirstIndex P

/-- The coordinate index carried by the source `Z` line of a branch: the
stored extended coordinate when it is a `Z`-block coordinate, and the first
coordinate otherwise.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
def subLineZIndex (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) : Fin P.m :=
  if h : P.m ≤ k.val ∧ k.val < 2 * P.m then ⟨k.val - P.m, by omega⟩
  else _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineFirstIndex P

















/-! ## The two directions of a branch -/

/-- The direction of the extended line of a branch: the elementary direction
at the stored coordinate in the axis branch, and the extended direction with
the coordinates preceding the stored coordinate replaced by zero in the
diagonal branch.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
def subLineExtDirection (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (kind : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineKind)
    (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2))
    (w : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
    Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd :=
  match kind with
  | .axis => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection k
  | .diagonal => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPrefixProjection (D := P.extendedDirectLd) k w

/-- The direction of a source line of a branch: the elementary direction at
its coordinate index in the axis branch, and the given source block with the
coordinates preceding that index replaced by zero in the diagonal branch.
Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
def subLineSourceDirection (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (kind : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineKind)
    (i : Fin P.m) (v : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P :=
  match kind with
  | .axis => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.coordinateDirection i
  | .diagonal => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.prefixProjection (P := P.toLdParams) i v

/-! ## Incidence of the two source blocks of a branch direction -/





/-! ## Canonical representatives of the two source blocks -/





end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Coordinate blocks of an extended point and of an extended direct sample

This module records the block decomposition used by the sampling procedure of
the sub-line lemma on the extended dimension.  A point of the extended space
is the tuple consisting of its two source point blocks and its two scalar
coordinates, and this decomposition is a bijection carrying the uniform law to
the uniform law; in particular the two source blocks of a uniform extended
point are independent and uniform.  The decomposition is linear, so it
commutes with the affine parameterization of a line, and it commutes with the
canonical identification of the extended scalar field with the source scalar
field.  The stored coordinate index of an extended direct sample splits along
the same three coordinate ranges.

## References

The decompositions support `lem:qld-sublines` in
blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
The coordinate blocks are those of `def:combine-map`, blueprint lines
445--480, paper lines 970--989.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

noncomputable section

/-! ## Linearity of the coordinate blocks -/









/-! ## The coordinate blocks of an extended point -/

/-- Split an extended point into its two source point blocks and its two
scalar coordinates.  Blueprint `def:combine-map`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/
def extendedPointBlockEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) ≃
      ((Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) ×
          (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)) ×
        (Fin 2 → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :=
  (Equiv.arrowCongr (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.finCombineEquiv P.m)
      (Equiv.refl (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))).trans
    ((Equiv.sumArrowEquivProdArrow _ _ _).trans
      (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.sumArrowEquivProdArrow _ _ _) (Equiv.refl _)))

/-!
# Restricting and completing global polynomial-pair measurements

The combining map embeds pairs of bounded individual-degree polynomials into
extended polynomials. Restricting a measurement along this embedding produces a
submeasurement whose missing operator is the sum of the noncombined effects.
Relabeling those effects by one specified pair completes the measurement and
preserves projectivity.

These algebraic constructions do not establish the concentration estimate
`eq:qld-g-non-separable` or the point consistency required by
`exists_globalPairWitness`; those are separate quantitative obligations.

## References

- Blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1375-1404`,
  `eq:qld-sgg-completeness` and the final completion paragraph.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder

noncomputable section

/-- Recover the two polynomial components by setting the unused block to zero
and the scalar coordinates to `(1,0)` or `(0,1)`. This algebraic substitution
is the left inverse implicit in the restriction to combined outcomes in
`eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. Unlike evaluation as a
polynomial function on a finite field, it does not require a degree bound. -/
noncomputable def recoverCombinedPair {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m : ℕ}
    (polynomial : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * m + 2)) K) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin m) K × MvPolynomial (Fin m) K :=
  (MvPolynomial.eval₂ MvPolynomial.C (fun index =>
    match _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.finCombineEquiv m index with
    | .inl (.inl coordinate) => MvPolynomial.X coordinate
    | .inl (.inr _) => 0
    | .inr scalar => if scalar = 0 then 1 else 0) polynomial,
   MvPolynomial.eval₂ MvPolynomial.C (fun index =>
    match _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.finCombineEquiv m index with
    | .inl (.inl _) => 0
    | .inl (.inr coordinate) => MvPolynomial.X coordinate
    | .inr scalar => if scalar = 1 then 1 else 0) polynomial)

/-- Substitution recovers both components of a combined polynomial. This is
formalization support for the relabeling in `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper
lines 1375--1380. -/
@[simp] theorem recoverCombinedPair_combinePoly {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m : ℕ}
    (first second : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.recoverCombinedPair (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePoly first second) = (first, second) := by
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.recoverCombinedPair, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePoly, MvPolynomial.eval₂_rename,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.embX, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.embZ, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.alphaVar, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.betaVar, Function.comp_def, MvPolynomial.eval₂_eta]

/-- Distinct polynomial pairs label distinct combined outcomes. This justifies
restricting a measurement on extended polynomials to pairs without duplicating
an effect in `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. -/
theorem combinePoly_injective {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (fun pair : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K × MvPolynomial (Fin m) K =>
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePoly pair.1 pair.2) := by
  exact (show Function.LeftInverse _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.recoverCombinedPair
    (fun pair : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K × MvPolynomial (Fin m) K =>
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePoly pair.1 pair.2) from fun pair =>
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.recoverCombinedPair_combinePoly pair.1 pair.2).injective

/-- The bounded polynomial-pair embedding used to restrict the global
measurement in `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. The degree
bound is inherited from `def:combine-map`; the two scalar coordinates have
degree one, allowed by admissibility. -/
noncomputable def combinedPolyEmbedding (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P ↪ _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) P.d where
  toFun pair := ⟨_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePoly_mem_polyFunc P.hd pair.1.2 pair.2.2⟩
  inj' := by
    intro first second heq
    have hpoly : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePoly first.1.1 first.2.1 = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePoly second.1.1 second.2.1 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val heq
    have hpair : (first.1.1, first.2.1) = (second.1.1, second.2.1) :=
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePoly_injective hpoly
    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.fst hpair))
      (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.snd hpair))



/-- Restrict an extended-polynomial measurement to combined outcomes, as in
`eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. Injectivity of the combining
map ensures that the retained effects sum to at most the identity. This
construction does not assert the source's quantitative completeness bound. -/
noncomputable def combinedPairSubmeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
    (measurement : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Submeasurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P) carrier where
  effect pair := measurement.effect (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPolyEmbedding P pair)
  pos pair := measurement.pos _
  sum_le_one := by
    classical
    rw [← Finset.sum_image (fun first _ second _ heq =>
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPolyEmbedding P).injective heq)]
    exact (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
      (fun outcome _ _ => measurement.pos outcome)).trans measurement.sum_le_one





/-- Relabel a combined polynomial by its unique pair and send every other
polynomial to a specified pair. This implements the completion at an arbitrary
outcome in the last paragraph of `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404. The
noncombined outcomes are retained at the completion outcome, not discarded. -/
noncomputable def completedPairLabel (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (completionPair : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) P.d → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P :=
  Function.extend (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPolyEmbedding P) id (fun _ => completionPair)

/-- Completion preserves every combined polynomial's pair label. -/
@[simp] theorem completedPairLabel_combinedPolyEmbedding (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (completionPair pair : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.completedPairLabel P completionPair (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPolyEmbedding P pair) = pair := by
  exact (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPolyEmbedding P).injective.extend_apply _ _ _



/-- The completed polynomial-pair measurement of the final paragraph of
`lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404, obtained by relabeling all extended
polynomial outcomes. No assertion about consistency is built into this
construction. -/
noncomputable def completedPairMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
    (measurement : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier)
    (completionPair : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P) carrier :=
  measurement.postprocess (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.completedPairLabel P completionPair)





open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus





end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Approximate commutation of the field-valued expanded point measurements

The approximate commutation of `lem:qld-comm-cons` is stated for the binary
refinements `M^{(Point,W),u,r}_b` of the expanded point measurements.  The
combined point measurements of `lem:qld-4-10` are built here directly from the
`F_q`-valued measurements `M^{(Point,W),u}_a`, so the commutation estimate is
transferred to them.  The transfer is exact: since
`M^{(Point,X),x}_a = E_r (-1)^{tr(ar)} X^r(x)` and
`M^{(Point,Z),z}_b = E_s (-1)^{tr(bs)} Z^s(z)`, the commutator of the two
measurement effects is the Fourier transform, in the outcome pair `(a, b)`,
of the commutators of the expanded observables, and Parseval's identity for
the additive characters of `F_q` turns the sum over `(a, b)` of the squared
norms into the average over `(r, s)` of the squared norms of the observable
commutators.  No factor depending on `q` is lost.

## Main results

* `sum_norm_sum_smul_sq_of_orthogonal`: Parseval's identity for an orthogonal
  system of coefficients.
* `sum_fixedCharacter_mul`: Fourier cancellation for the fixed trace character.
* `expPoint_comm`: the field-valued expanded point measurements approximately
  commute on every register placement, with the error of
  `lem:qld-comm-cons`.

## References

The commutation estimate for the binary refinements is item 2 of
`lem:qld-comm-cons`, blueprint
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1139-1210`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:466-505`; the
Fourier form of the point effects is `def:expanded-point-measurement`, paper
lines 384--418.  The role of the transfer in the proof of `lem:qld-4-10` is
explained in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-points-field-valued.tex`.
-/

/-!
# Z-point deficits of the evaluated pair-line measurement

This module bounds the deficit of the overlap between the evaluated paired-line
measurement and the expanded Z-point measurement. The proof inserts the completed
joint point measurement, replaces it by the X-then-Z ordered product, and sums
the X effects. It uses evaluated consistency and the distance from the joint
point measurement to that ordered product. The bound holds first over any
probability law on pairs of line-point pairs and then over a product of restricted
line-point laws, whose point marginal is the uniform pair.

The estimates hold for arbitrary opposite placements, with first-player
specializations; register commutation requires no symmetry of the state.
The completed-outcome and real-overlap lemmas are also available for other
calculations. The concrete X-deficit argument is separate, in
`MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Lines.ConcreteXDeficit`.

source `lem:claim-17-3`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1204-1239`; the
consistency input is `lem:qld-xz-lines` and the ordered products are those of
`lem:qld-4-10`.

/-!
# Commuting and anticommuting Pauli tuples

This module defines the tuple phase used in the Pauli basis test and the
conditional uniform distributions used by its observable analysis.

## References

The definitions and probability bounds formalize blueprint
`def:anticommuting-tuple` and `fact:omega-anticomm-prob`, with paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:64-95`.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT

noncomputable section

/-- A tuple `(u_X,u_Z,r_X,r_Z)` over the fixed field model of an admissible
Pauli-test parameter tuple. This is the tuple space of
blueprint `def:anticommuting-tuple`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:64-68`. -/
abbrev PauliTuple (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :=
  (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) ×
    (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P

/-- A Pauli tuple is anticommuting when its phase bit is nonzero. This is
blueprint `def:anticommuting-tuple`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:64-68`. -/
def IsAnticommuting {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} (ω : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P) : Prop :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.gammaValue P ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2 ≠ 0

/-- A Pauli tuple is commuting when its phase bit vanishes. This is the
complementary case in blueprint
`def:anticommuting-tuple`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:64-68`. -/
def IsCommuting {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} (ω : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P) : Prop :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.gammaValue P ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2 = 0

noncomputable instance instDecidablePredPauliTupleIsAnticommuting (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    DecidablePred (@_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsAnticommuting P) := Classical.decPred _

noncomputable instance instDecidablePredPauliTupleIsCommuting (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    DecidablePred (@_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsCommuting P) := Classical.decPred _

/-- The uniform probability of the anticommuting event. This is the first
quantity in blueprint
`fact:omega-anticomm-prob`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:70-77`. -/
noncomputable def anticommProb (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) : ℝ :=
  ((Finset.univ.filter (@_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsAnticommuting P)).card : ℝ) /
    Fintype.card (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P)

/-- The complementary uniform probability of the commuting event in
blueprint `fact:omega-anticomm-prob`,
paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:70-77`. -/
noncomputable def commProb (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) : ℝ :=
  ((Finset.univ.filter (@_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsCommuting P)).card : ℝ) /
    Fintype.card (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P)

/-! ### Auxiliary counting lemmas

The declarations of this section are formalization-only auxiliaries for the
proof of blueprint
`fact:omega-anticomm-prob`. They record the cardinalities used by the
exact computation of the anticommuting probability. -/

















/-! ### The exact anticommuting probability -/













/-! ### Conditional uniform distributions -/

/-- The conditional uniform distribution on anticommuting tuples. This is the
sampling convention for the anticommuting cases of
blueprint `lem:qld-win-implications`,
paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:210-287`. -/
noncomputable def anticommTupleDist (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.uniformOnFinset (Finset.univ.filter (@_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsAnticommuting P))

/-- The conditional uniform distribution on commuting tuples. This is the
sampling convention for the commuting cases of blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:210-287`. -/
noncomputable def commTupleDist (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.uniformOnFinset (Finset.univ.filter (@_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsCommuting P))





end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Typed strategy measurements and point observables

This file fixes a projective, possibly heterogeneous strategy for the Pauli
basis test and extracts the typed measurement families used in the analysis.
Malformed answers are folded into a fixed valid answer, so the extracted
families remain complete measurements. The winning hypothesis bounds their
original wrong-form mass by the rejection probability. `Option` is used only
for the completed line-evaluation classes.

## References

The ambient strategy convention and the observable `W^r(u)` are in
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:160-190`,
corresponding to blueprint `def:strategy-observables`. The typed question
and answer forms come from blueprint `def:pauli-question-distribution` and
`def:pauli-win-predicate`, with paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:964-1225`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-- The two local registers of a heterogeneous bipartite strategy. This is
formalization-only indexing for the player-dependent notation at paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:160-190`. -/
inductive PlayerSide where
  | alice
  | bob
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Inhabited

instance instFintypePlayerSide : Fintype _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide where
  elems := {.alice, .bob}
  complete := by
    intro side
    cases side <;> simp

/-- A projective strategy satisfying the winning premise used throughout
Section `sec:commutation`. The structure retains the distinct player spaces and
measurement families of `Strategy`. Paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:160-172`; blueprint
`sec:commutation`. -/
structure ProjectiveSetting (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ε : ℝ) where
  toStrategy : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisTest P)
  isProjective : toStrategy.IsProjective
  win : 1 - ε ≤ toStrategy.value

namespace ProjectiveSetting

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}

/-- The local Hilbert-space index type on a specified player side. It indexes
the side-qualified operators at paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:174-190`. -/
@[reducible] def LocalSpace (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide → Type
  | .alice => S.toStrategy.ιA
  | .bob => S.toStrategy.ιB

instance localSpaceFintype (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) :
    Fintype (S.LocalSpace side) := by
  cases side <;> simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.LocalSpace] <;> infer_instance

instance localSpaceDecidableEq (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) :
    DecidableEq (S.LocalSpace side) := by
  cases side <;> simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.LocalSpace] <;> infer_instance

/-- Select the strategy measurement before outcome postprocessing on one
player side. This is the heterogeneous interpretation of the shared symbol `M` at
paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:160-184`. -/
def strategyMeasurement (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (question : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) (S.LocalSpace side) := by
  cases side with
  | alice => exact S.toStrategy.A question
  | bob => exact S.toStrategy.B question

/-- Embed a point into the full Pauli question space in basis `W`. This is the
point-question content from `def:pauli-question-distribution`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:997-1008`, blueprint
`def:pauli-question-distribution`. -/
def contentOfPoint (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.embedLd P W fun i =>
    match i with
    | .inl (.inl j) => u j
    | .inl (.inr _) => 0
    | .inr _ => 0

/-- Embed a canonical line description into the full Pauli question space.
Axis lines clear the direction block, whereas diagonal lines retain their
canonical projected direction. Paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:997-1008`; blueprint
`def:pauli-question-distribution` and `rem:deg-line-representatives`. -/
def contentOfLine (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.embedLd P W fun i =>
    match i with
    | .inl (.inl j) => line.base j
    | .inl (.inr _) => line.seed
    | .inr j =>
        match line with
        | .axis _ _ _ => 0
        | .diagonal _ _ direction _ _ => direction j

/-- Fill the point, scalar, and phase blocks shared by Pair, Pair/W, and Magic
Square questions. This is the type-4 content of
`def:pauli-question-distribution`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1030-1120`, blueprint
`def:pauli-question-distribution`. -/
def contentOfTuple (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (uX uZ : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (rX rZ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P :=
  fun i =>
    match i with
    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inl (.inl j)))) => uX j
    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inl (.inr j)))) => uZ j
    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inr _))) => 0
    | .inl (.inl (.inr _)) => 0
    | .inl (.inr _) => rX
    | .inr _ => rZ

/-- The typed point question in basis `W`, from the strategy notation at paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:174-190` and
blueprint `def:pauli-question-distribution`. -/
def pointQuestion (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P :=
  (.point W, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.contentOfPoint P W u)

/-- The typed axis or diagonal line question represented by a canonical
`LineDesc`. Paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:174-184`; blueprint
`def:strategy-observables` and `rem:deg-line-representatives`. -/
def lineQuestion (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P :=
  match line.kind with
  | .axis => (.aline W, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.contentOfLine P W line)
  | .diagonal => (.dline W, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.contentOfLine P W line)

/-- The typed Pair question for a tuple `(u_X,u_Z,r_X,r_Z)`. Paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:210-249`; blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
def pairQuestion (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (uX uZ : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (rX rZ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P :=
  (.pair, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.contentOfTuple P uX uZ rX rZ)

/-- The typed Pair/W question for a tuple `(u_X,u_Z,r_X,r_Z)`. Paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:210-249`; blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
def pairWQuestion (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (uX uZ : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (rX rZ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P :=
  (.pairW W, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.contentOfTuple P uX uZ rX rZ)

/-- The typed Magic Square question for a tuple `(u_X,u_Z,r_X,r_Z)`. Paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:213-258`; blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
def msQuestion (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (t : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType)
    (uX uZ : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (rX rZ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P :=
  (.ms t, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.contentOfTuple P uX uZ rX rZ)





-- The support rewrites below elaborate the `Fintype` instance of
-- `PauliEdge × PauliSpace P`, whose nested sigma/sum instance chain exceeds the
-- default recursion depth.














/-- Fold every non-point answer into the fixed point answer `0`. This realizes
the typed point family without adding a bottom outcome; wrong-form mass remains
visible through `wrongFormEffect`. Paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:174-190`; blueprint
`def:strategy-observables`. -/
def pointAnswerOrZero {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P
  | .value a => a
  | _ => 0

/-- Fold every answer not prescribed for `line` into the zero coefficient
list. Axis answers are padded from degree `d` to degree `m*d`. This realizes
the coefficient convention of `def:ideg-deg-polynomials`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:51-62`, blueprint
`def:ideg-deg-polynomials`. -/
def lineAnswerOrZero (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) :=
  match line with
  | .axis _ _ _ => fun answer =>
      match answer with
      | .alinePoly f =>
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly.padTo (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left P.d (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt P.one_le_m)) f
      | _ => 0
  | .diagonal _ _ _ _ _ => fun answer =>
      match answer with
      | .dlinePoly f => f
      | _ => 0

/-- Fold every non-Pair answer into `(0,0)`. This is the complete typed Pair
family used in items 4 and 6 of `lem:qld-win-implications`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:210-258`. -/
def pairAnswerOrZero {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P → ZMod 2 × ZMod 2
  | .pairBits bits => bits
  | _ => (0, 0)

/-- Fold every non-Pair/W answer into bit `0`. This is the complete typed
Pair/W family used in items 4 and 7 of `lem:qld-win-implications`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:210-263`. -/
def pairWAnswerOrZero {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P → ZMod 2
  | .bit bit => bit
  | _ => 0

/-- Fold wrong-form Pauli-test answers into a fixed valid Magic Square answer
of the requested question type. This supplies the typed families needed for an
actual `Strategy msGame`; paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:213-258`, blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
def msAnswerOrZero {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} (t : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsAnswer :=
  match t with
  | .constraint _ => fun answer =>
      match answer with
      | .msTriple bits => .triple bits
      | _ => .triple 0
  | .var _ => fun answer =>
      match answer with
      | .bit bit => .bit bit
      | _ => .bit 0

/-- The complete typed point measurement on one player side. It is the
corresponding strategy measurement postprocessed by `pointAnswerOrZero`; paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:174-190`, blueprint
`def:strategy-observables`. -/
noncomputable def pointMeas (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (S.LocalSpace side) :=
  (S.strategyMeasurement side (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W u)).postprocess _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero

/-- The complete typed line measurement on one player side, uniformly indexed
by degree-`m*d` coefficient lists. Paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:174-184`; blueprint
`def:ideg-deg-polynomials` and `lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
noncomputable def lineMeas (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)) (S.LocalSpace side) :=
  (S.strategyMeasurement side (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.lineQuestion P W line)).postprocess
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.lineAnswerOrZero P line)

/-- The completed evaluation classes of a typed line measurement. This is the
only strategy-side family whose outcome uses `Option`; `none` is precisely the
non-evaluating class of `def:ideg-deg-polynomials`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:51-62`, blueprint
`def:ideg-deg-polynomials`. -/
noncomputable def lineEvalMeas (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (Option (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) (S.LocalSpace side) :=
  (S.lineMeas side W line).postprocess (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalOpt line u)

/-- The complete typed Pair measurement on one player side. Paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:210-249`; blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
noncomputable def pairMeas (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (uX uZ : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (rX rZ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) (S.LocalSpace side) :=
  (S.strategyMeasurement side (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.pairQuestion P uX uZ rX rZ)).postprocess _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.pairAnswerOrZero

/-- The complete typed Pair/W measurement on one player side. Paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:210-263`; blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
noncomputable def pairWMeas (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (uX uZ : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
    (rX rZ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) (S.LocalSpace side) :=
  (S.strategyMeasurement side (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.pairWQuestion P W uX uZ rX rZ)).postprocess
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.pairWAnswerOrZero

/-- The complete typed Pauli/W measurement on one player side. Paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:205-209`; blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
noncomputable def pauliMeas (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) (S.LocalSpace side) :=
  (S.strategyMeasurement side (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliQuestion P W)).postprocess _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliAnswerOrZero

/-- The complete typed Magic Square measurement on one player side. Its answer
alphabet is exactly `MsAnswer`; these families therefore define a Magic Square
strategy. Paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:213-258`;
blueprint `lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
noncomputable def msMeas (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (t : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType) (uX uZ : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
    (rX rZ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsAnswer (S.LocalSpace side) :=
  (S.strategyMeasurement side (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.msQuestion P t uX uZ rX rZ)).postprocess
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.msAnswerOrZero t)

/-- The sum of effects corresponding to answers that are invalid for a given
question type. This mass is kept separate from the fixed valid outcome into
which typed postprocessing folds it. Paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1225`, blueprint
`def:pauli-win-predicate`. -/
noncomputable def wrongFormEffect {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (t : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType) (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) ι) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι :=
  ∑ answer ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun answer => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.validPauliAnswer t answer = false),
    M.effect answer

















/-- The side-indexed strategy observable
`W^r(u) = sum_a (-1)^(tr(ar)) M_a^((Point,W),u)`. It uses the canonical
character `phaseSign` and the fixed trace of `P.model`. This is
`def:strategy-observables`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:174-190`, blueprint
`def:strategy-observables`. -/
noncomputable def pointObs (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (r : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.LocalSpace side) :=
  ∑ a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r)) • (S.pointMeas side W u).effect a

/-- Select projectivity of the strategy POVM on either local space. -/
private theorem strategyMeasurement_isProjective
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (question : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (S.strategyMeasurement side question) := by
  cases side with
  | alice => exact S.isProjective.1 question
  | bob => exact S.isProjective.2 question

/-- The typed point measurement remains projective after answer folding. -/
theorem pointMeas_isProjective (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (S.pointMeas side W u) := by
  apply _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective
  exact strategyMeasurement_isProjective S side _

/-- The point observables form an additive representation, as follows from
`eq:qld-strat-obs`, paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:174-190`.
This multiplication law is a formalization-only consequence of that definition. -/
theorem pointObs_mul (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (r s : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    S.pointObs side W r u * S.pointObs side W s u =
      S.pointObs side W (r + s) u := by
  classical
  let M := S.pointMeas side W u
  have hM : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.pointMeas_isProjective S side W u
  change (∑ a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r)) • M.effect a) *
      (∑ a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P,
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (a * s)) • M.effect a) =
    ∑ a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (a * (r + s))) • M.effect a
  calc
    _ = ∑ a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P, ∑ b : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P,
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r)) *
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (b * s))) •
            (M.effect a * M.effect b) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a ha
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b hb
      rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul]
    _ = ∑ a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P,
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (a * (r + s))) • M.effect a := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a ha
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single a]
      · rw [(hM a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
        congr 1
        rw [mul_add, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace, map_add, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign_add]
      · intro b hb hba
        have hab : a ≠ b := fun h => hba h.symm
        rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero M hM hab]
        simp
      · intro ha'
        exact (ha' (Finset.mem_univ a)).elim







end ProjectiveSetting

/-!
# Approximate commutation of the expanded point projections

The trace-coarse-grained expanded point projections approximately commute on
each of the four register placements.  The commutator of the two projections is
a scalar multiple of a factorized operator whose strategy factor is the twisted
commutator of the two point observables and whose Pauli factor is a product of
generalized Pauli observables; the latter is an isometry, so the placement
bookkeeping of `ExpandedPlacement` reduces the estimate to the twisted
commutation relation of `lem:qld-win-implications-obs` on the corresponding
player side.  Both player sides are treated explicitly.

## References

The declarations prove item 2 of `lem:qld-comm-cons` in
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1139-1178`, whose paper source
is `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:466-505`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-! ## Algebraic preliminaries -/

/-- The generalized Pauli observables are self-adjoint. This identity supports
`lem:qld-comm-cons`. Blueprint `lem:twisted-commutation`,
paper `references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1052-1096`. -/
theorem tauObservable_conjTranspose {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Finite K]
    [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (v : ι → K) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W v)ᴴ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W v := by
  cases nonempty_fintype K
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable_eq_sum_pauliProj, Matrix.conjTranspose_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => ?_)
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.star_phaseSign]
  congr 1
  exact (Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliVec W e)).isHermitian.eq



namespace ProjectiveSetting

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}

/-! ## The commutator of two expanded point projections -/

/-- The Pauli-register factor of the expanded `X` observable at a tuple. -/
noncomputable def tauX (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ω : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable .X (fun h => ω.2.2.1 * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec ω.1 h)

/-- The Pauli-register factor of the expanded `Z` observable at a tuple. -/
noncomputable def tauZ (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ω : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable .Z (fun h => ω.2.2.2 * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec ω.2.1 h)





/-- The twisted commutator of the two point observables at a tuple. -/
noncomputable def twistedCommutator (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (ω : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.LocalSpace side) :=
  S.pointObs side .X ω.2.2.1 ω.1 * S.pointObs side .Z ω.2.2.2 ω.2.1 -
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.gammaValue P ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2) •
      (S.pointObs side .Z ω.2.2.2 ω.2.1 * S.pointObs side .X ω.2.2.1 ω.1)





/-! ## The approximate commutation on each placement -/









end ProjectiveSetting

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT
