/-!
# Expanded registers and point measurements

This module adjoins two EPR pairs to a heterogeneous Pauli-basis-test strategy,
records the four register placements used in the analysis, and defines the
expanded point observables and measurements. Fourier inversion identifies their
effects with a convolution of projectors and proves completeness and projectivity.

## References

The constructions formalize blueprint `def:expanded-state`,
`def:expanded-observables`, `def:expanded-point-measurement`, and
`def:expanded-point-trace-projection`. Their paper source is
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:367-418`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries

noncomputable section

/-- The six registers `AA'A''BB'B''`, retaining distinct Alice and Bob local
spaces. This is the register index type of `def:expanded-state`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:367-372`, blueprint
`def:expanded-state`. -/
abbrev SixReg (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :=
  (ιA × (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) ×
    (ιB × (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P))

/-- Equality of six-register indices is supplied by classical decidability for
the register type. This is the index set of blueprint
`def:expanded-state`. -/
noncomputable instance sixRegDecidableEq (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (ιA ιB : Type*) : DecidableEq (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P ιA ιB) :=
  Classical.decEq _

/-- Reassociate the tensor product of the strategy state and two EPR states
directly into register order `AA'A''BB'B''` for
`eq:def-psihat`, paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:367-372`. -/
def sixRegShuffle (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :
    (((ιA × ιB) × (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) ×
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) ≃ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P ιA ιB where
  toFun p := ((p.1.1.1, (p.1.2.1, p.1.2.2)),
    (p.1.1.2, (p.2.1, p.2.2)))
  invFun p := (((p.1.1, p.2.1), (p.1.2.1, p.1.2.2)),
    (p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2))
  left_inv p := by cases p; rfl
  right_inv p := by cases p; rfl

/-- The four placements `AA'`, `BA''`, `BB'`, and `AB''` used explicitly in
the chapter-14 consistency statements. Paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:420-450`; blueprint
`def:symmetric-equivalents`. -/
inductive Placement where
  | AA'
  | BA''
  | BB'
  | AB''
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Inhabited

instance instFintypePlacement : Fintype _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement where
  elems := {.AA', .BA'', .BB', .AB''}
  complete := by
    intro placement
    cases placement <;> simp

/-- The strategy-player side supplying the local Hilbert space in each of the
four register placements at paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:420-450`. -/
@[reducible] def Placement.side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide
  | .AA' => .alice
  | .BA'' => .bob
  | .BB' => .bob
  | .AB'' => .alice

namespace ProjectiveSetting

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}

/-- A strategy-local register paired with one generalized-Pauli register. This
is the operator space in `def:expanded-observables`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:374-382`. -/
abbrev ExpandedLocalSpace (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) :=
  S.LocalSpace side × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P

/-- The strategy state tensored with EPR states on `A'A''` and `B'B''`, in the
six-register order. This is `eq:def-psihat`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:367-372`, blueprint
`eq:def-psihat`. -/
noncomputable def psiHat (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
  classical
  exact
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sixRegShuffle P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.vecTensor
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.vecTensor S.toStrategy.ψ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)))
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)))

/-- Place an operator on one of `AA'`, `BA''`, `BB'`, or `AB''`, with the
identity on all remaining registers. The input local space is determined by
the placement, so no equality between the player spaces is assumed. Paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:420-450`; blueprint
`def:symmetric-equivalents`. -/
noncomputable def place (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement)
    (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
  fun i j =>
    match p with
    | .AA' =>
        O (i.1.1, i.1.2.1) (j.1.1, j.1.2.1) *
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) i.1.2.2 j.1.2.2 *
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op S.toStrategy.ιB) i.2.1 j.2.1 *
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) i.2.2.1 j.2.2.1 *
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) i.2.2.2 j.2.2.2
    | .BA'' =>
        (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op S.toStrategy.ιA) i.1.1 j.1.1 *
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) i.1.2.1 j.1.2.1 *
          O (i.2.1, i.1.2.2) (j.2.1, j.1.2.2) *
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) i.2.2.1 j.2.2.1 *
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) i.2.2.2 j.2.2.2
    | .BB' =>
        (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op S.toStrategy.ιA) i.1.1 j.1.1 *
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) i.1.2.1 j.1.2.1 *
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) i.1.2.2 j.1.2.2 *
          O (i.2.1, i.2.2.1) (j.2.1, j.2.2.1) *
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) i.2.2.2 j.2.2.2
    | .AB'' =>
        O (i.1.1, i.2.2.2) (j.1.1, j.2.2.2) *
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) i.1.2.1 j.1.2.1 *
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) i.1.2.2 j.1.2.2 *
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op S.toStrategy.ιB) i.2.1 j.2.1 *
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) i.2.2.1 j.2.2.1

/-- The expanded observable
`W^r(u) tensor tau^W(r * ind_m(u))` on a selected player side. This is
Equation `eq:lc-23`, paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:374-382`,
blueprint `eq:lc-23`. -/
noncomputable def expObs (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (r : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (S.pointObs side W r u)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W (fun h => r * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u h))

/-- The Fourier average defining the expanded point effect. This is the first
display of `def:expanded-point-measurement`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:384-418`, blueprint
`def:expanded-point-measurement`. -/
noncomputable def expPointOp (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) fun r =>
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r)) • S.expObs side W r u

/-- The Pauli-register projector onto labels whose low-degree encoding has
value `a` at `u`. This is Equation `eq:qld-point-obs-def`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:389-394`, blueprint
`eq:qld-point-obs-def`. -/
noncomputable def tauPointProj (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) :=
  ∑ h ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun h : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P =>
      dotProduct h (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u) = a),
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W h





/-- The phase induced by the fixed binary trace is an additive character. -/
private theorem phaseSign_fixedBinTrace_mul (x y : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model x) * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model y) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (x + y)) := by
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace, map_add]
  exact (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign_add _ _).symm

/-- The trace phase converts addition of coefficients to multiplication. -/
private theorem phaseSign_fixedBinTrace_mul_add (x y r : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (x * r)) *
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (y * r)) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model ((x + y) * r)) := by
  rw [add_mul]
  exact phaseSign_fixedBinTrace_mul (x * r) (y * r)

/-- Orthogonality of the fixed trace character over the Pauli scalar field. -/
private theorem phaseSign_fixedBinTrace_expect (c : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    (𝔼 r : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (c * r))) =
      if c = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0 := by
  simpa only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign_eq_ffChar,
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.ffChar_apply, mul_comm c] using
    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.fourier_fact_scalar (p := 2) (F := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) c)

/-- Averaging a trace phase times an operator selects the zero coefficient. -/
private theorem average_phaseSign_fixedBinTrace_smul
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (c : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))
        (fun r => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (c * r)) • A) =
      if c = 0 then A else 0 := by
  classical
  rw [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_smul_const]
  simp only [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution, _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.uniformOnFinset,
    Finset.mem_univ, if_true, Finset.card_univ, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  have havg := phaseSign_fixedBinTrace_expect (P := P) c
  rw [Fintype.expect_eq_sum_div_card] at havg
  have hcoeff :
      ((1 / (Fintype.card (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (∑ r : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P,
            _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (c * r))) =
        if c = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0 := by
    push_cast
    simpa only [one_div, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, mul_comm] using havg
  rw [hcoeff]
  by_cases hc : c = 0 <;> simp [hc]

/-- Averaging three fixed trace characters imposes the convolution constraint. -/
private theorem average_three_phaseSign_fixedBinTrace_smul
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (a x y : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))
        (fun r => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r)) •
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (x * r)) •
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (y * r)) • A))) =
      if x + y = a then A else 0 := by
  haveI : CharP (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) 2 :=
    (Algebra.charP_iff (ZMod 2) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) 2).mp (ZMod.charP 2)
  have hzero : a + x + y = 0 ↔ x + y = a := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact (CharTwo.add_eq_zero.mp (by simpa only [add_assoc] using h)).symm
    · intro h
      rw [add_assoc]
      exact CharTwo.add_eq_zero.mpr h.symm
  calc
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))
        (fun r => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r)) •
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (x * r)) •
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (y * r)) • A))) =
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))
        (fun r => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model ((a + x + y) * r)) • A) := by
          apply _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_congr
          intro r
          rw [smul_smul, phaseSign_fixedBinTrace_mul_add a x r, smul_smul,
            phaseSign_fixedBinTrace_mul_add (a + x) y r]
    _ = if a + x + y = 0 then A else 0 :=
      average_phaseSign_fixedBinTrace_smul (a + x + y) A
    _ = if x + y = a then A else 0 := if_congr hzero rfl rfl

/-- A scalar in the indicator vector factors out of the dot product. -/
private theorem dot_smul_indicator (r : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) :
    dotProduct (fun h => r * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u h) e =
      dotProduct e (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u) * r := by
  change dotProduct (r • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u) e = _
  rw [smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

/-- Tensor products distribute over the sums in both factors. -/
private theorem heteroKron_sum_sum {α β ι κ : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (A : α → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) (B : β → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op κ) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (∑ x, A x) (∑ y, B y) =
      ∑ x, ∑ y, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (A x) (B y) := by
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_left]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ =>
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_right _ _ _

/-- Scalars in the two tensor factors act successively on their tensor product. -/
private theorem heteroKron_smul_smul {ι κ : Type*}
    (c d : ℂ) (A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) (B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op κ) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (c • A) (d • B) = c • (d • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron A B) := by
  unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron Matrix.kronecker
  rw [Matrix.smul_kronecker, Matrix.kronecker_smul]

/-- The expanded point effect is the convolution of the strategy point
measurement and the Pauli-register point projection. This is the final display
of `def:expanded-point-measurement`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:395-418`. -/
theorem expPointOp_eq_convolution (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
    (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    S.expPointOp side W u a =
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P =>
          p.1 + p.2 = a),
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect p.1)
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj W u p.2) := by
  classical
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.expPointOp]
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.expObs, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.pointObs, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable_eq_sum_pauliProj]
  simp_rw [dot_smul_indicator]
  calc
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))
        (fun r => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r)) •
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron
            (∑ x, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (x * r)) •
              (S.pointMeas side W u).effect x)
            (∑ e, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model
              (dotProduct e (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u) * r)) • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e)) =
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))
        (fun r => ∑ x, ∑ e,
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r)) •
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (x * r)) •
              (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model
                (dotProduct e (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u) * r)) •
                  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect x)
                    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e)))) := by
          apply _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_congr
          intro r
          rw [heteroKron_sum_sum]
          simp_rw [heteroKron_smul_smul, Finset.smul_sum]
    _ = ∑ x, ∑ e,
          if x + dotProduct e (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u) = a then
            _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect x) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e)
          else 0 := by
      rw [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_sum]
      simp_rw [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_sum]
      simp_rw [average_three_phaseSign_fixedBinTrace_smul]
    _ = ∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P =>
          p.1 + p.2 = a),
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect p.1)
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj W u p.2) := by
      simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj]
      rw [Finset.sum_filter, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x hx
      calc
        (∑ e, if x + dotProduct e (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u) = a then
              _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect x) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e)
            else 0) =
          ∑ y, ∑ e ∈ Finset.univ.filter
              (fun e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P => dotProduct e (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u) = y),
            if x + dotProduct e (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u) = a then
              _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect x) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e)
            else 0 :=
          (Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ
            (fun e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P => dotProduct e (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u))
            (fun e => if x + dotProduct e (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u) = a then
              _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect x) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e)
            else 0)).symm
        _ = ∑ y, if x + y = a then
              _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect x)
                (∑ e ∈ Finset.univ.filter
                  (fun e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P =>
                    dotProduct e (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u) = y),
                  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e)
            else 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro y hy
          by_cases hxy : x + y = a
          · rw [if_pos hxy, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_right]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro e he
            rw [if_pos]
            rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2]
            exact hxy
          · rw [if_neg hxy]
            apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
            intro e he
            rw [if_neg]
            intro heq
            apply hxy
            rw [← (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2]
            exact heq

/-- Each point fiber is a sum of positive Pauli projectors. -/
private theorem tauPointProj_nonneg (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    0 ≤ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj W u a := by
  classical
  unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun e he =>
    Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.posSemidef_pauliProj W e)

/-- The point fibers partition the complete family of Pauli eigenspace projectors. -/
private theorem sum_tauPointProj_eq_one (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    ∑ a, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj W u a = 1 := by
  classical
  rw [show (∑ a, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj W u a) =
      ∑ e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e by
    simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj]
    exact Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ
      (fun e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P => dotProduct e (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u))
      (fun e => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e)]
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sum_pauliProj_eq_one W

/-- The projective point measurement on one Pauli register obtained by
coarse-graining the generalized Pauli basis according to its value at `u`.
This is the ancillary measurement used in item 1 of `lem:qld-comm-cons`, paper
`eq:qld-point-obs-def` in
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:385-411`,
blueprint `def:ancillary-point-measurement`. -/
noncomputable def tauPointMeas (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj W u) (by
    exact tauPointProj_nonneg W u) (by
    exact sum_tauPointProj_eq_one W u)

/-- The effects of the Pauli point measurement are the point projectors. -/
@[simp] theorem tauPointMeas_effect (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointMeas W u).effect a = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj W u a := rfl

/-- The fine product measurement underlying the convolution definition of an
expanded point measurement. Its outcome records the strategy and Pauli point
values separately. Paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:390-411`,
blueprint `def:point-tau-measurement`. -/
noncomputable def pointTauMeas (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    (fun p => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect p.1)
      ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointMeas W u).effect p.2))
    (fun p => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
      ((S.pointMeas side W u).pos p.1) ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointMeas W u).pos p.2))
    (by
      change ∑ p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P,
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect p.1)
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj W u p.2) = 1
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      calc
        (∑ x, ∑ y, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect x)
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj W u y)) =
            _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (∑ x, (S.pointMeas side W u).effect x)
              (∑ y, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj W u y) := (heteroKron_sum_sum _ _).symm
        _ = 1 := by
          rw [(S.pointMeas side W u).sum_eq_one, sum_tauPointProj_eq_one]
          exact Matrix.one_kronecker_one)

/-- Effects of the fine product measurement are the corresponding Kronecker
products of strategy and Pauli point effects. -/
@[simp] theorem pointTauMeas_effect (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
    (p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    (S.pointTauMeas side W u).effect p =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect p.1)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj W u p.2) := rfl

/-- Expanded point effects are positive semidefinite. This is the positivity
obligation in `def:expanded-point-measurement`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:384-418`. -/
theorem expPointOp_nonneg (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    0 ≤ S.expPointOp side W u a := by
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.expPointOp_eq_convolution]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun p hp => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
    ((S.pointMeas side W u).pos p.1) (tauPointProj_nonneg W u p.2)

/-- Expanded point effects sum to the identity. This is the completeness
obligation in `def:expanded-point-measurement`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:384-418`. -/
theorem expPointOp_sum_eq_one (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    ∑ a, S.expPointOp side W u a = 1 := by
  simp_rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.expPointOp_eq_convolution]
  calc
    (∑ a, ∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter
        (fun p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P => p.1 + p.2 = a),
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect p.1)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj W u p.2)) =
      ∑ p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P,
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect p.1)
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj W u p.2) := by
      let f : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P :=
        fun p => p.1 + p.2
      let A : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P →
          _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) := fun p =>
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.pointMeas side W u).effect p.1)
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj W u p.2)
      change (∑ a, ∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p => f p = a), A p) =
        ∑ p, A p
      exact Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ f A
    _ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (∑ x, (S.pointMeas side W u).effect x)
        (∑ y, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.tauPointProj W u y) := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      exact (heteroKron_sum_sum _ _).symm
    _ = 1 := by
      rw [(S.pointMeas side W u).sum_eq_one,
        sum_tauPointProj_eq_one (P := P)]
      exact Matrix.one_kronecker_one

/-- The complete expanded point measurement on the chosen player and Pauli
register. Its effects are those of `def:expanded-point-measurement`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:384-418`, blueprint
`def:expanded-point-measurement`. -/
noncomputable def pointMeasExp (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne (S.expPointOp side W u)
    (S.expPointOp_nonneg side W u) (S.expPointOp_sum_eq_one side W u)



/-- Expanded observables inherit the additive representation law. -/
private theorem expObs_mul (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (r s : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    S.expObs side W r u * S.expObs side W s u =
      S.expObs side W (r + s) u := by
  calc
    S.expObs side W r u * S.expObs side W s u =
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron
          (S.pointObs side W r u * S.pointObs side W s u)
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W (fun h => r * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u h) *
            _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W (fun h => s * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u h)) := by
      exact (Matrix.mul_kronecker_mul
        (S.pointObs side W r u) (S.pointObs side W s u)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W (fun h => r * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u h))
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W (fun h => s * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u h))).symm
    _ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (S.pointObs side W (r + s) u)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W ((fun h => r * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u h) +
          (fun h => s * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u h))) := by
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.pointObs_mul, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable_mul]
    _ = S.expObs side W (r + s) u := by
      congr 2
      funext h
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
      ring

/-- Idempotence of the expanded point effect, the idempotence half of projectivity
in `def:expanded-point-measurement`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:384-418`. -/
private theorem expPointOp_mul_self (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
    (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    S.expPointOp side W u a * S.expPointOp side W u a =
      S.expPointOp side W u a := by
  classical
  let D := _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
  let F : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) := fun r =>
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r)) • S.expObs side W r u
  change _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution D F *
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution D F = _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution D F
  calc
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution D F * _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution D F =
        _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution D
          (fun r => F r * _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution D F) := by
      simpa using (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_mul_left_right D
        1 (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution D F) F).symm
    _ = _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution D
          (fun r => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution D (fun s => F r * F s)) := by
      apply _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_congr
      intro r
      simpa using
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_mul_left_right D (F r) 1 F).symm
    _ = _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution D
          (fun r => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution D (fun s => F (r + s))) := by
      apply _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_congr
      intro r
      apply _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_congr
      intro s
      dsimp only [F]
      rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul, expObs_mul]
      congr 1
      simpa only [mul_add] using
        phaseSign_fixedBinTrace_mul (P := P) (a * r) (a * s)
    _ = _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution D
          (fun _ => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution D F) := by
      apply _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_congr
      intro r
      exact (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_uniform_equiv
        ((Equiv.addLeft r).symm) F).symm
    _ = _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution D F := by
      exact _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_const_of_isProbability D
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution_isProbability (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) _

/-- A Fourier coefficient of the expanded representation is a projection. -/
private theorem expPointOp_isProj (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
    (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.IsProj (S.expPointOp side W u a) := by
  refine isStarProjection_iff'.2 ⟨expPointOp_mul_self S side W u a, ?_⟩
  rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]
  exact (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (S.expPointOp_nonneg side W u a)).isHermitian.eq

/-- The expanded point measurement is projective, as asserted after the
convolution formula in `def:expanded-point-measurement`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:395-418`. -/
theorem pointMeasExp_isProjective (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (S.pointMeasExp side W u) := by
  intro a
  change _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.IsProj (S.expPointOp side W u a)
  exact expPointOp_isProj S side W u a











end ProjectiveSetting

end

/-- The fourth directed bipartition, with `BB'` first, `AB''` second, and
the unused `A'A''` pair retained on the second side. This is a coordinate
equivalence, not an identification of the two strategy-player spaces. -/
def bbAbBipartition (params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (left right : Type*) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg params left right ≃
      (right × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister params) ×
        ((left × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister params) × (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister params × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister params)) where
  toFun indices := ((indices.2.1, indices.2.2.1),
    ((indices.1.1, indices.2.2.2), (indices.1.2.1, indices.1.2.2)))
  invFun indices := ((indices.2.1.1, (indices.2.2.1, indices.2.2.2)),
    (indices.1.1, (indices.1.2, indices.2.1.2)))
  left_inv indices := by cases indices; rfl
  right_inv indices := by cases indices; rfl

/-- Coordinates of the `BB' | AB''(A'A'')` bipartition. -/
@[simp] theorem bbAbBipartition_apply (params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (left right : Type*)
    (indices : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg params left right) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.bbAbBipartition params left right indices =
      ((indices.2.1, indices.2.2.1),
        ((indices.1.1, indices.2.2.2), (indices.1.2.1, indices.1.2.2))) := rfl


























end

/-!
# Self-consistency of the sandwich POVM

The sandwich POVM `R^{x,z}_{a,b} = M^Z_b M^X_a M^Z_b` of
`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/Sandwich.lean` is approximately self-consistent
between opposite register placements.  The source establishes this by a
Cauchy--Schwarz chain (displays `eq:qld-rw-self-cons-1` to
`eq:qld-rw-self-cons-4`); here an exact identity is used instead.  Writing
`P_1, P_2` for the two placements of an operator `P`,
`W_b = (M^Z_b)_1 (M^Z_b)_2`, and `D^W_c = (M^W_c)_1 - (M^W_c)_2`, the
consistency defect of the two placed sandwiches equals
`(1/2) ∑_b ‖D^Z_b ψ‖^2 + (1/2) ∑_{a,b} ‖D^X_a W_b ψ‖^2`,
by two applications of the identity
`∑_c ⟨w, P_c Q_c w⟩ = ‖w‖^2 - (1/2) ∑_c ‖(P_c - Q_c) w‖^2` for projective
measurements.  The second sum is then bounded by the self-consistency of `M^X`
and the commutators on the two placements, since
`D^X_a W_b = W_b D^X_a + (M^Z_b)_2 K^1_{a,b} - (M^Z_b)_1 K^2_{a,b}`, where
`K^i_{a,b}` is the placed commutator of `M^X_a` and `M^Z_b`.

## Main results

* `sandwich_overlap_identity`: the exact expression of the overlap of two
  placed sandwiches.
* `sandwich_defect_pointwise_le`: the pointwise bound on the consistency
  defect of the sandwich for a fixed point pair.
* `ProjectiveSetting.sandwichDefectBound`,
  `ProjectiveSetting.sandwich_offDiagonal_le_sandwichDefectBound`, and
  `ProjectiveSetting.avg_sandwichDefectBound_le`: the bound as a function of
  the point pair, the pointwise estimate, and the average.

## References

Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:743-790`,
blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:851-880`
(`lem:qld-4-10`, first step); the identity route is explained in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-points-field-valued.tex`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus

noncomputable section

/-! ## Quadratic-form identities -/









/-! ## The overlap of two placed sandwiches -/



/-! ## The bound for the placed sandwiches -/

namespace ProjectiveSetting

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}

/-- The pointwise bound on the consistency defect of the sandwich POVM between
two placements, as a function of the point pair: one half of the
`Z`-distance plus three halves of the `X`-distance and of the two placed
commutator sums. -/
def sandwichDefectBound (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p₁ p₂ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement)
    (xz : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PointPair P) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2) * ∑ b : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P, ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState
      (S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect b) -
        S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect b)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2 +
    (3 / 2) * ((∑ a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P, ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState
        (S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect a) -
          S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect a)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2) +
      (∑ ab : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P, ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState
        (S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
            (S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2) -
          S.place p₁ ((S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
            (S.pointMeasExp p₁.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2) +
      ∑ ab : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P, ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState
        (S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
            (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2) -
          S.place p₂ ((S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
            (S.pointMeasExp p₂.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2)









end ProjectiveSetting

end

/-!
# Orthonormalization of the sandwich POVM

For each fixed point pair `(x, z)`, the sandwich POVM `R^{x,z}` on one
register placement is consistent with the sandwich POVM on the opposite
placement, with the consistency defect bounded by
`ProjectiveSetting.sandwichDefectBound`.  The orthonormalization lemma
`lem:ortho`, in its explicit-constant form
`projective_rounding_with_explicit_constant`, therefore produces a projective
measurement `Q^{x,z}` on the original local space, within `220 · c^{1/4}` of
`R^{x,z}` on the expanded state, where `c` is that bound.  Choosing such a
measurement for every pair and averaging, the concavity of `t ↦ t^{1/4}`
turns the average of the fiberwise errors into the same function of the
average defect.

The orthonormalization lemma is stated for a bipartite state whose first
tensor factor carries the POVM to be rounded.  The two bipartitions used are
`AA' | BA''(B'B'')`, for Alice's measurements, and `BA'' | AA'(B'B'')`, for
Bob's; the second is introduced here.

## Main results

* `baAaBipartition` with its two placement lemmas.
* `avgOver_rpow_quarter_le`: Jensen's inequality for the fourth root.
* `ProjectiveSetting.exists_projective_close_sandwich`: the fiberwise
  orthonormalization, for any bipartition exhibiting the two placements as
  the two tensor factors.

## References

Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:786-790`
(the application of the orthonormalization lemma), blueprint
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:870-878` (`lem:qld-4-10`), and
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:395-464` (`lem:ortho`); the
route is explained in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-points-field-valued.tex`.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus

noncomputable section

/-! ## Jensen's inequality for the fourth root -/





/-! ## The bipartition with Bob's registers first -/

/-- Regroup `AA'A''BB'B''` as `BA'' | AA'(B'B'')`.  This is the bipartition
in which Bob's expanded local space is the first tensor factor, used to
orthonormalize the sandwich POVM on Bob's side. -/
def baAaBipartition (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P ιA ιB ≃
      (ιB × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) ×
        ((ιA × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) × (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) where
  toFun := fun ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩ => ((b, a''), ((a, a'), (b', b'')))
  invFun := fun ⟨⟨b, a''⟩, ⟨a, a'⟩, b', b''⟩ => ((a, (a', a'')), (b, (b', b'')))
  left_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩; rfl
  right_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨b, a''⟩, ⟨a, a'⟩, b', b''⟩; rfl



end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Placement calculus on the expanded state

This module records the algebra of the four register placements used by the
combining argument: a placement is a unital `*`-homomorphism, placements on
opposite register pairs commute, and the crosswise exchange of the two EPR
pairs of the expanded state carries the placement `AA'` to `AB''` and `BA''`
to `BB'` while fixing the expanded state.  The last fact transfers every
state-dependent distance between the two bipartition schemes of
`def:symmetric-equivalents` without assuming a symmetric strategy.

## References

The placements are those of `def:symmetric-equivalents`, blueprint
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:420-450`.  The
EPR exchange is a distinct auxiliary permutation, not the product `U_σ U_θ`
of `lem:symmetric-equivalents-transfer` in that blueprint.  It supports
transfer between the two bipartition schemes without symmetry of the strategy;
its use for `lem:qld-4-10` is analyzed in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-points-field-valued.tex`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

namespace ProjectiveSetting

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}

/-! ## The crosswise exchange of the two EPR pairs -/

/-- The permutation of the six registers exchanging `A'` with `B''` and `A''`
with `B'`, while fixing the strategy registers.  This auxiliary involution
supports `def:symmetric-equivalents`; it is distinct from the four-cycle on
the ancillas induced by `U_σ U_θ` in `lem:symmetric-equivalents-transfer`,
blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex`. -/
def eprCrossSwap (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P ιA ιB ≃ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P ιA ιB where
  toFun := fun ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩ => ((a, (b'', b')), (b, (a'', a')))
  invFun := fun ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩ => ((a, (b'', b')), (b, (a'', a')))
  left_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩; rfl
  right_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨a, a', a''⟩, b, b', b''⟩; rfl

















end ProjectiveSetting

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# The sandwich POVM of the expanded point measurements

The first step of the proof of `lem:qld-4-10` combines the two expanded point
measurements into the sandwich POVM
`R^{x,z}_{a,b} = M^{(Point,Z),z}_b M^{(Point,X),x}_a M^{(Point,Z),z}_b`.  The
source forms it from the binary refinements; here it is formed directly with
outcomes in `F_q × F_q`, which the Parseval transfer of
`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/Commutation.lean` makes possible.  This file
defines the POVM, proves that it is close to the ordered product
`M^Z_b M^X_a` by the approximate commutation, and records the consistency of
the ordered products across opposite register placements, which follows from
the self-consistency of each factor.

## Main results

* `ProjectiveSetting.sandwichPoint`: the sandwich POVM.
* `sandwichPoint_ordered_dist_le`: closeness of the sandwich to the ordered
  product on every placement, with the error of `lem:qld-comm-cons`.
* `ordered_cross_dist_le`: the ordered product on one placement is close to
  the reversed ordered product on the opposite placement.

## References

Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:731-748`
(the sandwich and display `eq:qld-r-2`), blueprint
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:803-960` (`lem:qld-4-10`); the
route is explained in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-points-field-valued.tex`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

namespace ProjectiveSetting

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}

/-- An expanded point effect is self-adjoint. -/
theorem pointMeasExp_effect_conjTranspose (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
    (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    ((S.pointMeasExp side W u).effect a)ᴴ = (S.pointMeasExp side W u).effect a :=
  (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective side W u a).isSelfAdjoint.isHermitian.eq

/-- An expanded point effect is idempotent. -/
theorem pointMeasExp_effect_mul_self (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
    (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    (S.pointMeasExp side W u).effect a * (S.pointMeasExp side W u).effect a =
      (S.pointMeasExp side W u).effect a :=
  (S.pointMeasExp_isProjective side W u a).isIdempotentElem.eq

/-- The sandwich `M^Z_b M^X_a M^Z_b` is `(M^X_a M^Z_b)ᴴ (M^X_a M^Z_b)`. -/
theorem sandwich_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (x z : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (a b : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    (S.pointMeasExp side .Z z).effect b * (S.pointMeasExp side .X x).effect a *
        (S.pointMeasExp side .Z z).effect b =
      ((S.pointMeasExp side .X x).effect a * (S.pointMeasExp side .Z z).effect b)ᴴ *
        ((S.pointMeasExp side .X x).effect a * (S.pointMeasExp side .Z z).effect b) := by
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.pointMeasExp_effect_conjTranspose,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.pointMeasExp_effect_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc _ _
      ((S.pointMeasExp side .X x).effect a * (S.pointMeasExp side .Z z).effect b),
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc ((S.pointMeasExp side .X x).effect a)
      ((S.pointMeasExp side .X x).effect a), _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.pointMeasExp_effect_mul_self,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc]

/-- The sandwich effects resolve the identity. -/
theorem sum_sandwich_eq_one (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (x z : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    ∑ ab : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P,
        (S.pointMeasExp side .Z z).effect ab.2 *
          (S.pointMeasExp side .X x).effect ab.1 *
          (S.pointMeasExp side .Z z).effect ab.2 = 1 := by
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type_right]
  calc ∑ b : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P, ∑ a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P,
        (S.pointMeasExp side .Z z).effect b * (S.pointMeasExp side .X x).effect a *
          (S.pointMeasExp side .Z z).effect b
      = ∑ b : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P, (S.pointMeasExp side .Z z).effect b *
          (∑ a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P, (S.pointMeasExp side .X x).effect a) *
          (S.pointMeasExp side .Z z).effect b := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = 1 := by
        simp_rw [(S.pointMeasExp side .X x).sum_eq_one, mul_one,
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.pointMeasExp_effect_mul_self]
        exact (S.pointMeasExp side .Z z).sum_eq_one

/-- The sandwich POVM `R^{x,z}_{a,b} = M^Z_b M^X_a M^Z_b` of the two expanded
point measurements, with outcomes in `F_q × F_q`.  This is the POVM of the
first step of the proof of `lem:qld-4-10`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:731-736`,
formed directly with field-valued outcomes rather than from the binary
refinements; see `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-points-field-valued.tex`. -/
def sandwichPoint (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (x z : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    (fun ab => (S.pointMeasExp side .Z z).effect ab.2 *
      (S.pointMeasExp side .X x).effect ab.1 *
      (S.pointMeasExp side .Z z).effect ab.2)
    (fun ab => by
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.sandwich_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self]
      exact Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
        (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.sum_sandwich_eq_one S side x z)

/-- The effects of the sandwich POVM. -/
@[simp] theorem sandwichPoint_effect (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (x z : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
    (ab : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    (S.sandwichPoint side x z).effect ab =
      (S.pointMeasExp side .Z z).effect ab.2 *
        (S.pointMeasExp side .X x).effect ab.1 *
        (S.pointMeasExp side .Z z).effect ab.2 := rfl











end ProjectiveSetting

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Extraction foundations

This module defines the register identifications used to pull the Pauli
measurements apart. It retains the distinct local spaces of a
heterogeneous strategy, coarse-grains the generalized Pauli projectors by a
dot product, and records the state and error expressions needed by the later
extraction witness.

The binary phases use the existing `phaseSign`; the fixed field basis remains
the basis stored in `P.model` and is not re-quantified here.

## References

The Pauli dot-product projectors formalize blueprint
`def:tau-dot-product-projector`, from
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1426-1429`.
The register and state helpers support blueprint `def:tilde-m-measurement`,
`def:v-swap-unitary`, and `lem:qld-unitary`, from paper lines 1429-1435 and
1666-1713.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-! ## Heterogeneous extraction registers -/

/-- One player's registers after adjoining the two generalized-Pauli
registers: `AA'A''` or `BB'B''`. This identifies the register order and spaces for
paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1429-1435,1687-1713` and
blueprint `def:tilde-m-measurement` and `def:v-swap-unitary`. -/
abbrev ExtractionBlock (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ι : Type*) :=
  (ι × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P

/-- The two heterogeneous extraction blocks in the order
`AA'A'' | BB'B''`. This is the block presentation of the existing `SixReg`
space used in blueprint
`lem:qld-unitary`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
abbrev ExtractionRegisters (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P ιA × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P ιB

/-- The auxiliary registers `AA'BB'` occurring before the extracted EPR
factor in blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`,
paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
abbrev ExtractionAuxRegisters (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :=
  (ιA × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) × (ιB × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)

/-- Reassociate the six-register order with the two extraction blocks.
This equivalence identifies the register order in paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1429-1435,1687-1713`. -/
def sixRegExtractionEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P ιA ιB ≃ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionRegisters P ιA ιB where
  toFun p := (((p.1.1, p.1.2.1), p.1.2.2),
    ((p.2.1, p.2.2.1), p.2.2.2))
  invFun p := ((p.1.1.1, (p.1.1.2, p.1.2)),
    (p.2.1.1, (p.2.1.2, p.2.2)))
  left_inv p := by cases p; rfl
  right_inv p := by cases p; rfl

/-- Shuffle `AA'BB' | A''B''` into the six-register order. This equivalence
places the ideal state in the order used in blueprint
`lem:qld-unitary`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
def extractionIdealShuffle (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionAuxRegisters P ιA ιB ×
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) ≃ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P ιA ιB where
  toFun p := ((p.1.1.1, (p.1.1.2, p.2.1)),
    (p.1.2.1, (p.1.2.2, p.2.2)))
  invFun p := (((p.1.1, p.1.2.1), (p.2.1, p.2.2.1)),
    (p.1.2.2, p.2.2.2))
  left_inv p := by cases p; rfl
  right_inv p := by cases p; rfl

namespace ProjectiveSetting

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}

/-- Place an operator on one complete extraction block, with the identity on
the other player's block, as in the side-qualified operators of paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1429-1435,1687-1713`. -/
noncomputable def placeSide (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side))) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
  cases side with
  | alice =>
      exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron O 1)
  | bob =>
      exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron 1 O)

/-- Lift an operator on a player's original strategy register to that player's
full extraction block. This places the Pauli and point measurements appearing
in blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis` and `lem:qld-unitary`. -/
noncomputable def onPlayer (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.LocalSpace side)) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron O 1) 1

/-- Place an operator on the original strategy register of the selected
player. This is the player-side placement used in blueprint
`lem:qld-unitary`. -/
noncomputable def placePlayer (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.LocalSpace side)) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
  cases side with
  | alice => exact S.place .AA' (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron O 1)
  | bob => exact S.place .BB' (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron O 1)

/-- Place an operator on the selected extracted register `A''` or `B''`.
The unused strategy register in the crossed placement is assigned the
identity. This is the placement of the ideal Pauli operators in
blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
noncomputable def placeExtractedRegister (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
  cases side with
  | alice =>
      exact S.place .BA'' (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op S.toStrategy.ιB) O)
  | bob =>
      exact S.place .AB'' (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op S.toStrategy.ιA) O)

/-- Place a pair of block operators simultaneously on `AA'A''` and
`BB'B''`. This is the simultaneous placement used for the transformed state in
blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
noncomputable def placeBoth (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (VA : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
    (VB : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron VA VB)

/-- Apply one operator to each heterogeneous extraction block. This is the
witness-independent state transformation used for `V_A tensor V_B` in
blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
noncomputable def applyBoth (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (VA : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
    (VB : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (S.placeBoth VA VB) ψ

/-- The state `aux tensor EPR_q^{tensor M}` in the six-register order.
This is the ideal state in Item 1 of blueprint
`lem:qld-unitary`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
noncomputable def idealExpState (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
  classical
  exact
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extractionIdealShuffle P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.vecTensor aux (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)))

end ProjectiveSetting

/-! ## Coarse-grained Pauli projectors -/

/-- Coarse-grain a finite operator family along a map of outcomes. This is the
operator-valued sum corresponding to `Measurement.postprocess`, used by
blueprint
`def:tau-dot-product-projector`. -/
noncomputable def bracketOp {α β ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq β]
    (N : α → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) (f : α → β) (b : β) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι :=
  ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b), N a



/-- The projector obtained by measuring in basis `W` and retaining outcomes
whose dot product with `u` is `a`. This is Equation `eq:def-tauwu` in
blueprint
`def:tau-dot-product-projector`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1426-1429`. -/
noncomputable def tauDotProj {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (u : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.bracketOp (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W) (fun h => dotProduct h u) a







/-! ## Conjugation and extraction error -/

/-- Conjugation of an operator by a square matrix, as used in the exact
conjugation equations in blueprint
`lem:v-swap-conjugation`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1713`. -/
noncomputable def conjBy {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (V N : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι :=
  V * N * Vᴴ

/-- The common error scale for constructing the pulled-apart measurements from
a global polynomial-pair witness. Here `deltaG` is its consistency error. The
remaining terms record the point-measurement transfer
and the Schwartz--Zippel loss; when `0 ≤ epsilon ≤ 1`, `sqrt epsilon` also
dominates terms of order `epsilon`.

This makes explicit the enlargement of the error called `deltaS` in
blueprint
`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1458-1605`. -/
noncomputable def deltaConstructPaulis (C epsilon deltaG : ℝ)
    (m d q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  C * (deltaG + Real.sqrt epsilon +
    ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))

/-- The explicit extraction scale
`C * (deltaS^(1/4) + md/q)` from blueprint
`lem:qld-unitary`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
noncomputable def deltaExtract (C deltaS : ℝ) (m d q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  C * (Real.rpow deltaS (1 / 4 : ℝ) + ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# The auxiliary vector from the EPR projection

Taking the partial inner product with the EPR vector constructs the
unnormalized auxiliary vector. Tensoring it with EPR gives exactly the
orthogonal projection of the original vector onto the EPR subspace.

## References

Blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`; paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1769-1783`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-- Move each extracted register before its auxiliary registers. This
permutation puts the ideal state in the order used by
`MagicSquareRigidity.exists_unit_residual`. -/
def extractionEprFirstEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P ιA ιB ≃
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × (ιA × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) ×
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × (ιB × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sixRegExtractionEquiv P ιA ιB).trans
    (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.prodComm _ _) (Equiv.prodComm _ _))

namespace Extraction

/-- Partial inner product with the EPR vector, leaving the auxiliary index.
This is the coordinate form of the vector defined at paper line 1769. -/
def eprPartialInner {R V : Type*} [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V]
    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (R × (V × V))) : EuclideanSpace ℂ R :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv R ℂ).symm
    (fun r => ∑ p : V × V, star (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState V p) * ψ (r, p))



end Extraction

namespace ProjectiveSetting

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ} (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)

open scoped Classical





/-- A normalized reference vector on `AA'BB'`, formed from the original state
and one EPR pair. It is used when the EPR projection of the given state vanishes. -/
def extractionAuxReference : EuclideanSpace ℂ
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexState _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.prodShuffle (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.vecTensor S.toStrategy.ψ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)))



/-- The EPR projection on registers `A''B''`, with identity on `AA'BB'`.
Paper lines 1766-1769 use this projection to select the auxiliary vector. -/
def extractionEprProjection : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extractionIdealShuffle P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB).symm
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB))
      (Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) x)
        (fun y => star (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) y))))

/-- The auxiliary vector before normalization, obtained by contracting the
extracted registers against EPR. This is `aux_0` at paper line 1769. -/
def extractionAux0
    (θ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Extraction.eprPartialInner
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extractionIdealShuffle P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB).symm θ)





end ProjectiveSetting

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-! # Encoding-supported Pauli reference measurements

The reference measurement measures the strategy's Pauli answer and an independent
ideal Pauli answer, then returns the bounded encoding of their sum. Its effects
vanish outside the encoding image. Evaluation of its polynomial outcome is the
convolution of the evaluated strategy measurement and the ideal point projectors.

These are internal auxiliary constructions for blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`
and `lem:qld-nonencoding-mass-bound`, not the quantitative support estimate. No
winning premise or global polynomial-pair witness is used or constructed here.

## References

The encoding is paper `eq:low-degree-encoding-definition` in
`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:882-897`. The convolution is the Pauli
answer replacement of the expanded point measurement at
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:383-418`.
The corrected use in `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis` is recorded in blueprint
`eq:qld-nonencoding-mass` and `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

variable {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {error : ℝ}

/-- The ideal Pauli basis measurement on the ancillary register, bundled using
positivity and completeness of the existing Pauli projectors. -/
noncomputable def pauliRegisterMeas (basis : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister params) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister params) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj basis)
    (fun answer => Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.posSemidef_pauliProj basis answer))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sum_pauliProj_eq_one basis)

/-- Every bounded encoding lies in the full-field decoder's encoding image. -/
@[simp] theorem isEncoding_encodingPoly (answer : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister params) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsEncoding (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.encodingPoly answer) := by
  unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsEncoding
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.decodeFq_lowDegreeEncoding]
  rfl

namespace ProjectiveSetting

/-- Measure the strategy Pauli answer and the ancillary ideal Pauli answer and
return the encoding of their sum. This complete POVM is the internal reference
measurement underlying blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`; it is not the global
polynomial measurement whose existence is required in `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
noncomputable def encodingPauliMeas (setting : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting params error)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (basis : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Poly params) (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tensorMeasurement (setting.pauliMeas side basis) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRegisterMeas basis)).postprocess
    fun answers => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.encodingPoly (answers.1 + answers.2)













end ProjectiveSetting

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Point consistency after decoding polynomial outcomes

This module expands the overlap of an original point measurement with a
pulled-apart measurement. The decoded polynomial is kept explicit, so the
calculation does not use the decoder identity outside the encoding image.

## References

These are auxiliary identities for blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`,
paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1483-1492`.
The restriction on the decoder identity is recorded in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus

noncomputable section

namespace ProjectiveSetting

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}





/-- Bob's extraction-block placement preserves finite sums. -/
theorem placeSide_bob_finset_sum (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    {I : Type*} (s : Finset I) (B : I → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
    S.placeSide .bob (∑ i ∈ s, B i) = ∑ i ∈ s, S.placeSide .bob (B i) := by
  classical
  change _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA)) (∑ i ∈ s, B i)) = _
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_right]
  ext row col
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.placeSide, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
    Matrix.sum_apply]



end ProjectiveSetting









end

/-!
# Point consistency with Alice's pulled-apart measurement

This module proves the register-interchanged overlap calculation for Item 1 of
blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`. Polynomial evaluation is replaced by
decoded evaluation only on encoding outcomes; the remaining loss is bounded
by the mass of the non-encoding outcomes.

## References

* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1463-1492`.
* `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex` records the necessary restriction
  on the decoder identity.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus

noncomputable section

namespace ProjectiveSetting

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ}





/-- Alice's extraction-block placement preserves finite sums. -/
theorem placeSide_alice_finset_sum (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
    {I : Type*} (s : Finset I) (B : I → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA)) :
    S.placeSide .alice (∑ i ∈ s, B i) = ∑ i ∈ s, S.placeSide .alice (B i) := by
  classical
  change _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (∑ i ∈ s, B i) (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = _
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_left]
  ext row col
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.placeSide, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply,
    Matrix.sum_apply]

end ProjectiveSetting









end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT
