/-!
# Placing operators on the expanded state

The four register placements of `def:symmetric-equivalents` put an operator of
one player's expanded local space on one of the register pairs `AA'`, `BA''`,
`BB'` and `AB''` of the expanded state `psiHat`.  This module records how such
a placement acts on `psiHat`: after the shuffle of `eq:def-psihat` the placed
operator is a threefold tensor product, so a factorized operator whose Pauli
factor is an isometry has the same state-dependent norm as its strategy factor
placed on the original state.  No symmetry between the two players is used;
each of the four placements is treated explicitly.

## References

The declarations support `def:symmetric-equivalents` and `lem:qld-comm-cons`
in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1002-1031` and
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1139-1178`.  Their paper source
is `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:420-505`.
-/

@[expose] public section

-- The unshuffled six-register index type of `eq:def-psihat` is a fourfold
-- iterated product; instance search for its `Fintype` and `DecidableEq`
-- structure needs a larger budget than the default.
set_option synthInstance.maxSize 400

open scoped BigOperators Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-! ## Coordinate tensors -/











namespace ProjectiveSetting





variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}

/-! ## The strategy factor of a placement -/

/-- Place a strategy-local operator on the player side that supplies the local
space of a register placement. Paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:420-450`, blueprint
`ch14_qpbt_observables.tex:1002-1031`. -/
noncomputable def placeStrategySide (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.LocalSpace side) →
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.toStrategy.ιA × S.toStrategy.ιB)
  | .alice, T => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron T 1
  | .bob, T => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron 1 T



/-! ## The action of a placement on the expanded state -/





/-! ## Opposite-placement bipartitions -/

/-- Regroup `AA'A''BB'B''` as `AA' | BA''(B'B'')`. This is the tensor
bipartition used for data processing on the `AA'`--`BA''` placement pair in
item 1 of `lem:qld-comm-cons`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:455-465`. -/
def aaBaBipartition (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P ιA ιB ≃
      (ιA × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) ×
        ((ιB × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) × (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) where
  toFun p := ((p.1.1, p.1.2.1), ((p.2.1, p.1.2.2), (p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2)))
  invFun p := ((p.1.1, (p.1.2, p.2.1.2)),
    (p.2.1.1, (p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2)))
  left_inv p := by cases p; rfl
  right_inv p := by cases p; rfl

/-- Regroup `AA'A''BB'B''` as `AB'' | BB'(A'A'')`. This is the tensor
bipartition used for data processing on the `AB''`--`BB'` placement pair in
item 1 of `lem:qld-comm-cons`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:455-465`. -/
def abBbBipartition (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (ιA ιB : Type*) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P ιA ιB ≃
      (ιA × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) ×
        ((ιB × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) × (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) where
  toFun p := ((p.1.1, p.2.2.2), ((p.2.1, p.2.2.1), (p.1.2.1, p.1.2.2)))
  invFun p := ((p.1.1, (p.2.2.1, p.2.2.2)),
    (p.2.1.1, (p.2.1.2, p.1.2)))
  left_inv p := by cases p; rfl
  right_inv p := by cases p; rfl

/-- Under the `AA' | BA''(B'B'')` bipartition, an `AA'` placement is the
ordinary left tensor placement. -/
theorem reindexOp_aaBaBipartition_left (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.aaBaBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron O
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ((S.toStrategy.ιB × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) ×
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)))) =
      S.place .AA' O := by
  ext i j
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.aaBaBipartition, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.place, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
    Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply, Matrix.one_apply, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.LocalSpace, Prod.ext_iff]
  split_ifs
  all_goals simp_all
  all_goals rfl

/-- Under the `AA' | BA''(B'B'')` bipartition, a `BA''` placement is the
ordinary right tensor placement, with identity on the unused EPR pair. -/
theorem reindexOp_aaBaBipartition_right (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.aaBaBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.toStrategy.ιA × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P))
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron O (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)))) =
      S.place .BA'' O := by
  ext i j
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.aaBaBipartition, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.place, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
    Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply, Matrix.one_apply, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.LocalSpace, Prod.ext_iff]
  split_ifs
  all_goals simp_all
  all_goals rfl

/-- Under the `AB'' | BB'(A'A'')` bipartition, an `AB''` placement is the
ordinary left tensor placement. -/
theorem reindexOp_abBbBipartition_left (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.abBbBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron O
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ((S.toStrategy.ιB × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) ×
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)))) =
      S.place .AB'' O := by
  ext i j
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.abBbBipartition, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.place, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
    Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply, Matrix.one_apply, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.LocalSpace, Prod.ext_iff]
  split_ifs
  all_goals simp_all
  all_goals rfl

/-- Under the `AB'' | BB'(A'A'')` bipartition, a `BB'` placement is the
ordinary right tensor placement, with identity on the unused EPR pair. -/
theorem reindexOp_abBbBipartition_right (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.abBbBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.toStrategy.ιA × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P))
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron O (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)))) =
      S.place .BB' O := by
  ext i j
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.abBbBipartition, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.place, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
    Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply, Matrix.one_apply, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.LocalSpace, Prod.ext_iff]
  split_ifs
  all_goals simp_all
  all_goals rfl

/-! ## The four placements -/



























end ProjectiveSetting

end

/-!
# Correlations on the two-player expanded state

The six-register state of `eq:def-psihat` factors as the two-player state
`ExtendedLineGame.pairState` and an unused normalized EPR pair, for each of
the opposite register placements `AA'`--`BA''` and `AB''`--`BB'`. Therefore
arbitrary Hermitian operators on the expanded local spaces have the same
correlation in the two descriptions. An individual operator need not factor
between its strategy register and its Pauli register.

These are formalization-only auxiliary identities for the strategy construction
in the proof of `lem:qld-4-7`. They do not establish its passing value or the
existence of its input measurements. Parent issue Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-QPBT-bak#119 remains open.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:367-372`,
  equation `eq:def-psihat`.
- The same source, `lem:qld-4-7`, proof at lines 1279-1288.
- Blueprint `def:expanded-state`, `def:symmetric-equivalents`, and `lem:qld-4-7`.
- Issue Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-QPBT-bak#302.
-/

@[expose] public section

-- The six-register products require the same instance-search size as ExpandedPlacement.
set_option synthInstance.maxSize 400

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum
open ProjectiveSetting

noncomputable section

namespace ExtendedLineGame

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : Real}

/-- Regroup the six registers as `(AA', BA'')` and the unused pair `(B', B'')`.
This is the first opposite-placement partition of `eq:def-psihat`. -/
def aaBaRegrouping (setting : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P setting.toStrategy.ιA setting.toStrategy.ιB ≃
      (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice × setting.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob) ×
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.aaBaBipartition P setting.toStrategy.ιA setting.toStrategy.ιB).trans
    (Equiv.prodAssoc _ _ _).symm

/-- Regroup the six registers as `(AB'', BB')` and the unused pair `(A', A'')`.
This is the second opposite-placement partition of `eq:def-psihat`. -/
def abBbRegrouping (setting : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P setting.toStrategy.ιA setting.toStrategy.ιB ≃
      (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice × setting.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob) ×
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.abBbBipartition P setting.toStrategy.ιA setting.toStrategy.ιB).trans
    (Equiv.prodAssoc _ _ _).symm









end ExtendedLineGame

/-!
# Expanded line measurements

For a generalized-Pauli basis `W` and a canonical line, the expanded line
measurement is the convolution of the strategy line measurement with the
projective measurement of one Pauli register whose outcome is the restriction
to that line of the low-degree encoding of the measured basis label. This file
states the three consistency conclusions the source draws for that family,
together with the existential form in which the source states them.

The argument runs as follows. Restricting a multilinear low-degree encoding to
a line gives a polynomial of degree at most `m*d` in the line parameter, and at
most `d` on an axis-parallel line (`LineMeasurement.Restriction`), whose
partial evaluation at a sampled point obeys the elementary calculus of
`LineMeasurement.Evaluation`.
Coarse-graining the generalized Pauli basis measurement along that restriction
gives the ancillary projectors `tau^{W,line}`, which are symmetric and hence
perfectly self-consistent on an EPR pair (`LineMeasurement.Projector`). Their
convolution with the strategy line measurement is again projective and vanishes
outside the degree-`d` outcomes on an axis line (`LineMeasurement.Expanded`).
Self-consistency of the convolution follows from self-consistency of the
strategy line measurements and the data-processing inequality
(`LineMeasurement.SelfConsistency`). The overlap of an expanded line
measurement with the expanded point effects selected by evaluation at the
sampled point factorizes exactly through the ancillary consistency of
`tau^{W,line}` with `tau^{W,u}` (`LineMeasurement.LinePointOverlap`); the
generic bipartite estimates of `LineMeasurement.BipartiteTransport` carry that
overlap to the two bipartitions of the six registers, giving the
evaluation-class conclusion (`LineMeasurement.EvalClassConsistency`) and, by
projective refinement, the line-versus-point conclusion
(`LineMeasurement.LinePointConsistency`).

Two features of this route differ from the source. The source derives its third
item from its second; here the evaluation-class estimate comes first, from the
exact overlap identity, and the second item follows from it by projective
refinement, so that the source's elementary sub-measurement inequality is not
needed. The source also transports a relation proved for one pair of register
placements to the remaining three by the symmetry of the test
(`lem:symmetric-equivalents-transfer`, which is not formalized); here each of
the four directed opposite-placement pairs is proved directly. The estimates
established are linear in `ε` for all three items, hence stronger than the
square-root error whenever `ε ≤ 1`; they are weakened to the common error
`deltaLine ε = √ε` only because the source states the three items with a single
error function (`LineMeasurement.SquareRootError`).

## References

The declarations formalize `def:expanded-line-measurement` and
`lem:qld-comm-line-cons` of `blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex`.
Their paper source is
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:523-678`.
-/

/-- The square-root error exhibited by the expanded-line consistency proof.
This is the final quantitative conclusion of `lem:qld-comm-line-cons`, paper

/-!
# Overlap of expanded line and expanded point measurements

This module computes the diagonal overlap, on the expanded state, between an
expanded line measurement on one placement and the expanded point effects
selected by evaluation at the sampled point on the opposite placement. Each
product of convolution terms factorizes into a strategy overlap and an EPR
overlap; the EPR overlap of a Pauli line projector with a Pauli point projector
vanishes unless the line polynomial evaluates to the point value, and then
equals the EPR overlap of the line projector alone. Summing over the
convolution fibers identifies the expanded overlap with the overlap of the
strategy's evaluation classes and its completed point measurement. This is the
computation displayed in items 2 and 3 of the expanded-line consistency lemma.

The sections on the linearity of the state quadratic form, on register
placements, and on the completed point measurements collect formalization-only
auxiliaries: the source uses these facts without stating them.

`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:534-545`,

/-!
# Placement calculus on the expanded state

This module records the algebra of the four register placements used by the
combining argument: a placement is a unital `*`-homomorphism, placements on
opposite register pairs commute, and the crosswise exchange of the two EPR
pairs of the expanded state carries the placement `AA'` to `AB''` and `BA''`
to `BB'` while fixing the expanded state.  The last fact transfers every
state-dependent distance between the two bipartition schemes of
`def:symmetric-equivalents` without assuming a symmetric strategy.

## References

The placements are those of `def:symmetric-equivalents`, blueprint
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:420-450`.  The
placement module proves EPR-exchange invariance for the involution
`(A' B'')(A'' B')`, which fixes `A` and `B`, in
`ProjectiveSetting.reindexState_eprCrossSwap_psiHat`; its use for
`lem:qld-4-10` is analyzed in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_linearity-theorem-quotation.tex`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

namespace ProjectiveSetting

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}

/-! ## Placements as reindexed tensor factors -/

/-- The `AA'` placement is the reindexed left factor of the
`AA' | BA''(B'B'')` bipartition. -/
theorem place_AA'_eq (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement.AA'.side)) :
    S.place .AA' O =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.aaBaBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron O
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ((S.toStrategy.ιB × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) ×
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)))) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_aaBaBipartition_left S O).symm

/-- The `BA''` placement is the reindexed right factor of the
`AA' | BA''(B'B'')` bipartition. -/
theorem place_BA''_eq (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement.BA''.side)) :
    S.place .BA'' O =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.aaBaBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.toStrategy.ιA × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P))
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron O (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)))) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_aaBaBipartition_right S O).symm

/-- The `AB''` placement is the reindexed left factor of the
`AB'' | BB'(A'A'')` bipartition. -/
theorem place_AB''_eq (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement.AB''.side)) :
    S.place .AB'' O =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.abBbBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron O
          (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ((S.toStrategy.ιB × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) ×
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)))) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_abBbBipartition_left S O).symm

/-- The `BB'` placement is the reindexed right factor of the
`AB'' | BB'(A'A'')` bipartition. -/
theorem place_BB'_eq (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (O : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement.BB'.side)) :
    S.place .BB' O =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.abBbBipartition P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.toStrategy.ιA × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P))
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron O (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)))) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_abBbBipartition_right S O).symm



/-- Reindexing an operator along an equivalence preserves positivity. -/
theorem reindexOp_nonneg {ι κ : Type*} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (e : ι ≃ κ) {M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op κ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    0 ≤ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp e M := by
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  rw [Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef] at hM ⊢
  exact hM.submatrix e.symm.symm

/-! ## The placement is a unital `*`-homomorphism -/



/-- A placement sends the local identity to the identity of the six-register
space. -/
theorem place_one (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement) :
    S.place p (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) = 1 := by
  ext i j
  cases p <;>
    · simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.place, Matrix.one_apply, Prod.ext_iff]
      split_ifs <;> simp_all

/-- A placement is additive over finite sums of local operators.
Compatibility name for `place_finset_sum`, retained for the combining-point
proofs that use this spelling. -/
theorem place_finsetSum (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement) {γ : Type*}
    (s : Finset γ) (O : γ → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
    S.place p (∑ x ∈ s, O x) = ∑ x ∈ s, S.place p (O x) :=
  S.place_finset_sum p s O



set_option synthInstance.maxSize 400 in
/-- A placement preserves positivity. -/
theorem place_nonneg (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
    ∀ (p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement) {A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)}, 0 ≤ A →
      0 ≤ S.place p A
  | .AA', A, hA => by
      classical
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.place_AA'_eq]
      exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg _ (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg hA
        (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg))
  | .BA'', A, hA => by
      classical
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.place_BA''_eq]
      exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg _ (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
        (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg hA (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)))
  | .BB', A, hA => by
      classical
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.place_BB'_eq]
      exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg _ (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
        (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg hA (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)))
  | .AB'', A, hA => by
      classical
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.place_AB''_eq]
      exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg _ (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg hA
        (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg))







/-- A complete measurement on a local expanded space, placed on one of the
four register pairs, is a complete measurement on the six-register space. -/
def placedMeasurement (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement) {α : Type*}
    [Fintype α] (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne (fun a => S.place p (M.effect a))
    (fun a => S.place_nonneg p (M.pos a))
    (by rw [← _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.place_finsetSum, M.sum_eq_one, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.place_one])

/-- The effects of a placed measurement are the placed effects. -/
@[simp] theorem placedMeasurement_effect (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement) {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) (a : α) :
    (S.placedMeasurement p M).effect a = S.place p (M.effect a) := rfl



end ProjectiveSetting

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Measurements on extraction blocks

This module places a complete measurement from either player's three-register
extraction block on the full six-register space. It also records the transport
of original-player consistency through the two adjoined EPR states.

## References

These are finite-dimensional placement lemmas supporting blueprint
`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis` and `lem:qld-unitary`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder Classical

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus

noncomputable section

namespace ProjectiveSetting

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon : ℝ} (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)

/-- Place a complete measurement on a player's full extraction block. -/
def blockMeasurement (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side))) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
  refine _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne (fun a => S.placeSide side (A.effect a)) ?_ ?_
  · intro a
    cases side
    · exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg _ (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg (A.pos a) Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
    · exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_nonneg _ (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg (A.pos a))
  · cases side
    · rw [← S.placeSide_alice_finset_sum, A.sum_eq_one]
      change _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp _ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
        (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = 1
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron_one_one]
      ext row col
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp, Matrix.one_apply]
    · rw [← S.placeSide_bob_finset_sum, A.sum_eq_one]
      change _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp _ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
        (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB))) = 1
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron_one_one]
      ext row col
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexOp, Matrix.one_apply]

/-- The effects of a block measurement use the existing block placement. -/
@[simp] theorem blockMeasurement_effect (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side))) (a : α) :
    (S.blockMeasurement side A).effect a = S.placeSide side (A.effect a) := by
  rfl







end ProjectiveSetting

/-!
# Pauli-register line projectors

This module constructs the projective measurement `tau^{W,line}` of one
generalized-Pauli register whose outcome is the restriction to a canonical
line of the low-degree encoding of the measured basis label. It records that
the outcome projectors are orthogonal projections summing to the identity,
that they are symmetric matrices (so that they act identically on either half
of an EPR pair), and that on an axis-parallel line they vanish outside the
embedded degree-`d` subspace.

## References

The projectors are `tau^{W,line}_{f''}` of `def:expanded-line-measurement`,
with paper source
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-556`. Their
perfect self-consistency on an EPR pair is the ancillary input to item 1 of
`lem:qld-comm-line-cons`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:527-532`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-- The Pauli-register projector onto labels whose low-degree encoding
restricts to `f` on `line`. This is `tau^{W,line}_f` in the proof of
`lem:qld-comm-line-cons`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-556`, blueprint
`def:expanded-line-measurement`. -/
noncomputable def tauLineProj (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) (f : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) :=
  ∑ h ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun h : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P =>
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.restrictToLine P.toLdParams line (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lowDegreeEncoding h) = f),
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W h

/-- Pauli line projectors are positive semidefinite. This is the positivity of
the ancillary measurement in `def:expanded-line-measurement`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-556`. -/
theorem tauLineProj_nonneg (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) (f : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)) :
    0 ≤ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj P W line f := by
  classical
  unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun e _ => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.posSemidef_pauliProj W e).nonneg



/-- Pauli line projectors belonging to distinct line polynomials are
orthogonal, while each projector is idempotent. This is the ancillary product
calculation in `def:expanded-line-measurement` and item 1 of
`lem:qld-comm-line-cons`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-558`. -/
theorem tauLineProj_mul_tauLineProj (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) (f g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj P W line f * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj P W line g =
      if f = g then _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj P W line f else 0 := by
  classical
  unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  by_cases hfg : f = g
  · subst g
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro e he
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single e]
    · rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj_mul_pauliProj, if_pos rfl]
    · intro e' he' hee'
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj_mul_pauliProj, if_neg hee'.symm]
    · exact fun h => (h he).elim
  · rw [if_neg hfg]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro e he
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro e' he'
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj_mul_pauliProj, if_neg]
    intro hee'
    apply hfg
    rw [← (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2, ← (Finset.mem_filter.mp he').2, hee']

/-- The line fibers partition the complete family of Pauli eigenspace
projectors. This is the completeness of the ancillary measurement in
`def:expanded-line-measurement`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-556`. -/
theorem sum_tauLineProj_eq_one (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) :
    ∑ f, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj P W line f = 1 := by
  classical
  rw [show (∑ f, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj P W line f) =
      ∑ e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e by
    simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj]
    exact Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ
      (fun e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P =>
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.restrictToLine P.toLdParams line (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lowDegreeEncoding e))
      (fun e => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e)]
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sum_pauliProj_eq_one W

/-- The projective line measurement on one Pauli register obtained by
measuring the generalized Pauli basis and restricting the low-degree encoding
of the outcome to `line`. This is the ancillary measurement of
`def:expanded-line-measurement`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-556`. -/
noncomputable def tauLineMeas (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj P W line) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj_nonneg P W line)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sum_tauLineProj_eq_one P W line)

/-- The effects of the Pauli line measurement are the line projectors. -/
@[simp] theorem tauLineMeas_effect (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) (f : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineMeas P W line).effect f = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj P W line f := rfl



/-! ## Interaction with the point projectors -/















/-! ## Perfect consistency on an EPR pair -/







end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Expanded line measurements

This module constructs the expanded line measurements by convolving a strategy
line measurement with the Pauli-register line projectors, and records that the
result is a projective measurement whose effects vanish, on an axis-parallel
line, outside the embedded degree-`d` outcome space. It also introduces the
fine strategy--Pauli product measurement of which the expanded line
measurement is the addition postprocessing, and the evaluation-class and
point-effect families used by the consistency estimates.

## References

The declarations formalize `def:expanded-line-measurement`, whose paper
source is
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-556`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-- The Kronecker product of two finite sums is the double sum of the pairwise
Kronecker products. This bilinearity identity proves completeness of the
convolution in `def:expanded-line-measurement`, from the construction in the
proof of the paper's `lem:qld-comm-line-cons`. -/
private theorem heteroKron_sum_sum {α β ι κ : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (A : α → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) (B : β → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op κ) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (∑ x, A x) (∑ y, B y) =
      ∑ x, ∑ y, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (A x) (B y) := by
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_left]
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_right]

/-- The tensor placement of a zero left factor vanishes. -/
theorem heteroKron_zero_left {ι κ : Type*} (B : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op κ) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (0 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) B = 0 := by
  unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron
  exact Matrix.zero_kronecker B

/-- The tensor placement of a zero right factor vanishes. -/
theorem heteroKron_zero_right {ι κ : Type*} (A : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op ι) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron A (0 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op κ) = 0 := by
  unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron
  exact Matrix.kronecker_zero A

namespace ProjectiveSetting

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}

/-- The line measurement of a projective strategy is again projective: folding
the answers of a line question into a coefficient list is a postprocessing, and
postprocessing preserves projectivity. This is the line analogue of the point
measurement projectivity; both follow because postprocessing preserves
projectivity. The line form is what the projectivity assertion of
`def:expanded-line-measurement` needs, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-556`. -/
theorem lineMeas_isProjective (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (S.lineMeas side W line) := by
  apply _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective
  cases side with
  | alice => exact S.isProjective.1 _
  | bob => exact S.isProjective.2 _



/-- The convolution of a strategy line effect with the corresponding
Pauli-register line projector. This is the displayed definition of
`hat M^(Line,W),line_f`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-556`, blueprint
`def:expanded-line-measurement`. -/
noncomputable def expLineOp (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams)
    (f : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
  ∑ pair ∈ Finset.univ.filter
      (fun pair : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) => pair.1 + pair.2 = f),
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.lineMeas side W line).effect pair.1)
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj P W line pair.2)

/-- Expanded line effects are positive semidefinite. This is the positivity
obligation of `def:expanded-line-measurement`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-556`. -/
theorem expLineOp_nonneg (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams)
    (f : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)) :
    0 ≤ S.expLineOp side W line f := by
  unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.expLineOp
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun pair _ => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
    ((S.lineMeas side W line).pos pair.1) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj_nonneg P W line pair.2)

/-- Expanded line effects sum to the identity. This is the completeness
obligation of `def:expanded-line-measurement`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-556`. -/
theorem expLineOp_sum_eq_one (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) :
    ∑ f, S.expLineOp side W line f = 1 := by
  let A : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) →
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) := fun pair =>
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.lineMeas side W line).effect pair.1)
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj P W line pair.2)
  let g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) →
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) := fun pair => pair.1 + pair.2
  calc
    (∑ f, S.expLineOp side W line f) =
        ∑ f, ∑ pair ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun pair => g pair = f), A pair := rfl
    _ = ∑ pair, A pair := Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ g A
    _ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (∑ x, (S.lineMeas side W line).effect x)
        (∑ y, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj P W line y) := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      exact (heteroKron_sum_sum _ _).symm
    _ = 1 := by
      rw [(S.lineMeas side W line).sum_eq_one, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sum_tauLineProj_eq_one]
      exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron_one_one

/-- The concrete expanded line measurement exhibited in the proof of
`lem:qld-comm-line-cons`. Paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-556`, blueprint
`def:expanded-line-measurement`. -/
noncomputable def lineMeasExp (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d))
      (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne (S.expLineOp side W line)
    (S.expLineOp_nonneg side W line) (S.expLineOp_sum_eq_one side W line)

/-- The effects of the expanded line measurement are the convolution
operators. -/
@[simp] theorem lineMeasExp_effect (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams)
    (f : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)) :
    (S.lineMeasExp side W line).effect f = S.expLineOp side W line f := rfl

/-- The fine product measurement underlying the convolution definition of an
expanded line measurement. Its outcome records the strategy and Pauli line
polynomials separately. Blueprint `def:line-tau-product-measurement`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-558`. -/
noncomputable def lineTauMeas (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    (fun p => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.lineMeas side W line).effect p.1)
      ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineMeas P W line).effect p.2))
    (fun p => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
      ((S.lineMeas side W line).pos p.1) ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineMeas P W line).pos p.2))
    (by
      change ∑ p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d),
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.lineMeas side W line).effect p.1)
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj P W line p.2) = 1
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
      calc
        (∑ x, ∑ y, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.lineMeas side W line).effect x)
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj P W line y)) =
            _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (∑ x, (S.lineMeas side W line).effect x)
              (∑ y, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj P W line y) := (heteroKron_sum_sum _ _).symm
        _ = 1 := by
          rw [(S.lineMeas side W line).sum_eq_one, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sum_tauLineProj_eq_one]
          exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron_one_one)

/-- Effects of the fine product measurement are the corresponding Kronecker
products of strategy and Pauli line effects. -/
@[simp] theorem lineTauMeas_effect (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams)
    (p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)) :
    (S.lineTauMeas side W line).effect p =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.lineMeas side W line).effect p.1)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj P W line p.2) := rfl



/-- An expanded line effect is idempotent: the strategy line projectors and
the Pauli line projectors are both orthogonal families, so distinct
convolution terms annihilate one another. This is the projectivity
calculation of `def:expanded-line-measurement`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-556`. -/
private theorem expLineOp_mul_self (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams)
    (f : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)) :
    S.expLineOp side W line f * S.expLineOp side W line f =
      S.expLineOp side W line f := by
  have hM := S.lineMeas_isProjective side W line
  unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.expLineOp
  set s := Finset.univ.filter
    (fun pair : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) => pair.1 + pair.2 = f) with hs
  let K : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
    fun p => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((S.lineMeas side W line).effect p.1)
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj P W line p.2)
  change (∑ p ∈ s, K p) * (∑ q ∈ s, K q) = ∑ p ∈ s, K p
  calc
    (∑ p ∈ s, K p) * (∑ q ∈ s, K q) = ∑ p ∈ s, ∑ q ∈ s, K p * K q := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ p ∈ s, ∑ q ∈ s, if q = p then K p else 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
      simp only [K]
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron_mul]
      by_cases hqp : q = p
      · subst hqp
        rw [if_pos rfl, (hM q.1).isIdempotentElem.eq,
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj_mul_tauLineProj, if_pos rfl]
      · rw [if_neg hqp]
        by_cases h1 : p.1 = q.1
        · have h2 : p.2 ≠ q.2 := fun h2 => hqp (Prod.ext h1.symm h2.symm)
          rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauLineProj_mul_tauLineProj, if_neg h2, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron_zero_right]
        · rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero _ hM h1,
            _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron_zero_left]
    _ = ∑ p ∈ s, K p := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
      simp [hp]

/-- The expanded line measurement is projective. This is the projectivity
assertion in `def:expanded-line-measurement`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:552-556`. -/
theorem lineMeasExp_isProjective (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (S.lineMeasExp side W line) := by
  intro f
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change S.expLineOp side W line f * S.expLineOp side W line f =
      S.expLineOp side W line f
    exact expLineOp_mul_self S side W line f
  · change star (S.expLineOp side W line f) = S.expLineOp side W line f
    rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose]
    exact (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
      (S.expLineOp_nonneg side W line f)).isHermitian.eq



/-- Evaluation classes of the expanded line measurement, including the
explicit `none` class for a non-evaluating canonical line. This is the
completed bracket family used in item 3 of `lem:qld-comm-line-cons`, blueprint
`eq:qld-comm-line-pt-cons2`. -/
noncomputable def lineEvalMeasExp (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (Option (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
  (S.lineMeasExp side W line).postprocess (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalOpt line u)

/-- Complete an expanded point measurement with a zero `none` outcome. This
is the right-hand family in the corrected item 3 of
`lem:qld-comm-line-cons`, blueprint
`eq:qld-comm-line-pt-cons2`. -/
noncomputable def pointMeasExpOption (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (Option (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
  (S.pointMeasExp side W u).postprocess some

/-- The point effect indexed by a line answer, with zero assigned when the
answer has no evaluation at the sampled point. This is the zero-direction
completion used in item 2 of `lem:qld-comm-line-cons`, blueprint
`eq:qld-comm-line-pt-cons`. -/
noncomputable def expPointEffectAtLineAnswer (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (f : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
  match _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalOpt line u f with
  | some a => (S.pointMeasExp side W u).effect a
  | none => 0

end ProjectiveSetting

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Combined X/Z line measurement

This module constructs the X-Z-X sandwich POVM used to combine one X-line
measurement with one Z-line measurement.  It also records the orientation of
the sandwich as a one-sided pasted measurement and the two axis-degree support
properties.

## References

The construction is the paired-line measurement in `lem:qld-xz-lines`, with
source `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:942-949`.
Its separate blueprint entries are `def:concrete-paired-line-measurement` and
`lem:concrete-paired-line-degree-support`; consistency remains the distinct
obligation `lem:combined-line-measurement-consistency`.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-- The paired-line POVM in the proof of `lem:qld-xz-lines`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:942-949`. The X effect is the outer
projector. This construction does not assert consistency with a point witness. -/
def ProjectiveSetting.combinedLineMeasurement {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (lineX lineZ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    (fun fs => (S.lineMeasExp side .X lineX).effect fs.1 *
      (S.lineMeasExp side .Z lineZ).effect fs.2 *
      (S.lineMeasExp side .X lineX).effect fs.1)
    (fun fs => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement
      (S.lineMeasExp side .Z lineZ) (S.lineMeasExp side .X lineX)
      (S.lineMeasExp_isProjective side .X lineX)).1 (fs.2, fs.1))
    (by
      classical
      have hsum := (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement
        (S.lineMeasExp side .Z lineZ) (S.lineMeasExp side .X lineX)
        (S.lineMeasExp_isProjective side .X lineX)).2
      simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pastedMeasurement, Fintype.sum_prod_type] at hsum ⊢
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      exact hsum)

/-- The effects of the paired-line POVM are the source's X-Z-X sandwiches. -/
@[simp] theorem ProjectiveSetting.combinedLineMeasurement_effect
    {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ} (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (lineX lineZ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams)
    (fX fZ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d)) :
    (S.combinedLineMeasurement side lineX lineZ).effect (fX, fZ) =
      (S.lineMeasExp side .X lineX).effect fX *
        (S.lineMeasExp side .Z lineZ).effect fZ *
        (S.lineMeasExp side .X lineX).effect fX := rfl







end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-- Select one component of a Pair answer. -/
def selectedPairBit (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (bits : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) : ZMod 2 :=
  match W with
  | .X => bits.1
  | .Z => bits.2











/-- Select the point coordinate of a shared Pauli tuple in one basis. -/
def selectedTuplePoint (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams}
    (ω : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P) : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P :=
  match W with
  | .X => ω.1
  | .Z => ω.2.1

/-- Select the scalar multiplier of a shared Pauli tuple in one basis. -/
def selectedTupleScalar (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams}
    (ω : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P :=
  match W with
  | .X => ω.2.2.1
  | .Z => ω.2.2.2

/-- The binary trace label extracted from a point answer. -/
def pointTraceLabel (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (ω : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P) (A : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) : ZMod 2 :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero A * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.WinImplications.selectedTupleScalar W ω)














end WinImplications

end

/-! ## Reversed verifier edges

The Pauli type graph is a set of unordered pairs, so every ordered edge used by

/-- The point/axis-line verifier edge, reversing `alinePointEdge`. -/
def pointAlineEdge (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge :=
  ⟨(.point W, .aline W), by simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges]⟩

/-- The point/diagonal-line verifier edge, reversing `dlinePointEdge`. -/
def pointDlineEdge (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge :=
  ⟨(.point W, .dline W), by simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges]⟩

/-- The Pauli/point verifier edge, reversing `pointPauliEdge`. -/
def pauliPointEdge (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge :=
  ⟨(.pauli W, .point W), by simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges]⟩

/-- The Pair/Pair-W verifier edge, reversing `pairWPairEdge`. -/
def pairPairWEdge (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge :=
  ⟨(.pair, .pairW W), by simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges]⟩

/-!
# Definitions for winning implications

This module defines the measurements, marginals, and induced Magic Square
strategy used by the exact and approximate winning implications.

## References

The definitions support `lem:qld-win-implications` and
`lem:qld-win-implications-obs` in
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:192-354` and
blueprint `lem:qld-win-implications` and `lem:qld-win-implications-obs`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section



/-- Reindex a heterogeneous strategy state after interchanging its two tensor
factors. This is the state used by the factor-interchanged conclusions at
paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:227-228`. -/
noncomputable def ProjectiveSetting.swappedState
    {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ} (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.toStrategy.ιB × S.toStrategy.ιA) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexState (Equiv.prodComm S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
    S.toStrategy.ψ

/-- The space of Pauli question pairs is finite because the underlying field
model is finite. Paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:197-199`;
blueprint `lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
noncomputable instance pauliQuestionPairFintype (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    Fintype (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P) :=
  Fintype.ofFinite _

/-- Equality of Pauli question pairs is decidable. This is used in the
consistency defect from item 1 of blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
noncomputable instance pauliQuestionPairDecidableEq (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    DecidableEq (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P) :=
  Classical.decEq _

/-- The coordinate space records the base and seed of an axis line, or the
base, seed, and direction of a diagonal line. It is finite and indexes the
line-point average in blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
abbrev LineDescCode (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :=
  ((Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) ⊕
    ((Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P ×
      (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))

/-- Map a canonical line to its kind and coordinate data: base and seed for an
axis line, and base, seed, and direction for a diagonal line. Blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
def lineDescCode (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDescCode P
  | .axis base seed _ => .inl (base, seed)
  | .diagonal base seed direction _ _ => .inr (base, seed, direction)

/-- The coordinate-data map on canonical lines is injective: lines of the same
kind with equal base, seed, and direction data are equal. This supports the
line-point average in blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
private theorem lineDescCode_injective (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    Function.Injective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineDescCode P) := by
  intro x y h
  cases x with
  | axis base seed baseFixed =>
      cases y with
      | axis base' seed' baseFixed' =>
          simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineDescCode, Sum.inl.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
          rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
          rfl
      | diagonal => simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineDescCode] at h
  | diagonal base seed direction baseFixed prefixZero =>
      cases y with
      | axis => simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineDescCode] at h
      | diagonal base' seed' direction' baseFixed' prefixZero' =>
          simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineDescCode, Sum.inr.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
          rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
          rfl

/-- The set of canonical axis and diagonal lines is finite. This finiteness is
used in the line-point average from item 2 of blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
noncomputable instance lineDescFintype (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    Fintype (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) :=
  Fintype.ofInjective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lineDescCode P) (by
    exact lineDescCode_injective P)

/-- The set of pairs consisting of a canonical line and a point is finite.
These pairs index the line-point distribution in the low-degree winning
implication. Paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:200-204`, blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
noncomputable instance linePointFintype (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    Fintype (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams × (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) :=
  Fintype.ofFinite _

namespace ProjectiveSetting

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}

/-- Complete a point measurement with a zero `none` outcome. This is the
right-hand family in the corrected low-degree item of
blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:197-204`. -/
noncomputable def pointMeasOption (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (Option (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) (S.LocalSpace side) :=
  (S.pointMeas side W u).postprocess some

/-- Trace-coarse-graining of a strategy point measurement. This is the family
`M^((Point,W),u)_[tr(·r)=a]` in items 5 and 7 of
`lem:qld-win-implications`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:232-263`, blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
noncomputable def pointTraceMeas (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
    (r : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) (S.LocalSpace side) :=
  (S.pointMeas side W u).postprocess fun a => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (a * r)

/-- Evaluate a Pauli-register answer through its low-degree encoding at `u`.
This is `M^(Pauli,W)_[g_h(u)=a]` in item 3 of
`lem:qld-win-implications`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:205-209`, blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
noncomputable def pauliEvalMeas (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (S.LocalSpace side) :=
  (S.pauliMeas side W).postprocess fun h => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lowDegreeEnc h u

/-- Select the `W` bit of a Pair answer. This is the bracketed Pair family in
item 4 of `lem:qld-win-implications`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:210-231`, blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
noncomputable def pairComponentMeas (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (ω : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) (S.LocalSpace side) :=
  (S.pairMeas side ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2).postprocess fun bits =>
    match W with
    | .X => bits.1
    | .Z => bits.2

/-- The bit measurement for a Magic Square variable question. This is
`M^(Variable_j,omega)_a` in item 7 of `lem:qld-win-implications`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:250-263`, blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
noncomputable def msVarBitMeas (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (j : Fin 9) (ω : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) (S.LocalSpace side) :=
  (S.msMeas side (.var j) ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2).postprocess _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msBitOrZero

/-- The Magic Square strategy induced by the test measurements at a fixed
Pauli tuple. It retains the original heterogeneous local spaces and state, as
required by item 6 of `lem:qld-win-implications`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:240-249`, blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
noncomputable def msStrategyAt (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    (ω : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msGame where
  ιA := S.toStrategy.ιA
  ιB := S.toStrategy.ιB
  ψ := S.toStrategy.ψ
  ψ_norm := S.toStrategy.ψ_norm
  A t := S.msMeas .alice t ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2
  B t := S.msMeas .bob t ω.1 ω.2.1 ω.2.2.1 ω.2.2.2

/-- The Magic Square value `Lambda_omega` is the ordinary tensor-product game
value of `msStrategyAt`. This is item 6 of `lem:qld-win-implications`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:240-249`, blueprint
`lem:qld-win-implications`. -/
noncomputable def msValueAt (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (ω : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P) : ℝ :=
  (S.msStrategyAt ω).value

end ProjectiveSetting

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT
