/-!
# Witnesses for combining the Pauli bases

This module defines the five measurement and distribution witnesses used in
the combining argument.  Every measurement is indexed by the player side, so
Alice's and Bob's local spaces remain distinct.  The extended-dimensional
line objects use the directly indexed low-degree interface and therefore do
not require a dimension-divisibility hypothesis.

## References

`CombinedPointsWitness`, `CombinedLinesWitness`, and `GlobalPairWitness` record
the measurement conclusions of `lem:qld-4-10`, `lem:qld-xz-lines`, and
`lem:qld-4-7`, respectively, in
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`.  `SubLineWitness` and
`ExtendedLinesWitness` instead support `lem:qld-sublines` and `lem:qld-4-13`
through the directly indexed extended-line carrier and probability law.  The
latter also uses the completed answer alphabet, rather than the field-valued
answer sum in the source statement.  The paper source is
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:689-709,
882-894,1020-1069,1267-1274`.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-! ## The canonical scalar identification -/

/-- Identify the direct extended game's scalar field with the Pauli scalar
field.  Both are selected by `fixedFieldModel`; only their proof argument for
admissibility differs. -/
noncomputable def extendedDirectScalarEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd ≃+* _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P := by
  have h : P.extendedDirectLd.hq = P.hq := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  cases h
  exact RingEquiv.refl _

/-- Transport an extended direct point into the canonical Pauli scalar field. -/
def directPointToPauli (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (u : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) :
    Fin (2 * P.m + 2) -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P :=
  fun i => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv P (u i)

/-! ## Combined point and line measurements -/

/-- Projective joint point measurements and their ordered consistency
guarantees from `lem:qld-4-10`, paper lines 689--709.  The `XZ` and `ZX`
products are retained as distinct fields. -/
structure CombinedPointsWitness {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (δ : ℝ) where
  /-- The complete joint measurement on each player's expanded local space. -/
  Q : (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) ->
    (Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) ->
    (Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) ->
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)
  /-- Every joint point measurement is projective. -/
  projective : ∀ side x z, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (Q side x z)
  /-- Joint point measurements agree across every directed opposite placement. -/
  self_consistent : ∀ p1 p2 : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement, p1.IsOpposite p2 ->
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.opFamilyDistSq
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution
        ((Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)))
      (fun xz ab => S.place p1 ((Q p1.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
      (fun xz ab => S.place p2 ((Q p2.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
      S.psiHat <= δ
  /-- Joint point measurements are close to the ordered `X`-then-`Z` product. -/
  consistent_XZ : ∀ p1 p2 : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement, p1.IsOpposite p2 ->
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.opFamilyDistSq
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution
        ((Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)))
      (fun xz ab => S.place p1 ((Q p1.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
      (fun xz ab => S.place p2
        ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
          (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2))
      S.psiHat <= δ
  /-- Joint point measurements are close to the ordered `Z`-then-`X` product. -/
  consistent_ZX : ∀ p1 p2 : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement, p1.IsOpposite p2 ->
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.opFamilyDistSq
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution
        ((Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)))
      (fun xz ab => S.place p1 ((Q p1.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
      (fun xz ab => S.place p2
        ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
          (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
      S.psiHat <= δ

/-- Joint line measurements and their evaluation consistency from
`lem:qld-xz-lines`, paper lines 882--894.  Evaluation uses explicit `Option`
outcomes, including the class of answers not determined at the sampled point. -/
structure CombinedLinesWitness {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ : ℝ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (points : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness S δQ)
    (δ : ℝ) where
  /-- The complete paired-line measurement on each expanded local space. -/
  T : (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) ->
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams ->
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d) ×
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly P.toLdParams (P.m * P.d))
      (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)
  /-- On an axis-parallel X line, outcomes outside degree `d` have zero effect. -/
  axis_degree_X : ∀ side lineX lineZ fX fZ,
    lineX.kind = .axis -> Not (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly.FitsDegree P.d fX) ->
      (T side lineX lineZ).effect (fX, fZ) = 0
  /-- On an axis-parallel Z line, outcomes outside degree `d` have zero effect. -/
  axis_degree_Z : ∀ side lineX lineZ fX fZ,
    lineZ.kind = .axis -> Not (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly.FitsDegree P.d fZ) ->
      (T side lineX lineZ).effect (fX, fZ) = 0
  /-- Evaluated line pairs are consistent with the completed point-pair
  measurement on every directed opposite placement. -/
  consistent : ∀ p1 p2 : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement, p1.IsOpposite p2 ->
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.consistencyDefect
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.prod (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist P.toLdParams)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointDist P.toLdParams))
      (fun sample answer => S.place p1
        (((T p1.side sample.1.1 sample.2.1).postprocess fun fs =>
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalOpt sample.1.1 sample.1.2 fs.1,
            _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalOpt sample.2.1 sample.2.2 fs.2)).effect answer))
      (fun sample answer => S.place p2
        (((points.Q p2.side sample.1.2 sample.2.2).postprocess fun ab =>
          (some ab.1, some ab.2)).effect answer))
      S.psiHat <= δ

/-! ## The subline distribution -/

/-- A tuple consisting of an extended line and its projected X and Z lines. -/
abbrev SubLineTriple (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc P.extendedDirectLd ×
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams)

/-- An extended line tuple together with a point sampled uniformly on it. -/
abbrev SubLinePointSample (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineTriple P ×
    (Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)

/-- The shared restricted line kind and two coordinate indices in one mixture
component of the subline law. -/
abbrev SubLineComponent (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineKind × (Fin P.m × Fin P.m)

/-- Select the restricted line-point distribution of a given kind and index. -/
noncomputable def restrictedLinePointDist (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (kind : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineKind) (i : Fin P.m) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams × (Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) :=
  match kind with
  | .axis => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.restrictedALineDist P.toLdParams i
  | .diagonal => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.restrictedDLineDist P.toLdParams i

/-- Sample a subline tuple and then a uniform affine parameter on its
extended line. -/
noncomputable def subLinePointDist (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (D : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineTriple P)) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLinePointSample P) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.prod D
    (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd))).map fun sample =>
      (sample.1, sample.1.1.base + sample.2 • sample.1.1.direction)

/-- Retain the projected line pair and the X projection of an extended point. -/
def subLineXProjection {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLinePointSample P) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
      (Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :=
  (sample.1.2, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projX (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P sample.2))

/-- Retain the projected line pair and the Z projection of an extended point. -/
def subLineZProjection {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLinePointSample P) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
      (Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :=
  (sample.1.2, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projZ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P sample.2))

/-- The X-point marginal associated with one restricted product component. -/
noncomputable def subLineXComponentDist (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (component : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineComponent P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution
      ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
        (Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.prod
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.restrictedLinePointDist P component.1 component.2.1)
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.restrictedLinePointDist P component.1 component.2.2).map Prod.fst)).map
      fun sample => ((sample.1.1, sample.2), sample.1.2)

/-- The Z-point marginal associated with one restricted product component. -/
noncomputable def subLineZComponentDist (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (component : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineComponent P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution
      ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
        (Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.prod
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.restrictedLinePointDist P component.1 component.2.1).map Prod.fst)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.restrictedLinePointDist P component.1 component.2.2)).map
      fun sample => ((sample.1, sample.2.1), sample.2.2)

/-- Directly indexed form of the subline distribution of `lem:qld-sublines`,
paper lines 1063--1069.  Its extended-line marginal is the directly indexed
line-point law rather than the seed-indexed line-point distribution over
`F_q^(2m+2)` of the source statement; that replacement is documented in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`, so this is a
formalization auxiliary record, not the source-labelled statement.  Its
source-mixture field records the X and Z point marginals separately; it does
not assert a joint conditional law for the pair of projected points. -/
structure SubLineWitness (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) where
  /-- The actual distribution of an extended line and two projected lines. -/
  D : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineTriple P)
  /-- The distribution has total mass one. -/
  isProbability : D.IsProbability
  /-- Its extended-line marginal is the direct line-point marginal. -/
  extended_marginal : D.map Prod.fst =
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLinePointDist P.extendedDirectLd).map Prod.fst
  /-- Every point of an extended line projects onto both stored source lines. -/
  incidence : ∀ sample ∈ D.support, ∀ u ∈ sample.1.pointSet,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projX (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P u) ∈ sample.2.1.pointSet ∧
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projZ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P u) ∈ sample.2.2.pointSet
  /-- Each line triple carries affine data sufficient for
  `combineLinePoly_spec`. -/
  compatibility : ∀ sample ∈ D.support,
    ∃ aX bX aZ bZ uAlpha vAlpha uBeta vBeta : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsCombineLineCompatible
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P sample.1.base)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P sample.1.direction)
        sample.2.1.base sample.2.1.direction
        sample.2.2.base sample.2.2.direction
        aX bX aZ bZ uAlpha vAlpha uBeta vBeta
  /-- Each one-point projected marginal is a mixture of restricted product
  laws.  No equality for their joint conditional law is claimed. -/
  source_mixture : ∃ components : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineComponent P),
    components.IsProbability ∧
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLinePointDist P D).map _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineXProjection =
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.bind components (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineXComponentDist P) ∧
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLinePointDist P D).map _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineZProjection =
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.bind components (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineZComponentDist P)
  /-- An extended axis line has axis-parallel projected lines. -/
  axis_closure : ∀ sample ∈ D.support, sample.1.kind = .axis ->
    sample.2.1.kind = .axis ∧ sample.2.2.kind = .axis

/-! ## Extended lines and global polynomial pairs -/

/-- Extended-line POVMs and directly indexed, completed-answer forms of the two
consistency relations in `lem:qld-4-13`, paper lines 1020--1034. The direct line
carrier avoids the dimension-divisibility obstruction documented in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`. -/
structure ExtendedLinesWitness {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ : ℝ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (points : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness S δQ)
    (δ : ℝ) where
  /-- The complete extended-line measurement on each player side. -/
  Qline : (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc P.extendedDirectLd ->
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly P.extendedDirectLd (P.m * P.d + 1))
      (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)
  /-- Axis-line outcomes outside degree `d` have zero effect. -/
  axis_degree : ∀ side line f, line.kind = .axis ->
    Not (∀ i, P.d < i.val -> f i = 0) ->
      (Qline side line).effect f = 0
  /-- Alice's evaluated line measurement is consistent with Bob's completed
  combined point measurement. -/
  consistent_alice : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.consistencyDefect
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLinePointDist P.extendedDirectLd)
    (fun sample answer => S.place .AA'
      (((Qline .alice sample.1).postprocess
        (fun f => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directEvalOpt sample.1 sample.2 f).map
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv P))).effect answer))
    (fun sample answer => S.place .BA''
      (((points.Q .bob
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projX (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P sample.2))
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projZ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P sample.2))).postprocess fun ab =>
          some (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P sample.2 (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.alphaVar P.m) * ab.1 +
            _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P sample.2 (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.betaVar P.m) * ab.2)).effect answer))
    S.psiHat <= δ
  /-- Bob's evaluated line measurement is consistent with Alice's completed
  combined point measurement. -/
  consistent_bob : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.consistencyDefect
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLinePointDist P.extendedDirectLd)
    (fun sample answer => S.place .BB'
      (((Qline .bob sample.1).postprocess
        (fun f => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directEvalOpt sample.1 sample.2 f).map
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv P))).effect answer))
    (fun sample answer => S.place .AB''
      (((points.Q .alice
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projX (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P sample.2))
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projZ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P sample.2))).postprocess fun ab =>
          some (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P sample.2 (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.alphaVar P.m) * ab.1 +
            _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P sample.2 (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.betaVar P.m) * ab.2)).effect answer))
    S.psiHat <= δ

/-- The side-indexed global polynomial-pair measurements handed to Chapter 16.
This is the exact conclusion of `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1267--1274, with
the two heterogeneous point-consistency displays stated separately. -/
structure GlobalPairWitness {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (δ : ℝ) where
  /-- The complete global polynomial-pair measurement on each player side. -/
  Smeas : (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) ->
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side)
  /-- Both global polynomial-pair measurements are projective. -/
  projective : ∀ side, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (Smeas side)
  /-- Alice's global evaluations are consistent with Bob's source point
  measurements, for each Pauli basis. -/
  point_consistent_alice : ∀ W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.consistencyDefect (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))
      (fun u a => S.place .AA'
        (((Smeas .alice).postprocess (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalAt W u)).effect a))
      (fun u a => S.place .BA''
        ((S.pointMeasExp .bob W u).effect a))
      S.psiHat <= δ
  /-- Bob's global evaluations are consistent with Alice's source point
  measurements, for each Pauli basis. -/
  point_consistent_bob : ∀ W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.consistencyDefect (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))
      (fun u a => S.place .BB'
        (((Smeas .bob).postprocess (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalAt W u)).effect a))
      (fun u a => S.place .AB''
        ((S.pointMeasExp .alice W u).effect a))
      S.psiHat <= δ

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Line/point rejection for the extended direct game

This module identifies the axis-line/point, diagonal-line/point, and reversed
point/axis-line branch rejections of the strategy constructed from an
`ExtendedLinesWitness` with the corresponding completed line-point defects.
These are finite postprocessing and state-transport steps in the first
paragraph of the proof of `lem:qld-4-7`; they do not establish a passing-value
bound or construct the supplied witness.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1279-1288`
- Blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
- Issues #302, #305, #307, and #309.
-/
@[expose] public section
open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

-- The six-register products use the same instance-search budget as StateTransport.
set_option synthInstance.maxSize 400

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

namespace ExtendedLineGame

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaQ deltaL : ℝ}
variable {setting : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
variable {points : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness setting deltaQ}

/-- The unique coordinate of the one-coordinate extended direct low-degree game. -/
def onlyCoordinate : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.k :=
  ⟨0, by change 0 < 1; decide⟩

/-- Read an axis-line answer by completed evaluation at the sampled point.
Failed completed evaluation, including a zero-direction ambiguity, remains
the `none` outcome. -/
def axisGameRead
    (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer P.extendedDirectLd → Option (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
  | .alinePolys coeffs =>
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directEvalOpt (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directALineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd sample) sample.point
        (coeffs _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.onlyCoordinate)).map (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv P)
  | _ => none

/-- Read the unique point coordinate as an optional Pauli scalar. Support for
`lem:qld-4-7`, paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1279-1288`. -/
def pointGameRead :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer P.extendedDirectLd → Option (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
  | .pointVals values => some (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv P (values _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.onlyCoordinate))
  | _ => none

















/-- Read a diagonal-line answer by completed evaluation at the sampled point.
Other answer formats and undefined evaluations return `none`.
Support for `lem:qld-4-7`, paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1279-1288`. -/
def diagonalGameRead
    (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer P.extendedDirectLd → Option (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
  | .dlinePolys coeffs =>
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directEvalOpt (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDLineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd sample) sample.point
        (coeffs _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.onlyCoordinate)).map (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv P)
  | _ => none

































end ExtendedLineGame
end

/-!
# Transport of the polynomial-pair completion

The actual singleton outcomes are transported by the canonical field
equivalence before applying the algebraic completion.
Every original outcome is retained, including those outside the combining image.

## References

Paper `eq:qld-sgg-completeness` and the completion paragraph of `lem:qld-4-7`,
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1375-1404`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus

noncomputable section

private theorem map_mem_polyFunc {K L : Type*} [CommSemiring K] [CommSemiring L]
    {n d : ℕ} (e : K →+* L) (p : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc n K d) :
    MvPolynomial.map e p.1 ∈ _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc n L d := by
  rw [MvPolynomial.mem_restrictDegree]
  intro s hs i
  exact (MvPolynomial.mem_restrictDegree _ _ _).mp p.2 s
    (MvPolynomial.support_map_subset e p.1 hs) i

/-- Exact singleton and coefficient-field equivalence for the actual rounded
outcomes. The degree certificates are transported through support inclusion. -/
def directPolynomialEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd ≃
      _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) P.d where
  toFun g := ⟨MvPolynomial.map (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1,
    by exact map_mem_polyFunc _ _⟩
  invFun p := fun _ => ⟨MvPolynomial.map (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm.toRingHom p.1,
    by exact map_mem_polyFunc _ _⟩
  left_inv g := by
    funext i
    have hi : i = (0 : Fin 1) := @Subsingleton.elim (Fin 1) _ i 0
    subst i
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (MvPolynomial.mapEquiv _ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv P)).symm_apply_apply _
  right_inv p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (MvPolynomial.mapEquiv _ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv P)).apply_symm_apply _

/-- The actual singleton outcome corresponding to a bounded polynomial pair. -/
def directCombinedEmbedding (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P ↪ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinedPolyEmbedding P).trans (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.directPolynomialEquiv P).symm.toEmbedding

/-- Relabel the actual rounded measurement in the canonical coefficient field. -/
def canonicalPolynomialMeasurement {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (R : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd ι) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) P.d) ι :=
  R.postprocess (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.directPolynomialEquiv P)

/-- The canonical relabeling retains each original effect exactly. -/
@[simp] theorem canonicalPolynomialMeasurement_effect {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (R : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd ι)
    (p : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) P.d) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.canonicalPolynomialMeasurement R).effect p =
      R.effect ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.directPolynomialEquiv P).symm p) := by
  have h := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SandwichProduct.postprocess_effect_of_injective R (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.directPolynomialEquiv P)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.directPolynomialEquiv P).injective ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.directPolynomialEquiv P).symm p)
  simpa only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.canonicalPolynomialMeasurement, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using h

/-- The complete projective pair construction applied to the actual
rounded measurement, including all excluded outcomes at one chosen pair. -/
def directPairMeasurement {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (R : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd ι)
    (pair₀ : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P) ι :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.completedPairMeasurement P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.canonicalPolynomialMeasurement R) pair₀







end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame

/-!
# Point consistency of the completed polynomial-pair measurements

The polynomial-pair completion is applied to the actual rounded outcomes. Its missing
mass and retained point mismatch are kept separate until the final bound.

## References

Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1375-1404`,
`eq:qld-sgg-completeness` and `eq:qld-sgg-mhat-sandwich`;
blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus PolynomialImageBounds

noncomputable section



/-- The retained diagonal overlap with the actual opposite point measurement. -/
def retainedPointOverlap {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p1 p2 : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement)
    (R : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : ℝ :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) (fun x =>
    ∑ pair : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.stateQForm S.psiHat
      (S.place p1 (R.effect (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.directCombinedEmbedding P pair)) *
        S.place p2 ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side W x).effect (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalAt W x pair))))




















end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame

# Retained point mismatch on the faithful combining image

The outcome sum ranges over the actual bounded polynomial-pair embedding.
The projected vectors and both heterogeneous placements are preserved.

## References

Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1360-1404`,

/-- The retained point mismatch is the squared norm of the incorrect point
projection on the actual vector `R_g psiHat`, averaged over the point. -/
def retainedPointMismatch {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p1 p2 : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement)
    (R : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : ℝ :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) (fun x =>
    ∑ pair : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P, ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState
      (1 - S.place p2 ((S.pointMeasExp p2.side W x).effect (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalAt W x pair)))
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 (R.effect (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.directCombinedEmbedding P pair)))
        S.psiHat)‖ ^ 2)



end

/-- A positive atom gives a positive atom of every push-forward. -/
private theorem map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos {Source Target : Type*}
    [DecidableEq Target] (law : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution Source) (mapping : Source → Target)
    (sample : Source) (hpositive : 0 < law.weight sample) :
    0 < (law.map mapping).weight (mapping sample) := by
  classical
  have hmem : sample ∈ law.support := by
    by_contra hnot
    simp [law.outsideSupport sample hnot] at hpositive
  exact hpositive.trans_le (Finset.single_le_sum
    (fun other _ => law.nonnegative other) (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hmem, rfl⟩))

/-- Every canonical direct line has positive marginal mass. In particular, the
conditional distribution in the construction at paper lines 1118--1132 is defined
on every direct line, including zero-direction diagonal lines. -/
theorem directLinePointDist_line_weight_pos (params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdParams)
    (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc params) :
    0 < ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLinePointDist params).map Prod.fst).weight line := by
  have huniform (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace params) :
      0 < (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace params)).weight sample := by
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.uniformDistribution_weight_apply]
    positivity
  suffices hpoint : 0 < (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLinePointDist params).weight (line, line.base) by
    exact map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos _ Prod.fst _ hpoint
  cases line with
  | axis base index baseFixed =>
    let sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace params := ⟨base, index, 0⟩
    have haxis := map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace params))
      (fun source => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directALineDescOf params source, source.point)) sample (huniform sample)
    have hdecode : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directALineDescOf params sample = .axis base index baseFixed := by
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directALineDescOf, sample, baseFixed]
    change 0 < (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directALinePointDist params).weight _ at haxis
    rw [hdecode] at haxis
    have hother := (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDLinePointDist params).nonnegative
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc.axis base index baseFixed, base)
    change 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directALinePointDist params).weight _ +
      (1 - 1 / 2) * (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDLinePointDist params).weight _
    change 0 < (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directALinePointDist params).weight
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc.axis base index baseFixed, base) at haxis
    dsimp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc.base]
    linarith
  | diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero =>
    let sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace params := ⟨base, index, direction⟩
    have hprefix : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPrefixProjection index direction = direction := by
      funext coordinate
      simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPrefixProjection]
      split_ifs with hbefore
      · exact (prefixZero coordinate hbefore).symm
      · rfl
    have hdiagonal := map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace params))
      (fun source => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDLineDescOf params source, source.point)) sample (huniform sample)
    have hdecode : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDLineDescOf params sample =
        .diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero := by
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDLineDescOf, sample, hprefix, baseFixed]
    change 0 < (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDLinePointDist params).weight _ at hdiagonal
    rw [hdecode] at hdiagonal
    have hother := (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directALinePointDist params).nonnegative
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc.diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero, base)
    change 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directALinePointDist params).weight _ +
      (1 - 1 / 2) * (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDLinePointDist params).weight _
    change 0 < (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDLinePointDist params).weight
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc.diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero, base) at hdiagonal
    dsimp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc.base]
    linarith

/-- The supported triples over a fixed extended line. Restricting the carrier
retains the affine compatibility proof without choosing any substitute lines. -/
abbrev SubLineWitness.Fiber {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} (sublines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineWitness params)
    (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc params.extendedDirectLd) :=
  ↥(sublines.D.support.filter (fun sample => sample.1 = line))

/-- The mass of a subline fiber is positive by the prescribed extended marginal. -/
theorem SubLineWitness.fiber_mass_pos {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams}
    (sublines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineWitness params) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc params.extendedDirectLd) :
    0 < (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).weight line := by
  rw [sublines.extended_marginal]
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLinePointDist_line_weight_pos _ _

/-- The genuine conditional law of the supported subline triples given their
extended line, as in paper lines 1118--1132. There is no zero-mass branch. -/
def SubLineWitness.conditionalLaw {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams}
    (sublines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineWitness params) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc params.extendedDirectLd) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (sublines.Fiber line) where
  support := Finset.univ
  weight sample := sublines.D.weight sample.val / (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).weight line
  nonnegative sample := div_nonneg (sublines.D.nonnegative sample.val)
    (sublines.fiber_mass_pos line).le
  outsideSupport sample hnot := (hnot (Finset.mem_univ sample)).elim

/-- Conditioning on an extended line preserves total mass one. -/
theorem SubLineWitness.conditionalLaw_isProbability {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams}
    (sublines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineWitness params) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc params.extendedDirectLd) :
    (sublines.conditionalLaw line).IsProbability := by
  change (∑ sample : sublines.Fiber line,
    sublines.D.weight sample.val / (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).weight line) = 1
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_coe_sort]
  exact div_self (sublines.fiber_mass_pos line).ne'

/-- Supported subline triples supply all eight affine coordinates in the
polynomial combination formula; the choice is only of proved compatible data. -/
 theorem SubLineWitness.exists_affineData {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams}
    (sublines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineWitness params) (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineTriple params)
    (hsample : sample ∈ sublines.D.support) :
    ∃ data : Fin 8 → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar params,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsCombineLineCompatible (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params sample.1.base)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params sample.1.direction)
        sample.2.1.base sample.2.1.direction sample.2.2.base sample.2.2.direction
        (data 0) (data 1) (data 2) (data 3) (data 4) (data 5) (data 6) (data 7) := by
  obtain ⟨offsetX, slopeX, offsetZ, slopeZ, alpha, alphaSlope, beta, betaSlope, hcompat⟩ :=
    sublines.compatibility sample hsample
  exact ⟨![offsetX, slopeX, offsetZ, slopeZ, alpha, alphaSlope, beta, betaSlope], hcompat⟩

/-- Affine coordinates for the actual subline triple, not a replacement POVM. -/
def SubLineWitness.affineData {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams}
    (sublines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineWitness params) (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineTriple params)
    (hsample : sample ∈ sublines.D.support) : Fin 8 → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar params :=
  Classical.choose (show
    ∃ data : Fin 8 → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar params,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsCombineLineCompatible (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params sample.1.base)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params sample.1.direction)
        sample.2.1.base sample.2.1.direction sample.2.2.base sample.2.2.direction
        (data 0) (data 1) (data 2) (data 3) (data 4) (data 5) (data 6) (data 7) from by
    exact sublines.exists_affineData sample hsample)



/-- The source polynomial combination on a supported triple, transported only
along the canonical identification of the two scalar models. -/
def SubLineWitness.combinedPolynomial {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams}
    (sublines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineWitness params) (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineTriple params)
    (hsample : sample ∈ sublines.D.support)
    (polynomials : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly params.toLdParams (params.m * params.d) ×
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly params.toLdParams (params.m * params.d)) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd (params.m * params.d + 1) :=
  let data := sublines.affineData sample hsample
  fun index => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv params).symm
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combineLinePoly (data 0) (data 1) (data 2) (data 3)
      (data 4) (data 5) (data 6) (data 7) polynomials.1 polynomials.2 index)

/-- The directly indexed form of the extended-line POVM at paper lines
1118--1132: condition the subline law and average the postprocessed paired-line POVMs. -/
def SubLineWitness.extendedMeasurement {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams}
    {error pointError lineError : ℝ} {setting : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting params error}
    {points : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness setting pointError}
    (sublines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineWitness params) (lines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc params.extendedDirectLd) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd (params.m * params.d + 1))
      (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace side) := by
  let family (sample : sublines.Fiber line) :=
    (lines.T side sample.val.2.1 sample.val.2.2).postprocess
      (sublines.combinedPolynomial sample.val (Finset.mem_filter.mp sample.property).1)
  have hsum : (∑ polynomial, _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution (sublines.conditionalLaw line)
      (fun sample => (family sample).effect polynomial)) = 1 := by
    rw [← _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_sum]
    simp only [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.sum_eq_one]
    exact _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_const_of_isProbability _
      (sublines.conditionalLaw_isProbability line) 1
  exact { effect := fun polynomial => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution
            (sublines.conditionalLaw line) (fun sample => (family sample).effect polynomial)
          pos := fun polynomial => _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.averageOperatorOverDistribution_nonneg _ _
            (fun sample => (family sample).pos polynomial)
          sum_le_one := le_of_eq hsum
          sum_eq_one := hsum }




























end

and corrected error convention retain their existing meanings.

## References

blueprint `lem:qld-4-13-established`.
See `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex` and
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex` for the remaining
comparison with the printed source theorem.

@[expose] public section

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus

/-- The actual paired-line versus point-pair overlap on one subline triple,
with its uniform affine parameter. This is the integrand of the first route. -/
def pairedSublineOverlap {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {error pointError lineError : ℝ}
    (setting : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting params error) (points : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness setting pointError)
    (lines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError) (first second : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement)
    (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineTriple params) : ℝ :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)) (fun parameter =>
    let point := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params (sample.1.base + parameter • sample.1.direction)
    ∑ pair, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.stateQForm setting.psiHat
      (setting.place first ((lines.T first.side sample.2.1 sample.2.2).effect pair) *
        setting.place second (((points.Q second.side (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projX point) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projZ point)).postprocess
          (fun values => (some values.1, some values.2))).effect
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalOpt sample.2.1 (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projX point) pair.1,
              _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalOpt sample.2.2 (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projZ point) pair.2))))

/-- The actual extended-line versus extended-point overlap. Both families use
the supplied witnesses and the source polynomial combination. -/
def extendedPointOverlap {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {error pointError lineError : ℝ}
    (setting : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting params error) (points : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness setting pointError)
    (lines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError) (sublines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineWitness params)
    (first second : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement)
    (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc params.extendedDirectLd ×
      (Fin params.extendedDirectLd.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)) : ℝ :=
  ∑ answer, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.stateQForm setting.psiHat
    (setting.place first (((sublines.extendedMeasurement lines first.side sample.1).postprocess
      (fun polynomial => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directEvalOpt sample.1 sample.2 polynomial).map
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv params))).effect answer) *
      setting.place second (((points.Q second.side
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projX (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params sample.2))
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projZ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params sample.2))).postprocess (fun values => some
          ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params sample.2) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.alphaVar params.m) * values.1 +
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params sample.2) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.betaVar params.m) * values.2))).effect answer))







/-- The ordered Z-then-X point overlap on the actual subline law. -/
def orderedSublineOverlap {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {error pointError lineError : ℝ}
    (setting : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting params error) (points : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness setting pointError)
    (lines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError) (first second : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement)
    (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineTriple params) : ℝ :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd)) (fun parameter =>
    let point := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params (sample.1.base + parameter • sample.1.direction)
    ∑ pair, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.stateQForm setting.psiHat
      (setting.place first ((lines.T first.side sample.2.1 sample.2.2).effect pair) *
        setting.place second
          ((setting.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projZ point)).effect
              (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalOpt sample.2.2 (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projZ point) pair.2) *
            (setting.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projX point)).effect
              (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalOpt sample.2.1 (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projX point) pair.1))))




end

/-!
# The sampling procedure of the sub-line lemma

This module carries out the sampling procedure of `lem:qld-sublines`.  A line
kind is drawn from the two kinds, an extended coordinate and an extended point
and direction are drawn uniformly, and two scalar seeds are drawn
independently in the coordinate-index fibers of the two coordinates that the
two source lines must carry.  The sampled triple consists of the axis or
diagonal line of the extended sample together with the two source lines
decoded from the two coordinate blocks of the extended point and direction and
from the two seeds.

The module records the elementary evaluations of that triple, the description
of the support of the resulting law, the three pointwise properties of a
sampled triple -- incidence of the two source blocks, compatibility of the
affine data, and closure of the axis branch -- and the identification of its
extended-line marginal.

## References

The construction is the proof of `lem:qld-sublines` in
blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
The restricted laws are `def:ith-restricted-line`, blueprint lines
1209--1228, paper lines 1038--1048.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT

noncomputable section

/-! ## The auxiliary randomness of one branch -/

/-- An extended point together with an extended direction.  Blueprint
`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
abbrev SubLinePointDir (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :=
  (Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) ×
    (Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)

/-- The auxiliary randomness of one branch of the sampling procedure: an
extended point, an extended direction, and the two scalar seeds of the two
source lines.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
abbrev SubLineSamplingData (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLinePointDir P × (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P.toLdParams × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P.toLdParams)

/-- The law of the scalar seed carried by a source line at a given coordinate
index: uniform on the coordinate-index fiber of that index.  Blueprint
`def:ith-restricted-line`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1048`. -/
noncomputable def subLineSeedDist (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (i : Fin P.m) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P.toLdParams) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.restrict (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P.toLdParams))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSeedIndexEvent P.toLdParams i) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldSeedIndexEvent_positive P.toLdParams i)



/-- The auxiliary randomness law of the sampling procedure: the extended
coordinate is uniform, the extended point and direction are uniform and
independent of it, and the two seeds are independent and uniform on the
coordinate-index fibers of the two coordinates carried by the two source
lines.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
noncomputable def subLineSamplingDist (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (Fin (2 * P.m + 2) × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineSamplingData P) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.bind (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (Fin (2 * P.m + 2))) fun k =>
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.prod (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLinePointDir P))
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.prod (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineSeedDist P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineXIndex P k))
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineSeedDist P (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineZIndex P k)))).map fun w => (k, w)



/-! ## The sampled triple -/

/-- The extended line of a branch: the canonical axis or diagonal line of an
extended sample.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
noncomputable def subLineExtLineOfSample (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (kind : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineKind) (s : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc P.extendedDirectLd :=
  match kind with
  | .axis => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directALineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd s
  | .diagonal => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDLineDescOf P.extendedDirectLd s

/-- The extended line of a branch, read off the auxiliary randomness.
Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
noncomputable def subLineExtLine (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (kind : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineKind)
    (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) (w : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineSamplingData P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc P.extendedDirectLd :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineExtLineOfSample P kind ⟨w.1.1, k, w.1.2⟩

/-- A source line of a branch: the canonical axis or diagonal line decoded
from a point block, a scalar seed and a direction block.  Blueprint
`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
noncomputable def subLineSourceLine (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (kind : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineKind)
    (b : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (s : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P.toLdParams)
    (d : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams :=
  match kind with
  | .axis => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aLineDescOfBlock P.toLdParams (b, (s, d))
  | .diagonal => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.dLineDescOfBlock P.toLdParams (b, (s, d))

/-- The triple sampled by one branch of the procedure: the extended line
together with the two source lines decoded from its two coordinate blocks and
from the two scalar seeds.  Blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`,
paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
-/
noncomputable def subLineTripleOf (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (kind : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineKind)
    (k : Fin (2 * P.m + 2)) (w : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineSamplingData P) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineTriple P :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineExtLine P kind k w,
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineSourceLine P kind (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projX (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P w.1.1)) w.2.1
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projX (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P w.1.2)),
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineSourceLine P kind (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projZ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P w.1.1)) w.2.2
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projZ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli P w.1.2))))

/-- The law of the triples sampled by one branch.  Blueprint
`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
noncomputable def subLineBranchDist (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (kind : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineKind) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineTriple P) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineSamplingDist P).map fun w => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineTripleOf P kind w.1 w.2

/-- The sub-line law of `lem:qld-sublines`: the equal mixture of the two
branches of the sampling procedure.  Blueprint
`lem:qld-sublines`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`. -/
noncomputable def subLineDist (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineTriple P) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.bind (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (Fin 2))
    ![_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineBranchDist P .axis, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.subLineBranchDist P .diagonal]

bare extended dimension.  This is the decomposition
`directLdSpaceIndexEquiv` of `def:ld-question-distribution` with its stored

/-!
# The projected mixtures of the sub-line law

This module assembles the two projected point marginals of the sub-line law of
`lem:qld-sublines` into mixtures of the restricted product laws.  Drawing a
uniform point of the extended line of a mixture of line laws is the same
mixture of the corresponding uniform-point laws, so the two projected
marginals of the sub-line law are the mixtures, over the drawn kind and the
drawn extended coordinate, of the projected marginals of one branch at one
extended coordinate.  Each of those is the component law of the pair of
indices carried by that branch, so the mixing law is the law of the kind
together with the pair of indices assigned to a uniform extended coordinate.

## References

The assembly is the last step of the proof of `lem:qld-sublines` in
blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
The restricted laws are `def:ith-restricted-line`, blueprint lines
1209--1228, paper lines 1038--1048.
-/

extended coordinate of one branch.  Blueprint

/-!
# Uniformity under the identification of the two scalar fields

The extended line of the sub-line construction lives over the scalar field of
the directly indexed extended game, while the two source lines live over the
scalar field of the Pauli basis test.  The two fields are identified
coordinatewise by a field isomorphism, so that identification is a bijection
of the coordinate spaces and therefore carries uniform laws to uniform laws.
This module records that transport for a whole extended point and for the two
source blocks of an extended point, and it records the resampling rule that
reading a function at the point of a uniformly random affine parameter on the
line through the canonical representative of a uniformly random point is the
same as reading that function at a uniformly random point.

## References

The statements support `lem:qld-sublines` in
blueprint `lem:qld-sublines`, whose source is
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1063-1116`.
The coordinate blocks are those of `def:combine-map`, blueprint lines
445--480, paper lines 970--989.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT

noncomputable section

/-! ## The identification of the two scalar fields as a bijection -/

/-- The coordinatewise identification of the extended scalar field with the
source scalar field on one source block, presented as a bijection.  Blueprint
`def:combine-map`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:970-989`. -/
noncomputable def directBlockToPauliEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) ≃ (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) where
  toFun v := fun i => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv P (v i)
  invFun v := fun i => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).symm (v i)
  left_inv v := by
    funext i
    simp
  right_inv v := by
    funext i
    simp

end

/-!
# Combining the point measurements

This module constructs the projective joint X/Z point measurements and defines
their scalar linear coarse-graining. The latter is
the genuine postprocessing of a complete measurement on each heterogeneous
player space.

## References

The construction is `lem:qld-4-10` in
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`, with paper source
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:689-709`.
The coarse-graining is `lem:qld-4-12` in the same blueprint, with paper source
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:993-1011`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-- A pair of source points and the two scalar coefficients used by the
extended point measurement. -/
abbrev ExtendedPointQuestion (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :=
  ((Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) ×
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)

namespace CombinedPointsWitness

/-- Coarse-grain a joint point measurement by `(a,b) |-> alpha*a + beta*b`
on the selected player side.  This is the concrete measurement of
`lem:qld-4-12`, paper lines 993--1011. -/
noncomputable def extendedQ {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε δ : ℝ}
    {S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε} (points : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness S δ)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (x z : Fin P.m -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)
    (alpha beta : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
  (points.Q side x z).postprocess fun ab => alpha * ab.1 + beta * ab.2

/-!
# A direct-game strategy from supplied extended-line measurements

The input is an existing `ExtendedLinesWitness`, not an existence assertion
for that witness. Axis answers are restricted using its degree-support field;
diagonal answers are extended by zero coefficients. Point answers are the
scalar coarse-grainings of the supplied joint point measurements.

These are construction lemmas for the first paragraph of the proof of
`lem:qld-4-7`, not a proof of that lemma or of the existence of its input.
The remaining game-value estimates and the dependency on issue Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-QPBT-bak#119 are
recorded in `audits/2026-09-06_extended-line-game-244.md`.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1020-1034`
- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1267-1402`
- Blueprint `lem:qld-4-7` and `rem:qld-4-7-divisibility`.
- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

namespace ExtendedLineGame



/-- The axis answer length fits inside the extended-line coefficient list. -/
theorem axis_degree_le (params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    params.d + 1 ≤ params.m * params.d + 2 := by
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right params.d params.one_le_m
  omega

/-- Restrict an extended-line answer to the axis degree bound. -/
def axisRead (params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (coeffs : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd (params.m * params.d + 1)) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd params.d :=
  fun index => coeffs (Fin.castLE (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.axis_degree_le params) index)





/-- Extend a diagonal-line coefficient list by zeros, without changing its polynomial. -/
def diagonalRead (params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (coeffs : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd (params.m * params.d + 1)) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd
      (params.extendedDirectLd.m * params.extendedDirectLd.d) :=
  fun index => if bound : index.val < params.m * params.d + 2
    then coeffs ⟨index.val, bound⟩ else 0



/-- A scalar answer, transported to the direct field and made a singleton tuple. -/
def pointAnswer (params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (answer : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar params) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer params.extendedDirectLd :=
  .pointVals (fun _ => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv params).symm answer)

/-- A singleton axis answer with the game's required degree. -/
def axisAnswer (params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (coeffs : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd (params.m * params.d + 1)) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer params.extendedDirectLd :=
  .alinePolys (fun _ => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.axisRead params coeffs)

/-- A singleton diagonal answer with the game's required coefficient length. -/
def diagonalAnswer (params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (coeffs : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd (params.m * params.d + 1)) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer params.extendedDirectLd :=
  .dlinePolys (fun _ => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.diagonalRead params coeffs)









variable {params : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaQ deltaL : ℝ}
variable {setting : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting params epsilon}
variable {points : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness setting deltaQ}

/-- The actual answer measurement at each direct-game question. No strategy
passing premise or producer of the supplied line witness is used. -/
def answerMeasurement (lines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLinesWitness setting points deltaL)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (question : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion params.extendedDirectLd) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer params.extendedDirectLd) (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
  match question.1 with
  | .point =>
    let point := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params question.2.point
    (points.extendedQ side (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projX point) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projZ point)
      (point (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.alphaVar params.m)) (point (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.betaVar params.m))).postprocess (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.pointAnswer params)
  | .aline =>
    (lines.Qline side (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directALineDescOf params.extendedDirectLd question.2)).postprocess
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.axisAnswer params)
  | .dline =>
    (lines.Qline side (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDLineDescOf params.extendedDirectLd question.2)).postprocess
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.diagonalAnswer params)









/-- The supplied completed line-point defect, with the two register placements
explicit. This still uses the six-register state, not the constructed game's state. -/
def completedLinePointDefect (lines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLinesWitness setting points deltaL)
    (linePlacement pointPlacement : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement)
    (law : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc params.extendedDirectLd ×
      (Fin params.extendedDirectLd.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ params.extendedDirectLd))) : ℝ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.consistencyDefect law
    (fun sample answer => setting.place linePlacement
      (((lines.Qline linePlacement.side sample.1).postprocess
        (fun coeffs => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directEvalOpt sample.1 sample.2 coeffs).map
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv params))).effect answer))
    (fun sample answer => setting.place pointPlacement
      (((points.Q pointPlacement.side
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projX (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params sample.2))
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.projZ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params sample.2))).postprocess fun values =>
          some (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params sample.2 (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.alphaVar params.m) * values.1 +
            _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directPointToPauli params sample.2 (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.betaVar params.m) * values.2)).effect answer))
    setting.psiHat





/-- The bipartite state on the two expanded local spaces, with one shared EPR
pair. It is not the six-register vector `psiHat` on a smaller index type. -/
def pairState (setting : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting params epsilon) :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice × setting.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexState _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.prodShuffle (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.vecTensor setting.toStrategy.ψ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister params)))

/-- The two-player state used by the constructed game is normalized. -/
theorem pairState_norm (setting : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting params epsilon) :
    ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.pairState setting‖ = 1 := by
  change ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexState _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.prodShuffle
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.vecTensor setting.toStrategy.ψ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister params)))‖ = 1
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexState_norm_eq, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.vecTensor_norm_eq, setting.toStrategy.ψ_norm,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState_norm, mul_one]

/-- The concrete direct-game strategy determined by the supplied measurements. -/
def strategy (lines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLinesWitness setting points deltaL) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdGame params.extendedDirectLd) where
  ιA := setting.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice
  ιB := setting.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob
  ψ := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.pairState setting
  ψ_norm := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.pairState_norm setting
  A := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.answerMeasurement lines .alice
  B := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.answerMeasurement lines .bob













end ExtendedLineGame

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Completed same-line evaluation comparison

This module compares Alice's and Bob's completed axis-line or diagonal-line
readouts through the corresponding point readouts. The comparison uses the
consistency triangle on the common direct-game sample and then applies the
already proved mixed and point/point branch bounds.

The readouts take values in `Option (PauliScalar P)`. Agreement on `none`, in
particular for zero directions, is not an equality of parameter evaluations;
no coefficient-collision conclusion is asserted here.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1279-1288`
- `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:389-401`
- Blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
- Issue Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-QPBT-bak#321.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

namespace ExtendedLineGame

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaQ deltaL : ℝ}
variable {setting : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
variable {points : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness setting deltaQ}



/-- The consistency defect of Alice's and Bob's completed axis-line readouts
on the common direct-game sample. Failed evaluation remains `none`. -/
noncomputable def axisSameLineEvaluationDefect
    (lines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLinesWitness setting points deltaL) : ℝ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.consistencyDefect (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd))
    (fun sample answer =>
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement
        (ιB := setting.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)
        ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.answerMeasurement lines .alice
          (.aline, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .aline sample)).postprocess
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.axisGameRead sample))).effect answer)
    (fun sample answer =>
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.rightPlacedMeasurement
        (ιA := setting.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)
        ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.answerMeasurement lines .bob
          (.aline, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .aline sample)).postprocess
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.axisGameRead sample))).effect answer)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.pairState setting)

/-- The consistency defect of Alice's and Bob's completed diagonal-line
readouts on the common direct-game sample. Failed evaluation remains `none`. -/
noncomputable def diagonalSameLineEvaluationDefect
    (lines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLinesWitness setting points deltaL) : ℝ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.consistencyDefect (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd))
    (fun sample answer =>
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement
        (ιB := setting.ExpandedLocalSpace .bob)
        ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.answerMeasurement lines .alice
          (.dline, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .dline sample)).postprocess
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.diagonalGameRead sample))).effect answer)
    (fun sample answer =>
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.rightPlacedMeasurement
        (ιA := setting.ExpandedLocalSpace .alice)
        ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.answerMeasurement lines .bob
          (.dline, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .dline sample)).postprocess
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.diagonalGameRead sample))).effect answer)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.pairState setting)











end ExtendedLineGame

/-!
# Failed completed line-evaluation mass

This module bounds the marginal Born mass of the `none` outcome of each
completed line read by the corresponding mixed line/point rejection branch.
Wrong-format point answers also read as `none`, so the proof first removes
those answer pairs using their zero Born weight and only then applies event
inclusion.

These statements concern completed `Option`-valued readouts. They do not
identify successful parameter evaluation or prove a coefficient-collision
bound.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1279-1288`
- `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:232-248`
- Blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
- Issue Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-QPBT-bak#332.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

namespace ExtendedLineGame

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaQ deltaL : ℝ}
variable {setting : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
variable {points : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness setting deltaQ}







/-- Alice's marginal mass of failed completed axis-line evaluation under the
uniform common direct sample. -/
noncomputable def axisAliceNoneMass
    (lines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLinesWitness setting points deltaL) : ℝ :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd)) fun sample =>
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aliceEventWeight (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.strategy lines)
      (.aline, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .aline sample)
      (fun answer => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.axisGameRead sample answer = none)

/-- Alice's marginal mass of failed completed diagonal-line evaluation under
the uniform common direct sample. -/
noncomputable def diagonalAliceNoneMass
    (lines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLinesWitness setting points deltaL) : ℝ :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdSpace P.extendedDirectLd)) fun sample =>
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aliceEventWeight (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.strategy lines)
      (.dline, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directLdMap P.extendedDirectLd .dline sample)
      (fun answer => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.diagonalGameRead sample answer = none)

/-- Bob's marginal mass of failed completed axis-line evaluation under the
uniform common direct sample. -/

/-!
# Bounds for independently parameter-evaluated line answers

This module specializes the parameter/completed-read comparison to the axis
and diagonal measurements supplied by an `ExtendedLinesWitness`. The affine
parameter is sampled independently of the line. Affine resampling then
recovers the original joint line-point law, including zero directions.
The numerical estimates are formalization-only consequences of the supplied
point and line witnesses supporting the classical-game construction in the
proof of `lem:qld-4-7`.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1020-1034`
- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1279-1288`
- `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:295-311`
- Blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
- Issue Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-QPBT-bak#341.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

namespace ExtendedLineGame

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaQ deltaL : ℝ}
variable {setting : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
variable {points : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness setting deltaQ}

/-- The unique coordinate in the extended direct game. -/
def lineCoordinate : Fin P.extendedDirectLd.k :=
  ⟨0, by change 0 < 1; decide⟩



/-- Read the axis coefficient vector from a direct-game answer. Wrong answer
formats receive an arbitrary zero value; their Born weight is zero. -/
def axisCoefficients
    (answer : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer P.extendedDirectLd) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly P.extendedDirectLd P.d :=
  match answer with
  | .alinePolys coefficients => coefficients _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.lineCoordinate
  | _ => 0

/-- Read the diagonal coefficient vector from a direct-game answer. Wrong
answer formats receive an arbitrary zero value; their Born weight is zero. -/
def diagonalCoefficients
    (answer : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdAnswer P.extendedDirectLd) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectDegPoly P.extendedDirectLd
      (P.extendedDirectLd.m * P.extendedDirectLd.d) :=
  match answer with
  | .dlinePolys coefficients => coefficients _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.lineCoordinate
  | _ => 0

/-- The canonical direct-game axis question represented by an axis line. -/
def axisQuestion (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc P.extendedDirectLd) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion P.extendedDirectLd :=
  (.aline, ⟨line.base, line.index, 0⟩)

/-- The canonical direct-game diagonal question represented by a diagonal line. -/
def diagonalQuestion (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLineDesc P.extendedDirectLd) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectLdQuestion P.extendedDirectLd :=
  (.dline, ⟨line.base, line.index, line.direction⟩)

/-- The axis parameter-evaluation defect under the actual axis-line marginal
and an independent uniform affine parameter. -/
noncomputable def axisParameterEvaluationDefect
    (lines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLinesWitness setting points deltaL) : ℝ :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directALinePointDist P.extendedDirectLd) fun sample =>
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)) fun parameter =>
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.parameterEvalDefect (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.strategy lines) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.axisQuestion sample.1)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.axisQuestion sample.1) _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.axisCoefficients _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.axisCoefficients parameter

/-- The diagonal parameter-evaluation defect under the actual diagonal-line
marginal and an independent uniform affine parameter, including zero directions. -/
noncomputable def diagonalParameterEvaluationDefect
    (lines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLinesWitness setting points deltaL) : ℝ :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.directDLinePointDist P.extendedDirectLd) fun sample =>
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd)) fun parameter =>
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.parameterEvalDefect (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.strategy lines) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.diagonalQuestion sample.1)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.diagonalQuestion sample.1) _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.diagonalCoefficients _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.diagonalCoefficients parameter





















end ExtendedLineGame

end
