/-!
# Point/point rejection for the extended direct game

This module bounds the point-agreement branch of the directly indexed
low-degree strategy by the self-consistency error of the supplied joint point
measurements.  The common extended point is transported by one coordinate
equivalence to the jointly uniform tuple `(x, z, alpha, beta)` before the
scalar coarse-graining is applied.

This is a formalization-only auxiliary for the supplied-witness route in the
proof of `lem:qld-4-7`; it does not construct the point witness or establish
the complete passing-value estimate.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:689-709`
- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1279-1288`
- `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:295-311`
- Issue Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-QPBT-bak#313.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

set_option synthInstance.maxSize 400

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum
open ProjectiveSetting

noncomputable section

namespace ExtendedLineGame

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaQ deltaL : ℝ}
variable {setting : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
variable {points : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness setting deltaQ}

@[simp]  theorem piCongrLeft_const_apply
    {I J K : Type*} (e : I ≃ J) (f : I → K) (j : J) :
    (e.piCongrLeft fun _ => K) f j = f (e.symm j) := by
  simp only [Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply, eq_rec_constant]

/-- Split a direct extended point into its two Pauli points and two scalar
coordinates.  This is a single bijection, so uniformity is joint rather than
an inference from four separate marginals. -/
noncomputable def directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    (Fin P.extendedDirectLd.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectScalarQ P.extendedDirectLd) ≃
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedPointQuestion P :=
  (Equiv.piCongrRight fun _ => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toEquiv).trans <|
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.finCombineEquiv P.m).piCongrLeft fun _ => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P).trans <|
      (Equiv.sumPiEquivProdPi fun _ : (Fin P.m ⊕ Fin P.m) ⊕ Fin 2 =>
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P).trans <|
        (Equiv.sumPiEquivProdPi fun _ : Fin P.m ⊕ Fin P.m =>
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P).prodCongr
            (piFinTwoEquiv fun _ => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)



















end ExtendedLineGame

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Rounded extended-polynomial ordered estimates

Direct soundness retains all three consistency conclusions through compression.
Its same-space projective rounding supplies the point comparison used in both
ordered estimates, with the actual point and line errors retained.

## References

`eq:qld-g-42` and `eq:qld-g-43`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1278-1300`.
The directly indexed completed-answer restriction is documented in
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex` and
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus

noncomputable section

namespace ExtendedLineGame

/-- Evaluation of the single extended polynomial returned by direct soundness,
at the point with blocks `(x,z,alpha,beta)`, in the canonical Pauli scalar field.
The singleton tuple carrier is exactly the `k = 1` soundness outcome carrier. -/
def extendedPolynomialRead (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (x : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedPointQuestion P)
    (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv P
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalDirectPolyTupleAt ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.directPointExtendedQuestionEquiv P).symm x) g (0 : Fin 1))



/-- The full polynomial-outcome squared-norm sum in `eq:qld-g-42/43`.
The order parameter selects either `M_X M_Z` or `M_Z M_X`.
The polynomial effect acts on `p1` and both point effects on `p2`. -/
def extendedPolynomialOrderedError {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p1 p2 : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement)
    (R : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
    (reverse : Bool) : ℝ :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.avgOver (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedPointQuestion P)) (fun x =>
    ∑ g, ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (S.place p1 (R.effect g) *
      (1 - S.place p2
        (∑ ab ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P =>
            x.2.1 * ab.1 + x.2.2 * ab.2 = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.extendedPolynomialRead P x g),
          if reverse then
            (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z x.1.2).effect ab.2 *
              (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X x.1.1).effect ab.1
          else
            (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X x.1.1).effect ab.1 *
              (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z x.1.2).effect ab.2))) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2)

















end ExtendedLineGame

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

The axis-axis and diagonal-diagonal verifier branches compare the complete
typed coefficient answers returned by the two line measurements. This module
identifies each branch rejection exactly with the corresponding coefficient-
answer consistency defect, averaged over the marginal law of the supplied
line. These are exact transport identities, not numerical passing bounds.

/-!
# Scalar and base coefficients of the rounded polynomial outcomes

The singleton polynomial is transported through the canonical field equivalence
and Mathlib's equivalence between a polynomial in a sum of variables and an
iterated polynomial ring. Its individual-degree certificate controls both levels.
Splitting each base coefficient by either block gives the partial degrees used
in the fiber calculation. Independence of both wrong blocks identifies the
outcome with the existing bounded polynomial-pair combining map.

## References

`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1310-1326`,
the coefficient expansion preceding `eq:qld-g-prime-bound`.
The partial coefficient argument and separated image are at lines 1341--1368,
`eq:qld-g-2` and `eq:qld-g-non-separable`; blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement

noncomputable section

namespace ExtendedLineGame







/-- The two base blocks, in the order `x,z` used by the extended game. -/
def baseCoordinateEquiv (m : ℕ) : Fin (2 * m) ≃ Fin m ⊕ Fin m :=
  (finCongr (by omega)).trans finSumFinEquiv.symm

/-- The scalar coordinates first, followed by the combined base coordinates. -/
def scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv (m : ℕ) : Fin (2 * m + 2) ≃ Fin 2 ⊕ Fin (2 * m) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.finCombineEquiv m).trans
    ((Equiv.sumCongr (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.baseCoordinateEquiv m).symm (Equiv.refl _)).trans
      (Equiv.sumComm _ _))

/-- The actual singleton outcome as a polynomial in `alpha,beta` with
coefficients in the `2m` base variables, over the canonical Pauli field. -/
def scalarPolynomial (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) :=
  MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv _ _ _
    (MvPolynomial.rename (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.scalarBaseCoordinateEquiv P.m)
      (MvPolynomial.map (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1))





/-- Split a base coefficient into a polynomial in either varying block with
coefficients in the fixed block. The order parameter selects either `x` or `z`
as the varying block. This supports the two applications of `eq:qld-g-2` in
paper lines 1341--1358 and blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
def blockCoefficientPolynomial (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (MvPolynomial (Fin P.m) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) :=
  MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv _ _ _ (MvPolynomial.rename
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
      (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)) ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a))











/-- Split the full joint uniform point into the base point and scalar point.
This is one equivalence of sample spaces, not four marginal identifications. -/
def scalarBaseQuestionEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    ((Fin (2 * P.m) → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) × (Fin 2 → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) ≃
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedPointQuestion P :=
  (((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).piCongrLeft fun _ => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P).trans
    (Equiv.sumPiEquivProdPi fun _ : Fin P.m ⊕ Fin P.m => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)).prodCongr
      (finTwoArrowEquiv (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))







/-- Joint sample equivalence for the fiber calculation: the first input block
is fixed and the second varies. Reversal exchanges both the point blocks and
the scalar coefficients, so its ordered product is `ZX`. This supports the
two orders in `eq:qld-g-42/43` and blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
def fiberQuestionEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (reverse : Bool) :
    (((Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) ×
      (Fin 2 → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) ≃ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedPointQuestion P :=
  (if reverse then Equiv.refl _ else Equiv.prodComm _ _).prodCongr
    ((finTwoArrowEquiv (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)).trans
      (if reverse then Equiv.prodComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _))











end ExtendedLineGame

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Scalar-nonlinear mass of the actual rounded measurements

The full polynomial-outcome ordered estimate is composed with the concentration
bound for scalar-nonlinear outcomes. Opposite placements commute; no symmetry of the
player spaces is required. Projectivity retains the actual outcome masses.

## References

`eq:qld-g-42`, `eq:qld-g-prime`, and `eq:qld-g-prime-bound`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1283-1326`.
This is only scalar-linearity concentration; the variable-separation estimates
and retained overlaps are separate results.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus PolynomialImageBounds

noncomputable section

namespace ExtendedLineGame

/-- Actual mass of outcomes outside `alpha*g1(x,z) + beta*g2(x,z)`. The
coefficients may still depend on both base blocks. -/
def scalarNonlinearMass {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement)
    (R : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g => ¬ ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m))
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P), _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.scalarPolynomial P g =
        MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1),
    ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (S.place p (R.effect g)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2
















end ExtendedLineGame

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Wrong-variable mass of rounded polynomial outcomes

The two block orders use the actual projected state vectors and the full
ordered-error sum. A common exceptional coefficient controls all outcomes
of the fixed-block measurement before their weights are summed.

## References

Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1328-1368`,
`eq:qld-g-separable`, `eq:qld-g-48`, `eq:qld-g-2`, and the two wrong-variable
mass bounds. This supports blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`; it does not establish
the subsequent retained overlaps or global polynomial-pair witness.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus PolynomialImageBounds

noncomputable section

namespace ExtendedLineGame

/-- Actual mass of scalar-linear outcomes whose second coefficient in the
chosen order depends on the varying block. In order `XZ` this is the coefficient
of beta depending on x; in order `ZX` it is the coefficient of alpha depending
on z. These are the two classes in `eq:qld-g-prime-xpt-bound` and
`eq:qld-g-prime-zpt-bound`, supporting blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
def scalarWrongVariableMass {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement)
    (R : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side))
    (reverse : Bool) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g =>
    (∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P),
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.scalarPolynomial P g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
        MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1) ∧
    ¬ ∃ r, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtendedLineGame.blockCoefficientPolynomial P g
      (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 0 else 1) 1) reverse = MvPolynomial.C r),
    ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (S.place p (R.effect g)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2














/-- Mass outside the existing bounded polynomial-pair combining image after
the canonical field transport. This is the actual separated image of
`eq:qld-g-non-separable` and `def:combine-map`, supporting blueprint
`lem:qld-4-7`; no completion or overlap assertion is included. -/
def separatedPolynomialMass {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (p : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement)
    (R : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DirectPolyMeasTuple P.extendedDirectLd (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p.side)) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g => ¬ ∃ pair : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P,
      MvPolynomial.map (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.extendedDirectScalarEquiv P).toRingHom (g (0 : Fin 1)).1 =
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1),
    ‖_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState (S.place p (R.effect g)) S.psiHat‖ ^ 2














end ExtendedLineGame

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# X-point subline averages

This directly indexed auxiliary construction follows the first consistency
route for combined lines. The question carrier, completed answer alphabet,
and corrected error convention retain their existing meanings.

## References

Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1118-1246`,
blueprint `lem:qld-4-13-established`.
See `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex` and
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex` for the remaining
comparison with the printed source theorem.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus
open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

noncomputable section

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ δP : ℝ} {S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε}
  {points : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness S δQ}



/-! ## The mixture form of a one-point sub-line average -/

/-- The overlap of the paired-line measurement at two source lines with the
expanded `X`-point effect at a point, summed over the line answers.  This is
the deficit integrand in the proof of `lem:claim-17-2`, as a function of the
two source lines and the `X`-point alone. -/
def xPointOverlapAt (lines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedLinesWitness S points δP)
    (first second : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement)
    (w : (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
      (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) : ℝ :=
  ∑ fX, ∑ fZ, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.stateQForm S.psiHat
    (S.place first ((lines.T first.side w.1.1 w.1.2).effect (fX, fZ)) *
      S.place second ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .X w.2).effect (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalOpt w.1.1 w.2 fX)))






end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Sub-line averages of the Z-point overlap

The Z-point overlap of the paired-line measurement depends on the two source
lines and the Z block of the sampled extended point. The separate projected-point
mixture properties of the directly indexed sub-line law identify each one-point
marginal as a mixture of restricted product laws. Both marginal averaging
identities are recorded here. Regrouping line answers by their evaluations
then transfers the Z-overlap deficit from
`MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.ZEvalDeficit` to this law.

The Z-overlap estimates hold for arbitrary opposite placements, with separate
first-player specializations. The concrete X-overlap deficit instead uses the
exact X marginal of the X-Z-X sandwich and is proved in
`MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Lines.ConcreteXDeficit`.

## References

The Z estimates support blueprint `lem:claim-17-3-re-direct`, alongside the
source `lem:claim-17-3`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1204-1239`.
The separate marginal identities encode the analogue of Property 2 of
`lem:qld-sublines` for the directly indexed law; source-distribution transport
remains separate.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus

noncomputable section

/-! ## Regrouping the line answers by their evaluations -/









/-! ## The two one-point overlaps -/

section Overlaps

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ δP : ℝ} {S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε}
  {points : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedPointsWitness S δQ}

/-- The overlap of the paired-line measurement at two source lines with the
expanded `Z`-point effect at a point, summed over the line answers.  This is
the integrand of the left-hand side of `lem:claim-17-3`, as a function of the
two source lines and the `Z`-point alone. -/
def zPointOverlapAt (lines : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.CombinedLinesWitness S points δP)
    (first second : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Placement)
    (w : (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams) ×
      (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) : ℝ :=
  ∑ fX, ∑ fZ, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.stateQForm S.psiHat
    (S.place first ((lines.T first.side w.1.1 w.1.2).effect (fX, fZ)) *
      S.place second ((S.pointMeasExpOption second.side .Z w.2).effect (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalOpt w.1.2 w.2 fZ)))




















end Overlaps

end

/-!
# Pulled-apart Pauli observables

This module constructs the measurements and observables used to pull the two
Pauli bases onto separate registers. The construction retains the distinct
local spaces of the two players and uses the binary basis fixed in the
canonical field model.

## References

The product form and observable relations formalize blueprint
`lem:tildew-product-form`, from
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1415-1456`.
The swap identities formalize blueprint `lem:v-swap-conjugation`, from paper
lines 1687-1713.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-! ## Pulled-apart measurements and observables -/

namespace PauliKind

/-- Select the polynomial belonging to a Pauli basis from a joint polynomial
outcome. This is the marginalization used at paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1421-1423` and blueprint
`def:s-w-marginals`. -/
def selectPoly {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P -> _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Poly P
  | pair => match W with
    | .X => pair.1
    | .Z => pair.2

end PauliKind

namespace GlobalPairWitness

/-- The single-basis marginal of the global polynomial-pair measurement.
This is blueprint
`def:s-w-marginals`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1421-1423`. -/
noncomputable def marginalPoly {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon delta : ℝ}
    {S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.GlobalPairWitness S delta)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Poly P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
  (w.Smeas side).postprocess W.selectPoly



end GlobalPairWitness

/-- The pulled-apart projective-measurement effect from Equation `eq:tilde_M`.
The polynomial marginal acts on the player's expanded local space and the
dot-product projector acts on the newly adjoined register. Blueprint
`eq:tilde_M`; paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1425-1435`. -/
noncomputable def tildeM {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon delta : ℝ}
    {S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.GlobalPairWitness S delta)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)
    (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
  ∑ g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Poly P,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((w.marginalPoly side W).effect g)
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauDotProj W u (dotProduct (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.decodeFq g) u - a))





/-- The binary observable obtained from the trace coarse-graining of `tildeM`.
This is Equation `eq:def-tildewj` in blueprint
`def:tilde-w-observables`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1437-1442`. -/
noncomputable def tildeObs {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon delta : ℝ}
    {S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.GlobalPairWitness S delta)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)
    (j : Fin P.model.basisDim) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
  ∑ a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a)) •
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tildeM w side W u a













/-! ## Swap conjugation -/

/-- Each crossed Pauli product is unitary, by the two involution identities
used at paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1699`. -/
 theorem swapPauli_mul_conjTranspose {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams}
    (pair : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.decodeFq pair.2) * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable .Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.decodeFq pair.1)) *
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.decodeFq pair.2) * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable .Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.decodeFq pair.1))ᴴ = 1 := by
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable_conjTranspose,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable_conjTranspose, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.mul_assoc (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.decodeFq pair.2)), _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable_sq,
    Matrix.mul_one, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable_sq]









/-- The swap map built from the global polynomial-pair measurement, with the
crossed decoded arguments required by `def:v-swap-unitary`. Blueprint
`def:v-swap-unitary`; paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1700`. -/
noncomputable def swapUnitary {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon delta : ℝ}
    {S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.GlobalPairWitness S delta)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
  ∑ pair : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PolyPair P,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((w.Smeas side).effect pair)
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.decodeFq pair.2) *
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable .Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.decodeFq pair.1))

/-- The swap map is a right unitary. This is the first exact unitarity
calculation of blueprint
`lem:v-swap-conjugation`, paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1699`.

Projectivity and completeness of `w.Smeas side` reduce the product to its
diagonal outcomes. The two Pauli involutions then cancel in reverse order. -/
theorem swapUnitary_mul_conjTranspose {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams}
    {epsilon delta : ℝ} {S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    (w : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.GlobalPairWitness S delta) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.swapUnitary w side * (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.swapUnitary w side)ᴴ = 1 := by
  classical
  apply _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.sum_heteroKron_mul_conjTranspose (w.Smeas side) (w.projective side)
  exact swapPauli_mul_conjTranspose









end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Pauli comparison for the concrete extraction maps

The ideal-state distance estimate is transported back to the six-register
operators occurring in the extraction witness, for both players.

## References

Blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`; paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1827-1858`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder Classical

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement

noncomputable section





namespace ProjectiveSetting

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)

/-- The evaluated total-Pauli consistency defect against the opposite
pulled-apart measurement, with the tensor factors in Alice--Bob order. -/
def evaluatedPauliDefect (w : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : ℝ :=
  match side with
  | .alice => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.consistencyDefect (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))
      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .alice ((S.pauliEvalMeas .alice W u).effect a))
      (fun u a => S.placeSide .bob (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tildeM w .bob W (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u) a)) S.psiHat
  | .bob => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.consistencyDefect (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))
      (fun u a => S.placeSide .alice (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tildeM w .alice W (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u) a))
      (fun u a => S.placePlayer .bob ((S.pauliEvalMeas .bob W u).effect a)) S.psiHat









end ProjectiveSetting

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Consistency of the pulled-apart Pauli measurements

This module records the two estimates by which the polynomial marginals absorb
the expanded point measurements, with all heterogeneous placements written
explicitly. It also defines the mass of non-encoding marginal outcomes and
states the support estimate needed by the corrected decoder calculation.

The marginal agreement estimates and reverse-placement correlation transports
are developed from a supplied global polynomial-pair witness.

## References

The marginal estimates formalize blueprint
`lem:qld-constructing-the-paulis-helper`, from
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1609-1664`.
The non-encoding support obligation contributes to blueprint
`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, from paper lines 1458-1608; see
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
open ProjectiveSetting

noncomputable section

/-! ## Absorption of expanded point measurements -/







































/-! ## Non-encoding support -/

/-- The state-dependent mass assigned by a side's polynomial marginal to
outcomes outside the low-degree encoding image.  The finite support filter is
written explicitly so the restricted decoder identity is never applied to an
arbitrary polynomial representative.

This is the left-hand side of blueprint
`eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`, from
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1458-1602`.
The support estimate is proved separately from the decoder identity; see
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`. -/
noncomputable def nonencodingMarginalMass {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams}
    {epsilon deltaS : ℝ} {S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
    (w : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.GlobalPairWitness S deltaS) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ g ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun g : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Poly P => ¬ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.IsEncoding g),
    (inner ℂ S.psiHat
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.applyOperatorToState
        (S.placeSide side
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron ((w.marginalPoly side W).effect g)
            (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P))))
        S.psiHat)).re



end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Total Pauli measurements under the extraction swaps

The evaluated overlap on the swapped state is the original evaluated-Pauli
consistency overlap. Both player orientations retain their six-register
placements. These identities instantiate the ideal-state Pauli comparison.

## References

Blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`; paper
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1785-1858`,
especially `eq:qld-unitary-6` and `eq:qld-unitary-9`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder Classical

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement

noncomputable section



namespace ProjectiveSetting

variable {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)

/-- The total Pauli POVM extended to the full local extraction block and
conjugated by the concrete swap. This is the measurement in `eq:qld-unitary-7`. -/
def swappedPauliMeas (w : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    (fun h => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.conjBy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.swapUnitary w side) (S.onPlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
    (fun h => by
      apply star_right_conjugate_nonneg
      exact _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
        (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg ((S.pauliMeas side W).pos h) Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
        Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg)
    (by
      simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.conjBy, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.onPlayer, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sum,
        ← _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_left, (S.pauliMeas side W).sum_eq_one,
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron_one_one, Matrix.mul_one, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.swapUnitary_mul_conjTranspose])





















end ProjectiveSetting

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Polynomial outcomes in the pulling argument

The joint measurement of a polynomial marginal and an ideal Pauli register
returns the difference between the polynomial and the encoding of the register.
Decoding this difference gives exactly the pulled-apart measurement. Polynomial
collision estimates apply to these representatives without an encoding-support
restriction on the original marginal.

## References

- Blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, Item 2.
- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1530-1605`,
  `eq:qld-pulling-11`, `eq:qld-pulling-12`, and the following symmetry argument.
- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`; only decoder linearity and its
  left-inverse identity are used here.
- Issue Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-QPBT-bak#123 tracks the `eq:qld-pulling-cons` extraction obligation;
  these
  auxiliary results do not assert it. This module was originally filed
  under issue Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-QPBT-bak#520, now closed.
- The collision estimate compares unequal difference polynomials under uniform
  evaluation.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
open WinImplications

noncomputable section

open scoped Classical

/-- The outcome `g - g_h` in `eq:qld-pulling-12` is a bounded polynomial
representative, even when `g` is not in the encoding image. -/
def pullingPoly {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} (outcome : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Poly P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Poly P :=
  outcome.1 - _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.encodingPoly outcome.2





/-- The projective measurement with polynomial outcomes `g - g_h` used to
organize the last step of the pulling argument. Its input witness remains
supplied; no global witness is constructed by this definition. -/
def pullingMeas {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ}
    {S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.GlobalPairWitness S deltaG)
    (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Poly P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tensorMeasurement (w.marginalPoly side W) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRegisterMeas W)).postprocess _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pullingPoly













end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Extraction by the swap unitaries

The concrete swap operators below yield the Pauli extraction conclusion. The
local maps are constructed from the global polynomial
measurements, and all operators retain the heterogeneous Alice and Bob
placements. The generalized Pauli projectors use the field and basis fixed by
`P.model`.

## References

The extraction witness records the conclusion of blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`,
from
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1860`.
The error-form comparison formalizes `lem:qld-extraction-error-form` and
supports `rem:pauli-robustness-form` in the blueprint; its paper source is
lines 1855-1858 and 1868-1876.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-- The concrete conclusion of `lem:qld-unitary`: the two swap maps extract an
EPR state and conjugate each player's total Pauli measurement to the canonical
Pauli projectors. The answer sum in `pauli_close` is over
`PauliRegister P`; the uniform distribution on `Unit` records that there is no
average over questions.

Blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`; paper
`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685,1827-1859`. The swap maps
are `swapUnitary w .alice` and `swapUnitary w .bob`, defined from the
side-indexed global measurements, and use only the basis fixed by `P.model`.
-/
structure ExtractionWitness {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaS : ℝ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (w : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.GlobalPairWitness S deltaS)
    (delta : ℝ) where
  /-- Each swap map is a right unitary. -/
  swap_right_unitary : ∀ side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.swapUnitary w side * (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.swapUnitary w side)ᴴ = 1
  /-- Each swap map is a left unitary. -/
  swap_left_unitary : ∀ side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide,
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.swapUnitary w side)ᴴ * _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.swapUnitary w side = 1
  /-- The auxiliary state on registers `AA'BB'`. -/
  aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
  /-- The auxiliary state is normalized. -/
  aux_norm : ‖aux‖ = 1
  /-- Applying both concrete swap maps to the expanded state extracts the ideal
  auxiliary-state/EPR tensor product. -/
  state_close :
    ‖S.applyBoth (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.swapUnitary w .alice) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat -
        S.idealExpState aux‖ ^ 2 ≤ delta
  /-- On the ideal extracted state, conjugated total-Pauli effects are close to
  the canonical projectors, for both players and both Pauli bases. -/
  pauli_close : ∀ (side : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PlayerSide) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind),
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.opFamilyDistSq (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution Unit)
      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) =>
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.conjBy (S.placeSide side (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.swapUnitary w side))
          (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) =>
        S.placeExtractedRegister side (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W h))
      (S.idealExpState aux) ≤ delta













end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Low-degree winning implications

This module proves the exact line-point and Pauli-basis consistency bounds.

## References

The line-point and Pauli-basis consistency theorems prove items 2 and 3
of `lem:qld-win-implications`
from `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:192-267`
and blueprint `lem:qld-win-implications` and `lem:qld-win-implications-obs`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

namespace WinImplications

local instance (priority := 10) instDecidableRel_qPBT {α β : Type*} (r : α → β → Prop) :
    DecidableRel r :=
  fun a b => Classical.propDecidable (r a b)

local instance linePointFintypeCanonical (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    Fintype (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams ×
      (Fin P.toLdParams.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ P.toLdParams)) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.linePointFintype P

/-- Coordinates outside one low-degree register in the Pauli seed. -/
abbrev PauliLdRemainder (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :=
  (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P

/-- Split a Pauli seed into a basis-selected low-degree seed and unused coordinates. -/
 def pauliLdSplit (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P ≃ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace P.toLdParams × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.WinImplications.PauliLdRemainder P where
  toFun z :=
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliToLd P W z,
      (match W with | .X => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliZBlock z | .Z => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliXBlock z,
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z))
  invFun zr := fun i =>
    match i with
    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inl (.inl j)))) =>
        match W with
        | .X => zr.1 (.inl (.inl j))
        | .Z => zr.2.1 j
    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inl (.inr j)))) =>
        match W with
        | .X => zr.2.1 j
        | .Z => zr.1 (.inl (.inl j))
    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inr _))) => zr.1 (.inl (.inr ()))
    | .inl (.inl (.inr j)) => zr.1 (.inr j)
    | .inl (.inr _) => zr.2.2.1
    | .inr _ => zr.2.2.2
  left_inv z := by
    funext i
    rcases i with ((((j | j) | u) | j) | u) | u <;> cases W <;> rfl
  right_inv zr := by
    rcases zr with ⟨z, other, rX, rZ⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i
      rcases i with (j | u) | j <;> cases W <;> rfl
    · cases W <;> rfl

/-- Coordinates discarded by the shared Pair and Magic Square projection. -/
abbrev PauliSharedRemainder (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P × (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)

/-- Split a Pauli seed into its shared tuple and discarded scalar/direction blocks. -/
def pauliSharedSplit (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P ≃ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.WinImplications.PauliSharedRemainder P where
  toFun z :=
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliXBlock z, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliZBlock z, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z),
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliScalarBlock z, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliDirectionBlock z)
  invFun zr := fun i =>
    match i with
    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inl (.inl j)))) => zr.1.1 j
    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inl (.inr j)))) => zr.1.2.1 j
    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inr _))) => zr.2.1
    | .inl (.inl (.inr j)) => zr.2.2 j
    | .inl (.inr _) => zr.1.2.2.1
    | .inr _ => zr.1.2.2.2
  left_inv z := by
    funext i
    rcases i with ((((j | j) | u) | j) | u) | u <;> rfl
  right_inv zr := by
    rcases zr with ⟨⟨uX, uZ, rX, rZ⟩, scalar, direction⟩
    rfl

/-- Split a low-degree seed into its point and unused scalar/direction blocks. -/
 def ldPointSplit (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdSpace L ≃ (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L) × (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L × (Fin L.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)) where
  toFun z := (z.point, z.seed, z.direction)
  invFun zr := fun i =>
    match i with
    | .inl (.inl j) => zr.1 j
    | .inl (.inr _) => zr.2.1
    | .inr j => zr.2.2 j
  left_inv z := by
    funext i
    rcases i with (j | u) | j <;> rfl
  right_inv zr := by
    rcases zr with ⟨point, seed, direction⟩
    rfl









































/-- The axis-line/point verifier edge in one Pauli basis. -/
def alinePointEdge (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge :=
  ⟨(.aline W, .point W), by simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges]⟩

/-- The diagonal-line/point verifier edge in one Pauli basis. -/
def dlinePointEdge (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge :=
  ⟨(.dline W, .point W), by simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges]⟩

/-- The point/Pauli verifier edge in one Pauli basis. -/
def pointPauliEdge (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge :=
  ⟨(.point W, .pauli W), by simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges]⟩

/-- The Pair-W/Pair verifier edge in one Pauli basis. -/
def pairWPairEdge (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge :=
  ⟨(.pairW W, .pair), by simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges]⟩

/-- The point/Pair-W verifier edge in one Pauli basis. -/
def pointPairWEdge (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge :=
  ⟨(.point W, .pairW W), by simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges]⟩





/-- Source-answer mismatch mass for the completed line and point readouts. -/
noncomputable def lowDegreeMismatchMass {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (sample : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc P.toLdParams × (Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) : ℝ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.outcomeEventWeight S.toStrategy
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.lineQuestion P W sample.1)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.pointQuestion P W sample.2)
    (fun A B =>
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.evalOpt sample.1 sample.2
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.lineAnswerOrZero P sample.1 A) ≠
        some (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting.pointAnswerOrZero B))
























end WinImplications

end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Magic Square winning implications

This module proves the exact induced Magic Square value and variable
consistency bounds on anticommuting Pauli tuples.

## References

The Magic Square value and consistency theorems prove items 6 and 7
of `lem:qld-win-implications`
from `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:192-267`
and blueprint `lem:qld-win-implications` and `lem:qld-win-implications-obs`.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

namespace WinImplications

/-- Select the Magic Square variable used by one Pauli basis. -/
def selectedMsVar : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind → Fin 9
  | .X => 0
  | .Z => 4

/-- The verifier edge comparing a point trace with its Magic Square variable. -/
def pointMsImplicationEdge : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge
  | .X => ⟨(.point .X, .ms (.var 0)), by simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges]⟩
  | .Z => ⟨(.point .Z, .ms (.var 4)), by simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges]⟩













/-- Lift a supported Magic Square incidence to the corresponding Pauli verifier edge. -/
def msImplicationEdge (xy : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType)
    (hxy : xy ∈ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.graphDistribution _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msEdges _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msEdges_nonempty).support) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge :=
  ⟨((.ms xy.1), (.ms xy.2)), by
    have hedge : Sym2.mk xy.1 xy.2 ∈ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msEdges :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hxy).2
    simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges, Finset.union_assoc, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue,
      Fin.reduceFinMk, Finset.union_insert, Finset.union_singleton,
      Finset.insert_union, Finset.mem_insert, Sym2.eq, Sym2.rel_iff',
      Prod.mk.injEq, reduceCtorEq, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType.ms.injEq, false_and,
      Prod.swap_prod_mk, and_false, or_self, Finset.mem_union,
      Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, and_self, exists_const,
      Finset.mem_filter, Prod.exists, false_or]
    exact Or.inr ⟨xy.1, xy.2, hedge, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩⟩





/-- Rejection mass of the induced Magic Square strategy at one tuple and question pair. -/
noncomputable def inducedMsRejection {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ}
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ProjectiveSetting P ε) (ω : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliTuple P) (xy : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType) : ℝ :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.outcomeEventWeight (S.msStrategyAt ω) xy.1 xy.2
    (fun a b => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msWinPredicate xy.1 xy.2 a b = false)








end WinImplications

end

/-!
# Exact bridge for the compact Pauli basis game

This module identifies the compact product-space presentation with the
registered Pauli basis test.  The bridge preserves the fixed field model, all
ordered edges, the full ambient seed, every answer constructor, the question
PMF, and every branch of the Boolean verifier.

## References

`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1491`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar

noncomputable section

/-- Copy the registered Pauli parameters into the compact numerical domain. -/
@[reducible] def PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams
    (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams where
  q := P.q
  m := P.m
  d := P.d
  hm := P.one_le_m
  hd := P.hd
  hq := P.hq
  hdvd := P.hdvd

/-- The compact and registered Pauli-basis labels are equivalent. -/
def pauliKindEquiv : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliKind ≃ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind where
  toFun
    | .X => .X
    | .Z => .Z
  invFun
    | .X => .X
    | .Z => .Z
  left_inv W := by cases W <;> rfl
  right_inv W := by cases W <;> rfl

/-- The compact 26-element type carrier is the registered Pauli type carrier. -/
def pauliTypeEquiv : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliType ≃ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType where
  toFun
    | .point W => .point (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv W)
    | .aline W => .aline (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv W)
    | .dline W => .dline (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv W)
    | .pauli W => .pauli (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv W)
    | .pairW W => .pairW (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv W)
    | .pair => .pair
    | .constraint i => .ms (.constraint i)
    | .variable j => .ms (.var j)
  invFun
    | .point W => .point (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv.symm W)
    | .aline W => .aline (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv.symm W)
    | .dline W => .dline (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv.symm W)
    | .pauli W => .pauli (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv.symm W)
    | .pairW W => .pairW (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv.symm W)
    | .pair => .pair
    | .ms (.constraint i) => .constraint i
    | .ms (.var j) => .variable j
  left_inv
    | .point W => by cases W <;> rfl
    | .aline W => by cases W <;> rfl
    | .dline W => by cases W <;> rfl
    | .pauli W => by cases W <;> rfl
    | .pairW W => by cases W <;> rfl
    | .pair => rfl
    | .constraint _ => rfl
    | .variable _ => rfl
  right_inv
    | .point W => by cases W <;> rfl
    | .aline W => by cases W <;> rfl
    | .dline W => by cases W <;> rfl
    | .pauli W => by cases W <;> rfl
    | .pairW W => by cases W <;> rfl
    | .pair => rfl
    | .ms t => by cases t <;> rfl

/-- Product coordinates identify the full compact and registered ambient spaces. -/
def pauliSpaceEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliSpace (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) ≃
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P where
  toFun z
    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inl (.inl i)))) => z.1 i
    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inl (.inr i)))) => z.2.1 i
    | .inl (.inl (.inl (.inr _))) => z.2.2.1
    | .inl (.inl (.inr i)) => z.2.2.2.1 i
    | .inl (.inr _) => z.2.2.2.2.1
    | .inr _ => z.2.2.2.2.2
  invFun z :=
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliXBlock z, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliZBlock z,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliScalarBlock z, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliDirectionBlock z,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z)
  left_inv z := by
    rcases z with ⟨uX, uZ, s, v, rX, rZ⟩
    rfl
  right_inv z := by
    funext i
    rcases i with ((((i | i) | u) | i) | u) | u <;> rfl

/-- Typed compact questions are equivalent to registered Pauli questions. -/
def pauliQuestionEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) ≃
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P :=
  Equiv.prodCongr _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliSpaceEquiv P)

/-- All seven compact answer constructors map to their registered counterparts. -/
def pauliAnswerEquivCompact (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliAnswer (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) ≃
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P where
  toFun
    | .value a => .value a
    | .alinePoly a => .alinePoly a
    | .dlinePoly a => .dlinePoly a
    | .pairBits a => .pairBits a
    | .bit a => .bit a
    | .msTriple a => .msTriple a
    | .pauliOutcome a => .pauliOutcome a
  invFun
    | .value a => .value a
    | .alinePoly a => .alinePoly a
    | .dlinePoly a => .dlinePoly a
    | .pairBits a => .pairBits a
    | .bit a => .bit a
    | .msTriple a => .msTriple a
    | .pauliOutcome a => .pauliOutcome a
  left_inv a := by cases a <;> rfl
  right_inv a := by cases a <;> rfl

/-- The compact and registered Magic Square incidence maps coincide. -/
@[simp] theorem magicVariable_eq_msConstraintVars (i : Fin 6) (j : Fin 3) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.magicVariable i j = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i j :=
  rfl

/-- The registered filtered Magic Square carrier is its direct 18-edge image. -/
theorem registeredMagicEdges_eq :
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType)).filter
          (fun xy => Sym2.mk xy.1 xy.2 ∈ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msEdges) |>.image
        (fun xy => Sym2.mk (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType.ms xy.1)
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType.ms xy.2))) =
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 6 × Fin 3)).image (fun ij =>
        Sym2.mk
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType.ms (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType.constraint ij.1))
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType.ms
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType.var
              (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars ij.1 ij.2)))) := by
  ext e
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msEdges, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Prod.exists, Sym2.eq_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, hab, he⟩
    rcases hab with ⟨a', b', hab⟩
    rcases hab with h | h
    · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨a', b', he⟩
    · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨a', b', Sym2.eq_swap.trans he⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b, he⟩
    exact ⟨_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType.constraint a,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType.var (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars a b),
      ⟨a, b, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩, he⟩

/-- The registered graph written with the direct Magic Square edge image. -/
def registeredPauliEdgesDirect : Finset (Sym2 _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType) :=
  let loops := Finset.univ.image fun t : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType => Sym2.mk t t
  let lines := (Finset.univ : Finset _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind).image (fun W =>
      Sym2.mk (.point W) (.aline W)) ∪
    (Finset.univ : Finset _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind).image (fun W =>
      Sym2.mk (.point W) (.dline W)) ∪
    (Finset.univ : Finset _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind).image (fun W =>
      Sym2.mk (.point W) (.pauli W))
  let basis := (Finset.univ : Finset _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind).image (fun W =>
      Sym2.mk (.point W) (.pairW W)) ∪
    ({Sym2.mk (.point .X) (.ms (.var 0)),
      Sym2.mk (.point .Z) (.ms (.var 4))} : Finset (Sym2 _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType))
  let pairs := (Finset.univ : Finset _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind).image fun W =>
    Sym2.mk (.pairW W) .pair
  let magic := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 6 × Fin 3)).image fun ij =>
    Sym2.mk (.ms (.constraint ij.1))
      (.ms (.var (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars ij.1 ij.2)))
  loops ∪ lines ∪ basis ∪ pairs ∪ magic

/-- The direct-component presentation is exactly the registered graph. -/
theorem registeredPauliEdgesDirect_eq :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.registeredPauliEdgesDirect := by
  unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.registeredPauliEdgesDirect
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.registeredMagicEdges_eq]
  simp

/-- Every compact edge maps to a registered edge. -/
theorem pauliEdges_map_mem {s : Sym2 _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliType} (h : s ∈ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges) :
    Sym2.map _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv s ∈ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges := by
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.registeredPauliEdgesDirect_eq]
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ,
    true_and, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h
  rcases h with ((((hloop | hlines) | hbasis) | hpairs) | hmagic)
  · rcases hloop with ⟨t, rfl⟩
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.registeredPauliEdgesDirect, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]
  · rcases hlines with (h | h) | h
    · rcases h with ⟨W, rfl⟩
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.registeredPauliEdgesDirect, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]
    · rcases h with ⟨W, rfl⟩
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.registeredPauliEdgesDirect, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]
    · rcases h with ⟨W, rfl⟩
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.registeredPauliEdgesDirect, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]
  · rcases hbasis with h | h | h
    · rcases h with ⟨W, rfl⟩
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.registeredPauliEdgesDirect, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]
    · rcases h with rfl
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.registeredPauliEdgesDirect, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]
    · rcases h with rfl
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.registeredPauliEdgesDirect, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]
  · rcases hpairs with ⟨W, rfl⟩
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.registeredPauliEdgesDirect, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]
  · rcases hmagic with ⟨i, j, rfl⟩
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.registeredPauliEdgesDirect, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]

/-- Every registered edge maps back to a compact edge. -/
theorem registeredPauliEdges_map_mem {s : Sym2 _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType}
    (h : s ∈ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges) :
    Sym2.map _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv.symm s ∈ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges := by
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.registeredPauliEdgesDirect_eq] at h
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.registeredPauliEdgesDirect, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h
  rcases h with ((((hloop | hlines) | hbasis) | hpairs) | hmagic)
  · rcases hloop with ⟨t, rfl⟩
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]
  · rcases hlines with (h | h) | h
    · rcases h with ⟨W, rfl⟩
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]
    · rcases h with ⟨W, rfl⟩
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]
    · rcases h with ⟨W, rfl⟩
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]
  · rcases hbasis with h | h | h
    · rcases h with ⟨W, rfl⟩
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]
    · rcases h with rfl
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]
    · rcases h with rfl
      simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]
  · rcases hpairs with ⟨W, rfl⟩
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]
  · rcases hmagic with ⟨i, j, rfl⟩
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliKindEquiv]

/-- The compact type map preserves the complete undirected edge set. -/
theorem pauliEdges_mem_equiv (e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliType) :
    Sym2.mk e.1 e.2 ∈ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges ↔
      Sym2.mk (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv e.1) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv e.2) ∈
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa using _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges_map_mem h
  · intro h
    have h' := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.registeredPauliEdges_map_mem h
    simpa using h'

/-- The compact and registered ordered-edge carriers are equivalent. -/
def pauliEdgeEquiv : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliEdge ≃ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge :=
  (Equiv.prodCongr _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliTypeEquiv).subtypeEquiv _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdges_mem_equiv

/-- The complete common-source spaces are equivalent coordinate by coordinate. -/
def pauliSourceEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliEdge ×
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliSpace (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) ≃
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) :=
  Equiv.prodCongr _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliEdgeEquiv (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliSpaceEquiv P)

/-- Equivalence of the two ordered question-pair carriers. -/
def pauliQuestionPairEquiv (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) ×
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) ≃
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P) :=
  Equiv.prodCongr (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P)

/-- The compact Pauli parameters select exactly the registered low-degree tuple. -/
theorem pauliLowDegreeParams_eq (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P).toLowDegreeParams =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.LowDegreeParams.ofLdParams P.toLdParams := by
  rfl

/-- The published low-degree map bridge specialized to the Pauli parameters. -/

    ((s.1.1.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliMap (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model) s.1.1.1 s.2),

        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model) s.1.1.2 s.2))
  let originalMap := fun s :
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P =>
    ((s.1.1.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliCL P s.1.1.1 s.2),
      (s.1.1.2, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliCL P s.1.1.2 s.2))
  have hcomm : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionPairEquiv P ∘ compactMap =
      originalMap ∘ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliSourceEquiv P := by
    funext s

    · apply Prod.ext
      · rfl
      · exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliMap_equiv P s.1.1.1 s.2
    · apply Prod.ext
      · rfl
      · exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliMap_equiv P s.1.1.2 s.2
  rw [show _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionPMF (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P)
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model) =

  rw [_root_.LIDT.PMF.uniformOfFintype_map_equiv (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliSourceEquiv P)]

  rw [_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution_toPMF] at hmap
  simpa only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisTest,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliQuestionDistribution] using hmap
