/-!
# The honest Pauli basis measurements of the completeness proof

This module builds the measurements used by the honest strategy of
`lem:pauli-completeness`: the generalized Pauli basis measurement in a fixed
basis `W`, and its coarse-graining by the binary trace
`h ↦ tr(g_h(u_W) r_W)` which the source calls `A` (for `W = X`) and `B`
(for `W = Z`).  The main results are the observable identity

  `A_0 - A_1 = τ^W(ind_m(u_W) r_W)`

of `eq:finally-got-an-observable`, and the resulting commutation law

  `𝒪_A 𝒪_B = (-1)^γ 𝒪_B 𝒪_A`

with `γ` the phase bit `eq:gamma-value`.  When `γ ≠ 0` the two observables
anticommute, so `thm:ms-from-ac` produces the Magic Square part of the honest
strategy.

## References

The construction is the strategy displayed in the proof of
`lem:pauli-completeness`,
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1237-1360`;
blueprint `lem:pauli-completeness`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

variable {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod 2) K]
  [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

/-! ### The generalized Pauli basis measurement -/

/-- Every generalized Pauli projector is a nonnegative operator.  The
positive semidefiniteness it repackages is `posSemidef_pauliProj`, blueprint
`def:generalized-pauli`, paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1101-1122`. -/
theorem pauliProj_nonneg (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (e : ι → K) : 0 ≤ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e :=
  Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.posSemidef_pauliProj W e)

/-- Every generalized Pauli projector is Hermitian. -/
theorem pauliProj_conjTranspose (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (e : ι → K) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e)ᴴ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.posSemidef_pauliProj W e).isHermitian.eq

/-- The generalized Pauli basis measurement in basis `W`: the projective
measurement whose outcomes are the labels of blueprint `def:generalized-pauli`, paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:1101-1122`. -/
noncomputable def pauliBasisMeasurement (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ι → K) (ι → K) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj_nonneg W) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sum_pauliProj_eq_one W)

/-- The effect of the generalized Pauli basis measurement at outcome `e` is the
projector `τ^W_e` onto the corresponding generalized Pauli eigenspace. -/
@[simp] theorem pauliBasisMeasurement_effect (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (e : ι → K) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisMeasurement W).effect e = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e := rfl

/-! ### Symmetry and Hermiticity of the generalized Pauli observables -/

omit [Fintype K] in
/-- Generalized Pauli observables are symmetric matrices in the computational
basis.  Symmetry is what makes the honest measurements consistent on the EPR
state used by `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1237-1360`. -/
theorem tauObservable_transpose (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (a : ι → K) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W a)ᵀ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W a := by
  haveI : CharP K 2 := (Algebra.charP_iff (ZMod 2) K 2).mp (ZMod.charP 2)
  have hswap : ∀ x y c : K, (x = y + c) ↔ (y = x + c) := by
    intro x y c
    constructor
    · rintro rfl
      rw [add_assoc, CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero, add_zero]
    · rintro rfl
      rw [add_assoc, CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero, add_zero]
  ext x y
  rw [Matrix.transpose_apply]
  cases W with
  | X =>
      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      change (if y i = x i + a i then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = if x i = y i + a i then 1 else 0
      by_cases h : x i = y i + a i
      · rw [if_pos h, if_pos ((hswap _ _ _).mp h)]
      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hc => h ((hswap _ _ _).mp hc))]
  | Z =>
      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      change (if y i = x i then _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binTrace K (a i * x i)) else 0) =
        if x i = y i then _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binTrace K (a i * y i)) else 0
      by_cases h : x i = y i
      · rw [h]
      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hc => h hc.symm)]

/-! ### Orthogonality of the generalized Pauli projectors

The generalized Pauli projectors in a fixed basis are pairwise orthogonal, so
every coarse-graining of a Pauli basis measurement is again projective.  This is
the projectivity used throughout the honest strategy of `lem:pauli-completeness`,
paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1364-1370`.
-/


/-- Every generalized Pauli projector is a projector. -/
theorem pauliProj_isProj (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (e : ι → K) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.IsProj (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e) := by
  refine isStarProjection_iff'.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj_mul_pauliProj W e e
  · rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj_conjTranspose]

/-- Every coarse-graining of a generalized Pauli basis measurement is
projective.  This is the projectivity of the honest Point, Line and Pauli
measurements in the proof of `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1364-1370`. -/
theorem pauliBasisMeasurement_postprocess_projective {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    [DecidableEq β] (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (g : (ι → K) → β) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisMeasurement W).postprocess g) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisMeasurement W)
    (fun e => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj_isProj W e) g



/-! ### The honest Pair/W measurements

For an ambient question `ω = (u_X, u_Z, r_X, r_Z)` the honest player measures
the Pauli register in basis `W` and reports the binary trace
`tr(g_h(u_W) r_W)` of the resulting label.  These are the measurements `A` and
`B` of the proof of `lem:pauli-completeness`,
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1277-1286`.
-/

/-- The binary trace bit `tr(g_h(u) r)` reported by the honest Pair/W
measurement on the Pauli label `h`.  Paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1277-1286`. -/
noncomputable def pauliTraceBit (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (r : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (h : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) : ZMod 2 :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lowDegreeEnc h u * r)

/-- The honest Pair/W measurement `τ^W_{[tr(g_·(u) r) = β]}` of the proof of
`lem:pauli-completeness`: the generalized Pauli basis measurement coarse-grained
by the trace bit.  Paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1277-1286`,
blueprint `lem:pauli-completeness`. -/
noncomputable def pauliTraceMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (r : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisMeasurement W).postprocess (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceBit P u r)

/-- The effect of the honest Pair/`W` measurement at the bit `β` is the sum of
the generalized Pauli projectors over the labels whose trace bit equals `β`,
which is the coarse-grained projector `τ^W_{[tr(g_·(u) r) = β]}` of the paper. -/
theorem pauliTraceMeasurement_effect (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (r : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (b : ZMod 2) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P W u r).effect b =
      ∑ h ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun h : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceBit P u r h = b),
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W h := rfl

/-- Equation `eq:finally-got-an-observable`: the observable of the honest
Pair/W measurement is the generalized Pauli observable at the label
`ind_m(u) r`.  Paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1300-1315`. -/
theorem obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (r : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P W u r) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W (r • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u) := by
  classical
  have hdot : ∀ e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P,
      dotProduct (r • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u) e = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lowDegreeEnc e u * r := by
    intro e
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lowDegreeEnc_eq_dotProduct]
    simp only [dotProduct, Finset.sum_mul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => by ring
  have hp : ∀ e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binTrace (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (dotProduct (r • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u) e)) =
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceBit P u r e) := by
    intro e
    rw [hdot e]
    rfl
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable_eq_sum_pauliProj,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e (_ : e ∈ Finset.univ) => by rw [hp e]),
    ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P))
      (fun e => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceBit P u r e = 0)]
  have hfilter :
      (Finset.univ.filter fun e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P => ¬ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceBit P u r e = 0) =
        Finset.univ.filter fun e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceBit P u r e = 1 := by
    ext e
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    rcases _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceBit P u r e) with h | h <;> simp [h]
  have h0 : ∑ e ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceBit P u r e = 0),
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceBit P u r e) • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P W u r).effect 0 := by
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_effect]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e he => ?_
    rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2]
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign]
  have h1 : ∑ e ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P => ¬ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceBit P u r e = 0),
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceBit P u r e) • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e =
      -(_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P W u r).effect 1 := by
    rw [hfilter, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_effect]
    calc ∑ e ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceBit P u r e = 1),
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceBit P u r e) • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e
        = ∑ e ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceBit P u r e = 1),
            (-1 : ℂ) • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e he => by
            rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2]
            norm_num [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign]
      _ = (-1 : ℂ) • ∑ e ∈ Finset.univ.filter
            (fun e : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceBit P u r e = 1), _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj W e :=
          Finset.smul_sum.symm
      _ = _ := neg_one_smul ℂ _
  rw [h0, h1, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
  rfl

/-- Each effect of the honest Pair/W measurement is the spectral projector of
its observable, so the measurement is projective; part of the projectivity
assertion of the honest strategy in the proof of `lem:pauli-completeness`,
paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1364-1370`. -/
theorem pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_eq_reflectionEffect (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (r : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (b : ZMod 2) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P W u r).effect b =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W (r • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u)) b := by
  rw [← _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect_obsOf_measurement]

/-- The honest Pair/W measurement is projective, as asserted for the honest
strategy in the proof of `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1364-1370`. -/
theorem pauliTraceMeasurement_projective (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (r : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P W u r) := by
  intro b
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_eq_reflectionEffect]
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionMeasurement_projective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable W (r • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec u))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable_conjTranspose W _) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable_sq W _) b

/-- The effects of the honest Pair/W measurement are symmetric matrices. -/
theorem pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_transpose (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (r : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (b : ZMod 2) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P W u r).effect b)ᵀ =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P W u r).effect b := by
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_eq_reflectionEffect]
  rcases _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one b with rfl | rfl
  · simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect, if_pos]
    rw [Matrix.transpose_smul, Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_one,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable_transpose]
  · simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect, if_neg one_ne_zero]
    rw [Matrix.transpose_smul, Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_one,
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable_transpose]



/-! ### The honest Point/W measurements -/

/-- The honest Point/W measurement: the generalized Pauli basis measurement
coarse-grained by the value `g_h(u)` of the low-degree encoding at the point
`u`.  Paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1248-1261`. -/
noncomputable def pauliPointMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisMeasurement W).postprocess (fun h => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lowDegreeEnc h u)

/-- The honest Point/W measurement is projective. -/
theorem pauliPointMeasurement_projective (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPointMeasurement P W u) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisMeasurement_postprocess_projective W _



/-! ### Honest line measurements -/

/-- Restrict a multivariate polynomial to an axis-parallel line, retaining the
coefficients through degree `d`.  This is the degree-`d` answer used for the
axis-line clause of `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1263-1273`. -/
noncomputable def restrictToAxisLine (L : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LdParams) (line : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.LineDesc L)
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin L.m) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ScalarQ L)) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DegPoly L L.d :=
  fun i => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.polynomialOnLine L line g).coeff i.val



/-- The honest axis-line measurement is the generalized Pauli basis
measurement coarse-grained by the degree-`d` restriction of `g_h` to the
canonical line carried by the question. -/
noncomputable def pauliALineMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (Fin (P.d + 1) → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) :=
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisMeasurement W).postprocess fun h =>
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.restrictToAxisLine P.toLdParams
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.aLineDescOf P.toLdParams
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldALineCL P.toLdParams (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliToLd P W z))) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lowDegreeEncoding h)

/-- The honest axis-line measurement is projective. -/
theorem pauliALineMeasurement_projective (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliALineMeasurement P W z) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisMeasurement_postprocess_projective W _



/-- The honest diagonal-line measurement is the generalized Pauli basis
measurement coarse-grained by the degree-`m d` restriction of `g_h` to the
canonical line carried by the question. -/
noncomputable def pauliDLineMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) :=
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisMeasurement W).postprocess fun h =>
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.restrictToLine P.toLdParams
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.dLineDescOf P.toLdParams
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.ldDLineCL P.toLdParams (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliToLd P W z))) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.lowDegreeEncoding h)

/-- The honest diagonal-line measurement is projective. -/
theorem pauliDLineMeasurement_projective (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliDLineMeasurement P W z) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisMeasurement_postprocess_projective W _





/-! ### The commutation law of the honest pair -/

/-- The commutation law `𝒪_A 𝒪_B = (-1)^γ 𝒪_B 𝒪_A` of the proof of
`lem:pauli-completeness`, with `γ` the phase bit `eq:gamma-value`.  Paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1316-1330`. -/
theorem obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_mul_comm (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliXBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z)) *
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliZBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z)) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z) •
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliZBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z)) *
          _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliXBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z))) := by
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable_X_mul_Z]
  rfl

/-- If the phase bit `γ` of `eq:gamma-value` is nonzero, the two honest Pair/W
observables anticommute.  Paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1316-1330`. -/
theorem obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_anticommute (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) (hgamma : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliXBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z)) *
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliZBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z)) =
      -(_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliZBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z)) *
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliXBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z))) := by
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_mul_comm]
  rcases _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z) with h | h
  · exact absurd h hgamma
  · rw [h]
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign]



/-! ### The pointwise Magic Square measurement -/

/-- The nine cell measurements obtained from the anticommuting Pair/X and
Pair/Z observables at a question with nonzero phase bit. -/
noncomputable def pauliMagicCellMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) (hgamma : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0) :
    Fin 9 → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × ZMod 2) :=
  let A := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliXBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z)
  let B := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliZBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z)
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellMeasurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf A) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf B)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_conjTranspose A (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .X _ _))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_conjTranspose B (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .Z _ _))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_sq A (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .X _ _))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_sq B (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .Z _ _))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_anticommute P z hgamma)

/-- Every Pauli-induced Magic Square cell measurement is projective. -/
theorem pauliMagicCellMeasurement_projective (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) (hgamma : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0) (j : Fin 9) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicCellMeasurement P z hgamma j) := by
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicCellMeasurement]
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellMeasurement_projective _ _
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_conjTranspose _ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .X _ _))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_conjTranspose _ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .Z _ _))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_sq _ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .X _ _))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_sq _ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .Z _ _))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_anticommute P z hgamma) j

/-- Cell effects belonging to one Magic Square constraint commute. -/
theorem pauliMagicCellMeasurement_commute (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) (hgamma : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin 6) (k l : Fin 3) (a b : ZMod 2) :
    Commute
      ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicCellMeasurement P z hgamma (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i k)).effect a)
      ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicCellMeasurement P z hgamma (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintVars i l)).effect b) := by
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicCellMeasurement]
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect_commute
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msConstraintObservable_commute _ _
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_sq _ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .X _ _))
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_sq _ (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .Z _ _))
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_anticommute P z hgamma) i k l) a b

/-- The Magic Square measurement family used at a Pauli question with nonzero
phase bit. -/
noncomputable def pauliMagicMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) (hgamma : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType → _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsAnswer (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × ZMod 2) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msStrategyMeasurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicCellMeasurement P z hgamma)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicCellMeasurement_projective P z hgamma)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicCellMeasurement_commute P z hgamma)

/-- The Pauli-induced Magic Square measurement is projective. -/
theorem pauliMagicMeasurement_projective (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) (hgamma : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0) (x : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicMeasurement P z hgamma x) := by
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msStrategyMeasurement_projective _ _ _ x

/-- Every effect of the Pauli-induced Magic Square measurement is symmetric. -/
theorem pauliMagicMeasurement_effect_transpose (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) (hgamma : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z ≠ 0)
    (x : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType) (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsAnswer) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicMeasurement P z hgamma x).effect a)ᵀ =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicMeasurement P z hgamma x).effect a := by
  apply _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msStrategyMeasurement_effect_transpose
  intro j b
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicCellMeasurement]
  apply _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.msCellMeasurement_transpose
  · rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement]
    exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable_transpose _ _
  · rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement]
    exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable_transpose _ _





/-! ### The Pair measurement in the case `γ = 0`

If the phase bit vanishes, the two honest Pair/W measurements commute and their
product is the Pair measurement `E^{Pair,ω}_{β_X, β_Z} = A_{β_X} B_{β_Z}` of
Equation `eq:pair-definition` in the proof of `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1331-1344`.
-/

/-- If the phase bit `γ` of `eq:gamma-value` vanishes, the two honest Pair/W
observables commute.  Paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1316-1330`. -/
theorem obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_commute (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) (hgamma : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z = 0) :
    Commute (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliXBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z)))
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliZBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z))) := by
  rw [commute_iff_eq, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_mul_comm, hgamma]
  simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.phaseSign]

/-- If the phase bit `γ` vanishes, the effects of the two honest Pair/W
measurements commute; this is the commutation assertion of the honest strategy
in the case `γ = 0`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1374-1382`. -/
theorem pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_commute (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) (hgamma : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z = 0) (a b : ZMod 2) :
    Commute ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliXBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z)).effect a)
      ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliZBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z)).effect b) := by
  have hOO :
      Commute (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind.X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliXBlock z)))
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.tauObservable _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind.Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z • _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.indicatorVec (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliZBlock z))) := by
    rw [← _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliXBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z),
      ← _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliZBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z)]
    exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.obsOf_pauliTraceMeasurement_commute P z hgamma
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_eq_reflectionEffect,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_eq_reflectionEffect]
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reflectionEffect_commute hOO a b

/-- The Pair effect `E^{Pair,ω}_{β_X, β_Z} = A_{β_X} B_{β_Z}` of Equation
`eq:pair-definition`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1331-1339`. -/
noncomputable def pauliPairEffect (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P)
    (β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliXBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z)).effect β.1 *
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliZBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z)).effect β.2

/-- For `γ = 0` the Pair effects are projectors, being products of commuting
projectors.  Paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1331-1344`. -/
theorem pauliPairEffect_isProj (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P)
    (hgamma : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z = 0) (β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.IsProj (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairEffect P z β) :=
  IsStarProjection.mul (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .X _ _ β.1)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P .Z _ _ β.2)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_commute P z hgamma β.1 β.2)

/-- The Pair effects sum to the identity. -/
theorem sum_pauliPairEffect (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) :
    ∑ β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairEffect P z β = 1 := by
  calc ∑ β : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairEffect P z β
      = ∑ a : ZMod 2, ∑ b : ZMod 2,
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliXBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z)).effect a *
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliZBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z)).effect b :=
        Fintype.sum_prod_type _
    _ = ∑ a : ZMod 2,
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliXBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z)).effect a *
            ∑ b : ZMod 2,
              (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliZBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z)).effect b :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = 1 := by
        rw [(_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .Z (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliZBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z)).sum_eq_one]
        simp [(_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P .X (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliXBlock z) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z)).sum_eq_one]

/-- The Pair measurement of Equation `eq:pair-definition` in the case `γ = 0`,
paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1331-1344`,
blueprint `lem:pauli-completeness`. -/
noncomputable def pauliPairMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P)
    (hgamma : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z = 0) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P) :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairEffect P z)
    (fun β => (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairEffect_isProj P z hgamma β).nonneg) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.sum_pauliPairEffect P z)

/-- The Pair measurement is projective. -/
theorem pauliPairMeasurement_projective (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P)
    (hgamma : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z = 0) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairMeasurement P z hgamma) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairEffect_isProj P z hgamma



end

/-!
# The honest Pauli measurement family

This module collects the measurements of
`MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.Completeness.HonestStrategy` into a single measurement
family indexed by the question type of the Pauli basis test.  Each honest
measurement acts on the tensor product of the Pauli register with the qubit
supplied to the Magic Square construction, and every outcome is relabelled into
the common answer alphabet of the test.  The results recorded here are the
projectivity and the symmetry of every effect of that family.

## References

The measurement family described here is the one displayed in the proof of
`lem:pauli-completeness`,
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1237-1360`;
blueprint `lem:pauli-completeness`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum

noncomputable section

/-! ### Tensor placement and relabeling -/

/-- The one-outcome measurement, used to make the harmless branches of the
honest strategy total on questions outside the sampler support. -/
noncomputable def unitMeasurement (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement Unit V :=
  _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne (fun _ => 1)
    (fun _ => Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg) (by simp)

/-- A deterministic measurement with prescribed outcome. -/
noncomputable def deterministicMeasurement {α V : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (a : α) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α V :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.unitMeasurement V).postprocess fun _ => a

/-- A deterministic measurement is projective. -/
theorem deterministicMeasurement_projective {α V : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (a : α) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.deterministicMeasurement (V := V) a) := by
  apply _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective
  intro u
  cases u
  exact IsStarProjection.one _

/-- Every effect of a deterministic measurement is symmetric. -/
theorem deterministicMeasurement_effect_transpose {α V : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (a b : α) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.deterministicMeasurement (V := V) a).effect b)ᵀ =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.deterministicMeasurement (V := V) a).effect b := by
  apply _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.postprocess_effect_transpose
  intro u
  cases u
  exact Matrix.transpose_one





/-- Tensor placement on the first factor preserves symmetry of effects. -/
theorem leftPlacedMeasurement_effect_transpose {α V W : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α V) (hM : ∀ a, (M.effect a)ᵀ = M.effect a) (a : α) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := W) M).effect a)ᵀ =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := W) M).effect a := by
  change (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (M.effect a) (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op W))ᵀ =
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron (M.effect a) (1 : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Op W)
  ext ⟨i, k⟩ ⟨j, l⟩
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
    Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
  rw [show M.effect a j i = M.effect a i j by
    exact congrFun (congrFun (hM a) i) j]
  by_cases hkl : k = l
  · subst l
    simp
  · simp [hkl, Ne.symm hkl]









/-- The local Hilbert-space index used by the honest Pauli strategy.  The
second factor is the qubit supplied to the Magic Square construction. -/
abbrev HonestIndex (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P × ZMod 2

/-- Place a Pauli-register measurement on the first factor of the honest local
space and relabel its outcomes with a global answer embedding. -/
noncomputable def placedPauliMeasurement {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams}
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P)) (f : α → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P) :=
  (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess f







/-! ### The total honest measurement family -/

/-- Embed a Magic Square answer into the global Pauli-test answer alphabet. -/
def pauliAnswerOfMs {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams} : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsAnswer → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P
  | .triple a => .msTriple a
  | .bit a => .bit a



/-- The honest point measurement at a typed Pauli question. -/
noncomputable def honestPointMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPointMeasurement P W (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPointBlock W z))
    (fun a => .value a)

/-- The honest axis-line measurement at a typed Pauli question. -/
noncomputable def honestALineMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliALineMeasurement P W z) (fun a => .alinePoly a)

/-- The honest diagonal-line measurement at a typed Pauli question. -/
noncomputable def honestDLineMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliDLineMeasurement P W z) (fun a => .dlinePoly a)

/-- The honest Pauli/W measurement at a typed Pauli question. -/
noncomputable def honestPauliMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisMeasurement W) (fun a => .pauliOutcome a)

/-- The honest Pair/W measurement at a typed Pauli question. The trace
measurement is retained when the phase is nonzero, whereas the proof of
`lem:pauli-completeness` chooses a trivial measurement in that inactive case.
The corresponding Pair checks then accept automatically. The present choice
remains projective, consistent, and commuting along the question graph, so it
gives the same existential completeness conclusion. -/
noncomputable def honestPairWMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P W
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPointBlock W z)
      (match W with | .X => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z | .Z => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z))
    (fun a => .bit a)

/-- The honest Pair measurement, with a deterministic harmless branch when the
two Pair/W observables anticommute. -/
noncomputable def honestPairMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P) := by
  classical
  by_cases hgamma : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z = 0
  · exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairMeasurement P z hgamma)
      (fun a => .pairBits a)
  · exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.deterministicMeasurement (V := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P) (.pairBits (0, 0))

/-- The honest Magic Square measurement at a typed Pauli question. -/
noncomputable def honestMagicMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (t : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.MsType)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P) := by
  classical
  by_cases hgamma : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z = 0
  · exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.deterministicMeasurement (V := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P)
      (match t with
      | .constraint _ => (.msTriple 0 : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P)
      | .var _ => (.bit 0 : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P))
  · exact (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicMeasurement P z hgamma t).postprocess _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliAnswerOfMs

/-- The total honest measurement family, defined on all 26 Pauli question
types and all ambient coefficient vectors. -/
noncomputable def honestMeasurement (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (t : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType) (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) :
    _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P) :=
  match t with
  | .point W => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPointMeasurement P W z
  | .aline W => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestALineMeasurement P W z
  | .dline W => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestDLineMeasurement P W z
  | .pauli W => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPauliMeasurement P W
  | .pairW W => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPairWMeasurement P W z
  | .pair => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPairMeasurement P z
  | .ms t => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMagicMeasurement P t z

/-- Injective answer relabelling preserves projectivity of a placed Pauli
measurement. -/
theorem placedPauliMeasurement_projective {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams}
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P))
    (hM : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M)
    (f : α → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement M f) := by
  intro a
  by_cases ha : a ∈ Set.range f
  · rcases ha with ⟨b, rfl⟩
    change _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.IsProj (((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess f).effect
      (f b))
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SandwichProduct.postprocess_effect_of_injective _ f hf b]
    exact _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.MakingMeasurementsProjective.isProj_kronecker
      (hM b) (IsStarProjection.one _)
  · change _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.IsProj
      (((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess f).effect a)
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.postprocess_effect_eq_zero_of_notMem _ _ ha]
    exact IsStarProjection.zero _

/-- Injective answer relabelling preserves symmetry of a placed Pauli
measurement. -/
theorem placedPauliMeasurement_effect_transpose {P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams}
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (M : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliRegister P))
    (hM : ∀ a, (M.effect a)ᵀ = M.effect a)
    (f : α → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement M f).effect a)ᵀ =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement M f).effect a := by
  rw [show _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement M f =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ZMod 2) M).postprocess f by rfl]
  apply _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.postprocess_effect_transpose
  intro b
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.leftPlacedMeasurement_effect_transpose M hM b

/-- The global honest measurement is projective at every question. -/
theorem honestMeasurement_projective (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (t : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement P t z) := by
  cases t with
  | point W =>
      simpa [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPointMeasurement] using
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement_projective
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPointMeasurement P W (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPointBlock W z))
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPointMeasurement_projective P W (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPointBlock W z))
          (fun a => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer.value a) (by intro; simp))
  | aline W =>
      simpa [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestALineMeasurement] using
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement_projective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliALineMeasurement P W z)
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliALineMeasurement_projective P W z)
          (fun a => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer.alinePoly a) (by intro; simp))
  | dline W =>
      simpa [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestDLineMeasurement] using
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement_projective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliDLineMeasurement P W z)
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliDLineMeasurement_projective P W z)
          (fun a => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer.dlinePoly a) (by intro; simp))
  | pauli W =>
      simpa [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPauliMeasurement] using
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement_projective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisMeasurement W)
          (fun a => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj_isProj W a)
          (fun a => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer.pauliOutcome a) (by intro; simp))
  | pairW W =>
      simpa [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPairWMeasurement] using
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement_projective
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement P W (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPointBlock W z)
            (match W with | .X => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRXBlock z | .Z => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliRZBlock z))
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_projective P W _ _)
          (fun a => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer.bit a) (by intro; simp))
  | pair =>
      classical
      by_cases hg : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z = 0
      · simpa [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPairMeasurement, hg] using
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement_projective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairMeasurement P z hg)
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairMeasurement_projective P z hg)
            (fun a => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer.pairBits a) (by intro; simp))
      · simpa [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPairMeasurement, hg] using
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.deterministicMeasurement_projective
            (V := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P) (α := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) (.pairBits (0, 0)))
  | ms t =>
      classical
      by_cases hg : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z = 0
      · simpa [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMagicMeasurement, hg] using
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.deterministicMeasurement_projective
            (V := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P) (α := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P)
            (match t with
            | .constraint _ => (.msTriple 0 : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P)
            | .var _ => (.bit 0 : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P)))
      · simpa [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMagicMeasurement, hg] using
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicMeasurement P z hg t)
            (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicMeasurement_projective P z hg t) _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliAnswerOfMs)

/-- The honest `Point/W` effects are symmetric matrices: each is a sum of
generalized Pauli projectors, and those are symmetric in the computational
basis.  Symmetry of the effects is what lets the maximally entangled state
transfer a player's measurement to its partner in the consistency step of
`lem:pauli-completeness`. -/
theorem pauliPointMeasurement_effect_transpose (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (u : Fin P.m → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPointMeasurement P W u).effect a)ᵀ =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPointMeasurement P W u).effect a := by
  apply _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.postprocess_effect_transpose
  intro h
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj_transpose W h

/-- The honest `ALine/W` effects are symmetric matrices, by the same
coarse-graining of symmetric generalized Pauli projectors as in the `Point`
case. -/
theorem pauliALineMeasurement_effect_transpose (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) (a : Fin (P.d + 1) → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliALineMeasurement P W z).effect a)ᵀ =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliALineMeasurement P W z).effect a := by
  apply _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.postprocess_effect_transpose
  intro h
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj_transpose W h

/-- The honest `DLine/W` effects are symmetric matrices, by the same
coarse-graining of symmetric generalized Pauli projectors as in the `Point`
case. -/
theorem pauliDLineMeasurement_effect_transpose (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (W : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliKind)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) (a : Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliDLineMeasurement P W z).effect a)ᵀ =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliDLineMeasurement P W z).effect a := by
  apply _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.postprocess_effect_transpose
  intro h
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj_transpose W h

/-- The global honest measurement has symmetric effects. -/
theorem honestMeasurement_effect_transpose (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) (t : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType)
    (z : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P) (a : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) :
    ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement P t z).effect a)ᵀ =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement P t z).effect a := by
  cases t with
  | point W =>
      change ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPointMeasurement P W z).effect a)ᵀ =
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPointMeasurement P W z).effect a
      exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement_effect_transpose _
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPointMeasurement_effect_transpose P W (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPointBlock W z)) _ _
  | aline W =>
      change ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestALineMeasurement P W z).effect a)ᵀ =
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestALineMeasurement P W z).effect a
      exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement_effect_transpose _
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliALineMeasurement_effect_transpose P W z) _ _
  | dline W =>
      change ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestDLineMeasurement P W z).effect a)ᵀ =
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestDLineMeasurement P W z).effect a
      exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement_effect_transpose _
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliDLineMeasurement_effect_transpose P W z) _ _
  | pauli W =>
      change ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPauliMeasurement P W).effect a)ᵀ =
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPauliMeasurement P W).effect a
      exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement_effect_transpose (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisMeasurement W)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliProj_transpose W) _ _
  | pairW W =>
      change ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPairWMeasurement P W z).effect a)ᵀ =
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPairWMeasurement P W z).effect a
      exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement_effect_transpose _
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_transpose P W _ _) _ _
  | pair =>
      classical
      by_cases hg : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z = 0
      · simpa [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPairMeasurement, hg] using
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.placedPauliMeasurement_effect_transpose (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairMeasurement P z hg)
            (fun β => by
              change (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairEffect P z β)ᵀ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairEffect P z β
              rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairEffect, Matrix.transpose_mul,
                _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_transpose,
                _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_transpose]
              exact (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliTraceMeasurement_effect_commute P z hg β.1 β.2).eq.symm)
            (fun a => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer.pairBits a) a)
      · simpa [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestPairMeasurement, hg] using
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.deterministicMeasurement_effect_transpose
            (α := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) (V := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P) (.pairBits (0, 0)) a)
  | ms t =>
      classical
      by_cases hg : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliPairGamma P z = 0
      · simpa [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMagicMeasurement, hg] using
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.deterministicMeasurement_effect_transpose
            (α := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) (V := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P)
            (match t with
            | .constraint _ => (.msTriple 0 : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P)
            | .var _ => (.bit 0 : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P)) a)
      · simpa [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMagicMeasurement, hg] using
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.postprocess_effect_transpose (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicMeasurement P z hg t)
            _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliAnswerOfMs
            (fun b => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliMagicMeasurement_effect_transpose P z hg t b) a)







end

/-!
# Completeness of the Pauli basis test

The Pauli basis test admits a symmetric presentation and a value-one SPCC
strategy.

## References

The source statement is blueprint
`lem:pauli-completeness`, from
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1229-1421`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT

noncomputable section

/-! ### Auxiliary facts about the Pauli question sampler

The two lemmas of this section are formalization-only.  They record that the
uniform law on the Pauli edge type, and the typed bind seeded by it, do not
depend on the finiteness and decidability data used to form them.  The general
identities about finite weighted distributions that this file uses are stated
in `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/DistributionAux.lean`.
-/

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the push-forward of a uniform distribution
does not depend on the finiteness and decidability data used to form it. -/
theorem map_uniformDistribution_congr {α γ : Type*}
    (i₁ i₂ : Fintype α) (j₁ j₂ : DecidableEq α) (k₁ k₂ : Nonempty α)
    (d₁ d₂ : DecidableEq γ) (e : α → γ) :
    @_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.map α γ d₁ (@_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution α i₁ j₁ k₁) e =
      @_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.map α γ d₂ (@_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution α i₂ j₂ k₂) e := by
  have hi : i₁ = i₂ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hj : j₁ = j₂ := funext fun _ => funext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hd : d₁ = d₂ := funext fun _ => funext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst hi
  subst hj
  subst hd
  rfl

/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: a uniformly seeded typed bind does not depend
on the finiteness and decidability data used to form it. -/
theorem bind_map_uniformDistribution_congr {α β γ : Type*}
    (i₁ i₂ : Fintype β) (j₁ j₂ : DecidableEq β) (k₁ k₂ : Nonempty β)
    (d₁ d₂ : DecidableEq γ) (μ : _root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution α) (g : α → β → γ) :
    @_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.bind α γ d₁ μ
        (fun a => @_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.map β γ d₁ (@_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution β i₁ j₁ k₁) (g a)) =
      @_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.bind α γ d₂ μ
        (fun a => @_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.map β γ d₂ (@_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution β i₂ j₂ k₂) (g a)) := by
  have hi : i₁ = i₂ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hj : j₁ = j₂ := funext fun _ => funext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hd : d₁ = d₂ := funext fun _ => funext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst hi
  subst hj
  subst hd
  rfl

/-! ### The Pauli question sampler as a typed conditionally linear distribution -/

/-- `lem:pauli-question-typed-equality`: the Pauli question sampler equals the
distribution that `def:typed-cl-distributions` (`ch12_qpbt_games.tex`) produces
from the family `pauliCL` on the Pauli type graph. Both laws draw an ordered
pair of types whose unordered pair is an edge of the Pauli type graph, draw one
uniform seed in the Pauli seed space, and return the two types together with the
images of that common seed under the two selected maps. The common-level family
assertion is stated separately as `isTypedCondLinearFamily_pauliCL`. Blueprint
`ch13_qpbt_test.tex`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1115-1120`
and `references/qpbt-paper/07_types.tex:84-93`. -/
theorem pauliQuestionDistribution_eq_typedCL (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliQuestionDistribution P =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.typedCLDistribution _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges (by
        refine ⟨Sym2.mk (.point .X) (.point .X), ?_⟩
        simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges]) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliCL P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliCL P) := by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdge_nonempty
  have himage : (Finset.univ : Finset _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge).image
      (Subtype.val : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType) =
      (Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType)).filter
        (fun ab => Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges) := by
    ext ab
    constructor
    · intro hab
      obtain ⟨e, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hab
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, e.2⟩
    · intro hab
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr
        ⟨⟨ab, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hab).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  have hmine : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.bind
      (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.Distribution.uniformOnFinset ((Finset.univ : Finset (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType)).filter
        (fun ab => Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliEdges)))
      (fun uv => (_root_.LIDT.MIPStarRE.LDT.uniformDistribution (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliSpace P)).map fun z =>
        ((uv.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliCL P uv.1 z), (uv.2, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliCL P uv.2 z))) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliQuestionDistribution P := by
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.bind_uniformOnFinset_map _ (Subtype.val : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliEdge → _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType × _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliType)
      Subtype.val_injective himage
      (fun uv z => ((uv.1, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliCL P uv.1 z), (uv.2, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliCL P uv.2 z)))]
    unfold _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliQuestionDistribution
    exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.map_uniformDistribution_congr _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  rw [← hmine]
  simp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.typedCLDistribution, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.graphDistribution, _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.clDistribution,
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Distribution.map_map]
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.bind_map_uniformDistribution_congr _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _



/-! ### Symmetry of the Pauli basis test -/

/-- Symmetry of the Pauli question distribution in the symmetric game appearing
in `lem:pauli-completeness`. It follows from the identification of the sampler
with the typed conditionally linear distribution of a single family, whose edge
law is a law on unordered pairs and is therefore symmetric. -/
theorem pauliQuestionDistribution_symm (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (x y : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliQuestionDistribution P).weight (x, y) =
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliQuestionDistribution P).weight (y, x) := by
  rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliQuestionDistribution_eq_typedCL P]
  exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.typedCLDistribution_symm _ _ _ (x, y)

/-- Symmetry of the Pauli decision predicate in the symmetric game appearing in
`lem:pauli-completeness`. -/
theorem pauliWinPredicate_symm (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (x y : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P) (a b : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliWinPredicate P x y a b = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliWinPredicate P y x b a := by
  obtain ⟨tA, xA⟩ := x
  obtain ⟨tB, xB⟩ := y
  -- Definitional reduction avoids module-private matcher equations from `simp`.
  dsimp only [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliWinPredicate]
  by_cases hT : tA = tB
  · subst hT
    rw [if_pos (rfl : tA = tA), if_pos (rfl : tA = tA)]
    rw [Bool.and_comm (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.validPauliAnswer tA b) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.validPauliAnswer tA a)]
    exact congrArg (fun c => if _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.validPauliAnswer tA a && _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.validPauliAnswer tA b then c
      else false) (decide_eq_decide.mpr eq_comm)
  · cases hvA : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.validPauliAnswer tA a
    · cases _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.validPauliAnswer tB b <;> rfl
    · cases hvB : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.validPauliAnswer tB b
      · rfl
      · rw [Bool.true_and, if_pos (rfl : true = true),
          if_pos (rfl : true = true), if_neg hT, if_neg (Ne.symm hT)]
        rcases tA with (_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|_|(iA|jA) <;>
          rcases a with uA|fA|gA|bitsA|bitA|trA|hhA <;>
          (try exact Bool.noConfusion hvA) <;>
          rcases tB with (_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|(_|_)|_|(iB|jB) <;>
          rcases b with uB|fB|gB|bitsB|bitB|trB|hhB <;>
          (try exact Bool.noConfusion hvB) <;>
          rfl

/-- The symmetric presentation of the Pauli basis test. The field and basis
are those fixed by `P.model`; no additional model is quantified. -/
noncomputable def pauliBasisTestSymm (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SymmetricGame where
  Question := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliQuestion P
  Answer := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliAnswer P
  μ := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliQuestionDistribution P
  μ_prob := (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisTest P).μ_prob
  μ_symm := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliQuestionDistribution_symm P
  decide := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliWinPredicate P
  decide_symm := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliWinPredicate_symm P



/-- The honest strategy of `lem:pauli-completeness`: the total honest
measurement family of `MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.Completeness.HonestStrategy.MeasurementFamily`
on the maximally entangled state of the Pauli register tensored with the Magic
Square qubit.  Blueprint `lem:pauli-completeness`, paper
`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1237-1360`. -/
noncomputable def honestStrategy (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SymmetricStrategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisTestSymm P) where
  ι := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P
  ψ := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P)
  ψ_norm := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.eprState_norm (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P)
  ψ_swap := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.reindexState_prodComm_eprState (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.HonestIndex P)
  M := fun q => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.honestMeasurement P q.1 q.2











end

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

/-!
# Strategy bridge for the compact Pauli basis game

This module transports compact strategies across the exact question and answer
equivalences of `PauliGameBridge`.  It preserves the game, Born value,
projectivity, symmetry, consistency, positive-support commutation, and the SPCC
predicate exactly.

## References

`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1126-1491`.
-/

@[expose] public section

      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.instDecidableEqPauliQuestion

namespace PMF

/-- Pushing a PMF through an equivalence preserves its mass at corresponding points. -/
@[simp] theorem map_equiv_apply {X Y : Type*} (p : PMF X) (e : X ≃ Y) (x : X) :
    (p.map e) (e x) = p x := by
  classical
  simp [PMF.map_apply, e.injective.eq_iff]

/-- A PMF pushed through an equivalence is evaluated by pulling the point back. -/
theorem map_equiv_apply' {X Y : Type*} (p : PMF X) (e : X ≃ Y) (y : Y) :
    (p.map e) y = p (e.symm y) := by
  simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PMF.map_equiv_apply p e (e.symm y)

end PMF





namespace Game

/-- Relabeling a compact game and then relabeling by the inverse equivalences is exact. -/
theorem relabel_symm_relabel {X Y A B X' Y' A' B' : Type}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    [Fintype X'] [Fintype Y'] [Fintype A'] [Fintype B']
    [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Y] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B]
    [DecidableEq X'] [DecidableEq Y'] [DecidableEq A'] [DecidableEq B']
    (G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game X Y A B) (eX : X ≃ X') (eY : Y ≃ Y')
    (eA : A ≃ A') (eB : B ≃ B') :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.relabel (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.relabel G eX eY eA eB)
        eX.symm eY.symm eA.symm eB.symm = G := by
  apply _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.ext
  · ext xy
    change ((G.μ.map (Equiv.prodCongr eX eY)).map
      (Equiv.prodCongr eX.symm eY.symm)) xy = G.μ xy
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PMF.map_equiv_apply']
    change (G.μ.map (Equiv.prodCongr eX eY))
      ((Equiv.prodCongr eX eY) xy) = G.μ xy
    exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PMF.map_equiv_apply G.μ (Equiv.prodCongr eX eY) xy
  · funext x y a b
    simp [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.relabel]

end Game

namespace SymmetricGame

/-- Relabel the questions and answers of a compact symmetric game. -/
def relabel {X A X' A' : Type}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype A] [Fintype X'] [Fintype A']
    [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq X'] [DecidableEq A']
    (G : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricGame X A) (eX : X ≃ X') (eA : A ≃ A') :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricGame X' A' where
  toGame := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.relabel G.toGame eX eX eA eA
  μ_symm := by
    intro x y
    change (G.μ.map (Equiv.prodCongr eX eX)) (x, y) =
      (G.μ.map (Equiv.prodCongr eX eX)) (y, x)
    rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PMF.map_equiv_apply', _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PMF.map_equiv_apply']
    exact G.μ_symm (eX.symm x) (eX.symm y)
  decide_symm := by
    intro x y a b
    exact G.decide_symm (eX.symm x) (eX.symm y) (eA.symm a) (eA.symm b)

end SymmetricGame

namespace SymmetricStrategy

/-- Relabel the questions and outcomes of a compact symmetric strategy. -/
def relabel {X A X' A' : Type}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype A] [Fintype X'] [Fintype A']
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricStrategy X A) (eX : X ≃ X') (eA : A ≃ A') :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricStrategy X' A' where
  ι := S.ι
  ψ := S.ψ
  ψ_norm := S.ψ_norm
  ψ_swap := S.ψ_swap
  meas := fun x => _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.POVM.relabel eA (S.meas (eX.symm x))

/-- Symmetric relabeling agrees with relabeling the underlying general strategy. -/
@[simp] theorem relabel_toStrategy {X A X' A' : Type}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype A] [Fintype X'] [Fintype A']
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricStrategy X A) (eX : X ≃ X') (eA : A ≃ A') :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricStrategy.relabel S eX eA).toStrategy =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy.relabel S.toStrategy eX eX eA eA :=
  rfl







end SymmetricStrategy

/-- Relabeling the concrete compact Pauli game gives the registered game exactly. -/
theorem pauliGame_relabel_eq (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.relabel
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliGame (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P)
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model)
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model))
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.ofGame (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisTest P) := by
  apply _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.ext
  · exact _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionPMF_map P
  · funext x y a b
    change _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliWin (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model)
        ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P).symm x) ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P).symm y)
        ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P).symm a) ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P).symm b) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliWinPredicate P x y a b
    simpa using _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliWin_equiv P
      ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P).symm x) ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P).symm y)
      ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P).symm a) ((_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P).symm b)

/-- Convert a compact Pauli strategy into a strategy for the registered game. -/
def pauliStrategyToLibrary (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)
    (S : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliAnswer (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliAnswer (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Strategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisTest P) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy.toStrategy (G := _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisTest P)
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Strategy.relabel S
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P)
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P))





/-- The compact Pauli game has the exact symmetric presentation transported from the source. -/
noncomputable def pauliSymmetricGame (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricGame
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliAnswer (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P)) :=
  _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricGame.relabel
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricGame.ofSymmetricGame (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisTestSymm P))
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P).symm (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P).symm

/-- The symmetric compact presentation has the compact Pauli game as its underlying game. -/
@[simp] theorem pauliSymmetricGame_toGame (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams) :
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliSymmetricGame P).toGame =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliGame (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model) := by
  calc
    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliSymmetricGame P).toGame =
        _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.relabel (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.ofGame (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisTest P))
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P).symm (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P).symm
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P).symm (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P).symm := rfl
    _ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.relabel (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.relabel
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliGame (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P)
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model)
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model))
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P))
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P).symm (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P).symm
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P).symm
          (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P).symm := by
      rw [_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliGame_relabel_eq]
    _ = _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliGame (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.binaryRepresentation P.model)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.fixedBinTrace P.model) :=
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.Game.relabel_symm_relabel _ _ _ _ _

/-- Convert a compact symmetric Pauli strategy into a registered symmetric strategy. -/
def pauliSymmetricStrategyToLibrary (P : _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.AdmissibleParams)

      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliQuestion (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))
      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliAnswer (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.SymmetricStrategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.pauliBasisTestSymm P) :=

    (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricStrategy.relabel S (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P))

      (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliAnswer (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.PauliParams.ofAdmissibleParams P) (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.PauliScalar P))) :
    _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricStrategy.ofSymmetricStrategy (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliSymmetricStrategyToLibrary P S) =
      _root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.SymmetricStrategy.relabel S (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliQuestionEquiv P)
        (_root_.MIPStarRE.QPBT.Palomar.pauliAnswerEquivCompact P) := by
